```
const { Document, Packer, Paragraph, TextRun, HeadingLevel, Table, TableRow, TableCell,
  WidthType, ShadingType, BorderStyle, AlignmentType, LevelFormat, convertInchesToTwip } = require("docx");
const fs = require("fs");

const NAVY = "2E5090";
const GOLD = "FDB913";
const CREAM = "FEF3D8";
const TEAL = "0F766E";

function h1(text) {
  return new Paragraph({
    text,
    heading: HeadingLevel.HEADING_1,
    spacing: { before: 300, after: 150 },
  });
}
function h2(text) {
  return new Paragraph({
    text,
    heading: HeadingLevel.HEADING_2,
    spacing: { before: 240, after: 120 },
  });
}
function body(text, opts = {}) {
  return new Paragraph({
    children: [new TextRun({ text, ...opts })],
    spacing: { after: 120 },
  });
}
function bullet(text, level = 0) {
  return new Paragraph({
    text,
    numbering: { reference: "bullets", level },
    spacing: { after: 60 },
  });
}
function cell(text, opts = {}) {
  return new TableCell({
    width: opts.width ? { size: opts.width, type: WidthType.DXA } : undefined,
    shading: opts.header ? { type: ShadingType.CLEAR, fill: NAVY } : undefined,
    margins: { top: 100, bottom: 100, left: 120, right: 120 },
    children: [
      new Paragraph({
        children: [
          new TextRun({
            text,
            bold: opts.header || opts.bold,
            color: opts.header ? "FFFFFF" : undefined,
            size: 20,
          }),
        ],
      }),
    ],
  });
}

const colWidths = [2600, 2400, 2400, 3000];

function featureTable(rows) {
  return new Table({
    width: { size: 10400, type: WidthType.DXA },
    columnWidths: colWidths,
    rows: [
      new TableRow({
        tableHeader: true,
        children: [
          cell("Feature", { header: true, width: colWidths[0] }),
          cell("Free Approach", { header: true, width: colWidths[1] }),
          cell("Status", { header: true, width: colWidths[2] }),
          cell("Notes", { header: true, width: colWidths[3] }),
        ],
      }),
      ...rows.map(
        (r) =>
          new TableRow({
            children: [
              cell(r[0], { width: colWidths[0], bold: true }),
              cell(r[1], { width: colWidths[1] }),
              cell(r[2], { width: colWidths[2] }),
              cell(r[3], { width: colWidths[3] }),
            ],
          })
      ),
    ],
  });
}
```

```
  .home-bg {
    position: absolute;

  .home-tint {
    position: absolute;
    top: 0; left: 0;
    width: 100%; height: 100%;
    background: #F2EEE6;
    opacity: 0.3;
  }
  .home-content {
    position: relative;
    padding: 56px 28px;
    text-align: center;
  }
  .greeting { color: #4A453D; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 500; margin: 0 0 8px; }
  .subgreeting { color: #6B6558; font-size: 13px; margin: 0 0 44px; }
  .home-card {
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
    background: rgba(250,248,243,0.92);
    border: none;
    border-radius: 18px;
    padding: 20px;
    margin-bottom: 14px;
    text-align: left;
    cursor: pointer;
    font-family: inherit;
  }
  .home-card p { margin: 0; }
  .home-card .title { color: #4A453D; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; margin-bottom: 4px; }
  .home-card .sub { color: #8B8579; font-size: 12px; }

  .daily-panel, .weekly-panel { padding: 48px 28px; position: relative; }
  .dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: #7C8B6F; margin: 0 auto 40px; }
  .prompt { text-align: center; color: #4A453D; font-size: 19px; font-weight: 500; margin: 0 0 48px; line-height: 1.5; }
  .chips { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px; justify-content: center; margin-bottom: 96px; }
  .chip {
    padding: 9px 18px; border-radius: 20px; border: 1px solid #D9D3C7;
    background: transparent; color: #4A453D; font-size: 13px; cursor: pointer; font-family: inherit;
  }
  .chip.selected { background: #E3E8DF; border-color: #7C8B6F; }
  .save-row { position: absolute; bottom: 28px; left: 28px; right: 28px; }
  .save-btn {
    width: 100%; padding: 15px; border-radius: 14px; border: none;
    background: #7C8B6F; color: #FAF8F3; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; font-family: inherit;
  }

  .who-idx { text-align: center; color: #8B8579; font-size: 11px; margin: 0 0 32px; }
  .who-item { text-align: center; color: #4A453D; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 500; margin: 0 0 8px; min-height: 56px; line-height: 1.5; }
  .who-period { text-align: center; color: #8B8579; font-size: 12px; margin: 0 0 40px; }
  .who-scale { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; margin-bottom: 10px; }
  .who-scale-btn {
    width: 34px; height: 34px; padding: 0; border-radius: 50%; border: 1px solid #D9D3C7;
    background: transparent; color: #8B8579; font-size: 13px; font-family: inherit; cursor: pointer;
    display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  }
  .who-scale-btn.selected { background: #8FA3AD; color: #FAF8F3; border-color: #8FA3AD; }
  .who-labels { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; }
  .who-labels span { font-size: 10px; color: #8B8579; max-width: 64px; }
  .who-labels span:last-child { text-align: right; }
  .prog-row { position: absolute; bottom: 28px; left: 28px; right: 28px; }
  .prog-track { height: 3px; background: #E3DCC9; border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden; }
  .prog-fill { height: 100%; width: 20%; background: #8FA3AD; border-radius: 4px; transition: width .4s; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="phone">
  <div class="tabs">
    <button class="tab active" data-tab="home">Home</button>
    <button class="tab" data-tab="daily">Daily note</button>
    <button class="tab" data-tab="weekly">Check-in</button>
  </div>

  <div class="panel active" id="panel-home">
    <img class="home-bg" src="screening_bg.jpg" alt="">
    <div class="home-tint"></div>
    <div class="home-content">
      <p class="greeting">Good evening</p>
      <p class="subgreeting">Take a moment whenever you're ready.</p>
      <button class="home-card" data-tab="daily">
        <p class="title">Daily note</p>
        <p class="sub">Not done yet today</p>
      </button>
      <button class="home-card" data-tab="weekly">
        <p class="title">Weekly check-in</p>
        <p class="sub">Due in 2 days</p>
      </button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="panel" id="panel-daily">
    <div class="daily-panel">
      <div class="dot"></div>
      <p class="prompt">What's one word<br>for today?</p>
      <div class="chips" id="wordChips"></div>
      <div class="save-row">
        <button class="save-btn" id="saveNoteBtn">Save</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="panel" id="panel-weekly">
    <div class="weekly-panel">
      <p class="who-idx">Question <span id="whoIdx">1</span> of 5</p>
      <p class="who-item" id="whoItem">I have felt cheerful and in good spirits</p>
      <p class="who-period">Over the last two weeks</p>
      <div class="who-scale" id="whoScale"></div>
      <div class="who-labels"><span>At no time</span><span>All of the time</span></div>
      <div class="prog-row">
        <div class="prog-track"><div class="prog-fill" id="whoProg"></div></div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
function showPanel(tab){
  document.querySelectorAll('.tab').forEach(function(t){
    t.classList.toggle('active', t.dataset.tab === tab);
  });
  document.querySelectorAll('.panel').forEach(function(p){
    p.classList.toggle('active', p.id === 'panel-' + tab);
  });
}
document.querySelectorAll('.tab').forEach(function(tab){
  tab.onclick = function(){ showPanel(this.dataset.tab); };
});
document.querySelectorAll('.home-card').forEach(function(card){
  card.onclick = function(){ showPanel(this.dataset.tab); };
});

var words = ['Tired','Grateful','Anxious','Calm','Hopeful'];
var chipWrap = document.getElementById('wordChips');
words.forEach(function(w){
  var chip = document.createElement('button');
  chip.className = 'chip';
  chip.textContent = w;
  chip.onclick = function(){
    Array.from(chipWrap.children).forEach(function(c){ c.classList.remove('selected'); });
    chip.classList.add('selected');
  };
  chipWrap.appendChild(chip);
});
document.getElementById('saveNoteBtn').onclick = function(){ showPanel('home'); };

var whoItems = [
  'I have felt cheerful and in good spirits',
  'I have felt calm and relaxed',
  'I have felt active and vigorous',
  'I woke up feeling fresh and rested',
  'My daily life has been filled with things that interest me'
];
var whoIdx = 0;
var whoScale = document.getElementById('whoScale');
function renderScale(){
  whoScale.innerHTML = '';
  for (var i = 0; i <= 5; i++){
    (function(val){
      var b = document.createElement('button');
      b.className = 'who-scale-btn';
      b.textContent = val;
      b.onclick = function(){
        Array.from(whoScale.children).forEach(function(c){ c.classList.remove('selected'); });
        b.classList.add('selected');
        setTimeout(function(){
          whoIdx++;
          if (whoIdx < whoItems.length){
            document.getElementById('whoItem').textContent = whoItems[whoIdx];
            document.getElementById('whoIdx').textContent = whoIdx + 1;
            document.getElementById('whoProg').style.width = ((whoIdx + 1) / 5 * 100) + '%';
            renderScale();
          } else {
            showPanel('home');
            whoIdx = 0;
            document.getElementById('whoItem').textContent = whoItems[0];
            document.getElementById('whoIdx').textContent = 1;
            document.getElementById('whoProg').style.width = '20%';
          }
        }, 300);
      };
      whoScale.appendChild(b);
    })(i);
  }
}
renderScale();
</script>
</body>
</html>
```

```
</div>

<script>
var moods = [
  {label:'Anxious',  x:0.16, y:0.16, h:255, s:26, l:56, size:58},
  {label:'Restless', x:0.42, y:0.08, h:16,  s:42, l:60, size:56},
  {label:'Excited',  x:0.82, y:0.10, h:40,  s:58, l:60, size:62},
  {label:'Hopeful',  x:0.54, y:0.36, h:42,  s:16, l:86, size:58},
  {label:'Heavy',    x:0.14, y:0.55, h:26,  s:26, l:44, size:60},
  {label:'Tired',    x:0.32, y:0.82, h:220, s:16, l:60, size:56},
  {label:'Calm',     x:0.58, y:0.86, h:210, s:42, l:62, size:62},
  {label:'Content',  x:0.82, y:0.62, h:150, s:34, l:54, size:58}
];

var field = document.getElementById('bubbleField');
var fw = 340, fh = 340;
function clamp(v,a,b){ return Math.max(a,Math.min(b,v)); }

var bubbles = moods.map(function(m){
  var size = m.size;
  var x = m.x * (fw - size);
  var y = fh - size - m.y * (fh - size);
  return {label:m.label, x:x, y:y, vx:(Math.random()-0.5)*0.2, vy:(Math.random()-0.5)*0.2, size:size, h:m.h, s:m.s, l:m.l, phase:Math.random()*6.28};
});

bubbles.forEach(function(b){
  var wrap = document.createElement('div');
  wrap.style.cssText = 'position:absolute;width:'+b.size+'px;height:'+(b.size+22)+'px;';
  var bobDiv = document.createElement('div');
  bobDiv.style.cssText = 'width:'+b.size+'px;height:'+b.size+'px;animation:bobf '+(4+Math.random()*2.5).toFixed(1)+'s ease-in-out infinite;animation-delay:-'+(Math.random()*4).toFixed(1)+'s;border-radius:50%;position:relative;';
  var lite = 'hsl('+b.h+','+clamp(b.s-8,5,60)+'%,'+clamp(b.l+14,55,95)+'%)';
  var base = 'hsl('+b.h+','+b.s+'%,'+b.l+'%)';
  var deep = 'hsl('+b.h+','+clamp(b.s+5,5,65)+'%,'+clamp(b.l-16,32,80)+'%)';
  var deepest = 'hsl('+b.h+','+clamp(b.s+8,5,68)+'%,'+clamp(b.l-24,25,72)+'%)';
  var capColor = 'hsl('+b.h+','+clamp(b.s+10,15,55)+'%,'+clamp(b.l-38,15,45)+'%)';
  var el = document.createElement('button');
  el.setAttribute('aria-label', b.label);
  el.style.cssText = 'width:100%;height:100%;border-radius:50%;border:none;cursor:pointer;position:relative;display:block;'+
    'background:radial-gradient(circle at 30% 26%, rgba(255,255,255,0.6) 0%, rgba(255,255,255,0.25) 12%, rgba(255,255,255,0) 26%),radial-gradient(circle at 38% 34%, '+lite+' 0%, '+base+' 44%, '+deep+' 80%, '+deepest+' 100%);'+
    'box-shadow:0 '+Math.round(b.size*0.1)+'px '+Math.round(b.size*0.16)+'px hsla('+b.h+','+b.s+'%,'+clamp(b.l-25,15,55)+'%,0.22);';
  var cap = document.createElement('div');
  cap.textContent = b.label;
  cap.style.cssText = 'text-align:center;font-size:11px;color:'+capColor+';margin-top:5px;font-weight:700;white-space:nowrap;';
  bobDiv.appendChild(el);
  wrap.appendChild(bobDiv);
  wrap.appendChild(cap);
  field.appendChild(wrap);
  b.wrap = wrap;
});

function step(){
  for(var i=0;i<bubbles.length;i++){
    var b = bubbles[i];
    b.phase += 0.005;
    b.vx += Math.sin(b.phase) * 0.003;
    b.vy += Math.cos(b.phase*0.85) * 0.003;
    for(var j=0;j<bubbles.length;j++){
      if(i===j) continue;
      var o = bubbles[j];
      var dx = (b.x+b.size/2)-(o.x+o.size/2), dy=(b.y+b.size/2)-(o.y+o.size/2);
      var dist = Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy), minDist=(b.size+o.size)/2+28;
      if(dist<minDist && dist>0.01){
        var force=(minDist-dist)/minDist*0.4;
        b.vx += (dx/dist)*force; b.vy += (dy/dist)*force;
      }
    }
    b.vx*=0.92; b.vy*=0.92; b.x+=b.vx; b.y+=b.vy;
    if(b.x<0){b.x=0;b.vx*=-0.5;} if(b.x>fw-b.size){b.x=fw-b.size;b.vx*=-0.5;}
    if(b.y<0){b.y=0;b.vy*=-0.5;} if(b.y>fh-b.size-22){b.y=fh-b.size-22;b.vy*=-0.5;}
    b.wrap.style.left=b.x+'px'; b.wrap.style.top=b.y+'px';
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(step);
}
step();
</script>
```

```
var selected = [];

bubbles.forEach(function(b){
  var wrap = document.createElement('div');
  wrap.style.cssText = 'position:absolute;width:'+b.size+'px;height:'+(b.size+22)+'px;';
  var bobDiv = document.createElement('div');
  bobDiv.style.cssText = 'width:'+b.size+'px;height:'+b.size+'px;animation:bobf '+(4+Math.random()*2.5).toFixed(1)+'s ease-in-out infinite;animation-delay:-'+(Math.random()*4).toFixed(1)+'s;border-radius:50%;position:relative;transition:transform .25s;';
  var lite = 'hsl('+b.h+','+clamp(b.s-8,5,60)+'%,'+clamp(b.l+14,55,95)+'%)';
  var base = 'hsl('+b.h+','+b.s+'%,'+b.l+'%)';
  var deep = 'hsl('+b.h+','+clamp(b.s+5,5,65)+'%,'+clamp(b.l-16,32,80)+'%)';
  var deepest = 'hsl('+b.h+','+clamp(b.s+8,5,68)+'%,'+clamp(b.l-24,25,72)+'%)';
  var capColor = 'hsl('+b.h+','+clamp(b.s+10,15,55)+'%,'+clamp(b.l-38,15,45)+'%)';
  b.base = base;
  var el = document.createElement('button');
  el.setAttribute('aria-label', b.label);
  el.setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'false');
  function paint(sel){
    el.style.cssText = 'width:100%;height:100%;border-radius:50%;cursor:pointer;position:relative;display:block;'+
      'border:'+(sel ? '3px solid #6690D6' : 'none')+';'+
      'background:radial-gradient(circle at 30% 26%, rgba(255,255,255,0.6) 0%, rgba(255,255,255,0.25) 12%, rgba(255,255,255,0) 26%),radial-gradient(circle at 38% 34%, '+lite+' 0%, '+base+' 44%, '+deep+' 80%, '+deepest+' 100%);'+
      'box-shadow:0 '+Math.round(b.size*0.1)+'px '+Math.round(b.size*0.16)+'px hsla('+b.h+','+b.s+'%,'+clamp(b.l-25,15,55)+'%,'+(sel?0.4:0.22)+');';
    bobDiv.style.transform = sel ? 'scale(1.08)' : 'scale(1)';
  }
  paint(false);
  el.onclick = function(){
    var idx = selected.indexOf(b);
    if(idx === -1){
      selected.push(b);
      el.setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'true');
    } else {
      selected.splice(idx, 1);
      el.setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'false');
    }
    paint(selected.indexOf(b) !== -1);
    document.getElementById('continueBtn').style.display = selected.length ? 'block' : 'none';
  };
  var cap = document.createElement('div');
  cap.textContent = b.label;
  cap.style.cssText = 'text-align:center;font-size:11px;color:'+capColor+';margin-top:5px;font-weight:700;white-space:nowrap;';
  bobDiv.appendChild(el);
```

```
var shareEnabled = false;
var userHasTherapist = false; // simulated account state — in the real app this comes from the logged-in profile

  isExpanded = !isExpanded;
  var ta = document.getElementById('journalText');
  document.getElementById('journalChromeTop').style.display = isExpanded ? 'none' : 'block';
  document.getElementById('journalChromeBottom').style.display = isExpanded ? 'none' : 'block';
  ta.style.minHeight = isExpanded ? '360px' : '100px';
  document.getElementById('expandIcon').innerHTML = isExpanded
    ? '<path d="M9 3v4a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H3m18 0h-4a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V3M3 15h4a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v4m6-6h4a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v4"/>'
    : '<path d="M8 3H5a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v3m18 0V5a2 2 0 0 0-2-2h-3M3 16v3a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h3m11-5v3a2 2 0 0 1-2 2h-3"/>';
  this.title = isExpanded ? 'Collapse' : 'Expand';
};

document.getElementById('shareBtn').onclick = function(){
  if(userHasTherapist){
    shareEnabled = true;
    document.getElementById('shareCheck').style.background = '#6690D6';
    document.getElementById('shareCheck').style.borderColor = '#6690D6';
    document.getElementById('shareNote').style.display = 'block';
    return;
  }
  var ask = document.getElementById('shareAsk');
  ask.style.display = ask.style.display === 'block' ? 'none' : 'block';
};
```

```
function renderTherapistList(returnTo){
  therapistSelectReturnTo = returnTo;
  var list = document.getElementById('therapistList');
  list.innerHTML = '';
  therapists.forEach(function(t){
    var card = document.createElement('button');
    card.style.cssText = 'display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;width:100%;padding:14px;border-radius:14px;border:1px solid #EEE0C4;background:#FFFFFF;cursor:pointer;margin-bottom:10px;text-align:left;';

    card.onclick = function(){
      userHasTherapist = true;
      therapistName = t.name;
      document.getElementById('panel-therapist-select').style.display = 'none';
      if(therapistSelectReturnTo === 'journal'){
        shareEnabled = true;
        document.getElementById('shareCheck').style.background = '#6690D6';
```

```
// ---- Bottom nav: Home / Journal / You ----
var allPanels = ['panel-bubbles','panel-journal','panel-saved','panel-support','panel-therapist-select','panel-intake','panel-booking','panel-history','panel-profile'];
function showOnly(panelId){
  allPanels.forEach(function(id){ document.getElementById(id).style.display = (id === panelId) ? 'block' : 'none'; });
}
function setActiveNav(which){
  ['navHome','navJournal','navYou'].forEach(function(id){ document.getElementById(id).classList.remove('active'); });
  document.getElementById(which).classList.add('active');
}

document.getElementById('navHome').onclick = function(){
  showOnly('panel-bubbles');
  setActiveNav('navHome');
};

document.getElementById('navJournal').onclick = function(){
  renderHistory();
  showOnly('panel-history');
  setActiveNav('navJournal');
};

document.getElementById('navYou').onclick = function(){
  renderProfile();
  showOnly('panel-profile');
  setActiveNav('navYou');
};

function renderHistory(){
  var list = document.getElementById('historyList');
  list.innerHTML = '';
  if(appState.entries.length === 0){
    var empty = document.createElement('p');
    empty.style.cssText = 'text-align:center;color:#9AABCE;font-size:13px;margin-top:40px;';
    empty.textContent = "Nothing here yet — your entries will show up once you save one.";
    list.appendChild(empty);
    return;
  }
  appState.entries.forEach(function(e){
    var card = document.createElement('div');
    card.style.cssText = 'background:#FFFFFF;border:1px solid #EEE0C4;border-radius:14px;padding:14px;margin-bottom:10px;';
    var dateStr = new Date(e.date).toLocaleDateString(undefined, {month:'short', day:'numeric', hour:'numeric', minute:'2-digit'});
    var dotsHtml = e.moods.map(function(m){ return '<span style="display:inline-block;width:14px;height:14px;border-radius:50%;background:'+m.color+';margin-right:4px;"></span>'; }).join('');
    var labelsHtml = e.moods.map(function(m){ return m.label; }).join(', ');
    card.innerHTML =
      '<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:8px;">'+
        '<div>'+dotsHtml+'</div>'+
        '<span style="font-size:10px;color:#B8A67A;">'+dateStr+'</span>'+
      '</div>'+
      (labelsHtml ? '<p style="font-size:11px;color:#9AABCE;margin:0 0 6px;">'+labelsHtml+'</p>' : '')+
      (e.text ? '<p style="font-size:13px;color:#2A2013;margin:0;white-space:pre-wrap;">'+e.text.replace(/</g,'&lt;')+'</p>' : '<p style="font-size:12px;color:#C7BFA8;margin:0;font-style:italic;">No note added</p>')+
      (e.sharedWithTherapist ? '<p style="font-size:10px;color:#6690D6;margin:8px 0 0;">Shared with your therapist</p>' : '');
    list.appendChild(card);
  });
}

function renderProfile(){
  var tArea = document.getElementById('profileTherapistArea');
  tArea.innerHTML = '';
  if(appState.userHasTherapist){
    tArea.innerHTML = '<p style="font-size:14px;color:#2A2013;font-weight:700;margin:0 0 10px;">'+appState.therapistName+'</p>';
    var changeBtn = document.createElement('button');
    changeBtn.textContent = 'Change therapist';
    changeBtn.style.cssText = 'width:100%;padding:11px;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid #C7D2E8;background:transparent;color:#5C6B94;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;margin-bottom:8px;';
    changeBtn.onclick = function(){ renderTherapistList('profile'); showOnly('panel-therapist-select'); };
    var disconnectBtn = document.createElement('button');
    disconnectBtn.textContent = 'Disconnect';
    disconnectBtn.style.cssText = 'width:100%;padding:11px;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid #F0C7C7;background:transparent;color:#C77B7B;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;';
    disconnectBtn.onclick = function(){
      appState.userHasTherapist = false;
      appState.therapistName = '';
      saveState();
      renderProfile();
    };
    tArea.appendChild(changeBtn);
    tArea.appendChild(disconnectBtn);
  } else if(appState.hasOutsideTherapist){
    tArea.innerHTML = '<p style="font-size:13px;color:#5C6B94;margin:0 0 10px;">You told us you see someone outside HOBS — we can\\'t share notes with them, but we won\\'t ask you to find one here.</p>';
    var undoBtn = document.createElement('button');
    undoBtn.textContent = "Actually, help me find one at HOBS";
    undoBtn.style.cssText = 'width:100%;padding:11px;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid #C7D2E8;background:transparent;color:#5C6B94;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;';
    undoBtn.onclick = function(){
      appState.hasOutsideTherapist = false;
      saveState();
      intakeReturnTo = 'profile';
      document.getElementById('intakeForm').style.display = 'block';
      document.getElementById('intakeThanks').style.display = 'none';
      showOnly('panel-intake');
    };
    tArea.appendChild(undoBtn);
  } else {
    tArea.innerHTML = '<p style="font-size:13px;color:#5C6B94;margin:0 0 10px;">Not connected yet.</p>';

// ---- Real voice-to-text via the browser's Speech Recognition API (free, but Chrome/Android-reliable only) ----
var SpeechRec = window.SpeechRecognition || window.webkitSpeechRecognition;
var recognition = null;
var isRecording = false;
if(SpeechRec){
  recognition = new SpeechRec();
  recognition.continuous = true;
  recognition.interimResults = false;
  recognition.onresult = function(event){
    var ta = document.getElementById('journalText');
    var transcript = '';
    for(var i = event.resultIndex; i < event.results.length; i++){
      transcript += event.results[i][0].transcript;
    }
    ta.value = (ta.value ? ta.value + ' ' : '') + transcript.trim();
  };
  recognition.onerror = function(){
    isRecording = false;
    document.getElementById('micBtn').style.opacity = '1';
  };
  recognition.onend = function(){
    if(isRecording){ recognition.start(); } // keep listening until user stops it
  };
}

document.getElementById('micBtn').onclick = function(){
  if(!SpeechRec){
    alert("Voice input isn't supported in this browser — try Chrome on Android, or type instead.");
    return;
  }
  isRecording = !isRecording;
  this.style.opacity = isRecording ? '0.6' : '1';
  if(isRecording){ recognition.start(); } else { recognition.stop(); }
};
</script>
</body>
```

```
var fw = field.offsetWidth || 300, fh = field.offsetHeight || 340;
function clamp(v,a,b){ return Math.max(a,Math.min(b,v)); }

var bubbles = moods.map(function(m){
  var size = m.size;
  var x = m.x * (fw - size);
  var y = fh - size - m.y * (fh - size);
  return {label:m.label, x:x, y:y, mx:m.x, my:m.y, vx:(Math.random()-0.5)*0.2, vy:(Math.random()-0.5)*0.2, size:size, h:m.h, s:m.s, l:m.l, phase:Math.random()*6.28};
});

var selected = [];

var resizeTimer;
window.addEventListener('resize', function(){
  clearTimeout(resizeTimer);
  resizeTimer = setTimeout(function(){
    fw = field.offsetWidth || fw;
    fh = field.offsetHeight || fh;
    bubbles.forEach(function(b){
      b.x = b.mx * (fw - b.size);
      b.y = fh - b.size - b.my * (fh - b.size);
    });
  }, 150);
});
```

### E-019f2bcf-28
- when: 2026-07-04T06:29:12.954791Z

- Claude's words just before this edit: "Now let's add the full JavaScript logic for the WHO-5 flow, scoring, and weekly-cadence check."

OLD (exact):
```
</script>
```

NEW (exact):
```
// ---- WHO-5 weekly check-in (validated instrument, gold-standard for Indian context incl. Gujarati validation) ----
if(!appState.who5Entries){ appState.who5Entries = []; }

var who5Items = [
  'I have felt cheerful and in good spirits',
  'I have felt calm and relaxed',
  'I have felt active and vigorous',
  'I woke up feeling fresh and rested',
  'My daily life has been filled with things that interest me'
];
var who5Idx = 0;
var who5Answers = [];

function who5AlreadyDoneThisWeek(){
  if(appState.who5Entries.length === 0) return false;
  var last = new Date(appState.who5Entries[0].date);
  var days = (Date.now() - last.getTime()) / (1000*60*60*24);
  return days < 7;
}

document.getElementById('who5EntryBtn').onclick = function(){
  if(who5AlreadyDoneThisWeek()){
    alert("You've already done this week's check-in — it'll be ready again in a few days.");
    return;
  }
  who5Idx = 0;
  who5Answers = [];
  document.getElementById('who5Item').textContent = who5Items[0];
  document.getElementById('who5Idx').textContent = '1';
  document.getElementById('who5Prog').style.width = '20%';
  renderWho5Scale();
  showOnly('panel-who5');
};

function renderWho5Scale(){
  var scale = document.getElementById('who5Scale');
  scale.innerHTML = '';
  for(var i = 0; i <= 5; i++){
    (function(val){
      var b = document.createElement('button');
      b.textContent = val;
      b.style.cssText = 'width:36px;height:36px;padding:0;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid #E3D5AE;background:transparent;color:#9A7B3E;font-size:13px;font-family:inherit;cursor:pointer;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;transition:background .2s,color .2s,border-color .2s;';
      b.onclick = function(){
        who5Answers.push(val);
        Array.from(scale.children).forEach(function(c){ c.style.background='transparent'; c.style.color='#9A7B3E'; c.style.borderColor='#E3D5AE'; });
        b.style.background = '#6690D6';
        b.style.color = '#FFF8F0';
        b.style.borderColor = '#6690D6';
        setTimeout(function(){
          who5Idx++;
          if(who5Idx < who5Items.length){
            document.getElementById('who5Item').textContent = who5Items[who5Idx];
            document.getElementById('who5Idx').textContent = (who5Idx+1);
            document.getElementById('who5Prog').style.width = ((who5Idx+1)/5*100)+'%';
            renderWho5Scale();
          } else {
            finishWho5();
          }
        }, 300);
      };
      scale.appendChild(b);
    })(i);
  }
}

function finishWho5(){
  var raw = who5Answers.reduce(function(a,b){ return a+b; }, 0);
  var score = raw * 4; // WHO-5 standard conversion: raw 0-25 -> 0-100
  appState.who5Entries.unshift({date: new Date().toISOString(), score: score});
  saveState();

  var arc = document.getElementById('who5Arc');
  var totalLen = 157; // approx length of the semicircle path
  arc.style.strokeDasharray = totalLen;
  arc.style.strokeDashoffset = totalLen * (1 - score/100);
  document.getElementById('who5ScoreText').textContent = score;

  var interp = document.getElementById('who5Interpretation');
  if(score <= 28){
    interp.textContent = "Scores this low sometimes go with a rough stretch. It might help to bring this up with your therapist.";
  } else if(score <= 50){
    interp.textContent = "This suggests things have felt harder than usual lately. Shared with your therapist for context, not a verdict.";
  } else {
    interp.textContent = "A score above 50 generally reflects steady wellbeing. Shared with your therapist to spot patterns over time.";
  }
  showOnly('panel-who5-results');
}

document.getElementById('who5BackBtn').onclick = function(){
  showOnly('panel-bubbles');
  setActiveNav('navHome');
};

document.getElementById('who5DoneBtn').onclick = function(){
  showOnly('panel-bubbles');
  setActiveNav('navHome');
};
</script>
```

```
if(!appState.tasks){ appState.tasks = []; }

function pendingTasks(){

function renderTaskFocus(){

  area.innerHTML = '';

  if(pending.length === 0){
    var img = document.createElement('img');

    sub.textContent = "Whenever something comes to mind, there's room for it here.";
    var addBtn = document.createElement('button');

    area.appendChild(addBtn);

  var card = document.createElement('div');
  card.style.cssText = 'background:#FFFFFF;border:1px solid #EEE0C4;border-radius:20px;padding:32px 24px;margin-bottom:20px;';
  var taskText = document.createElement('p');
  taskText.style.cssText = 'font-size:19px;font-weight:700;color:#2A2013;margin:0;line-height:1.4;';

  var doneBtn = document.createElement('button');
  doneBtn.textContent = 'Done';
  doneBtn.style.cssText = 'display:block;width:100%;padding:15px;border-radius:14px;border:none;background:#6690D6;color:#FFF8F0;font-size:15px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;margin-bottom:10px;';
  doneBtn.onclick = function(){
    current.done = true;
    current.completedDate = new Date().toISOString();
    saveState();
    renderTaskFocus();
  };

  var laterBtn = document.createElement('button');
  laterBtn.textContent = 'Not right now';
  laterBtn.style.cssText = 'display:block;width:100%;padding:15px;border-radius:14px;border:1px solid #EEE0C4;background:transparent;color:#2A2013;font-size:15px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;margin-bottom:16px;';
  laterBtn.onclick = function(){
    appState.tasks = appState.tasks.filter(function(t){ return t !== current; });
    appState.tasks.push(current);
    saveState();
    renderTaskFocus();
  };

  var addLink = document.createElement('button');
  addLink.textContent = '+ Add another task';
  addLink.style.cssText = 'background:none;border:none;color:#9A7B3E;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;';
  addLink.onclick = function(){ openAddTask(); };

  area.appendChild(eyebrow);

  area.appendChild(doneBtn);
  area.appendChild(laterBtn);

}

      c.style.background = active ? '#6690D6' : 'transparent';
      c.style.color = active ? '#FFF8F0' : '#9A7B3E';
      c.style.borderColor = active ? '#6690D6' : '#E3D5AE';
    });
  };
});

document.getElementById('saveTaskBtn').onclick = function(){

  if(!title) return;
```

```
function renderBodyDoubleChecklist(){
  var list = document.getElementById('bodyDoubleTaskList');
  list.innerHTML = '';
  var relevant = appState.tasks.filter(function(t){ return !t.done; });
  if(relevant.length === 0){
    var empty = document.createElement('p');
    empty.style.cssText = 'font-size:13px;color:#B0AA98;font-style:italic;margin:0 0 4px;';
    empty.textContent = 'No tasks queued — that\\'s fine, just showing up counts.';
    list.appendChild(empty);
    return;
  }
  relevant.forEach(function(t){
    var row = document.createElement('label');
    row.style.cssText = 'display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:12px;background:#FFFFFF;border:1px solid #EEE0C4;border-radius:12px;margin-bottom:8px;cursor:pointer;';
    var cb = document.createElement('input');
    cb.type = 'checkbox';
    cb.style.cssText = 'width:18px;height:18px;accent-color:#6690D6;cursor:pointer;flex-shrink:0;';
    cb.onchange = function(){
      t.done = cb.checked;
      t.completedDate = cb.checked ? new Date().toISOString() : null;
      saveState();
    };
    var label = document.createElement('span');
    label.style.cssText = 'font-size:14px;color:#2A2013;';
    label.textContent = t.title;
    row.appendChild(cb);
    row.appendChild(label);
    list.appendChild(row);
  });
```

```
  strip.innerHTML = '';
  var dayLetters = ['S','M','T','W','T','F','S'];
  var today = new Date();
  var todayDow = today.getDay();
  for(var i = -todayDow; i <= (6 - todayDow); i++){
    var d = new Date(today);
    d.setDate(today.getDate() + i);
    var isToday = i === 0;
    var col = document.createElement('div');
    col.style.cssText = 'display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:4px;padding:6px 8px;border-radius:14px;'+(isToday ? 'background:#E9F0FB;' : '');
    var letter = document.createElement('span');
    letter.style.cssText = 'font-size:11px;color:'+(isToday ? '#6690D6' : '#B0AA98')+';font-weight:'+(isToday?'700':'500')+';';
    letter.textContent = dayLetters[d.getDay()];
    var num = document.createElement('span');
    num.style.cssText = 'font-size:14px;color:'+(isToday ? '#2A2013' : '#9AABCE')+';font-weight:700;';
    num.textContent = d.getDate();
    col.appendChild(letter);
    col.appendChild(num);
    strip.appendChild(col);
  }
}
```

```
var sheetDuration = 30;
var sheetRepeat = false;
var durationCycle = [15, 30, 45, 60];
function todayISO(){ var d = new Date(); return d.getFullYear()+'-'+String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')+'-'+String(d.getDate()).padStart(2,'0'); }
var sheetSelectedDate = todayISO();
var sheetCalViewYear, sheetCalViewMonth;

function formatDateLabel(iso){
  var today = todayISO();
  var d = new Date(iso + 'T00:00:00');
  var tmr = new Date(); tmr.setDate(tmr.getDate()+1);
  var tmrISO = tmr.getFullYear()+'-'+String(tmr.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')+'-'+String(tmr.getDate()).padStart(2,'0');
  if(iso === today) return 'Today';
  if(iso === tmrISO) return 'Tomorrow';
  return d.toLocaleDateString(undefined, {month:'short', day:'numeric'});
}

function openAddTaskSheet(){
  document.getElementById('sheetTaskInput').value = '';
  sheetDuration = 30; sheetRepeat = false; sheetSelectedDate = todayISO();
  document.getElementById('sheetDurationChip').lastChild.textContent = ' 30m';
  document.getElementById('sheetDayChip').lastChild.textContent = ' Today';
  document.getElementById('sheetRepeatChip').style.background = '#F0EEE8';
  document.getElementById('sheetRepeatChip').style.color = '#9AABCE';
  document.getElementById('sheetCalendarPopup').style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('addTaskSheetBackdrop').style.display = 'block';
  document.getElementById('addTaskSheet').style.display = 'block';
  document.getElementById('sheetTaskInput').focus();
}

function closeAddTaskSheet(){
  document.getElementById('addTaskSheetBackdrop').style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('addTaskSheet').style.display = 'none';
}

document.getElementById('bodyDoubleAddTaskBtn').onclick = openAddTaskSheet;
document.getElementById('sheetCloseBtn').onclick = closeAddTaskSheet;
document.getElementById('addTaskSheetBackdrop').onclick = closeAddTaskSheet;

document.getElementById('sheetDurationChip').onclick = function(){
  var idx = durationCycle.indexOf(sheetDuration);
  sheetDuration = durationCycle[(idx + 1) % durationCycle.length];
  this.lastChild.textContent = ' ' + sheetDuration + 'm';
};

function renderSheetCalendar(){
  var label = document.getElementById('sheetCalLabel');
  label.textContent = new Date(sheetCalViewYear, sheetCalViewMonth, 1).toLocaleDateString(undefined, {month:'long', year:'numeric'});
  var grid = document.getElementById('sheetCalGrid');
  grid.innerHTML = '';
  ['S','M','T','W','T','F','S'].forEach(function(d){
    var h = document.createElement('div');
    h.style.cssText = 'text-align:center;font-size:10px;color:#B0AA98;font-weight:700;padding:4px 0;';
    h.textContent = d;
    grid.appendChild(h);
  });
  var firstDay = new Date(sheetCalViewYear, sheetCalViewMonth, 1).getDay();
  var daysInMonth = new Date(sheetCalViewYear, sheetCalViewMonth + 1, 0).getDate();
  for(var i = 0; i < firstDay; i++){ grid.appendChild(document.createElement('div')); }
  for(var day = 1; day <= daysInMonth; day++){
    var iso = sheetCalViewYear+'-'+String(sheetCalViewMonth+1).padStart(2,'0')+'-'+String(day).padStart(2,'0');
    var cell = document.createElement('button');
    cell.textContent = day;
    var isSelected = iso === sheetSelectedDate;
    var isToday = iso === todayISO();
    cell.style.cssText = 'aspect-ratio:1;border-radius:50%;border:none;font-size:12px;cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;'+
      (isSelected ? 'background:#6690D6;color:#FFF8F0;font-weight:700;' : isToday ? 'background:#E9F0FB;color:#6690D6;font-weight:700;' : 'background:transparent;color:#2A2013;');
    cell.onclick = function(){
      var y = sheetCalViewYear, m = sheetCalViewMonth, d = parseInt(this.textContent);
      sheetSelectedDate = y+'-'+String(m+1).padStart(2,'0')+'-'+String(d).padStart(2,'0');
      document.getElementById('sheetDayChip').lastChild.textContent = ' ' + formatDateLabel(sheetSelectedDate);
      document.getElementById('sheetCalendarPopup').style.display = 'none';
      renderSheetCalendar();
    };
    grid.appendChild(cell);
  }
}

document.getElementById('sheetDayChip').onclick = function(){
  var popup = document.getElementById('sheetCalendarPopup');
  if(popup.style.display === 'block'){ popup.style.display = 'none'; return; }
  var d = new Date(sheetSelectedDate + 'T00:00:00');
  sheetCalViewYear = d.getFullYear(); sheetCalViewMonth = d.getMonth();
  renderSheetCalendar();
  popup.style.display = 'block';
};

document.getElementById('sheetCalPrev').onclick = function(){
  sheetCalViewMonth--; if(sheetCalViewMonth < 0){ sheetCalViewMonth = 11; sheetCalViewYear--; }
  renderSheetCalendar();
};
document.getElementById('sheetCalNext').onclick = function(){
  sheetCalViewMonth++; if(sheetCalViewMonth > 11){ sheetCalViewMonth = 0; sheetCalViewYear++; }
  renderSheetCalendar();
};

document.getElementById('sheetRepeatChip').onclick = function(){
  sheetRepeat = !sheetRepeat;
  this.style.background = sheetRepeat ? '#E9F0FB' : '#F0EEE8';
  this.style.color = sheetRepeat ? '#6690D6' : '#9AABCE';
};

document.getElementById('sheetSaveTaskBtn').onclick = function(){
  var title = document.getElementById('sheetTaskInput').value.trim();
  if(!title) return;
  appState.tasks.push({title: title, date: sheetSelectedDate, duration: sheetDuration, repeat: sheetRepeat, done: false, subtasks: [], createdDate: new Date().toISOString()});
  saveState();
  closeAddTaskSheet();
  renderBodyDoubleTaskList();
};
</script>
</body>
```

```
function renderTaskCalendar(){
  var label = document.getElementById('taskCalLabel');
  label.textContent = new Date(taskCalViewYear, taskCalViewMonth, 1).toLocaleDateString(undefined, {month:'long', year:'numeric'});
  var grid = document.getElementById('taskCalGrid');
  grid.innerHTML = '';
  ['S','M','T','W','T','F','S'].forEach(function(d){
    var h = document.createElement('div');
    h.style.cssText = 'text-align:center;font-size:10px;color:#B0AA98;font-weight:700;padding:4px 0;';
    h.textContent = d;
    grid.appendChild(h);
  });
  var firstDay = new Date(taskCalViewYear, taskCalViewMonth, 1).getDay();
  var daysInMonth = new Date(taskCalViewYear, taskCalViewMonth + 1, 0).getDate();
  for(var i = 0; i < firstDay; i++){ grid.appendChild(document.createElement('div')); }
  for(var day = 1; day <= daysInMonth; day++){
    var iso = taskCalViewYear+'-'+String(taskCalViewMonth+1).padStart(2,'0')+'-'+String(day).padStart(2,'0');
    var cell = document.createElement('button');
    cell.textContent = day;
    var isSelected = iso === taskCalSelectedDate;
    var isToday = iso === todayISO();
    cell.style.cssText = 'aspect-ratio:1;border-radius:50%;border:none;font-size:13px;cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;'+
      (isSelected ? 'background:#6690D6;color:#FFF8F0;font-weight:700;' : isToday ? 'background:#E9F0FB;color:#6690D6;font-weight:700;' : 'background:transparent;color:#2A2013;');
    cell.onclick = function(){
      var d = parseInt(this.textContent);
      taskCalSelectedDate = taskCalViewYear+'-'+String(taskCalViewMonth+1).padStart(2,'0')+'-'+String(d).padStart(2,'0');
      renderTaskCalendar();
    };
    grid.appendChild(cell);
  }
}
```

```
<script>
(function(){
  const STORAGE_KEY = 'hobs_calendar_state_v1';
  const MOOD_COLORS = { anxious:'#8C7AA8', heavy:'#6B4A3A', excited:'#FDB913', calm:'#6690D6', content:'#5FAE7A', hopeful:'#FFF6E8' };
  const MOOD_LABELS = { anxious:'Anxious', heavy:'Heavy', excited:'Excited', calm:'Calm', content:'Content', hopeful:'Hopeful' };
  const COOKIE_LINES = [
    "You did it! Look what you built today!",
    "One more brick in the wall you're building. Proud of you.",
    "That's not nothing. That's real, actual progress.",
    "Small step, real step. Both count the same to me.",
    "You showed up for yourself today. That matters."
  ];

  let state = loadState();
  let viewYear, viewMonth; // 0-indexed month
  let activeDateKey = null;
  let lastCelebratedTask = null;

  const today = new Date();
  viewYear = today.getFullYear();
  viewMonth = today.getMonth();

  function loadState(){
    try {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
      if (raw) return JSON.parse(raw);
    } catch(e){}
    return seedDemoState();
  }

  function seedDemoState(){
    const s = { moodByDate:{}, tasksByDate:{} };
    const d = new Date();
    const k1 = dateKey(new Date(d.getFullYear(), d.getMonth(), d.getDate()-1));
    const k2 = dateKey(new Date(d.getFullYear(), d.getMonth(), d.getDate()-3));
    s.moodByDate[k1] = { moods:['calm','content'] };
    s.moodByDate[k2] = { moods:['anxious'] };
    const todayKey = dateKey(d);
    s.tasksByDate[todayKey] = [
      { id: uid(), title: 'Reply to donor email', done:false, subtasks:[] },
      { id: uid(), title: 'Finish screening report', done:false, subtasks:[
        { id: uid(), title: 'Draft section 1', done:true },
        { id: uid(), title: 'Draft section 2', done:false }
      ]}
    ];
    saveStateObj(s);
    return s;
  }

  function saveState(){ saveStateObj(state); }
  function saveStateObj(s){ localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(s)); }
  function uid(){ return Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,10); }
  function dateKey(d){ return d.getFullYear()+'-'+String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')+'-'+String(d.getDate()).padStart(2,'0'); }
  function isToday(y,m,day){ return y===today.getFullYear() && m===today.getMonth() && day===today.getDate(); }

  const monthTitleEl = document.getElementById('monthTitle');
  const dayGrid = document.getElementById('dayGrid');
  const MONTH_NAMES = ['January','February','March','April','May','June','July','August','September','October','November','December'];

  function renderCalendar(){
    monthTitleEl.textContent = MONTH_NAMES[viewMonth] + ' ' + viewYear;
    dayGrid.innerHTML = '';
    const firstDay = new Date(viewYear, viewMonth, 1).getDay();
    const daysInMonth = new Date(viewYear, viewMonth+1, 0).getDate();

    for (let i=0;i<firstDay;i++){
      const empty = document.createElement('div');
      empty.className = 'day-cell empty';
      dayGrid.appendChild(empty);
    }

    for (let day=1; day<=daysInMonth; day++){
      const key = viewYear+'-'+String(viewMonth+1).padStart(2,'0')+'-'+String(day).padStart(2,'0');
      const cell = document.createElement('div');
      cell.className = 'day-cell' + (isToday(viewYear,viewMonth,day) ? ' today' : '');
      cell.dataset.key = key;

      const num = document.createElement('div');
      num.className = 'day-num';
      num.textContent = day;
      cell.appendChild(num);

      const mood = state.moodByDate[key];
      if (mood && mood.moods && mood.moods.length){
        const dotsWrap = document.createElement('div');
        dotsWrap.className = 'mood-dots';
        mood.moods.slice(0,3).forEach(m=>{
          const dot = document.createElement('span');
          dot.className = 'mood-dot';
          dot.style.background = MOOD_COLORS[m] || '#ccc';
          if (m === 'hopeful') dot.style.border = '1px solid #E8C97A';
          dotsWrap.appendChild(dot);
        });
        cell.appendChild(dotsWrap);
      }

      const tasks = state.tasksByDate[key];
      if (tasks && tasks.length){
        const allDone = tasks.every(t=>t.done);
        const indicator = document.createElement('span');
        indicator.className = 'task-indicator ' + (allDone ? 'done' : 'pending');
        cell.appendChild(indicator);
      }

      cell.addEventListener('click', ()=> openDay(key));
      dayGrid.appendChild(cell);
    }
  }

  document.getElementById('prevMonthBtn').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    viewMonth--; if (viewMonth<0){ viewMonth=11; viewYear--; } renderCalendar();
  });
  document.getElementById('nextMonthBtn').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    viewMonth++; if (viewMonth>11){ viewMonth=0; viewYear++; } renderCalendar();
  });

  // ===== DAY PANEL =====
  const panelCalendar = document.getElementById('panel-calendar');
  const panelDay = document.getElementById('panel-day');
  const panelCeleb = document.getElementById('panel-celebration');

  function openDay(key){
    activeDateKey = key;
    panelCalendar.classList.add('hidden');
    panelDay.classList.remove('hidden');
    renderDayPanel();
  }
  document.getElementById('dayBackBtn').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    panelDay.classList.add('hidden');
    panelCalendar.classList.remove('hidden');
    renderCalendar();
  });

  function renderDayPanel(){
    const [y,m,d] = activeDateKey.split('-').map(Number);
    const dateObj = new Date(y, m-1, d);
    const opts = { weekday:'long', month:'long', day:'numeric' };
    document.getElementById('dayDateTitle').textContent = dateObj.toLocaleDateString('en-US', opts);

    const moodArea = document.getElementById('dayMoodArea');
    const mood = state.moodByDate[activeDateKey];
    if (mood && mood.moods && mood.moods.length){
      moodArea.innerHTML = '<div class="mood-chip-row">' + mood.moods.map(m=>
        `<span class="mood-chip" style="background:${MOOD_COLORS[m]}22;"><span class="mood-dot" style="width:8px;height:8px;background:${MOOD_COLORS[m]};display:inline-block;border-radius:50%;"></span>${MOOD_LABELS[m]}</span>`
      ).join('') + '</div>';
    } else {
      moodArea.innerHTML = '<p class="empty-mood">No mood logged this day yet.</p>';
    }

    renderTaskList();
  }

  function renderTaskList(){
    const listEl = document.getElementById('taskList');
    const tasks = state.tasksByDate[activeDateKey] || [];
    listEl.innerHTML = '';
    tasks.forEach(task=>{
      const item = document.createElement('div');
      item.className = 'task-item';

      const row = document.createElement('div');
      row.className = 'task-row';

      const cb = document.createElement('div');
      cb.className = 'checkbox' + (task.done ? ' done' : '');
      cb.innerHTML = task.done ? '✓' : '';
      cb.addEventListener('click', ()=> toggleTask(task.id));
      row.appendChild(cb);

      const title = document.createElement('span');
      title.className = 'task-title' + (task.done ? ' done' : '');
      title.textContent = task.title;
      row.appendChild(title);

      const bd = document.createElement('button');
      bd.className = 'breakdown-btn';
      bd.textContent = '+';
      bd.title = 'Break into smaller steps';
      bd.addEventListener('click', ()=> toggleSubtaskForm(item, task.id));
      row.appendChild(bd);

      item.appendChild(row);

      if (task.subtasks && task.subtasks.length){
        const subList = document.createElement('div');
        subList.className = 'subtask-list';
        task.subtasks.forEach(sub=>{
          const subRow = document.createElement('div');
          subRow.className = 'subtask-row';
          const scb = document.createElement('div');
          scb.className = 'sub-checkbox' + (sub.done ? ' done' : '');
          scb.addEventListener('click', ()=> toggleSubtask(task.id, sub.id));
          subRow.appendChild(scb);
          const stitle = document.createElement('span');
          stitle.className = 'subtask-title' + (sub.done ? ' done' : '');
          stitle.textContent = sub.title;
          subRow.appendChild(stitle);
          subList.appendChild(subRow);
        });
        item.appendChild(subList);
      }

      listEl.appendChild(item);
    });
  }

  function toggleSubtaskForm(container, taskId){
    let existing = container.querySelector('.subtask-add');
    if (existing){ existing.remove(); return; }
    const wrap = document.createElement('div');
    wrap.className = 'subtask-add';
    wrap.innerHTML = `<input type="text" placeholder="Break this into a smaller step..."><button>Add</button>`;
    const input = wrap.querySelector('input');
    const btn = wrap.querySelector('button');
    btn.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
      if (!input.value.trim()) return;
      addSubtask(taskId, input.value.trim());
      wrap.remove();
    });
    container.appendChild(wrap);
    input.focus();
  }

  function addSubtask(taskId, title){
    const tasks = state.tasksByDate[activeDateKey];
    const task = tasks.find(t=>t.id===taskId);
    if (!task.subtasks) task.subtasks = [];
    task.subtasks.push({ id: uid(), title, done:false });
    saveState();
    renderDayPanel();
  }

  function toggleSubtask(taskId, subId){
    const tasks = state.tasksByDate[activeDateKey];
    const task = tasks.find(t=>t.id===taskId);
    const sub = task.subtasks.find(s=>s.id===subId);
    sub.done = !sub.done;
    if (sub.done && task.subtasks.every(s=>s.done) && !task.done){
      task.done = true;
      saveState();
      renderDayPanel();
      renderCalendar();
      showCelebration(task);
      return;
    }
    saveState();
    renderDayPanel();
  }

  function toggleTask(taskId){
    const tasks = state.tasksByDate[activeDateKey];
    const task = tasks.find(t=>t.id===taskId);
    task.done = !task.done;
    saveState();
    renderDayPanel();
    renderCalendar();
    if (task.done) showCelebration(task);
  }

  document.getElementById('addTaskBtn').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    const input = document.getElementById('newTaskInput');
    if (!input.value.trim()) return;
    if (!state.tasksByDate[activeDateKey]) state.tasksByDate[activeDateKey] = [];
    state.tasksByDate[activeDateKey].push({ id: uid(), title: input.value.trim(), done:false, subtasks:[] });
    input.value = '';
    saveState();
    renderDayPanel();
  });

  // ===== CELEBRATION / MINDMAP =====
  function showCelebration(task){
    lastCelebratedTask = task;
    panelDay.classList.add('hidden');
    panelCeleb.classList.remove('hidden');
    document.getElementById('cookieLine').textContent = COOKIE_LINES[Math.floor(Math.random()*COOKIE_LINES.length)];
    drawMindmap();
  }
  document.getElementById('celebBackBtn').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    panelCeleb.classList.add('hidden');
    panelDay.classList.remove('hidden');
  });
  document.getElementById('keepGoingBtn').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    panelCeleb.classList.add('hidden');
    panelDay.classList.remove('hidden');
  });

  function drawMindmap(){
    const svg = document.getElementById('mindmapSvg');
    svg.innerHTML = '';
    const doneTasks = (state.tasksByDate[activeDateKey] || []).filter(t=>t.done);
    const cx=140, cy=100, r=32;
    const ns = 'http://www.w3.org/2000/svg';

    doneTasks.forEach((t,i)=>{
      const angle = (i / Math.max(doneTasks.length,1)) * Math.PI*2 - Math.PI/2;
      const nx = cx + Math.cos(angle)*72;
      const ny = cy + Math.sin(angle)*62;
      const line = document.createElementNS(ns,'line');
      line.setAttribute('x1',cx); line.setAttribute('y1',cy);
      line.setAttribute('x2',nx); line.setAttribute('y2',ny);
      line.setAttribute('stroke','#D9C9A3'); line.setAttribute('stroke-width','2');
      svg.appendChild(line);

      const node = document.createElementNS(ns,'circle');
      node.setAttribute('cx',nx); node.setAttribute('cy',ny); node.setAttribute('r',22);
      node.setAttribute('fill', t===lastCelebratedTask ? '#3B8F63' : '#EAF4EE');
      svg.appendChild(node);

      const label = document.createElementNS(ns,'text');
      label.setAttribute('x',nx); label.setAttribute('y',ny+38);
      label.setAttribute('text-anchor','middle');
      label.setAttribute('font-size','9');
      label.setAttribute('fill','#5C6B94');
      const short = t.title.length>14 ? t.title.slice(0,13)+'…' : t.title;
      label.textContent = short;
      svg.appendChild(label);
    });

    const center = document.createElementNS(ns,'circle');
    center.setAttribute('cx',cx); center.setAttribute('cy',cy); center.setAttribute('r',r);
    center.setAttribute('fill','#FDB913');
    svg.appendChild(center);
    const centerText = document.createElementNS(ns,'text');
    centerText.setAttribute('x',cx); centerText.setAttribute('y',cy+4);
    centerText.setAttribute('text-anchor','middle');
    centerText.setAttribute('font-size','10');
    centerText.setAttribute('font-weight','700');
    centerText.setAttribute('fill','#2E3A5A');
    centerText.textContent = 'Today';
    svg.appendChild(centerText);
  }

  // ===== SHARE SHEET =====
  const shareOverlay = document.getElementById('shareOverlay');
  document.getElementById('shareProgressBtn').addEventListener('click', ()=> shareOverlay.classList.remove('hidden'));
  document.getElementById('closeShareBtn').addEventListener('click', ()=> shareOverlay.classList.add('hidden'));

  document.querySelectorAll('.share-opt').forEach(btn=>{
    btn.addEventListener('click', ()=> handleShare(btn.dataset.target));
  });
  document.getElementById('moreShareBtn').addEventListener('click', ()=> handleShare('more'));

  async function handleShare(target){
    shareOverlay.classList.add('hidden');
    if (target === 'therapist'){ showToast('Sent to your therapist ✓'); return; }
    if (target === 'group'){ showToast('Posted to your support group ✓'); return; }

    try {
      const canvas = await html2canvas(document.getElementById('celebrationCard'), { backgroundColor:'#FFF8F0', scale:2 });
      canvas.toBlob(async (blob)=>{
        const file = new File([blob], 'hobs-progress.png', { type:'image/png' });
        if (navigator.canShare && navigator.canShare({ files:[file] })){
          try {
            await navigator.share({ files:[file], title:'My progress today', text:'Sharing my progress from HOBS Companion 🐕' });
            return;
          } catch(e){ /* user cancelled or unsupported, fall through */ }
        }
        const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
        const a = document.createElement('a');
        a.href = url; a.download = 'hobs-progress.png'; a.click();
        showToast(target==='whatsapp' ? 'Image saved — attach it in WhatsApp' : target==='instagram' ? 'Image saved — add it to your Story' : 'Image saved to your device');
      }, 'image/png');
    } catch(e){
      showToast("Couldn't capture image right now");
    }
  }

  let toastTimer;
  function showToast(msg){
    const t = document.getElementById('toast');
    t.textContent = msg;
    t.classList.add('show');
    clearTimeout(toastTimer);
    toastTimer = setTimeout(()=> t.classList.remove('show'), 2400);
  }

  renderCalendar();
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
```
