```
<script>
(function(){
  const STORAGE_KEY = 'hobs_app_state_v1';
  const MOOD_COLORS = { anxious:'#8C7AA8', heavy:'#6B4A3A', excited:'#FDB913', calm:'#6690D6', content:'#5FAE7A', hopeful:'#FFF6E8' };
  const MOOD_LABELS = { anxious:'Anxious', heavy:'Heavy', excited:'Excited', calm:'Calm', content:'Content', hopeful:'Hopeful' };
  const COOKIE_LINES = [
    "You did it! Look what you built today!",
    "One more brick in the wall you're building. Proud of you.",
    "That's not nothing. That's real, actual progress.",
    "Small step, real step. Both count the same to me.",
    "You showed up for yourself today. That matters."
  ];
  const THERAPISTS = ['Dr. Priya Mehta','Dr. Rohan Shah','Ms. Ananya Iyer','Dr. Kavita Rao'];
  const WHO5_ITEMS = [
    'I have felt cheerful and in good spirits',
    'I have felt calm and relaxed',
    'I have felt active and vigorous',
    'I woke up feeling fresh and rested',
    'My daily life has been filled with things that interest me'
  ];

  function defaultState(){
    return {
      moodByDate: {}, journalByDate: {}, tasksByDate: {}, who5History: [],
      therapistStatus: 'none', connectedTherapistName: null, supportGroupJoined: false,
      dismissFindProfessional: false, dismissJoinGroup: false,
      prefs: { showPitches: true }
    };
  }
  function loadState(){
    try { const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY); if (raw) return Object.assign(defaultState(), JSON.parse(raw)); } catch(e){}
    return defaultState();
  }
  let state = loadState();
  function saveState(){ localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(state)); }
  function uid(){ return Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,10); }
  function dateKey(d){ return d.getFullYear()+'-'+String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')+'-'+String(d.getDate()).padStart(2,'0'); }
  const today = new Date();
  const todayKey = dateKey(today);

  let toastTimer;
  function showToast(msg){
    const t = document.getElementById('toast');
    t.textContent = msg; t.classList.add('show');
    clearTimeout(toastTimer);
    toastTimer = setTimeout(()=> t.classList.remove('show'), 2400);
  }

  function showPanel(id){
    document.querySelectorAll('.content').forEach(el => el.style.display = 'none');
    document.getElementById(id).style.display = 'block';
  }

  // ================= NAV FOOTER =================
  const TAB_PANEL = { home:'panel-bubbles', calendar:'panel-calendar', history:'panel-history', profile:'panel-profile' };
  document.querySelectorAll('.nav-item').forEach(btn=>{
    btn.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
      document.querySelectorAll('.nav-item').forEach(b=>b.classList.remove('active'));
      btn.classList.add('active');
      const tab = btn.dataset.tab;
      if (tab === 'calendar') renderCalendar();
      if (tab === 'history') renderHistory();
      if (tab === 'profile') renderProfile();
      showPanel(TAB_PANEL[tab]);
    });
  });
  function goHome(){
    document.querySelectorAll('.nav-item').forEach(b=>b.classList.remove('active'));
    document.querySelector('.nav-item[data-tab="home"]').classList.add('active');
    showPanel('panel-bubbles');
  }

  // ================= MOOD BUBBLES =================
  let selectedMoods = [];
  const bubbleField = document.getElementById('bubbleField');
  const bubbleDefs = Object.keys(MOOD_COLORS).map(key=>({ key, color: MOOD_COLORS[key], label: MOOD_LABELS[key], size: 56 + Math.round(Math.random()*16) }));

  function layoutBubbles(){
    const w = bubbleField.clientWidth || 300;
    const h = bubbleField.clientHeight || 340;
    const positions = bubbleDefs.map((b,i)=>({
      x: 20 + Math.random()*(w - b.size - 40),
      y: 20 + Math.random()*(h - b.size - 40)
    }));
    // simple repulsion relaxation
    for (let iter=0; iter<40; iter++){
      for (let i=0;i<positions.length;i++){
        for (let j=i+1;j<positions.length;j++){
          const a = positions[i], b2 = positions[j];
          const ra = bubbleDefs[i].size/2, rb = bubbleDefs[j].size/2;
          const dx = (a.x+ra) - (b2.x+rb), dy = (a.y+ra) - (b2.y+rb);
          const dist = Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy) || 0.01;
          const minDist = ra+rb+6;
          if (dist < minDist){
            const push = (minDist-dist)/2;
            const nx = dx/dist, ny = dy/dist;
            a.x += nx*push; a.y += ny*push;
            b2.x -= nx*push; b2.y -= ny*push;
          }
        }
      }
    }
    positions.forEach(p=>{
      p.x = Math.max(4, Math.min(w - 60, p.x));
      p.y = Math.max(4, Math.min(h - 60, p.y));
    });
    return positions;
  }

  function renderBubbles(){
    bubbleField.innerHTML = '';
    const positions = layoutBubbles();
    bubbleDefs.forEach((b,i)=>{
      const el = document.createElement('div');
      el.className = 'mood-bubble' + (selectedMoods.includes(b.key) ? ' selected' : '');
      el.style.width = b.size+'px'; el.style.height = b.size+'px';
      el.style.left = positions[i].x+'px'; el.style.top = positions[i].y+'px';
      el.style.background = `radial-gradient(circle at 32% 28%, ${lighten(b.color)}, ${b.color})`;
      el.style.animationDelay = (Math.random()*2).toFixed(2)+'s';
      el.style.animationDuration = (3 + Math.random()*1.6).toFixed(2)+'s';
      el.innerHTML = `<span>${b.label}</span>`;
      el.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
        if (selectedMoods.includes(b.key)) selectedMoods = selectedMoods.filter(m=>m!==b.key);
        else selectedMoods.push(b.key);
        el.classList.toggle('selected');
        document.getElementById('continueBtn').style.display = selectedMoods.length ? 'block' : 'none';
      });
      bubbleField.appendChild(el);
    });
  }
  function lighten(hex){
    const c = hex.replace('#','');
    const num = parseInt(c.length===3 ? c.split('').map(x=>x+x).join('') : c, 16);
    const r = Math.min(255, ((num>>16)&255) + 60);
    const g = Math.min(255, ((num>>8)&255) + 60);
    const bl = Math.min(255, (num&255) + 60);
    return `rgb(${r},${g},${bl})`;
  }
  let resizeTimer;
  window.addEventListener('resize', ()=>{ clearTimeout(resizeTimer); resizeTimer = setTimeout(renderBubbles, 200); });

  document.getElementById('continueBtn').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    if (!selectedMoods.length) return;
    showPanel('panel-journal');
    renderJournalDots();
    document.getElementById('journalText').value = '';
    resetShareUI();
  });

  function renderJournalDots(){
    const wrap = document.getElementById('journalDots');
    wrap.innerHTML = selectedMoods.map(m=>`<span style="width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:${MOOD_COLORS[m]};display:inline-block;"></span>`).join('');
  }

  document.getElementById('backBtn').addEventListener('click', goHome);

  // ================= JOURNAL =================
  let isExpanded = false;
  document.getElementById('expandBtn').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    isExpanded = !isExpanded;
    document.getElementById('journalText').style.minHeight = isExpanded ? '220px' : '100px';
  });

  let recognizing = false, recognition = null;
  const SpeechRec = window.SpeechRecognition || window.webkitSpeechRecognition;
  document.getElementById('micBtn').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    if (!SpeechRec){ showToast('Voice input not supported on this device'); return; }
    if (recognizing){ recognition.stop(); return; }
    recognition = new SpeechRec();
    recognition.continuous = true; recognition.interimResults = false; recognition.lang = 'en-IN';
    recognition.onresult = (e)=>{
      let transcript = '';
      for (let i=e.resultIndex;i<e.results.length;i++) transcript += e.results[i][0].transcript;
      const ta = document.getElementById('journalText');
      ta.value = (ta.value ? ta.value + ' ' : '') + transcript;
    };
    recognition.onend = ()=>{ recognizing = false; document.getElementById('micBtn').style.background = '#6690D6'; };
    recognition.start();
    recognizing = true;
    document.getElementById('micBtn').style.background = '#C77B7B';
  });

  let shareActive = false;
  function resetShareUI(){
    shareActive = false;
    document.getElementById('shareCheck').style.background = 'transparent';
    document.getElementById('shareAsk').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('outsideNote').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('pendingMatchNote').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('shareNote').style.display = 'none';
  }
  document.getElementById('shareBtn').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    shareActive = !shareActive;
    document.getElementById('shareCheck').style.background = shareActive ? '#6690D6' : 'transparent';
    document.getElementById('shareAsk').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('outsideNote').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('pendingMatchNote').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('shareNote').style.display = 'none';
    if (!shareActive) return;

    const status = document.getElementById('demoHasTherapist').checked ? 'connected' : state.therapistStatus;
    if (status === 'connected'){
      document.getElementById('shareNote').style.display = 'block';
    } else if (status === 'outside'){
      document.getElementById('outsideNote').style.display = 'block';
      shareActive = false;
      document.getElementById('shareCheck').style.background = 'transparent';
    } else {
      document.getElementById('shareAsk').style.display = 'block';
    }
  });
  document.getElementById('hasTherapistYes').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    renderTherapistList();
    showPanel('panel-therapist-select');
  });
  document.getElementById('hasTherapistNo').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    document.getElementById('intakeForm').style.display = 'block';
    document.getElementById('intakeThanks').style.display = 'none';
    showPanel('panel-intake');
  });
  document.getElementById('hasTherapistOutside').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    state.therapistStatus = 'outside'; saveState();
    document.getElementById('shareAsk').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('outsideNote').style.display = 'block';
    shareActive = false;
    document.getElementById('shareCheck').style.background = 'transparent';
  });

  function renderTherapistList(){
    const wrap = document.getElementById('therapistList');
    wrap.innerHTML = '';
    THERAPISTS.forEach(name=>{
      const initials = name.split(' ').filter(w=>w!=='Dr.'&&w!=='Ms.').map(w=>w[0]).join('');
      const row = document.createElement('div');
      row.className = 'therapist-option';
      row.innerHTML = `<div class="therapist-avatar">${initials}</div><span style="font-size:13.5px;color:#2A2013;font-weight:600;">${name}</span>`;
      row.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
        state.therapistStatus = 'connected';
        state.connectedTherapistName = name;
        saveState();
        showPanel('panel-journal');
        shareActive = true;
        document.getElementById('shareCheck').style.background = '#6690D6';
        document.getElementById('shareAsk').style.display = 'none';
        document.getElementById('shareNote').style.display = 'block';
        showToast('Connected with ' + name);
      });
      wrap.appendChild(row);
    });
  }
  document.getElementById('therapistSelectBackBtn').addEventListener('click', ()=> showPanel('panel-journal'));

  document.getElementById('intakeBackBtn').addEventListener('click', ()=> showPanel('panel-journal'));
  document.getElementById('intakeSubmitBtn').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    const name = document.getElementById('intakeName').value.trim();
    const contact = document.getElementById('intakeContact').value.trim();
    if (!name || !contact){ document.getElementById('intakeError').style.display = 'block'; return; }
    document.getElementById('intakeError').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('intakeForm').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('intakeThanks').style.display = 'block';
  });
  document.getElementById('intakeDoneBtn').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    showPanel('panel-journal');
    shareActive = false;
    document.getElementById('shareCheck').style.background = 'transparent';
    document.getElementById('shareAsk').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('pendingMatchNote').style.display = 'block';
  });

  document.getElementById('saveNoteBtn').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    const text = document.getElementById('journalText').value.trim();
    state.moodByDate[todayKey] = { moods: selectedMoods.slice() };
    if (!state.journalByDate[todayKey]) state.journalByDate[todayKey] = [];
    if (text || selectedMoods.length){
      state.journalByDate[todayKey].push({ id: uid(), text, moods: selectedMoods.slice(), sharedWithTherapist: shareActive, time: Date.now() });
    }
    saveState();
    renderSavedPitch();
    showPanel('panel-saved');
    selectedMoods = [];
    document.getElementById('continueBtn').style.display = 'none';
    renderBubbles();
  });

  document.getElementById('savedBackBtn').addEventListener('click', goHome);
  document.getElementById('notNowBtn').addEventListener('click', goHome);

  let currentSavedPitches = [];
  function renderSavedPitch(){
    const area = document.getElementById('savedPitchArea');
    area.innerHTML = '';
    currentSavedPitches = [];
    if (!state.prefs.showPitches){ return; }
    const status = document.getElementById('demoHasTherapist').checked ? 'connected' : state.therapistStatus;

    if (status === 'connected'){
      area.innerHTML += `<button id="pitchConnect" style="display:block;width:100%;padding:15px;border-radius:14px;border:none;background:#6690D6;color:#FFF8F0;font-size:15px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;margin-bottom:10px;">Connect with ${state.connectedTherapistName}</button>`;
      if (!state.dismissJoinGroup) area.innerHTML += pitchGroupBtn();
    } else if (status === 'outside'){
      if (!state.dismissJoinGroup) area.innerHTML += pitchGroupBtn();
    } else {
      if (!state.dismissFindProfessional) area.innerHTML += `<button id="pitchFind" style="display:block;width:100%;padding:15px;border-radius:14px;border:none;background:#6690D6;color:#FFF8F0;font-size:15px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;margin-bottom:10px;">Find a professional</button>`;
      if (!state.dismissJoinGroup) area.innerHTML += pitchGroupBtn();
    }
    const connectBtn = document.getElementById('pitchConnect');
    if (connectBtn) connectBtn.addEventListener('click', ()=> showPanel('panel-booking'));
    const findBtn = document.getElementById('pitchFind');
    if (findBtn){ findBtn.addEventListener('click', ()=>{ document.getElementById('intakeForm').style.display='block'; document.getElementById('intakeThanks').style.display='none'; showPanel('panel-intake'); }); currentSavedPitches.push('find'); }
    const groupBtn = document.getElementById('pitchGroup');
    if (groupBtn){ groupBtn.addEventListener('click', ()=>{ document.getElementById('supportIntro').style.display = state.supportGroupJoined ? 'none':'block'; document.getElementById('supportJoined').style.display = state.supportGroupJoined ? 'block':'none'; showPanel('panel-support'); }); currentSavedPitches.push('group'); }
  }
  function pitchGroupBtn(){
    return `<button id="pitchGroup" style="display:block;width:100%;padding:15px;border-radius:14px;border:1px solid #EEE0C4;background:transparent;color:#2A2013;font-size:15px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;margin-bottom:10px;">Join support group</button>`;
  }
  document.getElementById('dontShowAgainBtn').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    if (currentSavedPitches.includes('find')) state.dismissFindProfessional = true;
    if (currentSavedPitches.includes('group')) state.dismissJoinGroup = true;
    saveState();
    goHome();
  });

  // ================= SUPPORT GROUP =================
  document.getElementById('supportBackBtn').addEventListener('click', goHome);
  document.getElementById('joinSupportBtn').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    state.supportGroupJoined = true; saveState();
    document.getElementById('supportIntro').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('supportJoined').style.display = 'block';
  });
  document.getElementById('supportDoneBtn').addEventListener('click', goHome);
  document.getElementById('supportJoinedDoneBtn').addEventListener('click', goHome);

  // ================= BOOKING =================
  document.getElementById('bookingBackBtn').addEventListener('click', goHome);
  document.getElementById('bookingDoneBtn').addEventListener('click', goHome);

  // ================= WHO-5 =================
  let who5Idx = 0, who5Answers = [];
  document.getElementById('who5EntryBtn').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    who5Idx = 0; who5Answers = [];
    renderWho5();
    showPanel('panel-who5');
  });
  document.getElementById('who5BackBtn').addEventListener('click', goHome);
  function renderWho5(){
    document.getElementById('who5Idx').textContent = who5Idx+1;
    document.getElementById('who5Item').textContent = WHO5_ITEMS[who5Idx];
    document.getElementById('who5Prog').style.width = (((who5Idx+1)/5)*100)+'%';
    const scaleWrap = document.getElementById('who5Scale');
    scaleWrap.innerHTML = '';
    for (let v=0; v<=5; v++){
      const btn = document.createElement('button');
      btn.textContent = v;
      btn.style.cssText = 'width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:50%;border:1.5px solid #D9C9A3;background:#FFFFFF;color:#2A2013;font-weight:700;font-size:13px;cursor:pointer;';
      btn.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
        who5Answers[who5Idx] = v;
        who5Idx++;
        if (who5Idx >= 5){ finishWho5(); } else { renderWho5(); }
      });
      scaleWrap.appendChild(btn);
    }
  }
  function finishWho5(){
    const raw = who5Answers.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0);
    const pct = raw * 4;
    state.who5History.push({ date: todayKey, score: pct });
    saveState();
    document.getElementById('who5ScoreNum').textContent = pct;
    const category = pct < 28 ? 'Worth talking to someone' : pct < 50 ? 'A tough stretch' : pct < 75 ? 'Doing okay' : 'Feeling good';
    document.getElementById('who5Category').textContent = category;
    const msg = pct < 50
      ? "This score suggests you might be going through a lot right now. It could help to talk to one of our professionals — no pressure, just an option."
      : "Thanks for checking in with yourself. Small signals like this matter.";
    document.getElementById('who5Message').textContent = msg;
    const circumference = 220;
    const offset = circumference - (pct/100)*circumference;
    document.getElementById('who5ArcFill').style.strokeDashoffset = offset;
    showPanel('panel-who5-results');
  }
  document.getElementById('who5DoneBtn').addEventListener('click', goHome);

  // ================= CALENDAR =================
  let viewYear = today.getFullYear(), viewMonth = today.getMonth();
  const MONTH_NAMES = ['January','February','March','April','May','June','July','August','September','October','November','December'];
  function isToday(y,m,day){ return y===today.getFullYear() && m===today.getMonth() && day===today.getDate(); }

  function renderCalendar(){
    document.getElementById('monthTitle').textContent = MONTH_NAMES[viewMonth] + ' ' + viewYear;
    const grid = document.getElementById('dayGrid');
    grid.innerHTML = '';
    const firstDay = new Date(viewYear, viewMonth, 1).getDay();
    const daysInMonth = new Date(viewYear, viewMonth+1, 0).getDate();
    for (let i=0;i<firstDay;i++){
      const empty = document.createElement('div'); empty.className = 'day-cell empty'; grid.appendChild(empty);
    }
    for (let day=1; day<=daysInMonth; day++){
      const key = viewYear+'-'+String(viewMonth+1).padStart(2,'0')+'-'+String(day).padStart(2,'0');
      const cell = document.createElement('div');
      cell.className = 'day-cell' + (isToday(viewYear,viewMonth,day) ? ' today' : '');
      const num = document.createElement('div'); num.className='day-num'; num.textContent = day; cell.appendChild(num);
      const mood = state.moodByDate[key];
      if (mood && mood.moods && mood.moods.length){
        const dotsWrap = document.createElement('div'); dotsWrap.className='mood-dots';
        mood.moods.slice(0,3).forEach(m=>{
          const dot = document.createElement('span'); dot.className='mood-dot'; dot.style.background = MOOD_COLORS[m]||'#ccc';
          dotsWrap.appendChild(dot);
        });
        cell.appendChild(dotsWrap);
      }
      const tasks = state.tasksByDate[key];
      if (tasks && tasks.length){
        const allDone = tasks.every(t=>t.done);
        const ind = document.createElement('span'); ind.className = 'task-indicator ' + (allDone?'done':'pending');
        cell.appendChild(ind);
      }
      cell.addEventListener('click', ()=> openDay(key));
      grid.appendChild(cell);
    }
  }
  document.getElementById('prevMonthBtn').addEventListener('click', ()=>{ viewMonth--; if(viewMonth<0){viewMonth=11;viewYear--;} renderCalendar(); });
  document.getElementById('nextMonthBtn').addEventListener('click', ()=>{ viewMonth++; if(viewMonth>11){viewMonth=0;viewYear++;} renderCalendar(); });

  // ================= DAY DETAIL =================
  let activeDateKey = null, lastCelebratedTask = null;
  function openDay(key){
    activeDateKey = key;
    showPanel('panel-day');
    renderDayPanel();
  }
  document.getElementById('dayBackBtn').addEventListener('click', ()=>{ showPanel('panel-calendar'); renderCalendar(); });
  function renderDayPanel(){
    const [y,m,d] = activeDateKey.split('-').map(Number);
    const dateObj = new Date(y, m-1, d);
    document.getElementById('dayDateTitle').textContent = dateObj.toLocaleDateString('en-US',{ weekday:'long', month:'long', day:'numeric' });
    const moodArea = document.getElementById('dayMoodArea');
    const mood = state.moodByDate[activeDateKey];
    if (mood && mood.moods && mood.moods.length){
      moodArea.innerHTML = '<div class="mood-chip-row">' + mood.moods.map(m=>
        `<span class="mood-chip" style="background:${MOOD_COLORS[m]}22;"><span class="mood-dot" style="width:8px;height:8px;background:${MOOD_COLORS[m]};display:inline-block;"></span>${MOOD_LABELS[m]}</span>`).join('') + '</div>';
    } else {
      moodArea.innerHTML = '<p class="empty-mood">No mood logged this day yet.</p>';
    }
    renderTaskList();
  }
  function renderTaskList(){
    const listEl = document.getElementById('taskList');
    const tasks = state.tasksByDate[activeDateKey] || [];
    listEl.innerHTML = '';
    tasks.forEach(task=>{
      const item = document.createElement('div'); item.className='task-item';
      const row = document.createElement('div'); row.className='task-row';
      const cb = document.createElement('div'); cb.className='checkbox'+(task.done?' done':''); cb.innerHTML = task.done?'✓':'';
      cb.addEventListener('click', ()=> toggleTask(task.id)); row.appendChild(cb);
      const title = document.createElement('span'); title.className='task-title'+(task.done?' done':''); title.textContent = task.title; row.appendChild(title);
      const bd = document.createElement('button'); bd.className='breakdown-btn'; bd.textContent='+';
      bd.addEventListener('click', ()=> toggleSubtaskForm(item, task.id)); row.appendChild(bd);
      item.appendChild(row);
      if (task.subtasks && task.subtasks.length){
        const subList = document.createElement('div'); subList.className='subtask-list';
        task.subtasks.forEach(sub=>{
          const subRow = document.createElement('div'); subRow.className='subtask-row';
          const scb = document.createElement('div'); scb.className='sub-checkbox'+(sub.done?' done':'');
          scb.addEventListener('click', ()=> toggleSubtask(task.id, sub.id)); subRow.appendChild(scb);
          const stitle = document.createElement('span'); stitle.className='subtask-title'+(sub.done?' done':''); stitle.textContent = sub.title;
          subRow.appendChild(stitle); subList.appendChild(subRow);
        });
        item.appendChild(subList);
      }
      listEl.appendChild(item);
    });
  }
  function toggleSubtaskForm(container, taskId){
    let existing = container.querySelector('.subtask-add');
    if (existing){ existing.remove(); return; }
    const wrap = document.createElement('div'); wrap.className='subtask-add';
    wrap.innerHTML = `<input type="text" placeholder="Break this into a smaller step..."><button>Add</button>`;
    const input = wrap.querySelector('input'), btn = wrap.querySelector('button');
    btn.addEventListener('click', ()=>{ if(!input.value.trim())return; addSubtask(taskId, input.value.trim()); wrap.remove(); });
    container.appendChild(wrap); input.focus();
  }
  function addSubtask(taskId, title){
    const task = state.tasksByDate[activeDateKey].find(t=>t.id===taskId);
    if (!task.subtasks) task.subtasks = [];
    task.subtasks.push({ id: uid(), title, done:false });
    saveState(); renderDayPanel();
  }
  function toggleSubtask(taskId, subId){
    const task = state.tasksByDate[activeDateKey].find(t=>t.id===taskId);
    const sub = task.subtasks.find(s=>s.id===subId);
    sub.done = !sub.done;
    if (sub.done && task.subtasks.every(s=>s.done) && !task.done){
      task.done = true; saveState(); renderDayPanel(); showCelebration(task); return;
    }
    saveState(); renderDayPanel();
  }
  function toggleTask(taskId){
    const task = state.tasksByDate[activeDateKey].find(t=>t.id===taskId);
    task.done = !task.done; saveState(); renderDayPanel();
    if (task.done) showCelebration(task);
  }
  document.getElementById('addTaskBtn').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    const input = document.getElementById('newTaskInput');
    if (!input.value.trim()) return;
    if (!state.tasksByDate[activeDateKey]) state.tasksByDate[activeDateKey] = [];
    state.tasksByDate[activeDateKey].push({ id: uid(), title: input.value.trim(), done:false, subtasks:[] });
    input.value = ''; saveState(); renderDayPanel();
  });

  // ================= CELEBRATION / MINDMAP =================
  function showCelebration(task){
    lastCelebratedTask = task;
    showPanel('panel-celebration');
    document.getElementById('cookieLine').textContent = COOKIE_LINES[Math.floor(Math.random()*COOKIE_LINES.length)];
    drawMindmap();
  }
  document.getElementById('celebBackBtn').addEventListener('click', ()=>{ showPanel('panel-day'); });
  document.getElementById('keepGoingBtn').addEventListener('click', ()=>{ showPanel('panel-day'); });
  function drawMindmap(){
    const svg = document.getElementById('mindmapSvg'); svg.innerHTML = '';
    const doneTasks = (state.tasksByDate[activeDateKey] || []).filter(t=>t.done);
    const cx=140, cy=100, r=32; const ns = 'http://www.w3.org/2000/svg';
    doneTasks.forEach((t,i)=>{
      const angle = (i / Math.max(doneTasks.length,1)) * Math.PI*2 - Math.PI/2;
      const nx = cx + Math.cos(angle)*72, ny = cy + Math.sin(angle)*62;
      const line = document.createElementNS(ns,'line');
      line.setAttribute('x1',cx); line.setAttribute('y1',cy); line.setAttribute('x2',nx); line.setAttribute('y2',ny);
      line.setAttribute('stroke','#D9C9A3'); line.setAttribute('stroke-width','2'); svg.appendChild(line);
      const node = document.createElementNS(ns,'circle');
      node.setAttribute('cx',nx); node.setAttribute('cy',ny); node.setAttribute('r',22);
      node.setAttribute('fill', t===lastCelebratedTask ? '#3B8F63' : '#EAF4EE'); svg.appendChild(node);
      const label = document.createElementNS(ns,'text');
      label.setAttribute('x',nx); label.setAttribute('y',ny+38); label.setAttribute('text-anchor','middle');
      label.setAttribute('font-size','9'); label.setAttribute('fill','#5C6B94');
      label.textContent = t.title.length>14 ? t.title.slice(0,13)+'…' : t.title; svg.appendChild(label);
    });
    const center = document.createElementNS(ns,'circle');
    center.setAttribute('cx',cx); center.setAttribute('cy',cy); center.setAttribute('r',r); center.setAttribute('fill','#FDB913');
    svg.appendChild(center);
    const centerText = document.createElementNS(ns,'text');
    centerText.setAttribute('x',cx); centerText.setAttribute('y',cy+4); centerText.setAttribute('text-anchor','middle');
    centerText.setAttribute('font-size','10'); centerText.setAttribute('font-weight','700'); centerText.setAttribute('fill','#2E3A5A');
    centerText.textContent = 'Today'; svg.appendChild(centerText);
  }

  // ================= SHARE SHEET =================
  const shareOverlay = document.getElementById('shareOverlay');
  document.getElementById('shareProgressBtn').addEventListener('click', ()=> shareOverlay.classList.remove('hidden'));
  document.getElementById('closeShareBtn').addEventListener('click', ()=> shareOverlay.classList.add('hidden'));
  document.querySelectorAll('.share-opt').forEach(btn=> btn.addEventListener('click', ()=> handleShare(btn.dataset.target)));
  document.getElementById('moreShareBtn').addEventListener('click', ()=> handleShare('more'));
  async function handleShare(target){
    shareOverlay.classList.add('hidden');
    if (target === 'therapist'){ showToast('Sent to your therapist ✓'); return; }
    if (target === 'group'){ showToast('Posted to your support group ✓'); return; }
    if (typeof html2canvas === 'undefined'){ showToast('Screenshot library unavailable offline'); return; }
    try {
      const canvas = await html2canvas(document.getElementById('celebrationCard'), { backgroundColor:'#FFF8F0', scale:2 });
      canvas.toBlob(async (blob)=>{
        const file = new File([blob], 'hobs-progress.png', { type:'image/png' });
        if (navigator.canShare && navigator.canShare({ files:[file] })){
          try { await navigator.share({ files:[file], title:'My progress today', text:'Sharing my progress from HOBS Companion' }); return; } catch(e){}
        }
        const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
        const a = document.createElement('a'); a.href = url; a.download = 'hobs-progress.png'; a.click();
        showToast(target==='whatsapp' ? 'Image saved — attach it in WhatsApp' : target==='instagram' ? 'Image saved — add it to your Story' : 'Image saved to your device');
      }, 'image/png');
    } catch(e){ showToast("Couldn't capture image right now"); }
  }

  // ================= HISTORY =================
  function renderHistory(){
    const wrap = document.getElementById('historyList');
    const dates = Object.keys(state.journalByDate).sort().reverse();
    if (!dates.length){ wrap.innerHTML = '<p class="empty-mood" style="text-align:center;">Nothing here yet.</p>'; return; }
    wrap.innerHTML = dates.map(key=>{
      const entries = state.journalByDate[key];
      return entries.map(e=>{
        const moodDots = (e.moods||[]).map(m=>`<span class="mood-dot" style="background:${MOOD_COLORS[m]};display:inline-block;margin-right:2px;"></span>`).join('');
        const [y,m,d] = key.split('-').map(Number);
        const label = new Date(y,m-1,d).toLocaleDateString('en-US',{ weekday:'short', month:'short', day:'numeric' });
        return `<div class="history-item"><div class="history-date">${label} ${moodDots}</div><div class="history-text">${e.text ? escapeHtml(e.text) : '<span style="color:#B0AA98;">No note written</span>'}</div></div>`;
      }).join('');
    }).join('');
  }
  function escapeHtml(s){ const d = document.createElement('div'); d.textContent = s; return d.innerHTML; }

  // ================= PROFILE =================
  function renderProfile(){
    const tArea = document.getElementById('profileTherapistArea');
    if (state.therapistStatus === 'connected'){
      tArea.innerHTML = `<p style="font-size:13.5px;color:#2A2013;font-weight:600;margin:0 0 10px;">Connected with ${state.connectedTherapistName}</p><button id="disconnectStep1" style="background:none;border:none;color:#C77B7B;font-size:12px;cursor:pointer;text-decoration:underline;">Disconnect</button><div id="disconnectConfirm" style="display:none;margin-top:8px;"><p style="font-size:11.5px;color:#5C6B94;margin:0 0 8px;">Are you sure? This can't be undone from here.</p><button id="disconnectYes" style="margin-right:8px;background:#C77B7B;color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:8px;padding:6px 12px;font-size:11.5px;cursor:pointer;">Yes, disconnect</button><button id="disconnectNo" style="background:transparent;border:1px solid #EEE0C4;border-radius:8px;padding:6px 12px;font-size:11.5px;cursor:pointer;">Cancel</button></div>`;
      document.getElementById('disconnectStep1').addEventListener('click', ()=> document.getElementById('disconnectConfirm').style.display='block');
      document.getElementById('disconnectNo').addEventListener('click', ()=> document.getElementById('disconnectConfirm').style.display='none');
      document.getElementById('disconnectYes').addEventListener('click', ()=>{ state.therapistStatus='none'; state.connectedTherapistName=null; saveState(); renderProfile(); showToast('Disconnected'); });
    } else if (state.therapistStatus === 'outside'){
      tArea.innerHTML = `<p style="font-size:13px;color:#5C6B94;">You've told us you see someone outside HOBS.</p>`;
    } else {
      tArea.innerHTML = `<p style="font-size:13px;color:#5C6B94;margin:0 0 10px;">Not connected yet.</p><button id="profileFindBtn" style="background:#6690D6;color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:10px;padding:9px 14px;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;">Find a professional</button>`;
      document.getElementById('profileFindBtn').addEventListener('click', ()=>{ document.getElementById('intakeForm').style.display='block'; document.getElementById('intakeThanks').style.display='none'; showPanel('panel-intake'); });
    }
    const sArea = document.getElementById('profileSupportArea');
    sArea.innerHTML = state.supportGroupJoined
      ? `<p style="font-size:13px;color:#3B8F63;font-weight:600;">You're on the list ✓</p>`
      : `<p style="font-size:13px;color:#5C6B94;margin:0 0 10px;">Not joined yet.</p><button id="profileJoinBtn" style="background:#6690D6;color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:10px;padding:9px 14px;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;">Join support group</button>`;
    const joinBtn = document.getElementById('profileJoinBtn');
    if (joinBtn) joinBtn.addEventListener('click', ()=>{ state.supportGroupJoined = true; saveState(); renderProfile(); });

    const pArea = document.getElementById('profilePrefsArea');
    pArea.innerHTML = `
      <div class="toggle-row"><span>Show suggestion cards after saving</span><div class="toggle ${state.prefs.showPitches?'on':''}" id="togglePitches"></div></div>
      <div class="toggle-row"><span>Reset dismissed suggestions</span><button id="resetDismiss" style="background:none;border:none;color:#6690D6;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;">Reset</button></div>
    `;
    document.getElementById('togglePitches').addEventListener('click', function(){ state.prefs.showPitches = !state.prefs.showPitches; saveState(); this.classList.toggle('on'); });
    document.getElementById('resetDismiss').addEventListener('click', ()=>{ state.dismissFindProfessional=false; state.dismissJoinGroup=false; saveState(); showToast('Suggestions reset'); });
  }

  // ================= INIT =================
  renderBubbles();
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

```

```
// ================= DATE HELPERS (shared by WHO-5 / Calendar / Body Doubling) =================
function pad2(n){ return n < 10 ? '0'+n : ''+n; }
function keyFor(d){ return d.getFullYear()+'-'+pad2(d.getMonth()+1)+'-'+pad2(d.getDate()); }
var TODAY = new Date();
var TODAY_KEY = keyFor(TODAY);
function uidGen(){ return Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,10); }
function getTasks(dateKey){
  if(!appState.tasksByDate[dateKey]) appState.tasksByDate[dateKey] = [];
  return appState.tasksByDate[dateKey];
}
function moodsForDate(dateKey){
  var out = [];
  appState.entries.forEach(function(e){
    if(keyFor(new Date(e.date)) === dateKey){
      e.moods.forEach(function(m){ out.push(m); });
    }
  });
  return out;
}

// ================= WHO-5 =================
var WHO5_ITEMS = [
  'I have felt cheerful and in good spirits',
  'I have felt calm and relaxed',
  'I have felt active and vigorous',
  'I woke up feeling fresh and rested',

];

  showOnly('panel-who5');
};
document.getElementById('who5BackBtn').onclick = function(){ showOnly('panel-bubbles'); setActiveNav('navHome'); };
function renderWho5(){
  document.getElementById('who5Idx').textContent = who5Idx + 1;
  document.getElementById('who5Item').textContent = WHO5_ITEMS[who5Idx];
  document.getElementById('who5Prog').style.width = (((who5Idx+1)/5)*100)+'%';
  var wrap = document.getElementById('who5Scale');
  wrap.innerHTML = '';
  for(var v=0; v<=5; v++){
    (function(v){
      var btn = document.createElement('button');
      btn.textContent = v;
      btn.style.cssText = 'width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:50%;border:1.5px solid #D9C9A3;background:#FFFFFF;color:#2A2013;font-weight:700;font-size:13px;cursor:pointer;';
      btn.onclick = function(){
        who5Answers[who5Idx] = v;
        who5Idx++;
        if(who5Idx >= 5){ finishWho5(); } else { renderWho5(); }
      };
      wrap.appendChild(btn);
    })(v);
  }
}
function finishWho5(){
  var raw = who5Answers.reduce(function(a,b){ return a+b; }, 0);
  var pct = raw * 4;
  appState.who5History.push({ date: TODAY_KEY, score: pct });
  saveState();
  document.getElementById('who5ScoreText').textContent = pct;
  var circumference = 157; // approx length of the arc path
  var offset = circumference - (pct/100)*circumference;
  document.getElementById('who5Arc').setAttribute('stroke-dasharray', circumference);
  document.getElementById('who5Arc').setAttribute('stroke-dashoffset', offset);
  showOnly('panel-who5-results');
}
document.getElementById('who5DoneBtn').onclick = function(){ showOnly('panel-bubbles'); setActiveNav('navHome'); };

// ================= CALENDAR =================
var viewYear = TODAY.getFullYear(), viewMonth = TODAY.getMonth();
var MONTH_NAMES = ['January','February','March','April','May','June','July','August','September','October','November','December'];
var MOOD_COLOR_MAP = {}; // built from live bubble colors so calendar always matches the picker exactly
moods.forEach(function(m){ MOOD_COLOR_MAP[m.label] = 'hsl('+m.h+','+m.s+'%,'+m.l+'%)'; });

function renderCalendar(){
  document.getElementById('monthTitle').textContent = MONTH_NAMES[viewMonth] + ' ' + viewYear;
  var grid = document.getElementById('dayGrid');
  grid.innerHTML = '';
  var firstDay = new Date(viewYear, viewMonth, 1).getDay();
  var daysInMonth = new Date(viewYear, viewMonth+1, 0).getDate();
  for(var i=0; i<firstDay; i++){
    var empty = document.createElement('div'); empty.className = 'day-cell empty'; grid.appendChild(empty);
  }
  for(var day=1; day<=daysInMonth; day++){
    (function(day){
      var key = viewYear+'-'+pad2(viewMonth+1)+'-'+pad2(day);
      var cell = document.createElement('div');
      cell.className = 'day-cell' + ((viewYear===TODAY.getFullYear() && viewMonth===TODAY.getMonth() && day===TODAY.getDate()) ? ' today' : '');
      var num = document.createElement('div'); num.className = 'day-num'; num.textContent = day; cell.appendChild(num);
      var dayMoods = moodsForDate(key);
      if(dayMoods.length){
        var dotsWrap = document.createElement('div'); dotsWrap.className = 'mood-dots-cal';
        dayMoods.slice(0,3).forEach(function(m){
          var dot = document.createElement('span'); dot.className = 'mood-dot-cal'; dot.style.background = m.color;
          dotsWrap.appendChild(dot);
        });
        cell.appendChild(dotsWrap);
      }
      var tasks = getTasks(key);
      if(tasks.length){
        var allDone = tasks.every(function(t){ return t.done; });
        var ind = document.createElement('span'); ind.className = 'task-indicator ' + (allDone ? 'done' : 'pending');
        cell.appendChild(ind);
      }
      cell.onclick = function(){ openDay(key); };
      grid.appendChild(cell);
    })(day);
  }
}

    moodArea.innerHTML = '<div class="mood-chip-row">' + dayMoods.map(function(m){
      return '<span class="mood-chip-cal" style="background:'+m.color+'22;"><span class="mood-dot-cal" style="width:8px;height:8px;background:'+m.color+';display:inline-block;"></span>'+m.label+'</span>';
    }).join('') + '</div>';
  } else {
    moodArea.innerHTML = '<p class="empty-mood">No mood logged this day yet.</p>';
  }
  document.getElementById('startBodyDoubleBtn').style.display = (activeDayKey === TODAY_KEY) ? 'block' : 'none';
  renderTaskListCal();
}
document.getElementById('startBodyDoubleBtn').onclick = function(){
  renderBodyDouble();
  showOnly('panel-bodydouble');
};
function renderTaskListCal(){
  var listEl = document.getElementById('taskListCal');
  var tasks = getTasks(activeDayKey);
  listEl.innerHTML = '';
  tasks.forEach(function(task){
    var item = document.createElement('div'); item.className = 'task-item';
    var row = document.createElement('div'); row.className = 'task-row';
    var cb = document.createElement('div'); cb.className = 'task-checkbox' + (task.done ? ' done' : ''); cb.innerHTML = task.done ? '✓' : '';
    cb.onclick = function(){ toggleTaskCal(task.id); };
    row.appendChild(cb);
    var title = document.createElement('span'); title.className = 'task-title-cal' + (task.done ? ' done' : ''); title.textContent = task.title;
    row.appendChild(title);
    var bd = document.createElement('button'); bd.className = 'breakdown-btn'; bd.textContent = '+';
    bd.onclick = function(){ toggleSubtaskForm(item, task.id); };
    row.appendChild(bd);
    item.appendChild(row);
    if(task.subtasks && task.subtasks.length){
      var subList = document.createElement('div'); subList.className = 'subtask-list';
      task.subtasks.forEach(function(sub){
        var subRow = document.createElement('div'); subRow.className = 'subtask-row';
        var scb = document.createElement('div'); scb.className = 'sub-checkbox' + (sub.done ? ' done' : '');
        scb.onclick = function(){ toggleSubtask(task.id, sub.id); };
        subRow.appendChild(scb);
        var stitle = document.createElement('span'); stitle.className = 'subtask-title' + (sub.done ? ' done' : ''); stitle.textContent = sub.title;
        subRow.appendChild(stitle);
        subList.appendChild(subRow);
      });
      item.appendChild(subList);
    }
    listEl.appendChild(item);
  });
}
function toggleSubtaskForm(container, taskId){
  var existing = container.querySelector('.subtask-add');
  if(existing){ existing.remove(); return; }
  var wrap = document.createElement('div'); wrap.className = 'subtask-add';
  wrap.innerHTML = '<input type="text" placeholder="Break this into a smaller step..."><button>Add</button>';
  var input = wrap.querySelector('input'), btn = wrap.querySelector('button');
  btn.onclick = function(){ if(!input.value.trim()) return; addSubtask(taskId, input.value.trim()); wrap.remove(); };
  container.appendChild(wrap); input.focus();
}
function addSubtask(taskId, title){
  var task = getTasks(activeDayKey).find(function(t){ return t.id === taskId; });
  if(!task.subtasks) task.subtasks = [];
  task.subtasks.push({ id: uidGen(), title: title, done:false });
  saveState(); renderTaskListCal();
}
function toggleSubtask(taskId, subId){
  var task = getTasks(activeDayKey).find(function(t){ return t.id === taskId; });
  var sub = task.subtasks.find(function(s){ return s.id === subId; });
  sub.done = !sub.done;
  if(sub.done && task.subtasks.every(function(s){ return s.done; }) && !task.done){
    task.done = true; saveState(); renderTaskListCal(); showCelebration(task); return;
  }
  saveState(); renderTaskListCal();
}
function toggleTaskCal(taskId){

// ================= CELEBRATION / MINDMAP =================
var COOKIE_LINES = [
  "You did it! Look what you built today!",
  "One more brick in the wall you're building. Proud of you.",
  "That's not nothing. That's real, actual progress.",
  "Small step, real step. Both count the same to me.",
  "You showed up for yourself today. That matters."
];
function showCelebration(task){
  lastCelebratedTask = task;
  document.getElementById('cookieLine').textContent = COOKIE_LINES[Math.floor(Math.random()*COOKIE_LINES.length)];
  drawMindmap();
  showOnly('panel-celebration');
}
document.getElementById('celebBackBtn').onclick = function(){ showOnly('panel-day'); renderDayPanel(); };
document.getElementById('keepGoingBtn').onclick = function(){ showOnly('panel-day'); renderDayPanel(); };
function drawMindmap(){
  var svg = document.getElementById('mindmapSvg'); svg.innerHTML = '';
  var doneTasks = getTasks(activeDayKey).filter(function(t){ return t.done; });
  var cx=140, cy=95, r=32; var ns = 'http://www.w3.org/2000/svg';
  doneTasks.forEach(function(t,i){
    var angle = (i / Math.max(doneTasks.length,1)) * Math.PI*2 - Math.PI/2;
    var nx = cx + Math.cos(angle)*76, ny = cy + Math.sin(angle)*58;
    var line = document.createElementNS(ns,'line');
    line.setAttribute('x1',cx); line.setAttribute('y1',cy); line.setAttribute('x2',nx); line.setAttribute('y2',ny);
    line.setAttribute('stroke','#D9C9A3'); line.setAttribute('stroke-width','2'); svg.appendChild(line);
    var node = document.createElementNS(ns,'circle');
    node.setAttribute('cx',nx); node.setAttribute('cy',ny); node.setAttribute('r',22);
    node.setAttribute('fill', t===lastCelebratedTask ? '#3B8F63' : '#EAF4EE'); svg.appendChild(node);
    var label = document.createElementNS(ns,'text');
    label.setAttribute('x',nx); label.setAttribute('y',ny+38); label.setAttribute('text-anchor','middle');
    label.setAttribute('font-size','9'); label.setAttribute('fill','#5C6B94');
    label.textContent = t.title.length>14 ? t.title.slice(0,13)+'…' : t.title; svg.appendChild(label);
  });
  var center = document.createElementNS(ns,'circle');
  center.setAttribute('cx',cx); center.setAttribute('cy',cy); center.setAttribute('r',r); center.setAttribute('fill','#FDB913');
  svg.appendChild(center);
  var centerText = document.createElementNS(ns,'text');
  centerText.setAttribute('x',cx); centerText.setAttribute('y',cy+4); centerText.setAttribute('text-anchor','middle');
  centerText.setAttribute('font-size','10'); centerText.setAttribute('font-weight','700'); centerText.setAttribute('fill','#2E3A5A');
  centerText.textContent = (activeDayKey === TODAY_KEY) ? 'Today' : activeDayKey.slice(5); svg.appendChild(centerText);
}

// ================= SHARE SHEET =================
var toastTimer;
function showToast(msg){
  var t = document.getElementById('toastMsg');
  t.textContent = msg; t.classList.add('show');
  clearTimeout(toastTimer);
  toastTimer = setTimeout(function(){ t.classList.remove('show'); }, 2400);
}
document.getElementById('shareProgressBtn').onclick = function(){ document.getElementById('shareOverlay').style.display = 'flex'; };
document.getElementById('closeShareBtn').onclick = function(){ document.getElementById('shareOverlay').style.display = 'none'; };
document.querySelectorAll('.share-opt').forEach(function(btn){
  btn.onclick = function(){ handleShare(btn.getAttribute('data-target')); };
});
document.getElementById('moreShareBtn').onclick = function(){ handleShare('more'); };
function handleShare(target){
  document.getElementById('shareOverlay').style.display = 'none';
  if(target === 'therapist'){ showToast('Sent to ' + (appState.therapistName || 'your therapist') + ' ✓'); return; }
  if(target === 'group'){ showToast('Posted to your body doubling group ✓'); return; }
  if(typeof html2canvas === 'undefined'){ showToast("Screenshot library didn't load — check your connection"); return; }
  html2canvas(document.getElementById('celebrationCard'), { backgroundColor:'#FFF8F0', scale:2 }).then(function(canvas){
    canvas.toBlob(function(blob){
      var file = new File([blob], 'hobs-progress.png', { type:'image/png' });
      if(navigator.canShare && navigator.canShare({ files:[file] })){
        navigator.share({ files:[file], title:'My progress today', text:'Sharing my progress from HOBS Companion' }).catch(function(){});
        return;
      }
      var url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      var a = document.createElement('a'); a.href = url; a.download = 'hobs-progress.png'; a.click();
      showToast(target==='whatsapp' ? 'Image saved — attach it in WhatsApp' : target==='instagram' ? 'Image saved — add it to your Story' : 'Image saved to your device');
    }, 'image/png');
  }).catch(function(){ showToast("Couldn't capture image right now"); });
}

// ================= SHARED ADD-TASK SHEET (used by Calendar day view + Body Doubling) =================
var sheetTargetDate = TODAY_KEY;
function openAddTaskSheet(dateKey){

var bdSelectedKey = TODAY_KEY;

document.getElementById('bdTodayToggle').onclick = function(){

  document.getElementById('bdWeekStrip').style.display = bdStripOpen ? 'flex' : 'none';
  document.getElementById('bdTodayChevron').style.transform = bdStripOpen ? 'rotate(0deg)' : 'rotate(180deg)';

function renderBodyDouble(){
  bdSelectedKey = TODAY_KEY;
  renderBodyDoubleWeekStrip();
  renderBodyDoubleTaskList();
}
function renderBodyDoubleWeekStrip(){
  var strip = document.getElementById('bdWeekStrip');
  strip.innerHTML = '';
  var base = new Date(TODAY);
  base.setDate(base.getDate() - base.getDay());
  var dayLetters = ['S','M','T','W','T','F','S'];
  for(var i=0;i<7;i++){
    (function(i){
      var d = new Date(base); d.setDate(base.getDate()+i);
      var key = keyFor(d);
      var isSelected = key === bdSelectedKey;
      var isToday = key === TODAY_KEY;
      var cell = document.createElement('div');
      cell.className = 'bd-week-day';
      cell.style.background = isSelected ? '#E9F0FB' : 'transparent';
      cell.innerHTML =
        '<span style="font-size:10px;color:#9AABCE;font-weight:700;">'+dayLetters[i]+'</span>'+
        '<span style="width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:50%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;'+
          (isToday ? 'background:#6690D6;color:#FFFFFF;' : 'color:#2A2013;')+'">'+d.getDate()+'</span>';
      cell.onclick = function(){ bdSelectedKey = key; renderBodyDoubleWeekStrip(); renderBodyDoubleTaskList(); };
      strip.appendChild(cell);
    })(i);
  }
}
function renderBodyDoubleTaskList(){
  var tasks = getTasks(bdSelectedKey);
  document.getElementById('bdTaskCount').textContent = tasks.length + (tasks.length === 1 ? ' task' : ' tasks');
  var listEl = document.getElementById('bodyDoubleTaskList');
  listEl.innerHTML = '';
  if(!tasks.length){
    listEl.innerHTML = '<p style="text-align:center;color:#B0AA98;font-size:12px;font-style:italic;">No tasks queued — that\'s fine, just showing up counts.</p>';
    return;
  }
  tasks.forEach(function(task){
    var item = document.createElement('div'); item.className = 'task-item';
    var row = document.createElement('div'); row.className = 'task-row';
    var cb = document.createElement('div'); cb.className = 'task-checkbox' + (task.done ? ' done' : ''); cb.innerHTML = task.done ? '✓' : '';
    cb.onclick = function(){
      task.done = !task.done; saveState(); renderBodyDoubleTaskList();
      if(task.done){ activeDayKey = bdSelectedKey; showCelebration(task); }
    };
    row.appendChild(cb);
    var title = document.createElement('span'); title.className = 'task-title-cal' + (task.done ? ' done' : ''); title.textContent = task.title;
    row.appendChild(title);
    item.appendChild(row);
    listEl.appendChild(item);
  });
}
</script>
```

```
// ---- Date helpers shared by Calendar / Body Doubling ----
function pad2(n){ return n < 10 ? '0'+n : ''+n; }
function keyFor(d){ return d.getFullYear()+'-'+pad2(d.getMonth()+1)+'-'+pad2(d.getDate()); }
var TODAY_DATE = new Date();
var TODAY_KEY = keyFor(TODAY_DATE);
function uidGen(){ return Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,10); }

if(!appState.tasksByDate){ appState.tasksByDate = {}; }
function getTasks(dateKey){
  if(!appState.tasksByDate[dateKey]) appState.tasksByDate[dateKey] = [];
  return appState.tasksByDate[dateKey];
}
function moodsForDate(dateKey){
  var out = [];
  appState.entries.forEach(function(e){
    if(keyFor(new Date(e.date)) === dateKey){ e.moods.forEach(function(m){ out.push(m); }); }
  });
  return out;
}

// ---- Calendar (month grid: mood + task dots) ----
var viewYear = TODAY_DATE.getFullYear(), viewMonth = TODAY_DATE.getMonth();
var MONTH_NAMES = ['January','February','March','April','May','June','July','August','September','October','November','December'];

function renderCalendar(){
  document.getElementById('monthTitle').textContent = MONTH_NAMES[viewMonth] + ' ' + viewYear;
  var grid = document.getElementById('dayGrid');
  grid.innerHTML = '';
  var firstDay = new Date(viewYear, viewMonth, 1).getDay();
  var daysInMonth = new Date(viewYear, viewMonth+1, 0).getDate();
  for(var i=0; i<firstDay; i++){
    var empty = document.createElement('div'); empty.className = 'day-cell empty'; grid.appendChild(empty);
  }
  for(var day=1; day<=daysInMonth; day++){
    (function(day){
      var key = viewYear+'-'+pad2(viewMonth+1)+'-'+pad2(day);
      var cell = document.createElement('div');
      cell.className = 'day-cell' + ((viewYear===TODAY_DATE.getFullYear() && viewMonth===TODAY_DATE.getMonth() && day===TODAY_DATE.getDate()) ? ' today' : '');
      var num = document.createElement('div'); num.className = 'day-num'; num.textContent = day; cell.appendChild(num);
      var dayMoods = moodsForDate(key);
      if(dayMoods.length){
        var dotsWrap = document.createElement('div'); dotsWrap.className = 'mood-dots-cal';
        dayMoods.slice(0,3).forEach(function(m){
          var dot = document.createElement('span'); dot.className = 'mood-dot-cal'; dot.style.background = m.color;
          dotsWrap.appendChild(dot);
        });
        cell.appendChild(dotsWrap);
      }
      var tasks = getTasks(key);
      if(tasks.length){
        var allDone = tasks.every(function(t){ return t.done; });
        var ind = document.createElement('span'); ind.className = 'task-indicator ' + (allDone ? 'done' : 'pending');
        cell.appendChild(ind);
      }
      cell.onclick = function(){ openDay(key); };
      grid.appendChild(cell);
    })(day);
  }
}
document.getElementById('prevMonthBtn').onclick = function(){ viewMonth--; if(viewMonth<0){ viewMonth=11; viewYear--; } renderCalendar(); };
document.getElementById('nextMonthBtn').onclick = function(){ viewMonth++; if(viewMonth>11){ viewMonth=0; viewYear++; } renderCalendar(); };

// ---- Day detail ----
var activeDayKey = null, lastCelebratedTask = null;
function openDay(key){
  activeDayKey = key;
  showOnly('panel-day');
  renderDayPanel();
}
document.getElementById('dayBackBtn').onclick = function(){ renderCalendar(); showOnly('panel-calendar'); setActiveNav('navTasks'); };
function renderDayPanel(){
  var parts = activeDayKey.split('-').map(Number);
  var dObj = new Date(parts[0], parts[1]-1, parts[2]);
  document.getElementById('dayDateTitle').textContent = dObj.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { weekday:'long', month:'long', day:'numeric' });
  var moodArea = document.getElementById('dayMoodArea');
  var dayMoods = moodsForDate(activeDayKey);
  if(dayMoods.length){
    moodArea.innerHTML = '<div class="mood-chip-row">' + dayMoods.map(function(m){
      return '<span class="mood-chip-cal" style="background:'+m.color+'22;"><span class="mood-dot-cal" style="width:8px;height:8px;background:'+m.color+';display:inline-block;"></span>'+m.label+'</span>';
    }).join('') + '</div>';
  } else {
    moodArea.innerHTML = '<p class="empty-mood">No mood logged this day yet.</p>';
  }
  document.getElementById('startBodyDoubleBtn').style.display = (activeDayKey === TODAY_KEY) ? 'block' : 'none';
  renderTaskListCal();
}
document.getElementById('startBodyDoubleBtn').onclick = function(){ openBodyDouble(); };
function renderTaskListCal(){
  var listEl = document.getElementById('taskListCal');
  var tasks = getTasks(activeDayKey);
  listEl.innerHTML = '';
  tasks.forEach(function(task){
    var item = document.createElement('div'); item.className = 'task-item';
    var row = document.createElement('div'); row.className = 'task-row';
    var cb = document.createElement('div'); cb.className = 'task-checkbox' + (task.done ? ' done' : ''); cb.innerHTML = task.done ? '✓' : '';
    cb.onclick = function(){ toggleTaskCal(task.id); };
    row.appendChild(cb);
    var title = document.createElement('span'); title.className = 'task-title-cal' + (task.done ? ' done' : ''); title.textContent = task.title;
    row.appendChild(title);
    var bd = document.createElement('button'); bd.className = 'breakdown-btn'; bd.textContent = '+';
    bd.onclick = function(){ toggleSubtaskForm(item, task.id); };
    row.appendChild(bd);
    item.appendChild(row);

      var subList = document.createElement('div'); subList.className = 'subtask-list';
      task.subtasks.forEach(function(sub){
        var subRow = document.createElement('div'); subRow.className = 'subtask-row';
        var scb = document.createElement('div'); scb.className = 'sub-checkbox' + (sub.done ? ' done' : '');
        scb.onclick = function(){ toggleSubtask(task.id, sub.id); };
        subRow.appendChild(scb);
        var stitle = document.createElement('span'); stitle.className = 'subtask-title' + (sub.done ? ' done' : ''); stitle.textContent = sub.title;
        subRow.appendChild(stitle);
        subList.appendChild(subRow);
      });
      item.appendChild(subList);
    }
    listEl.appendChild(item);
  });
}
function toggleSubtaskForm(container, taskId){
  var existing = container.querySelector('.subtask-add');
  if(existing){ existing.remove(); return; }
  var wrap = document.createElement('div'); wrap.className = 'subtask-add';
  wrap.innerHTML = '<input type="text" placeholder="Break this into a smaller step..."><button>Add</button>';
  var input = wrap.querySelector('input'), btn = wrap.querySelector('button');
  btn.onclick = function(){ if(!input.value.trim()) return; addSubtask(taskId, input.value.trim()); wrap.remove(); };
  container.appendChild(wrap); input.focus();
}
function addSubtask(taskId, title){
  var task = getTasks(activeDayKey).find(function(t){ return t.id === taskId; });
  if(!task.subtasks) task.subtasks = [];
  task.subtasks.push({ id: uidGen(), title: title, done:false });
  saveState(); renderTaskListCal();
}
function toggleSubtask(taskId, subId){
  var task = getTasks(activeDayKey).find(function(t){ return t.id === taskId; });
  var sub = task.subtasks.find(function(s){ return s.id === subId; });
  sub.done = !sub.done;
  if(sub.done && task.subtasks.every(function(s){ return s.done; }) && !task.done){

}

  var input = document.getElementById('newTaskInputCal');
  if(!input.value.trim()) return;
  getTasks(activeDayKey).push({ id: uidGen(), title: input.value.trim(), done:false, subtasks:[] });

};

var toastTimer;
function showToast(msg){
  var t = document.getElementById('toastMsg');
  t.textContent = msg; t.classList.add('show');
  clearTimeout(toastTimer);
  toastTimer = setTimeout(function(){ t.classList.remove('show'); }, 2400);

document.getElementById('shareProgressBtn').onclick = function(){ document.getElementById('shareOverlay').style.display = 'flex'; };
document.getElementById('closeShareBtn').onclick = function(){ document.getElementById('shareOverlay').style.display = 'none'; };
document.querySelectorAll('.share-opt').forEach(function(btn){
  btn.onclick = function(){ handleShare(btn.getAttribute('data-target')); };
});
document.getElementById('moreShareBtn').onclick = function(){ handleShare('more'); };
function handleShare(target){
  document.getElementById('shareOverlay').style.display = 'none';
  if(target === 'therapist'){ showToast('Sent to ' + (appState.therapistName || 'your therapist') + ' ✓'); return; }
  if(target === 'group'){ showToast('Posted to your body doubling group ✓'); return; }
  if(typeof html2canvas === 'undefined'){ showToast("Screenshot library didn't load — check your connection"); return; }
  html2canvas(document.getElementById('celebrationCard'), { backgroundColor:'#FFF8F0', scale:2 }).then(function(canvas){
    canvas.toBlob(function(blob){
      var file = new File([blob], 'hobs-progress.png', { type:'image/png' });
      if(navigator.canShare && navigator.canShare({ files:[file] })){
        navigator.share({ files:[file], title:'My progress today', text:'Sharing my progress from HOBS Companion' }).catch(function(){});
        return;
      }
      var url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      var a = document.createElement('a'); a.href = url; a.download = 'hobs-progress.png'; a.click();
      showToast(target==='whatsapp' ? 'Image saved — attach it in WhatsApp' : target==='instagram' ? 'Image saved — add it to your Story' : 'Image saved to your device');
    }, 'image/png');
  }).catch(function(){ showToast("Couldn't capture image right now"); });
}
```

```
var PRIORITY_COLORS = { low:'#9AABCE', medium:'#FDB913', high:'#C77B7B' };
function formatDeadline(iso){
  var d = new Date(iso), now = new Date();
  var diffMs = d - now;
  var mins = Math.round(diffMs/60000);
  if(mins < 0) return { text:'Was due ' + d.toLocaleDateString('en-US',{month:'short',day:'numeric'}), color:'#B0AA98' };
  if(mins < 60) return { text:'Due in ' + mins + 'm', color:'#C77B7B' };
  var hrs = Math.round(mins/60);
  if(hrs < 24) return { text:'Due in ' + hrs + 'h', color:'#9A7B3E' };
  var days = Math.round(hrs/24);
  return { text:'Due in ' + days + (days===1?' day':' days'), color:'#5C6B94' };
}
function cyclePriority(taskId, dateKey, rerender){
  var order = [null,'low','medium','high'];
  var task = getTasks(dateKey).find(function(t){ return t.id === taskId; });
  var idx = order.indexOf(task.priority || null);
  task.priority = order[(idx+1) % order.length];
  saveState(); rerender();
}
```

```
function openAddTaskSheet(dateKey){
  sheetTargetKey = dateKey || bdSelectedKey || TODAY_KEY;
  document.getElementById('sheetTaskInput').value = '';
  sheetDuration = 30; sheetRepeat = false; sheetPriority = null;

}

};

document.getElementById('sheetRepeatChip').onclick = function(){

  this.style.color = sheetRepeat ? '#6690D6' : '#9AABCE';
};

document.querySelectorAll('.priority-chip').forEach(function(chip){
  chip.onclick = function(){
    var p = chip.getAttribute('data-priority');
    sheetPriority = (sheetPriority === p) ? null : p;
    document.querySelectorAll('.priority-chip').forEach(function(c){ c.style.outline = 'none'; c.style.boxShadow = 'none'; });
    if(sheetPriority) chip.style.boxShadow = 'inset 0 0 0 2px ' + PRIORITY_COLORS[sheetPriority];
  };
});

document.getElementById('sheetDeadlineToggle').onclick = function(){
  this.style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('sheetDeadlineInput').style.display = 'block';
  document.getElementById('sheetDeadlineInput').focus();
};

document.getElementById('sheetSaveTaskBtn').onclick = function(){
  var title = document.getElementById('sheetTaskInput').value.trim();
  if(!title) return;
  var deadlineVal = document.getElementById('sheetDeadlineInput').value;
  getTasks(sheetTargetKey).push({
    id: uidGen(), title: title, duration: sheetDuration, repeat: sheetRepeat,
    priority: sheetPriority, deadline: deadlineVal ? new Date(deadlineVal).toISOString() : null,
    done: false, subtasks: []
  });
  saveState();
  closeAddTaskSheet();
  if(sheetTargetKey === bdSelectedKey) renderBodyDoubleTaskList();
  if(sheetTargetKey === activeDayKey) renderTaskListCal();
};
```

```
function renderProgressTimeline(){
  var wrap = document.getElementById('progressTimeline');
  wrap.innerHTML = '';
  var keys = Object.keys(appState.tasksByDate).filter(function(k){ return appState.tasksByDate[k].length > 0; }).sort();
  if(!keys.length){
    wrap.innerHTML = '<p class="empty-mood" style="text-align:center;">No tasks yet — add one from the Calendar and it\'ll show up here.</p>';
    return;
  }
  keys.forEach(function(key){
    var tasks = appState.tasksByDate[key];
    var parts = key.split('-').map(Number);
    var label = new Date(parts[0], parts[1]-1, parts[2]).toLocaleDateString('en-US', { weekday:'short', month:'short', day:'numeric' });
    var dayBlock = document.createElement('div'); dayBlock.className = 'timeline-day';
    dayBlock.innerHTML = '<p class="timeline-date">' + label + (key === TODAY_KEY ? ' · Today' : '') + '</p>';

      var cb = document.createElement('div'); cb.className = 'task-checkbox' + (t.done ? ' done' : ''); cb.innerHTML = t.done ? '✓' : '';
      cb.onclick = function(){
        t.done = !t.done; saveState();
        if(t.done) checkAchievements();
        renderProgressTimeline();
      };
      row.appendChild(cb);
      var pdot = document.createElement('span'); pdot.className = 'priority-dot';
      pdot.style.background = t.priority ? PRIORITY_COLORS[t.priority] : '#EEE0C4';
      pdot.onclick = function(){ cyclePriority(t.id, key, renderProgressTimeline); };
      row.appendChild(pdot);
      var title = document.createElement('span'); title.style.cssText = 'flex:1;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:#2A2013;' + (t.done ? 'text-decoration:line-through;color:#B0AA98;' : '');
      title.textContent = t.title;
      row.appendChild(title);
      dayBlock.appendChild(row);
    });
    wrap.appendChild(dayBlock);
  });
}

var BADGES = [

  { count:10, emoji:'⭐', name:'In the Groove',      desc:'10 tasks done — real rhythm forming.' },
  { count:25, emoji:'💎', name:'Consistency Star',  desc:'25 tasks done. That\'s dedication.' },
  { count:50, emoji:'🏆', name:'Unstoppable',        desc:'50 tasks done. Look how far you\'ve come.' }
];
function totalCompletedCount(){
  var total = 0;
  Object.keys(appState.tasksByDate).forEach(function(key){
    appState.tasksByDate[key].forEach(function(t){
      if(t.done) total++;
      if(t.subtasks) t.subtasks.forEach(function(s){ if(s.done) total += 0.5; });
    });
  });
  return Math.floor(total);
}
function checkAchievements(){
  var count = totalCompletedCount();
  var newlyEarned = null;
  BADGES.forEach(function(b){
    if(count >= b.count && appState.lastBadgeCount < b.count){ newlyEarned = b; }
  });
  if(newlyEarned){ appState.lastBadgeCount = count; saveState(); }
  return newlyEarned;
}
function showAchievement(badge, thenFn){
  document.getElementById('achievementEmoji').textContent = badge.emoji;
  document.getElementById('achievementName').textContent = badge.name;
  document.getElementById('achievementDesc').textContent = badge.desc;
  document.getElementById('achievementOverlay').style.display = 'flex';
  fireConfetti();
  document.getElementById('achievementDoneBtn').onclick = function(){
    document.getElementById('achievementOverlay').style.display = 'none';
    thenFn();
  };
}
function renderAchievements(){
  var count = totalCompletedCount();
  var grid = document.getElementById('badgeGrid');
  grid.innerHTML = BADGES.map(function(b){
    var locked = count < b.count;
    return '<div class="badge-card' + (locked ? ' locked' : '') + '"><div class="badge-emoji">'+b.emoji+'</div><p class="badge-name">'+b.name+'</p><p class="badge-sub">'+(locked ? b.count + ' tasks to unlock' : b.desc)+'</p></div>';
  }).join('');
}
document.getElementById('openAchievementsBtn').onclick = function(){ renderAchievements(); showOnly('panel-achievements'); };
document.getElementById('achievementsBackBtn').onclick = function(){ showOnly('panel-calendar'); };

// lightweight confetti burst, no external library needed
function fireConfetti(){
  var canvas = document.getElementById('confettiCanvas');
  var rect = document.querySelector('.phone').getBoundingClientRect();
  canvas.width = rect.width; canvas.height = rect.height;
  canvas.style.left = rect.left + 'px'; canvas.style.top = rect.top + 'px';
  var ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  var colors = ['#FDB913','#6690D6','#5FAE7A','#C77B7B','#8C7AA8'];
  var particles = [];
  for(var i=0;i<70;i++){
    particles.push({
      x: canvas.width/2, y: canvas.height*0.35,
      vx: (Math.random()-0.5)*8, vy: (Math.random()-1.2)*8,
      size: 4+Math.random()*4, color: colors[Math.floor(Math.random()*colors.length)],
      rot: Math.random()*360, vr: (Math.random()-0.5)*10
    });
  }
  var frame = 0;
  function tick(){
    ctx.clearRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);
    frame++;
    particles.forEach(function(p){
      p.vy += 0.25; p.x += p.vx; p.y += p.vy; p.rot += p.vr;
      ctx.save(); ctx.translate(p.x,p.y); ctx.rotate(p.rot*Math.PI/180);
      ctx.fillStyle = p.color; ctx.fillRect(-p.size/2,-p.size/2,p.size,p.size);
      ctx.restore();
    });
    if(frame < 90) requestAnimationFrame(tick); else ctx.clearRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);
  }
  tick();
}
```

```
function finishWho5(){
```

```
  var score = raw * 4; // WHO-5 standard conversion: raw 0-25 -> 0-100
  appState.who5Entries.unshift({date: new Date().toISOString(), score: score});
  saveState();

  var arc = document.getElementById('who5Arc');
  var totalLen = 157; // approx length of the semicircle path
  arc.style.strokeDasharray = totalLen;
  arc.style.strokeDashoffset = totalLen * (1 - score/100);
  document.getElementById('who5ScoreText').textContent = score;

  var interp = document.getElementById('who5Interpretation');
  var supportArea = document.getElementById('who5SupportArea');
  supportArea.innerHTML = '';
  if(score <= 28){
    interp.textContent = "Scores this low sometimes go with a rough stretch. You don't have to sit with this alone.";
    var crisisNote = document.createElement('p');
    crisisNote.style.cssText = 'font-size:11px;color:#9AABCE;max-width:280px;margin:0 auto 14px;line-height:1.6;';
    crisisNote.textContent = "If it feels like too much right now: KIRAN Mental Health Helpline, 1800-599-0019, free and 24/7.";
    supportArea.appendChild(crisisNote);
    supportArea.appendChild(makeWho5SupportBtn());
  } else if(score <= 50){
    interp.textContent = "This suggests things have felt harder than usual lately. Talking it through can help — no pressure either way.";
    supportArea.appendChild(makeWho5SupportBtn());

  }

}

function makeWho5SupportBtn(){
```

```
document.getElementById('openAchievementsBtn').onclick = function(){ renderAchievements(); showOnly('panel-achievements'); };
document.getElementById('achievementsBackBtn').onclick = function(){ showOnly('panel-calendar'); };

// ================= REWARDS (credit math only — NOT a real payment system yet) =================
// IMPORTANT: this is prototype-only, cosmetic tracking using localStorage. Real money must
// never be driven by client-side data — see build log for the required backend before this
// can be wired to an actual voucher/payment.
var DAILY_CREDIT_CAP = 10;   // rs
var MONTHLY_CREDIT_CAP = 300; // rs

function completedTasksOnDate(key){
  return (appState.tasksByDate[key] || []).filter(function(t){ return t.done; }).length;
}
function renderRewards(){
  var todayCount = completedTasksOnDate(TODAY_KEY);
  var todayCredit = Math.min(todayCount, DAILY_CREDIT_CAP);

  var monthPrefix = TODAY_KEY.slice(0,7);
  var monthCredit = 0;
  Object.keys(appState.tasksByDate).forEach(function(key){
    if(key.slice(0,7) === monthPrefix){
      monthCredit += Math.min(completedTasksOnDate(key), DAILY_CREDIT_CAP);
    }
  });
  monthCredit = Math.min(monthCredit, MONTHLY_CREDIT_CAP);

  document.getElementById('rewardTodayValue').textContent = '₹' + todayCredit + ' / ₹' + DAILY_CREDIT_CAP;
  document.getElementById('rewardTodayBar').style.width = (todayCredit/DAILY_CREDIT_CAP*100) + '%';
  document.getElementById('rewardMonthValue').textContent = '₹' + monthCredit + ' / ₹' + MONTHLY_CREDIT_CAP;
  document.getElementById('rewardMonthBar').style.width = (monthCredit/MONTHLY_CREDIT_CAP*100) + '%';
}
document.getElementById('openRewardsBtn').onclick = function(){ renderRewards(); showOnly('panel-rewards'); };
document.getElementById('rewardsBackBtn').onclick = function(){ showOnly('panel-calendar'); };
```

```
document.getElementById('achievementsBackBtn').onclick = function(){ showOnly('panel-calendar'); };
```

NEW (exact):
```
document.getElementById('openAchievementsBtn').onclick = function(){ renderAchievements(); showOnly('panel-achievements'); };
document.getElementById('achievementsBackBtn').onclick = function(){ showOnly('panel-calendar'); };

// ================= SEARCH =================
function openSearch(){
  document.getElementById('searchInput').value = '';
  document.getElementById('searchResults').innerHTML = '';
  showOnly('panel-search');
  document.getElementById('searchInput').focus();
}
document.getElementById('headerSearchBtn').onclick = openSearch;
document.getElementById('profileSearchBtn').onclick = openSearch;
document.getElementById('searchBackBtn').onclick = function(){ showOnly('panel-bubbles'); setActiveNav('navHome'); };

document.getElementById('searchInput').addEventListener('input', function(){
  var q = this.value.trim().toLowerCase();
  var resultsEl = document.getElementById('searchResults');
  resultsEl.innerHTML = '';
  if(!q){ return; }

  var results = [];
  appState.entries.forEach(function(e){
    if(e.text && e.text.toLowerCase().indexOf(q) !== -1){
      var dateStr = new Date(e.date).toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month:'short', day:'numeric' });
      results.push({ type:'Journal · ' + dateStr, text:e.text, action:function(){ renderHistory(); showOnly('panel-history'); setActiveNav('navJournal'); } });
    }
  });
  Object.keys(appState.tasksByDate).forEach(function(key){
    appState.tasksByDate[key].forEach(function(t){
      if(t.title.toLowerCase().indexOf(q) !== -1){
        results.push({ type:'Task · ' + key, text:t.title, action:function(){ openDay(key); } });
      }
      (t.subtasks||[]).forEach(function(s){
        if(s.title.toLowerCase().indexOf(q) !== -1){
          results.push({ type:'Subtask · ' + key, text:s.title, action:function(){ openDay(key); } });
        }
      });
    });
  });

  if(!results.length){
    resultsEl.innerHTML = '<p class="empty-mood" style="text-align:center;">Nothing matching that yet.</p>';
    return;
  }
  results.forEach(function(r){
    var item = document.createElement('div'); item.className = 'search-result-item';
    item.innerHTML = '<p class="search-result-type">' + r.type + '</p><p class="search-result-text">' + r.text.replace(/</g,'&lt;') + '</p>';
    item.onclick = r.action;
    resultsEl.appendChild(item);
  });
});
```

```
if(!appState.who5Entries){ appState.who5Entries = []; }
```

NEW (exact):
```
// ---- WHO-5 bi-weekly follow-up (validated instrument recalls "the last two weeks" - bi-weekly cadence matches its actual clinical window, more accurate than a 7-day lock) ----
if(!appState.who5Entries){ appState.who5Entries = []; }

var who5Items = [
  'I have felt cheerful and in good spirits',
  'I have felt calm and relaxed',
  'I have felt active and vigorous',
  'I woke up feeling fresh and rested',
  'My daily life has been filled with things that interest me'
];
var who5Idx = 0;
var who5Answers = [];

function who5AlreadyDoneThisCycle(){
  if(appState.who5Entries.length === 0) return false;
  var last = new Date(appState.who5Entries[0].date);
  var days = (Date.now() - last.getTime()) / (1000*60*60*24);
  return days < 14;
}

function refreshWho5EntryButton(){
  var btn = document.getElementById('who5EntryBtn');
  if(who5AlreadyDoneThisCycle()){
    btn.textContent = 'Done for this cycle';
    btn.style.opacity = '0.5';
    btn.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
  } else {
    btn.textContent = 'Bi-weekly follow-up';
    btn.style.opacity = '1';
    btn.style.pointerEvents = 'auto';
  }
}
refreshWho5EntryButton();

document.getElementById('who5EntryBtn').onclick = function(){
  if(who5AlreadyDoneThisCycle()) return;
  who5Idx = 0;
  who5Answers = [];
  document.getElementById('who5Item').textContent = who5Items[0];
  document.getElementById('who5Idx').textContent = '1';
  document.getElementById('who5Prog').style.width = '20%';
  renderWho5Scale();
  showOnly('panel-who5');
};

// ---- Mood Tracker: real chart from actual mood entries, last 14 days ----
document.getElementById('openMoodTrackerBtn').onclick = function(){
  refreshWho5EntryButton();
  renderMoodChart();
  showOnly('panel-mood-tracker');
};
document.getElementById('moodTrackerBackBtn').onclick = function(){ showOnly('panel-bubbles'); setActiveNav('navHome'); };

function renderMoodChart(){
  var wrap = document.getElementById('moodChartBars');
  wrap.innerHTML = '';
  var cutoff = Date.now() - 14*24*60*60*1000;
  var counts = {}, colors = {};
  appState.entries.forEach(function(e){
    if(new Date(e.date).getTime() < cutoff) return;
    e.moods.forEach(function(m){
      counts[m.label] = (counts[m.label]||0) + 1;
      colors[m.label] = m.color;
    });
  });
  var labels = Object.keys(counts);
  if(!labels.length){
    wrap.parentElement.innerHTML = '<p class="mood-chart-empty">Check in on your mood a few times and your chart will show up here.</p>';
    return;
  }
  var maxCount = Math.max.apply(null, labels.map(function(l){ return counts[l]; }));
  labels.forEach(function(label){
    var col = document.createElement('div'); col.className = 'mood-chart-col';
    var bar = document.createElement('div'); bar.className = 'mood-chart-bar'; bar.style.background = colors[label];
    var lab = document.createElement('div'); lab.className = 'mood-chart-label'; lab.textContent = label;
    col.appendChild(bar); col.appendChild(lab);
    wrap.appendChild(col);
    setTimeout(function(){ bar.style.height = Math.max(8, (counts[label]/maxCount*120)) + 'px'; }, 50);
  });
}
```
