NEW (exact):
```
var HEAVY_MOODS = ['Anxious','Restless','Heavy','Tired'];
var LIGHT_MOODS = ['Excited','Hopeful','Calm','Content'];
var MOOD_AFFIRMATIONS = {
  light: [
    "You've been feeling pretty steady and good lately — that's worth noticing.",
    "Your recent days have leaned light. Enjoy that, however long it lasts.",
    "Things have looked good for you lately. I'm glad."
  ],
  heavy: [
    "It's looked like a heavier stretch lately. Be gentle with yourself — you're still showing up.",
    "Recent days have felt like a lot. Checking in like this, even now, still counts.",
    "This has looked like a harder few days. You don't have to push through it alone."
  ],
  mixed: [
    "Your days have had a real mix lately — ups and downs both count.",
    "Some easier days, some harder ones. That's most people's normal, not a failure.",
    "A bit of everything lately. Thanks for tracking it honestly."
  ]
};

function renderMoodChart(){
  var wrap = document.getElementById('moodChartBars');
  wrap.innerHTML = '';
  var windowDays = 14;
  var cutoff = Date.now() - windowDays*24*60*60*1000;
  var counts = {}, colors = {};
  var daysWithEntry = {};
  var heavyTotal = 0, lightTotal = 0;
  appState.entries.forEach(function(e){
    var t = new Date(e.date).getTime();
    if(t < cutoff) return;
    daysWithEntry[keyFor(new Date(e.date))] = true;
    e.moods.forEach(function(m){
      counts[m.label] = (counts[m.label]||0) + 1;
      colors[m.label] = m.color;
      if(HEAVY_MOODS.indexOf(m.label) !== -1) heavyTotal++;
      if(LIGHT_MOODS.indexOf(m.label) !== -1) lightTotal++;
    });
  });
  var dayCount = Object.keys(daysWithEntry).length;
  document.getElementById('moodChartDayCount').textContent = 'Checked in ' + dayCount + ' of the last ' + windowDays + ' days';

  var labels = Object.keys(counts);
  var affirmCard = document.getElementById('moodAffirmationCard');
  if(!labels.length){
    wrap.parentElement.innerHTML = '<p class="mood-chart-empty">Check in on your mood a few times and your chart will show up here.</p>';
    affirmCard.style.display = 'none';
    return;
  }
  var maxCount = Math.max.apply(null, labels.map(function(l){ return counts[l]; }));
  labels.forEach(function(label){
    var col = document.createElement('div'); col.className = 'mood-chart-col';
    var bar = document.createElement('div'); bar.className = 'mood-chart-bar'; bar.style.background = colors[label];
    var lab = document.createElement('div'); lab.className = 'mood-chart-label'; lab.textContent = label;
    col.appendChild(bar); col.appendChild(lab);
    wrap.appendChild(col);
    setTimeout(function(){ bar.style.height = Math.max(8, (counts[label]/maxCount*120)) + 'px'; }, 50);
  });

  var total = heavyTotal + lightTotal;
  var tier = 'mixed';
  if(total > 0){
    if(lightTotal / total >= 0.6) tier = 'light';
    else if(heavyTotal / total >= 0.6) tier = 'heavy';
  }
  var lines = MOOD_AFFIRMATIONS[tier];
  document.getElementById('moodAffirmationText').textContent = lines[Math.floor(Math.random()*lines.length)];
  affirmCard.style.display = 'flex';
```

```
// ================= MASCOT INTRODUCTIONS (comic speech bubble, positioned per-mascot) =================
function bobImgFallback(img){
  var span = document.createElement('span');
  span.innerHTML = '<svg viewBox="0 0 40 40" style="width:60px;height:60px;"><ellipse cx="8" cy="16" rx="5" ry="8" fill="#8C9FBF"/><ellipse cx="32" cy="16" rx="5" ry="8" fill="#8C9FBF"/><ellipse cx="20" cy="22" rx="13" ry="12" fill="#8C9FBF"/><ellipse cx="15" cy="21" rx="2" ry="2.6" fill="#2A2013"/><ellipse cx="25" cy="21" rx="2" ry="2.6" fill="#2A2013"/><path d="M18 29q2 3 4 0" stroke="#2A2013" stroke-width="1.4" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>';
  img.replaceWith(span.firstChild);
}
var MASCOTS = {
  bob: { name:'Bob', text:"Hi, I'm Bob. I'm not here to fix anything or tell you what to do — just to listen, really listen. Tell me more, whenever you're ready." },
  kunnu: { name:'Kunnu', text:"Hey, I'm Kunnu. I'm usually the one checking on everyone else, so I know exactly how much it matters when someone does it back. Come sit with us, okay?" },
  cookie: { name:'Cookie', text:"I'm Cookie! I love celebrating wins — big ones, tiny ones, doesn't matter. If you finished something today, I already think you're doing great." },
  po: { name:'Po', text:"Hi, I'm Po. I don't always have the answers — honestly, most days I'm still figuring things out too. But I'll sit with you while you do." }
};
function showMascotBubble(key, btnId){
  var m = MASCOTS[key];
  var bubble = document.getElementById('comicBubble');
  var btn = document.getElementById(btnId);
  document.getElementById('comicBubbleName').textContent = m.name;
  document.getElementById('comicBubbleText').textContent = m.text;
  bubble.style.display = 'block';
  var lineup = document.getElementById('mascotLineup');
  var lineupBox = lineup.getBoundingClientRect();
  var btnBox = btn.getBoundingClientRect();
  var left = btnBox.left - lineupBox.left + (btnBox.width/2) - 30;
  left = Math.max(4, Math.min(left, lineupBox.width - bubble.offsetWidth - 4));
  bubble.style.left = left + 'px';
  bubble.style.bottom = (lineupBox.height - (btnBox.top - lineupBox.top) + 14) + 'px';
  bubble.style.setProperty('--tail-left', (btnBox.left - lineupBox.left + btnBox.width/2 - left - 10) + 'px');
  bubble.querySelector('.comic-bubble')?.style && null;
  document.styleSheets[0]; // no-op guard
  bubble.style.setProperty('left', left + 'px');
  var tailOffset = (btnBox.left - lineupBox.left + btnBox.width/2 - left - 10);
  var styleTag = document.getElementById('comicTailStyle');
  if(!styleTag){ styleTag = document.createElement('style'); styleTag.id = 'comicTailStyle'; document.head.appendChild(styleTag); }
  styleTag.textContent = '.comic-bubble::after, .comic-bubble::before { left: ' + tailOffset + 'px; }';
}
document.getElementById('meetBobBtn').onclick = function(){ showMascotBubble('bob','meetBobBtn'); };
document.getElementById('meetKunnuBtn').onclick = function(){ showMascotBubble('kunnu','meetKunnuBtn'); };
document.getElementById('meetCookieBtn').onclick = function(){ showMascotBubble('cookie','meetCookieBtn'); };
document.getElementById('meetPoBtn').onclick = function(){ showMascotBubble('po','meetPoBtn'); };
document.getElementById('comicBubbleClose').onclick = function(){ document.getElementById('comicBubble').style.display = 'none'; };
document.getElementById('meetTeamBtn').onclick = function(){ showOnly('panel-team'); };
```

```
// ================= SCREENING TESTS =================
// NOTE: shortened, representative versions of standard public instruments, reframed per HOBS's
// established clinical-guardrail conventions (no diagnostic labels, gentle language). Verify exact
// item wording against the live homeofbeautifulsouls.com screening page before real launch.
var TESTS = {
  loneliness: {
    name: 'Loneliness Screening', color: '#6690D6',
    items: ['How often do you feel that you lack companionship?', 'How often do you feel left out?', 'How often do you feel isolated from others?'],
    scale: [{label:'Hardly ever', val:1}, {label:'Some of the time', val:2}, {label:'Often', val:3}],
    interpret: function(score){
      if(score <= 4) return { cat:'On the lighter side', text:"Your answers suggest you're feeling fairly connected right now." };
      if(score <= 6) return { cat:'Worth noticing', text:"There's some loneliness showing up here. That's common, and worth paying attention to." };
      return { cat:'Significant', text:"This suggests loneliness has been a real weight lately. Talking to someone about this can genuinely help." };
    }
  },
  trauma: {
    name: 'Trauma & Stress Response Screening', color: '#C77B7B',
    items: [
      'Repeated, disturbing memories of a stressful experience',
      'Feeling suddenly as if the experience were happening again',
      'Feeling very upset when reminded of the experience',
      'Avoiding thoughts or feelings related to the experience',
      'Avoiding activities or situations that remind you of it',
      'Trouble remembering important parts of the experience',
      'Feeling distant or cut off from other people',
      'Trouble falling or staying asleep',
      'Feeling irritable or having angry outbursts',
      'Difficulty concentrating'
    ],
    scale: [{label:'Not at all',val:0},{label:'A little bit',val:1},{label:'Moderately',val:2},{label:'Quite a bit',val:3},{label:'Extremely',val:4}],
    interpret: function(score){
      if(score <= 12) return { cat:'On the lighter side', text:"These experiences don't seem to be weighing heavily right now." };
      if(score <= 25) return { cat:'Worth noticing', text:"Some stress responses are showing up here. That's real, and worth exploring with someone." };
      return { cat:'Significant', text:"This suggests these experiences have been affecting you quite a bit. A trauma-informed professional can really help here." };
    }
  },
  dissociation: {
    name: 'Dissociative Experiences Screening', color: '#0F766E',
    items: [
      'Finding yourself in a place and having no idea how you got there',
      'Finding new things among your belongings that you don\'t remember buying',
      'Not recognizing friends or family members for a moment',
      'Feeling as though you\'re standing next to yourself, watching yourself do something',
      'Being told you sometimes don\'t recognize people you know well',
      'Feeling as if the world around you isn\'t real',
      'Not being sure whether things you remember happened or were a dream',
      'Finding yourself somewhere and not remembering how you got there'
    ],
    scale: [{label:'Never',val:0},{label:'Rarely',val:1},{label:'Sometimes',val:2},{label:'Often',val:3},{label:'Very often',val:4}],
    interpret: function(score){
      if(score <= 10) return { cat:'On the lighter side', text:"These experiences don't seem to come up much for you." };
      if(score <= 20) return { cat:'Worth noticing', text:"Some of these experiences show up sometimes. Worth mentioning to a professional." };
      return { cat:'Significant', text:"These experiences seem to come up often for you. A conversation with a trauma-informed professional could help a lot." };
    }
  }
};
var currentTestKey = null, testIdx = 0, testAnswers = [];

function renderTestsList(){
  var wrap = document.getElementById('testsList');
  wrap.innerHTML = '';
  Object.keys(TESTS).forEach(function(key){
    var t = TESTS[key];
    var card = document.createElement('div');
    card.style.cssText = 'background:#FFFFFF;border:1px solid #EEE0C4;border-left:4px solid '+t.color+';border-radius:14px;padding:16px;margin-bottom:10px;cursor:pointer;';
    card.innerHTML = '<p style="font-size:13.5px;font-weight:700;color:#2A2013;margin:0 0 4px;">'+t.name+'</p><p style="font-size:11px;color:#9AABCE;margin:0;">'+t.items.length+' questions · a couple minutes</p>';
    card.onclick = function(){ startTest(key); };
    wrap.appendChild(card);
  });
}
document.getElementById('openTestsBtn').onclick = function(){ renderTestsList(); showOnly('panel-tests'); };
document.getElementById('testsBackBtn').onclick = function(){ showOnly('panel-bubbles'); setActiveNav('navHome'); };
document.getElementById('testDetailBackBtn').onclick = function(){ showOnly('panel-tests'); };

function startTest(key){
  currentTestKey = key; testIdx = 0; testAnswers = [];
  renderTestItem();
  showOnly('panel-test-detail');
}
function renderTestItem(){
  var t = TESTS[currentTestKey];
  document.getElementById('testProgress').textContent = 'Question ' + (testIdx+1) + ' of ' + t.items.length;
  document.getElementById('testItemText').textContent = t.items[testIdx];
  document.getElementById('testProg').style.width = (((testIdx+1)/t.items.length)*100) + '%';
  var scaleWrap = document.getElementById('testScale');
  scaleWrap.innerHTML = '';
  t.scale.forEach(function(opt){
    var btn = document.createElement('button');
    btn.textContent = opt.label;
    btn.style.cssText = 'display:block;width:100%;padding:13px;border-radius:12px;border:1.5px solid #EEE0C4;background:#FFFFFF;color:#2A2013;font-size:13.5px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;margin-bottom:8px;';
    btn.onclick = function(){
      testAnswers[testIdx] = opt.val;
      testIdx++;
      if(testIdx >= t.items.length){ finishTest(); } else { renderTestItem(); }
    };
    scaleWrap.appendChild(btn);
  });
}
function finishTest(){
  var t = TESTS[currentTestKey];
  var score = testAnswers.reduce(function(a,b){ return a+b; }, 0);
  var result = t.interpret(score);
  document.getElementById('testResultTitle').textContent = t.name;
  document.getElementById('testResultScore').textContent = score;
  document.getElementById('testResultCategory').textContent = result.cat;
  document.getElementById('testResultText').textContent = result.text;
  var supportArea = document.getElementById('testResultSupportArea');
  supportArea.innerHTML = '';
  if(result.cat !== 'On the lighter side'){
    var btn = document.createElement('button');
    var connected = document.getElementById('demoHasTherapist').checked || appState.userHasTherapist;
    btn.textContent = connected ? 'Message ' + (appState.therapistName || 'your therapist') : 'Find someone to talk to';
    btn.style.cssText = 'display:block;width:100%;padding:15px;border-radius:14px;border:none;background:#6690D6;color:#FFF8F0;font-size:15px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;margin-bottom:12px;';
    btn.onclick = function(){
      if(connected){ showOnly('panel-booking'); }
      else {
        intakeReturnTo = 'bubbles';
        document.getElementById('intakeForm').style.display = 'block';
        document.getElementById('intakeThanks').style.display = 'none';
        showOnly('panel-intake');
      }
    };
    supportArea.appendChild(btn);
  }
  showOnly('panel-test-results');
}
document.getElementById('testResultDoneBtn').onclick = function(){ renderTestsList(); showOnly('panel-tests'); };

// ================= GROUNDING & RELAXATION =================

    steps: [
      'Breathe in slowly through your nose for 4 seconds.',
      'Hold that breath gently for 4 seconds.',
      'Breathe out slowly through your mouth for 4 seconds.',
      'Hold at the bottom for 4 seconds.',
      'Repeat this square of breath for a few rounds.'
    ]
  },
  pmr: {
    name: 'Progressive Muscle Relaxation', color:'#B5892E',
    steps: [
      'Start at your feet — tense the muscles tightly for 5 seconds, then release.',
      'Move up to your calves and thighs — tense, hold, release.',
      'Tense your stomach and chest — hold, then let go.',
      'Clench your hands and arms — hold, then release.',
      'Scrunch your shoulders up to your ears — hold, then drop them.',
      'Finish with your face — scrunch everything, then let it go soft.'
    ]
  }
};
function renderGroundingList(){
  var wrap = document.getElementById('groundingList');
  wrap.innerHTML = '';
  Object.keys(GROUNDING_EXERCISES).forEach(function(key){
    var g = GROUNDING_EXERCISES[key];

    card.innerHTML = '<p style="font-size:13.5px;font-weight:700;color:#2A2013;margin:0 0 4px;">'+g.name+'</p><p style="font-size:11px;color:#9AABCE;margin:0;">'+g.steps.length+' steps</p>';
    card.onclick = function(){ openGroundingDetail(key); };
    wrap.appendChild(card);
  });
}
document.getElementById('openGroundingBtn').onclick = function(){ renderGroundingList(); showOnly('panel-grounding'); };
document.getElementById('groundingBackBtn').onclick = function(){ showOnly('panel-bubbles'); setActiveNav('navHome'); };
document.getElementById('groundingDetailBackBtn').onclick = function(){ showOnly('panel-grounding'); };
function openGroundingDetail(key){

  document.getElementById('groundingDetailTitle').textContent = g.name;
  var wrap = document.getElementById('groundingDetailSteps');

    row.style.cssText = 'display:flex;gap:12px;background:#FFFFFF;border:1px solid #EEE0C4;border-radius:14px;padding:14px;margin-bottom:8px;';
    row.innerHTML = '<span style="width:24px;height:24px;border-radius:50%;background:'+g.color+'22;color:'+g.color+';display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:11px;font-weight:800;flex-shrink:0;">'+(i+1)+'</span><p style="font-size:13px;color:#2A2013;margin:0;line-height:1.5;">'+step+'</p>';
    wrap.appendChild(row);

function openWorksheetDetail(key){
  currentWorksheetKey = key;

  wrap.innerHTML = '';
  var saved = appState.worksheetEntries[key] || {};
  w.fields.forEach(function(f){

    block.style.marginBottom = '14px';
    var label = document.createElement('p');
    label.style.cssText = 'font-size:12px;color:#5C6B94;font-weight:600;margin:0 0 6px;';
    label.textContent = f.label;
    var textarea = document.createElement('textarea');
    textarea.id = 'wf_' + f.key;
    textarea.placeholder = f.placeholder;
    textarea.value = saved[f.key] || '';
    textarea.style.cssText = 'width:100%;min-height:60px;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid #EEE0C4;background:#FFFFFF;padding:12px;font-size:13px;color:#2A2013;font-family:inherit;box-sizing:border-box;resize:vertical;';
    block.appendChild(label); block.appendChild(textarea);
    wrap.appendChild(block);
  });
  showOnly('panel-worksheet-detail');
}
document.getElementById('worksheetSaveBtn').onclick = function(){
  var w = WORKSHEETS[currentWorksheetKey];
  var data = {};
  w.fields.forEach(function(f){ data[f.key] = document.getElementById('wf_'+f.key).value; });
  appState.worksheetEntries[currentWorksheetKey] = data;
  saveState();
  showToast('Saved');
  showOnly('panel-worksheets');
  renderWorksheetsList();
};
```

```
}
```

```
document.getElementById('bodyDoubleAddTaskBtn').onclick = function(){ openAddTaskSheet(bdSelectedKey); };
```

```
document.getElementById('addTaskSheetBackdrop').onclick = closeAddTaskSheet;

document.getElementById('sheetDurationChip').onclick = function(){
  var idx = durationCycle.indexOf(sheetDuration);
  sheetDuration = durationCycle[(idx + 1) % durationCycle.length];
  this.lastChild.textContent = ' ' + sheetDuration + 'm';
};

document.getElementById('sheetRepeatChip').onclick = function(){
  sheetRepeat = !sheetRepeat;
  this.style.background = sheetRepeat ? '#E9F0FB' : '#F0EEE8';
  this.style.color = sheetRepeat ? '#6690D6' : '#9AABCE';
};

document.querySelectorAll('.priority-chip').forEach(function(chip){
  chip.onclick = function(){
    var p = chip.getAttribute('data-priority');
    sheetPriority = (sheetPriority === p) ? null : p;
    document.querySelectorAll('.priority-chip').forEach(function(c){ c.style.outline = 'none'; c.style.boxShadow = 'none'; });
    if(sheetPriority) chip.style.boxShadow = 'inset 0 0 0 2px ' + PRIORITY_COLORS[sheetPriority];
  };
});

document.getElementById('sheetDeadlineToggle').onclick = function(){
  this.style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('sheetDeadlineInput').style.display = 'block';
  document.getElementById('sheetDeadlineInput').focus();
};

document.getElementById('sheetBreakdownToggle').onclick = function(){
  this.style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('sheetSubtaskArea').style.display = 'block';
  addSheetSubtaskRow();
};

function addSheetSubtaskRow(){
  var area = document.getElementById('sheetSubtaskArea');
  var row = document.createElement('div');
  row.style.cssText = 'display:flex;gap:6px;margin-bottom:6px;';
  var input = document.createElement('input');
  input.type = 'text';
  input.placeholder = 'Step ' + (area.children.length + 1) + '...';
  input.style.cssText = 'flex:1;border:1px solid #EEE0C4;border-radius:10px;padding:9px 10px;font-size:12.5px;font-family:inherit;';
  row.appendChild(input);
  area.appendChild(row);
  input.focus();
}
document.getElementById('sheetSubtaskArea').addEventListener('keydown', function(e){
  if(e.key === 'Enter'){
    e.preventDefault();
    addSheetSubtaskRow();
  }
});

document.getElementById('sheetSaveTaskBtn').onclick = function(){
  var title = document.getElementById('sheetTaskInput').value.trim();
  if(!title) return;
  var deadlineVal = document.getElementById('sheetDeadlineInput').value;
  var subInputs = document.querySelectorAll('#sheetSubtaskArea input');
  var subtasks = [];
  subInputs.forEach(function(inp){
    if(inp.value.trim()) subtasks.push({ id: uidGen(), title: inp.value.trim(), done:false });
  });
  getTasks(sheetTargetKey).push({
    id: uidGen(), title: title, duration: sheetDuration, repeat: sheetRepeat,
    priority: sheetPriority, deadline: deadlineVal ? new Date(deadlineVal).toISOString() : null,
    done: false, subtasks: subtasks
  });
  saveState();
  closeAddTaskSheet();
  if(sheetTargetKey === bdSelectedKey) renderBodyDoubleTaskList();
  if(sheetTargetKey === activeDayKey) renderTaskListCal();
};
```

```
var currentWorksheetCategory = null, currentWorksheetKey = null;

function renderWorksheetCategoryList(){
  var wrap = document.getElementById('worksheetCategoryList');
  wrap.innerHTML = '';
  Object.keys(WORKSHEET_CATEGORIES).forEach(function(catKey){
    var cat = WORKSHEET_CATEGORIES[catKey];
    var count = Object.keys(cat.worksheets).length;
    var card = document.createElement('div');
    card.style.cssText = 'background:#FFFFFF;border:1px solid #EEE0C4;border-left:4px solid '+cat.color+';border-radius:14px;padding:16px;margin-bottom:10px;cursor:pointer;';
    card.innerHTML = '<p style="font-size:14px;font-weight:700;color:#2A2013;margin:0 0 4px;">'+cat.name+'</p><p style="font-size:11px;color:#9AABCE;margin:0;">'+cat.sub+' · '+count+' worksheets</p>';
    card.onclick = function(){ openWorksheetCategory(catKey); };
    wrap.appendChild(card);
  });
}
document.getElementById('openWorksheetsBtn').onclick = function(){ renderWorksheetCategoryList(); showOnly('panel-worksheets'); };
document.getElementById('worksheetsBackBtn').onclick = function(){ showOnly('panel-bubbles'); setActiveNav('navHome'); };

function openWorksheetCategory(catKey){
  currentWorksheetCategory = catKey;
  var cat = WORKSHEET_CATEGORIES[catKey];
  document.getElementById('worksheetCategoryTitle').textContent = cat.name;
  document.getElementById('worksheetCategorySub').textContent = cat.sub;
  var wrap = document.getElementById('worksheetsList');
  wrap.innerHTML = '';
  Object.keys(cat.worksheets).forEach(function(key){
    var w = cat.worksheets[key];
    var card = document.createElement('div');
    card.style.cssText = 'background:#FFFFFF;border:1px solid #EEE0C4;border-left:4px solid '+w.color+';border-radius:14px;padding:16px;margin-bottom:10px;cursor:pointer;';
    card.innerHTML = '<p style="font-size:13.5px;font-weight:700;color:#2A2013;margin:0 0 4px;">'+w.name+'</p><p style="font-size:11px;color:#9AABCE;margin:0;">'+w.fields.length+' prompts</p>';
    card.onclick = function(){ openWorksheetDetail(key); };
    wrap.appendChild(card);
  });
  showOnly('panel-worksheet-category');
}
document.getElementById('worksheetCategoryBackBtn').onclick = function(){ showOnly('panel-worksheets'); };
document.getElementById('worksheetDetailBackBtn').onclick = function(){ showOnly('panel-worksheet-category'); };

function openWorksheetDetail(key){
  currentWorksheetKey = key;
  var w = WORKSHEET_CATEGORIES[currentWorksheetCategory].worksheets[key];
  document.getElementById('worksheetDetailTitle').textContent = w.name;
  document.getElementById('worksheetDetailIntro').textContent = w.intro || '';
  var wrap = document.getElementById('worksheetDetailFields');
  wrap.innerHTML = '';
  var saved = appState.worksheetEntries[key] || {};
  w.fields.forEach(function(f){
    var block = document.createElement('div');
    block.style.marginBottom = '14px';
    var label = document.createElement('p');
    label.style.cssText = 'font-size:12px;color:#5C6B94;font-weight:600;margin:0 0 6px;';
    label.textContent = f.label;
    var textarea = document.createElement('textarea');
    textarea.id = 'wf_' + f.key;
    textarea.placeholder = f.placeholder;
    textarea.value = saved[f.key] || '';
    textarea.style.cssText = 'width:100%;min-height:60px;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid #EEE0C4;background:#FFFFFF;padding:12px;font-size:13px;color:#2A2013;font-family:inherit;box-sizing:border-box;resize:vertical;';
    block.appendChild(label); block.appendChild(textarea);
    wrap.appendChild(block);
  });
  showOnly('panel-worksheet-detail');
}
document.getElementById('worksheetSaveBtn').onclick = function(){
  var w = WORKSHEET_CATEGORIES[currentWorksheetCategory].worksheets[currentWorksheetKey];
  var data = {};
  w.fields.forEach(function(f){ data[f.key] = document.getElementById('wf_'+f.key).value; });
  appState.worksheetEntries[currentWorksheetKey] = data;
  saveState();
  showToast('Saved');
  openWorksheetCategory(currentWorksheetCategory);
```

```
      '<div class="mascot-card-arc" style="background:'+g.color+';">'+MASCOT_MINI_SVG[g.mascot]+'</div>'+
      '<div class="mascot-card-body"><p class="mascot-card-title">'+g.name+'</p><p class="mascot-card-sub">'+g.steps.length+' steps'+(g.video ? ' · video guide' : '')+'</p></div>';
    card.onclick = function(){ openGroundingDetail(key); };
    wrap.appendChild(card);
  });
}
document.getElementById('openGroundingBtn').onclick = function(){ renderGroundingList(); showOnly('panel-grounding'); };
document.getElementById('groundingBackBtn').onclick = function(){ showOnly('panel-bubbles'); setActiveNav('navHome'); };
document.getElementById('groundingDetailBackBtn').onclick = function(){ showOnly('panel-grounding'); };
function openGroundingDetail(key){
  var g = GROUNDING_EXERCISES[key];
  document.getElementById('groundingDetailTitle').textContent = g.name;
  var wrap = document.getElementById('groundingDetailSteps');
  wrap.innerHTML = '';

  var introP = document.createElement('p');
  introP.style.cssText = 'font-size:12.5px;color:#5C6B94;line-height:1.6;text-align:center;margin:0 0 16px;';
  introP.textContent = g.intro;
  wrap.appendChild(introP);

  if(g.video){
    var vid = document.createElement('a');
    vid.className = 'video-link-card';
    vid.href = g.video.url; vid.target = '_blank'; vid.rel = 'noopener';
    vid.innerHTML = '<span class="video-link-play"><svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="#fff"><path d="M8 5v14l11-7z"/></svg></span><span class="video-link-text"><p class="video-link-title">Watch a guided video</p><p class="video-link-source">'+g.video.source+'</p></span>';
    wrap.appendChild(vid);
  }

  g.steps.forEach(function(step, i){
    var row = document.createElement('div');
    row.style.cssText = 'display:flex;gap:12px;background:#FFFFFF;border:1px solid #EEE0C4;border-radius:14px;padding:14px;margin-bottom:8px;';
    row.innerHTML = '<span style="width:24px;height:24px;border-radius:50%;background:'+g.color+'22;color:'+g.color+';display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:11px;font-weight:800;flex-shrink:0;">'+(i+1)+'</span><p style="font-size:13px;color:#2A2013;margin:0;line-height:1.6;">'+step+'</p>';
    wrap.appendChild(row);
  });
  showOnly('panel-grounding-detail');
}
```

```
  }
```

```
    var dateStr = new Date(e.date).toLocaleDateString(undefined, {month:'short', day:'numeric', hour:'numeric', minute:'2-digit'});

    if(e.type === 'worksheet'){
      card.innerHTML =
        '<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:8px;">'+
          '<span style="font-size:10px;font-weight:800;color:'+e.color+';text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.03em;">'+e.categoryName+' worksheet</span>'+

        '<p style="font-size:13px;color:#2A2013;font-weight:700;margin:0 0 4px;">'+e.worksheetName+'</p>'+
        '<p style="font-size:11px;color:#9AABCE;margin:0;">Completed — tap Worksheets to review or update it.</p>'+
        (e.sharedWithTherapist ? '<p style="font-size:10px;color:#6690D6;margin:8px 0 0;">Shared with your therapist</p>' : '');
    } else {
      var dotsHtml = e.moods.map(function(m){ return '<span style="display:inline-block;width:14px;height:14px;border-radius:50%;background:'+m.color+';margin-right:4px;"></span>'; }).join('');
      var labelsHtml = e.moods.map(function(m){ return m.label; }).join(', ');
      card.innerHTML =
        '<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:8px;">'+
          '<div>'+dotsHtml+'</div>'+
          '<span style="font-size:10px;color:#B8A67A;">'+dateStr+'</span>'+
        '</div>'+
        (labelsHtml ? '<p style="font-size:11px;color:#9AABCE;margin:0 0 6px;">'+labelsHtml+'</p>' : '')+
        (e.text ? '<p style="font-size:13px;color:#2A2013;margin:0;white-space:pre-wrap;">'+e.text.replace(/</g,'&lt;')+'</p>' : '<p style="font-size:12px;color:#C7BFA8;margin:0;font-style:italic;">No note added</p>')+
        (e.sharedWithTherapist ? '<p style="font-size:10px;color:#6690D6;margin:8px 0 0;">Shared with your therapist</p>' : '');
    }

    var isConnected = document.getElementById('demoHasTherapist').checked || appState.userHasTherapist;
    if(!e.sharedWithTherapist && isConnected){
      var shareBtn = document.createElement('button');
      shareBtn.textContent = 'Share with ' + (appState.therapistName || 'your therapist');
      shareBtn.style.cssText = 'margin-top:8px;background:none;border:none;color:#6690D6;font-size:10.5px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;padding:0;text-decoration:underline;';
      shareBtn.onclick = function(){
        e.sharedWithTherapist = true;
        saveState();
        renderHistory();
      };
      card.appendChild(shareBtn);
    }
    list.appendChild(card);
  });
}
```

```
  .mascot-card-arc svg.mascot-mini { width:52px; height:52px; position:absolute; left:50%; bottom:6px; transform:translateX(-50%); z-index:2; filter:drop-shadow(0 3px 5px rgba(0,0,0,0.15)); }
  .mascot-card-body { padding:12px 16px 16px; text-align:center; }
  .mascot-card-title { font-size:13.5px; font-weight:700; color:#2A2013; margin:0 0 3px; }
```

```
document.getElementById('saveNoteBtn').onclick = function(){
  var entry = {
    date: new Date().toISOString(),
    moods: selected.map(function(b){ return {label:b.label, color:b.base}; }),
    text: document.getElementById('journalText').value,
    sharedWithTherapist: shareEnabled
  };
  appState.entries.unshift(entry);
  saveState();
  document.getElementById('panel-journal').style.display = 'none';
  resetJournalState();

  var distressMoods = ['Anxious', 'Restless', 'Heavy'];
  var isDistressed = entry.moods.some(function(m){ return distressMoods.indexOf(m.label) !== -1; });
  if(isDistressed){
    renderGroundingList();
    showOnly('panel-grounding');
    setActiveNav('navBreathe');
    showToast("That sounded like a lot — here's something that might help");
  } else {
    renderSavedPanel();
    document.getElementById('panel-saved').style.display = 'block';
  }
};
```

```
function startTest(key){
  currentTestKey = key; testIdx = 0; testAnswers = [];
  renderTestItem();
  showOnly('panel-test-detail');
}
function renderTestItem(){
  var t = TESTS[currentTestKey];
  document.getElementById('testProgress').textContent = 'Question ' + (testIdx+1) + ' of ' + t.items.length;
  document.getElementById('testItemText').textContent = t.items[testIdx];
  document.getElementById('testProg').style.width = (((testIdx+1)/t.items.length)*100) + '%';
  var scaleWrap = document.getElementById('testScale');
  scaleWrap.innerHTML = '';
  t.scale.forEach(function(opt){
    var btn = document.createElement('button');
    btn.textContent = opt.label;
    btn.style.cssText = 'display:block;width:100%;padding:13px;border-radius:12px;border:1.5px solid #EEE0C4;background:#FFFFFF;color:#2A2013;font-size:13.5px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;margin-bottom:8px;';
    btn.onclick = function(){
      testAnswers[testIdx] = opt.val;
      testIdx++;
      if(testIdx >= t.items.length){ finishTest(); } else { renderTestItem(); }
    };
    scaleWrap.appendChild(btn);
  });
}
function finishTest(){
  var t = TESTS[currentTestKey];
  var score = testAnswers.reduce(function(a,b){ return a+b; }, 0);

  document.getElementById('testResultScore').textContent = score;
  document.getElementById('testResultCategory').textContent = result.cat;
  document.getElementById('testResultText').textContent = result.text;
  var supportArea = document.getElementById('testResultSupportArea');
  supportArea.innerHTML = '';

    var btn = document.createElement('button');
    var connected = document.getElementById('demoHasTherapist').checked || appState.userHasTherapist;
    btn.textContent = connected ? 'Message ' + (appState.therapistName || 'your therapist') : 'Find someone to talk to';

    btn.onclick = function(){

        document.getElementById('intakeThanks').style.display = 'none';
        showOnly('panel-intake');
      }
    };
    supportArea.appendChild(btn);
  }
  showOnly('panel-test-results');
}
document.getElementById('testResultDoneBtn').onclick = function(){ renderTestsList(); showOnly('panel-tests'); };
```

```
function startTest(key){

  renderTestItem();
  showOnly('panel-test-detail');
}
function renderTestItem(){

    btn.onclick = function(){
```

```
var currentTestKey = null, testFlatItems = [], testIdx = 0, testAnswers = [];

function startTest(key){
  currentTestKey = key;
  var t = TESTS_DATA[key];
  testFlatItems = [];
  t.dimensions.forEach(function(dim, dIdx){
    dim.items.forEach(function(item, iIdx){
      testFlatItems.push({ text:item.text, reverse:!!item.reverse, dimIdx:dIdx, scale:dim.scale, maxPerItem:dim.maxPerItem });
    });
  });
  testIdx = 0; testAnswers = [];
  renderTestItem();
  showOnly('panel-test-detail');
}
function renderTestItem(){
  var item = testFlatItems[testIdx];
  document.getElementById('testProgress').textContent = 'Question ' + (testIdx+1) + ' of ' + testFlatItems.length;
  document.getElementById('testItemText').textContent = item.text;
  document.getElementById('testProg').style.width = (((testIdx+1)/testFlatItems.length)*100) + '%';
  var scaleWrap = document.getElementById('testScale');
  scaleWrap.innerHTML = '';
  item.scale.forEach(function(opt){
    var btn = document.createElement('button');
    btn.textContent = opt.label;
    btn.style.cssText = 'display:block;width:100%;padding:13px;border-radius:12px;border:1.5px solid #EEE0C4;background:#FFFFFF;color:#2A2013;font-size:13.5px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;margin-bottom:8px;';
    btn.onclick = function(){
      testAnswers[testIdx] = opt.val;
      testIdx++;
      if(testIdx >= testFlatItems.length){ finishTest(); } else { renderTestItem(); }
    };
    scaleWrap.appendChild(btn);
  });
}

function finishTest(){
  var t = TESTS_DATA[currentTestKey];
  document.getElementById('testResultTitle').textContent = t.name + ' (' + t.shortName + ')';
  var subNote = document.getElementById('testSubstituteNote');
  if(t.isSubstitute){ subNote.style.display = 'block'; subNote.textContent = t.substituteNote; }
  else { subNote.style.display = 'none'; }

  // check self-harm flag (PHQ-9 item 9)
  var selfHarmFlag = false;
  t.dimensions.forEach(function(dim, dIdx){
    if(dim.selfHarmItemIndex !== undefined){
      var flatIdx = testFlatItems.findIndex(function(fi, idx){
        var count = 0;
        for(var i=0;i<dIdx;i++) count += t.dimensions[i].items.length;
        return idx === count + dim.selfHarmItemIndex;
      });
      if(flatIdx !== -1 && testAnswers[flatIdx] > 0) selfHarmFlag = true;
    }
  });
  document.getElementById('testResultCrisisNote').style.display = selfHarmFlag ? 'block' : 'none';

  var bodyWrap = document.getElementById('testResultBody');
  bodyWrap.innerHTML = '';
  var anyElevated = false;
  var offset = 0;

  t.dimensions.forEach(function(dim, dIdx){
    var rawSum = 0;
    dim.items.forEach(function(item, iIdx){
      var flatIdx = offset + iIdx;
      var val = testAnswers[flatIdx];
      rawSum += item.reverse ? (dim.maxPerItem - val) : val;
    });
    offset += dim.items.length;

    if(t.isPersonality){
      var maxPossible = dim.items.length * dim.maxPerItem;
      var pct = rawSum / maxPossible;
      var level = pct < 0.4 ? 'Low' : pct < 0.65 ? 'Moderate' : 'High';
      var row = document.createElement('div');
      row.style.cssText = 'text-align:left;margin-bottom:14px;';
      row.innerHTML = '<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:4px;"><span style="font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;color:#2A2013;">'+dim.name+'</span><span style="font-size:11px;font-weight:700;color:'+t.color+';">'+level+'</span></div>'+
        '<div style="height:6px;background:#F0E9D8;border-radius:4px;overflow:hidden;"><div style="height:100%;width:'+(pct*100)+'%;background:'+t.color+';border-radius:4px;"></div></div>';
      bodyWrap.appendChild(row);
    } else if(dim.bands){
      var band = bandInterpret(rawSum, dim.bands);
      if(band.cat && band.cat.indexOf('Normal') === -1 && band.cat.indexOf('Minimal') === -1 && band.cat.indexOf('Low') === -1 && band.cat.indexOf('Lower') === -1 && band.cat.indexOf('Good') === -1 && band.cat.indexOf('Typical') === -1) anyElevated = true;
      var multiDim = t.dimensions.length > 1;
      var row2 = document.createElement('div');
      row2.style.cssText = multiDim ? 'text-align:left;margin-bottom:16px;padding-bottom:14px;border-bottom:1px solid #F0E9D8;' : 'margin-bottom:8px;';
      if(multiDim){
        row2.innerHTML = '<p style="font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;color:#2A2013;margin:0 0 2px;">'+dim.name+'</p><p style="font-size:22px;font-weight:800;color:#2E3A5A;margin:0;">'+rawSum+' <span style="font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:'+t.color+';">— '+band.cat+'</span></p>'+(band.text ? '<p style="font-size:11.5px;color:#5C6B94;margin:4px 0 0;">'+band.text+'</p>' : '');
      } else {
        row2.innerHTML = '<p style="font-size:32px;font-weight:800;color:#2E3A5A;margin:0;">'+rawSum+'</p><p style="font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:'+t.color+';margin:2px 0 10px;">'+band.cat+'</p><p class="prompt-sub" style="max-width:280px;margin:0 auto 4px;">'+band.text+'</p>';
      }
      bodyWrap.appendChild(row2);
    }
  });

  var supportArea = document.getElementById('testResultSupportArea');
  supportArea.innerHTML = '';
  if(anyElevated || selfHarmFlag){
    var btn = document.createElement('button');
    var connected = document.getElementById('demoHasTherapist').checked || appState.userHasTherapist;
    btn.textContent = connected ? 'Message ' + (appState.therapistName || 'your therapist') : 'Find someone to talk to';
    btn.style.cssText = 'display:block;width:100%;padding:15px;border-radius:14px;border:none;background:#6690D6;color:#FFF8F0;font-size:15px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;margin-bottom:12px;';
    btn.onclick = function(){
      if(connected){ showOnly('panel-booking'); }
      else {
        intakeReturnTo = 'bubbles';
        document.getElementById('intakeForm').style.display = 'block';
        document.getElementById('intakeThanks').style.display = 'none';
        showOnly('panel-intake');
      }
    };
    supportArea.appendChild(btn);
  }

  document.getElementById('testEmailName').value = '';
  document.getElementById('testEmailAddress').value = '';
  showOnly('panel-test-results');
}
document.getElementById('testResultDoneBtn').onclick = function(){ renderTestsList(); renderProfessionalAssessmentList(); showOnly('panel-tests'); };

if(!appState.testReportRequests){ appState.testReportRequests = []; }
document.getElementById('testEmailSubmitBtn').onclick = function(){
  var name = document.getElementById('testEmailName').value.trim();
  var email = document.getElementById('testEmailAddress').value.trim();

  document.getElementById('testEmailAddress').value = '';
};
```

```
      '<a href="https://wa.me/'+WHATSAPP_NUMBER+'?text='+waText+'" target="_blank" rel="noopener" style="display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;color:#25A55A;text-decoration:none;">'+
      '<svg width="13" height="13" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor"><path d="M12 2a10 10 0 0 0-8.5 15.2L2 22l4.9-1.3A10 10 0 1 0 12 2z"/></svg> Talk to us on WhatsApp</a>';
    wrap.appendChild(card);
  });
}

document.getElementById('openScreeningGaugeBtn').onclick = function(){ renderTestsList(); renderProfessionalAssessmentList(); showOnly('panel-tests'); };
document.getElementById('testsBackBtn').onclick = function(){ showOnly('panel-bubbles'); setActiveNav('navHome'); };
document.getElementById('testDetailBackBtn').onclick = function(){ showOnly('panel-tests'); };

var currentTestKey = null, testFlatItems = [], testIdx = 0, testAnswers = [];

function startTest(key){
  currentTestKey = key;
  var t = TESTS_DATA[key];
  testFlatItems = [];
  t.dimensions.forEach(function(dim, dIdx){
    dim.items.forEach(function(item, iIdx){
      testFlatItems.push({ text:item.text, reverse:!!item.reverse, dimIdx:dIdx, scale:dim.scale, maxPerItem:dim.maxPerItem });
    });
  });
  testIdx = 0; testAnswers = [];
  renderTestItem();
  showOnly('panel-test-detail');
}
function renderTestItem(){
  var item = testFlatItems[testIdx];
  document.getElementById('testProgress').textContent = 'Question ' + (testIdx+1) + ' of ' + testFlatItems.length;
  document.getElementById('testItemText').textContent = item.text;
  document.getElementById('testProg').style.width = (((testIdx+1)/testFlatItems.length)*100) + '%';
  var scaleWrap = document.getElementById('testScale');
  scaleWrap.innerHTML = '';
  item.scale.forEach(function(opt){
    var btn = document.createElement('button');
    btn.textContent = opt.label;
    btn.style.cssText = 'display:block;width:100%;padding:13px;border-radius:12px;border:1.5px solid #EEE0C4;background:#FFFFFF;color:#2A2013;font-size:13.5px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;margin-bottom:8px;';
    btn.onclick = function(){
      testAnswers[testIdx] = opt.val;
      testIdx++;
      if(testIdx >= testFlatItems.length){ finishTest(); } else { renderTestItem(); }
    };
    scaleWrap.appendChild(btn);
  });
}

function finishTest(){
  var t = TESTS_DATA[currentTestKey];
  document.getElementById('testResultTitle').textContent = t.name + ' (' + t.shortName + ')';
  var subNote = document.getElementById('testSubstituteNote');
  if(t.isSubstitute){ subNote.style.display = 'block'; subNote.textContent = t.substituteNote; }
  else { subNote.style.display = 'none'; }

  var selfHarmFlag = false;
  var offsetCheck = 0;
  t.dimensions.forEach(function(dim, dIdx){
    if(dim.selfHarmItemIndex !== undefined){
      var flatIdx = offsetCheck + dim.selfHarmItemIndex;
      if(testAnswers[flatIdx] > 0) selfHarmFlag = true;
    }
    offsetCheck += dim.items.length;
  });
  document.getElementById('testResultCrisisNote').style.display = selfHarmFlag ? 'block' : 'none';

  var bodyWrap = document.getElementById('testResultBody');
  bodyWrap.innerHTML = '';
  var anyElevated = false;
  var offset = 0;

  t.dimensions.forEach(function(dim, dIdx){
    var rawSum = 0;
    dim.items.forEach(function(item, iIdx){
      var flatIdx = offset + iIdx;
      var val = testAnswers[flatIdx];
      rawSum += item.reverse ? (dim.maxPerItem - val) : val;
    });
    offset += dim.items.length;

    if(t.isPersonality){
      var maxPossible = dim.items.length * dim.maxPerItem;
      var pct = rawSum / maxPossible;
      var level = pct < 0.4 ? 'Low' : pct < 0.65 ? 'Moderate' : 'High';
      var row = document.createElement('div');
      row.style.cssText = 'text-align:left;margin-bottom:14px;';
      row.innerHTML = '<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:4px;"><span style="font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;color:#2A2013;">'+dim.name+'</span><span style="font-size:11px;font-weight:700;color:'+t.color+';">'+level+'</span></div>'+
        '<div style="height:6px;background:#F0E9D8;border-radius:4px;overflow:hidden;"><div style="height:100%;width:'+(pct*100)+'%;background:'+t.color+';border-radius:4px;"></div></div>';
      bodyWrap.appendChild(row);
    } else if(dim.bands){
      var band = bandInterpret(rawSum, dim.bands);
      var lowCats = ['Normal','Minimal','Low','Lower','Good','Typical'];
      var isLow = lowCats.some(function(lc){ return band.cat.indexOf(lc) !== -1; });
      if(!isLow) anyElevated = true;
      var multiDim = t.dimensions.length > 1;
      var row2 = document.createElement('div');
      row2.style.cssText = multiDim ? 'text-align:left;margin-bottom:16px;padding-bottom:14px;border-bottom:1px solid #F0E9D8;' : 'margin-bottom:8px;';
      if(multiDim){
        row2.innerHTML = '<p style="font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;color:#2A2013;margin:0 0 2px;">'+dim.name+'</p><p style="font-size:22px;font-weight:800;color:#2E3A5A;margin:0;">'+rawSum+' <span style="font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:'+t.color+';">— '+band.cat+'</span></p>'+(band.text ? '<p style="font-size:11.5px;color:#5C6B94;margin:4px 0 0;">'+band.text+'</p>' : '');
      } else {
        row2.innerHTML = '<p style="font-size:32px;font-weight:800;color:#2E3A5A;margin:0;">'+rawSum+'</p><p style="font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:'+t.color+';margin:2px 0 10px;">'+band.cat+'</p><p class="prompt-sub" style="max-width:280px;margin:0 auto 4px;">'+(band.text||'')+'</p>';
      }
      bodyWrap.appendChild(row2);
    }
  });

  var supportArea = document.getElementById('testResultSupportArea');
  supportArea.innerHTML = '';
  if(anyElevated || selfHarmFlag){
    var btn = document.createElement('button');
    var connected = document.getElementById('demoHasTherapist').checked || appState.userHasTherapist;
    btn.textContent = connected ? 'Message ' + (appState.therapistName || 'your therapist') : 'Find someone to talk to';
    btn.style.cssText = 'display:block;width:100%;padding:15px;border-radius:14px;border:none;background:#6690D6;color:#FFF8F0;font-size:15px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;margin-bottom:12px;';
    btn.onclick = function(){
      if(connected){ showOnly('panel-booking'); }
      else {
        intakeReturnTo = 'bubbles';
        document.getElementById('intakeForm').style.display = 'block';
        document.getElementById('intakeThanks').style.display = 'none';
        showOnly('panel-intake');
      }
    };
    supportArea.appendChild(btn);
  }

  document.getElementById('testEmailName').value = '';
  document.getElementById('testEmailAddress').value = '';
  showOnly('panel-test-results');
}
document.getElementById('testResultDoneBtn').onclick = function(){ renderTestsList(); renderProfessionalAssessmentList(); showOnly('panel-tests'); };

if(!appState.testReportRequests){ appState.testReportRequests = []; }
document.getElementById('testEmailSubmitBtn').onclick = function(){
  var name = document.getElementById('testEmailName').value.trim();
  var email = document.getElementById('testEmailAddress').value.trim();
  if(!name || !email){ showToast('Add your name and email first'); return; }
  appState.testReportRequests.push({ name:name, email:email, test:currentTestKey, date:new Date().toISOString() });
  saveState();
  showToast('Sent — check your email soon');
  document.getElementById('testEmailName').value = '';
  document.getElementById('testEmailAddress').value = '';
};

// ================= GROUNDING & RELAXATION =================
```

```
function renderTeamList(){
  var wrap = document.getElementById('teamList');
```

```
function renderTeamList(){
```

```
      ? '<img src="'+m.photo+'" alt="'+m.name+'" id="teamPhoto'+idx+'" style="width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;border-radius:50%;" onerror="teamPhotoFallback(this, \''+initials+'\')">'
      : initials;
    return '<div style="flex:0 0 130px;text-align:center;">'+

}
function teamPhotoFallback(img, initials){

}
```


NEW (exact):
```
document.getElementById('startBodyDoubleBtn').onclick = function(){ openBodyDouble(); };

var dayMoodSelected = [];
document.getElementById('addMoodBtnCal').onclick = function(){
  dayMoodSelected = [];
  var chipsWrap = document.getElementById('dayMoodChips');
  chipsWrap.innerHTML = '';
  moods.forEach(function(m){
    var color = 'hsl('+m.h+','+m.s+'%,'+m.l+'%)';
    var chip = document.createElement('button');
    chip.textContent = m.label;
    chip.style.cssText = 'padding:9px 14px;border-radius:20px;border:2px solid '+color+';background:#FFFFFF;color:#2A2013;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;';
    chip.onclick = function(){
      var idx = dayMoodSelected.indexOf(m.label);
      if(idx === -1){ dayMoodSelected.push(m.label); chip.style.background = color; chip.style.color = '#fff'; }
      else { dayMoodSelected.splice(idx,1); chip.style.background = '#FFFFFF'; chip.style.color = '#2A2013'; }
    };
    chipsWrap.appendChild(chip);
  });
  document.getElementById('dayMoodSheetBackdrop').style.display = 'block';
  document.getElementById('dayMoodSheet').style.display = 'block';
};
document.getElementById('dayMoodSheetClose').onclick = function(){
  document.getElementById('dayMoodSheetBackdrop').style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('dayMoodSheet').style.display = 'none';
};
document.getElementById('dayMoodSheetBackdrop').onclick = document.getElementById('dayMoodSheetClose').onclick;
document.getElementById('dayMoodSaveBtn').onclick = function(){
  if(!dayMoodSelected.length){ showToast('Pick at least one mood'); return; }
  var parts = activeDayKey.split('-').map(Number);
  var dateObj = new Date(parts[0], parts[1]-1, parts[2], 12, 0, 0);
  var moodObjs = dayMoodSelected.map(function(label){
    var m = moods.find(function(mm){ return mm.label === label; });
    return { label: m.label, color: 'hsl('+m.h+','+m.s+'%,'+m.l+'%)' };
  });
  appState.entries.unshift({ date: dateObj.toISOString(), moods: moodObjs, text: '', sharedWithTherapist: false });
  saveState();
  document.getElementById('dayMoodSheetBackdrop').style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('dayMoodSheet').style.display = 'none';
  showToast('Mood saved for that day');
  renderDayPanel();
};
```

```
function renderCustomResult(t, result){
  var subNote = document.getElementById('testSubstituteNote');
  subNote.style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('testResultCrisisNote').style.display = 'none';
  var bodyWrap = document.getElementById('testResultBody');
  bodyWrap.innerHTML =
    '<p style="font-size:32px;font-weight:800;color:#2E3A5A;margin:0;">'+result.global+'</p>'+
    '<p style="font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:'+result.col+';margin:2px 0 10px;">'+result.lv+'</p>'+
    '<p class="prompt-sub" style="max-width:280px;margin:0 auto 16px;">'+result.msg+'</p>';
  if(result.components){
    result.components.forEach(function(c){
      var pct = Math.round(c.score/3*100);
      var row = document.createElement('div');
      row.style.cssText = 'text-align:left;margin-bottom:10px;';
      row.innerHTML = '<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:11.5px;margin-bottom:3px;"><span style="color:#2A2013;">'+c.name+'</span><span style="font-weight:700;color:'+c.color+';">'+c.score+'/3</span></div><div style="height:5px;background:#F0E9D8;border-radius:3px;overflow:hidden;"><div style="height:100%;width:'+pct+'%;background:'+c.color+';"></div></div>';
      bodyWrap.appendChild(row);
    });
  }
  var supportArea = document.getElementById('testResultSupportArea');
  supportArea.innerHTML = '';
  if(result.elevated){
    var btn = document.createElement('button');
    var connected = document.getElementById('demoHasTherapist').checked || appState.userHasTherapist;
    btn.textContent = connected ? 'Message ' + (appState.therapistName || 'your therapist') : 'Find someone to talk to';
    btn.style.cssText = 'display:block;width:100%;padding:15px;border-radius:14px;border:none;background:#6690D6;color:#FFF8F0;font-size:15px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;margin-bottom:12px;';
    btn.onclick = function(){
      if(connected){ showOnly('panel-booking'); }
      else {
        intakeReturnTo = 'bubbles';
        document.getElementById('intakeForm').style.display = 'block';
        document.getElementById('intakeThanks').style.display = 'none';
        showOnly('panel-intake');
      }
    };
    supportArea.appendChild(btn);
  }
  document.getElementById('testEmailName').value = '';
  document.getElementById('testEmailAddress').value = '';
  showOnly('panel-test-results');
}
document.getElementById('testResultDoneBtn').onclick = function(){ renderTestsList(); renderProfessionalAssessmentList(); showOnly('panel-tests'); };
```

```
  psqi: {
    name:'Sleep Quality Screening', shortName:'PSQI', color:'#C77B7B', duration:'10-15 min',
    description:'Your sleep quality over the past month, scored across 7 real clinical components.',
    customScore: function(rawAnswers){
      var bedTime = rawAnswers[0], latMin = parseFloat(rawAnswers[1])||0, wakeTime = rawAnswers[2], hrs = parseFloat(rawAnswers[3])||0;
      var q5a = parseInt(rawAnswers[4])||0;
      var C1 = parseInt(rawAnswers[14])||0;
      var latScore = latMin<=15?0:latMin<=30?1:latMin<=60?2:3;
      var latSum = latScore + q5a;
      var C2 = latSum===0?0:latSum<=2?1:latSum<=4?2:3;
      var C3 = hrs>7?0:hrs>=6?1:hrs>=5?2:3;
      var C4 = 0;
      try{
        var bed=String(bedTime||'').split(':'), wake=String(wakeTime||'').split(':');
        if(bed.length===2 && wake.length===2 && bed[0]!==''){
          var bedM=parseInt(bed[0])*60+parseInt(bed[1]), wakeM=parseInt(wake[0])*60+parseInt(wake[1]), inBed=wakeM-bedM;
          if(inBed<=0) inBed+=1440;
          if(inBed>0 && hrs>0){ var eff=(hrs*60/inBed)*100; C4 = eff>85?0:eff>=75?1:eff>=65?2:3; }
        }
      }catch(ex){}
      var distSum=0; for(var i=5;i<=13;i++) distSum += parseInt(rawAnswers[i])||0;
      var C5 = distSum===0?0:distSum<=9?1:distSum<=18?2:3;
      var C6 = parseInt(rawAnswers[15])||0;
      var daySum = (parseInt(rawAnswers[16])||0) + (parseInt(rawAnswers[17])||0);
      var C7 = daySum===0?0:daySum<=2?1:daySum<=4?2:3;
      var global = C1+C2+C3+C4+C5+C6+C7;
      var lv, col;
      if(global<=5){ lv='Good Sleep Quality'; col='#22c55e'; }
      else if(global<=10){ lv='Mild Sleep Difficulty'; col='#ca8a04'; }
      else if(global<=15){ lv='Moderate Sleep Difficulty'; col='#ea580c'; }
      else { lv='Severe Sleep Difficulty'; col='#dc2626'; }
      var msg = 'Your global PSQI score is '+global+' out of 21 (scores above 5 indicate meaningful sleep disturbance).';
      return {
        global:global, lv:lv, col:col, msg:msg, elevated: global>5,
        components:[
          {name:'Subjective Sleep Quality', score:C1, color:'#1E3A5F'},
          {name:'Sleep Latency', score:C2, color:'#1E3A5F'},
          {name:'Sleep Duration', score:C3, color:'#1E3A5F'},
          {name:'Habitual Sleep Efficiency', score:C4, color:'#1E3A5F'},
          {name:'Sleep Disturbances', score:C5, color:'#1E3A5F'},
          {name:'Sleep Medication Use', score:C6, color:'#1E3A5F'},
          {name:'Daytime Dysfunction', score:C7, color:'#1E3A5F'}
        ]
      };
    },
    dimensions:[{ key:'total', items:[
      { text:'During the past month, what time have you usually gone to bed at night?', type:'time' },
      { text:'During the past month, how long (in minutes) has it usually taken you to fall asleep each night?', type:'number', unit:'minutes' },
      { text:'During the past month, what time have you usually gotten up in the morning?', type:'time' },
      { text:'During the past month, how many hours of actual sleep did you get at night?', type:'number', unit:'hours' },
      { text:'During the past month, how often have you had trouble sleeping because you cannot get to sleep within 30 minutes?' },
      { text:'During the past month, how often have you had trouble sleeping because you wake up in the middle of the night or early morning?' },
      { text:'During the past month, how often have you had trouble sleeping because you have to get up to use the bathroom?' },
      { text:'During the past month, how often have you had trouble sleeping because you cannot breathe comfortably?' },
      { text:'During the past month, how often have you had trouble sleeping because you cough or snore loudly?' },
      { text:'During the past month, how often have you had trouble sleeping because you feel too cold?' },
      { text:'During the past month, how often have you had trouble sleeping because you feel too hot?' },
      { text:'During the past month, how often have you had trouble sleeping because you had bad dreams?' },
      { text:'During the past month, how often have you had trouble sleeping because you have pain?' },
      { text:'During the past month, how often have you had trouble sleeping for any other reason?' },
      { text:'During the past month, how would you rate your sleep quality overall?' },
      { text:'During the past month, how often have you taken medicine to help you sleep?' },
      { text:'During the past month, how often have you had trouble staying awake during driving, eating, or social activity?' },
      { text:'During the past month, how much of a problem has it been to keep up enough enthusiasm to get things done?' }
    ], scale:SCALE_4ALWAYS, maxPerItem:3 }]
  },

  ders: {

  ucla20: {
    name:'Loneliness Screening', shortName:'UCLA-20', color:'#5C6B94', duration:'5-8 min',
    description:'How connected or isolated you\'ve been feeling right now, across social and emotional dimensions.',
    dimensions:[{ key:'total', items:[
      { text:'How often do you feel that you are "in tune" with the people around you?', reverse:true },

      { text:'How often do you feel that there is no one you can turn to?' },
```

```
    name:'Sleep Quality Screening', shortName:'PSQI', color:'#C77B7B', duration:'10-15 min',
    description:'Your sleep quality over the past month, scored across 7 real clinical components.',
    customScore: function(rawAnswers){
      var bedTime = rawAnswers[0], latMin = parseFloat(rawAnswers[1])||0, wakeTime = rawAnswers[2], hrs = parseFloat(rawAnswers[3])||0;
      var q5a = parseInt(rawAnswers[4])||0;
      var C1 = parseInt(rawAnswers[14])||0;
      var latScore = latMin<=15?0:latMin<=30?1:latMin<=60?2:3;
      var latSum = latScore + q5a;
      var C2 = latSum===0?0:latSum<=2?1:latSum<=4?2:3;
      var C3 = hrs>7?0:hrs>=6?1:hrs>=5?2:3;
      var C4 = 0;
      try{
        var bed=String(bedTime||'').split(':'), wake=String(wakeTime||'').split(':');
        if(bed.length===2 && wake.length===2 && bed[0]!==''){
          var bedM=parseInt(bed[0])*60+parseInt(bed[1]), wakeM=parseInt(wake[0])*60+parseInt(wake[1]), inBed=wakeM-bedM;
          if(inBed<=0) inBed+=1440;
          if(inBed>0 && hrs>0){ var eff=(hrs*60/inBed)*100; C4 = eff>85?0:eff>=75?1:eff>=65?2:3; }
        }
      }catch(ex){}
      var distSum=0; for(var i=5;i<=13;i++) distSum += parseInt(rawAnswers[i])||0;
      var C5 = distSum===0?0:distSum<=9?1:distSum<=18?2:3;
      var C6 = parseInt(rawAnswers[15])||0;
      var daySum = (parseInt(rawAnswers[16])||0) + (parseInt(rawAnswers[17])||0);
      var C7 = daySum===0?0:daySum<=2?1:daySum<=4?2:3;
      var global = C1+C2+C3+C4+C5+C6+C7;
      var lv, col;
      if(global<=5){ lv='Good Sleep Quality'; col='#22c55e'; }
      else if(global<=10){ lv='Mild Sleep Difficulty'; col='#ca8a04'; }
      else if(global<=15){ lv='Moderate Sleep Difficulty'; col='#ea580c'; }
      else { lv='Severe Sleep Difficulty'; col='#dc2626'; }
      var msg = 'Your global PSQI score is '+global+' out of 21 (scores above 5 indicate meaningful sleep disturbance).';
      return {
        global:global, lv:lv, col:col, msg:msg, elevated: global>5,
        components:[
          {name:'Subjective Sleep Quality', score:C1, color:'#1E3A5F'},
          {name:'Sleep Latency', score:C2, color:'#1E3A5F'},
          {name:'Sleep Duration', score:C3, color:'#1E3A5F'},
          {name:'Habitual Sleep Efficiency', score:C4, color:'#1E3A5F'},
          {name:'Sleep Disturbances', score:C5, color:'#1E3A5F'},
          {name:'Sleep Medication Use', score:C6, color:'#1E3A5F'},
          {name:'Daytime Dysfunction', score:C7, color:'#1E3A5F'}
```

```
function getComplaintText(item){
  var t = item.text.replace(/\?$/,'').trim();
  t = t.replace(/^(Do you |Does your |Are you |Is your |How often (do|have) you |I |When I'm upset, I |During the past month, )/i, function(m){ return m; });
  return t.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + t.slice(1) + '.';
}

function extractChiefComplaints(t, dim, answers, offset){
  var scored = [];
  dim.items.forEach(function(item, i){
    var flatIdx = offset + i;
    var val = answers[flatIdx];
    if(val === undefined || item.type === 'time') return;
    var numVal = parseFloat(val);
    if(isNaN(numVal)) return;
    var concernValue = item.reverse ? (dim.maxPerItem - numVal) : numVal;
    var ratio = dim.maxPerItem ? (concernValue / dim.maxPerItem) : 0;
    if(t.key === 'afi') ratio = 1 - (numVal / dim.maxPerItem); // ability-framed: low score = concern
    scored.push({ text:item.text, ratio:ratio });
  });
  scored.sort(function(a,b){ return b.ratio - a.ratio; });
  var top = scored.filter(function(s){ return s.ratio >= 0.55; }).slice(0,4);
  if(top.length < 2) top = scored.slice(0, 3);
  return top.map(function(s){ return getComplaintText({text:s.text}); });
}

function buildReportContent(t, testAnswersLocal, resultData){
  var content = REPORT_CONTENT[t.internalKey] || null;
  var offset = 0;
  var allComplaints = [];
  t.dimensions.forEach(function(dim){
    allComplaints = allComplaints.concat(extractChiefComplaints({key:t.internalKey}, dim, testAnswersLocal, offset));
    offset += dim.items.length;
  });
  allComplaints = allComplaints.slice(0, 4);
  return { models: content ? content.models : [], activities: content ? content.activities : [], complaints: allComplaints };
}

```

```
function extractChiefComplaints(testKey, dim, answers, offset){
  var scored = [];
  dim.items.forEach(function(item, i){
    var flatIdx = offset + i;
    var val = answers[flatIdx];
    if(val === undefined || item.type === 'time') return;
    var numVal = parseFloat(val);
    if(isNaN(numVal)) return;
    var concernValue = item.reverse ? (dim.maxPerItem - numVal) : numVal;
    var ratio = dim.maxPerItem ? (concernValue / dim.maxPerItem) : 0;
    if(testKey === 'afi') ratio = 1 - (numVal / dim.maxPerItem); // ability-framed: low score = concern
    scored.push({ text:item.text, ratio:ratio });
  });
  scored.sort(function(a,b){ return b.ratio - a.ratio; });
  var top = scored.filter(function(s){ return s.ratio >= 0.55; }).slice(0,4);
  if(top.length < 2) top = scored.slice(0, 3);
  return top.map(function(s){ return getComplaintText({text:s.text}); });
}

function buildReportContent(testKey, t, testAnswersLocal){
  var content = REPORT_CONTENT[testKey] || null;
  var offset = 0;
  var allComplaints = [];
  t.dimensions.forEach(function(dim){
    if(dim.items[0] && dim.items[0].type === 'time'){ offset += dim.items.length; return; }
    allComplaints = allComplaints.concat(extractChiefComplaints(testKey, dim, testAnswersLocal, offset));
    offset += dim.items.length;
  });
  allComplaints = allComplaints.slice(0, 4);
  return { models: content ? content.models : [], activities: content ? content.activities : [], complaints: allComplaints };
}
```

```
  });
```

```
  var shared = document.getElementById('quickJournalShareCheck').checked;

  var distressMoods = ['Anxious', 'Restless', 'Heavy'];
  var isDistressed = quickJournalSelected.some(function(l){ return distressMoods.indexOf(l) !== -1; });
```

```
function renderMoodPastDays(){
  var wrap = document.getElementById('moodPastDaysList');
  wrap.innerHTML = '';
  var byDate = {};
  appState.entries.forEach(function(e){
    if(!e.moods || !e.moods.length) return;
    var key = keyFor(new Date(e.date));
    if(!byDate[key]) byDate[key] = [];
    e.moods.forEach(function(m){
      if(!byDate[key].some(function(existing){ return existing.label === m.label; })) byDate[key].push(m);
    });
  });
  var dateKeys = Object.keys(byDate).sort().reverse();
  if(!dateKeys.length){
    wrap.innerHTML = '<p style="text-align:center;color:#B0AA98;font-size:12px;font-style:italic;padding:16px 0;">No moods logged yet — they\'ll show up here once you check in.</p>';
    return;
  }
  dateKeys.slice(0, 30).forEach(function(key){
    var parts = key.split('-').map(Number);
    var dateObj = new Date(parts[0], parts[1]-1, parts[2]);
    var isToday = key === TODAY_KEY;
    var label = isToday ? 'Today' : dateObj.toLocaleDateString(undefined, {weekday:'short', month:'short', day:'numeric'});
    var dotsHtml = byDate[key].map(function(m){ return '<span style="display:inline-block;width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:50%;background:'+m.color+';margin-right:4px;"></span>'; }).join('');
    var namesHtml = byDate[key].map(function(m){ return m.label; }).join(', ');
    var row = document.createElement('div');
    row.style.cssText = 'display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;background:#FFFFFF;border:1px solid #EEE0C4;border-radius:14px;padding:12px 14px;margin-bottom:8px;cursor:pointer;';
    row.innerHTML = '<div><p style="font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;color:#2A2013;margin:0 0 4px;">'+label+'</p><p style="font-size:11px;color:#9AABCE;margin:0;">'+namesHtml+'</p></div><div>'+dotsHtml+'</div>';
    row.onclick = function(){ openDay(key); };
    wrap.appendChild(row);
  });
}
```

```
-- ============================================================
-- HOBS COMPANION — SUPABASE SCHEMA
-- Run this in Supabase Dashboard → SQL Editor → New Query → Run
-- Replaces localStorage entirely. Every table has Row Level Security
-- so each user can only ever see/edit their own data.
-- ============================================================

-- Supabase Auth already provides auth.users — we don't create that ourselves.
-- Every table below references auth.uid() to scope data per-person.

-- ---------- MOOD / JOURNAL ENTRIES ----------
create table entries (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  user_id uuid references auth.users not null default auth.uid(),
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  moods jsonb not null default '[]',        -- [{label, color}]
  text text default '',
  type text default 'journal',              -- 'journal' | 'worksheet'
  worksheet_name text,
  category_name text,
  category_color text,
  shared_with_therapist boolean default false
);
alter table entries enable row level security;
create policy "Users manage own entries" on entries for all using (auth.uid() = user_id);

-- ---------- TASKS ----------
create table tasks (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  user_id uuid references auth.users not null default auth.uid(),
  date_key text not null,                   -- 'YYYY-MM-DD'
  title text not null,
  done boolean default false,
  priority text,                            -- 'low' | 'medium' | 'high' | null
  deadline timestamptz,
  duration int,
  repeat boolean default false,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
);
alter table tasks enable row level security;
create policy "Users manage own tasks" on tasks for all using (auth.uid() = user_id);

-- ---------- SUBTASKS ----------
create table subtasks (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  task_id uuid references tasks(id) on delete cascade not null,
  user_id uuid references auth.users not null default auth.uid(),
  title text not null,
  done boolean default false,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
);
alter table subtasks enable row level security;
create policy "Users manage own subtasks" on subtasks for all using (auth.uid() = user_id);

-- ---------- WORKSHEET RESPONSES ----------
create table worksheet_responses (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  user_id uuid references auth.users not null default auth.uid(),
  worksheet_key text not null,
  category_key text not null,
  answers jsonb not null default '{}',
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now()
);
alter table worksheet_responses enable row level security;
create policy "Users manage own worksheets" on worksheet_responses for all using (auth.uid() = user_id);

-- ---------- SCREENING TEST RESULTS ----------
create table test_results (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  user_id uuid references auth.users not null default auth.uid(),
  test_key text not null,
  answers jsonb not null default '[]',
  score jsonb not null default '{}',        -- computed result snapshot
  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
);
alter table test_results enable row level security;
create policy "Users manage own test results" on test_results for all using (auth.uid() = user_id);

-- ---------- WHO-5 BI-WEEKLY CHECK-INS ----------
create table who5_entries (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  user_id uuid references auth.users not null default auth.uid(),
  score int not null,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
);
alter table who5_entries enable row level security;
create policy "Users manage own who5 entries" on who5_entries for all using (auth.uid() = user_id);

-- ---------- USER PROFILE / STATE ----------
create table profiles (
  user_id uuid references auth.users primary key default auth.uid(),
  name text,
  has_therapist boolean default false,
  therapist_name text,
  has_outside_therapist boolean default false,
  has_support_group boolean default false,
  dismissed_pitch boolean default false,
  dismissed_support_pitch boolean default false,
  last_badge_count int default 0,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
);
alter table profiles enable row level security;
create policy "Users manage own profile" on profiles for all using (auth.uid() = user_id);

-- Auto-create a profile row the moment someone signs up
create function public.handle_new_user()
returns trigger as $$
begin
  insert into public.profiles (user_id) values (new.id);
  return new;
end;
$$ language plpgsql security definer;

create trigger on_auth_user_created
  after insert on auth.users
  for each row execute procedure public.handle_new_user();

-- ---------- REWARD CREDITS (computed, but logged for audit/history) ----------
create table credit_log (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  user_id uuid references auth.users not null default auth.uid(),
  date_key text not null,
  credit_amount numeric not null,
  reason text,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
);
alter table credit_log enable row level security;
create policy "Users manage own credit log" on credit_log for all using (auth.uid() = user_id);

```

```
// ================= SUPABASE BACKEND CONNECTION =================
var SUPABASE_URL = 'https://adjvptkzyckkvewbfmzf.supabase.co';
var SUPABASE_KEY = 'sb_publishable_OfcfAkUyxd9oXKeGvVxBIw_KxUV9TzE';
var sb = window.supabase.createClient(SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_KEY);
var currentUser = null;
var authMode = 'signin';

function showAuthError(msg){
  var el = document.getElementById('authError');
  el.textContent = msg;
  el.style.display = 'block';
}
function hideAuthError(){
  document.getElementById('authError').style.display = 'none';
}

document.getElementById('authToggleModeBtn').onclick = function(){
  authMode = authMode === 'signin' ? 'signup' : 'signin';
  document.getElementById('authSubmitBtn').textContent = authMode === 'signin' ? 'Sign In' : 'Create Account';
  document.getElementById('authToggleModeBtn').textContent = authMode === 'signin' ? "Don't have an account? Sign up" : 'Already have an account? Sign in';
  document.getElementById('authSubtitle').textContent = authMode === 'signin' ? 'Sign in to sync your data across devices.' : 'Create an account so your data is never lost.';
  hideAuthError();
};

document.getElementById('authSubmitBtn').onclick = function(){
  hideAuthError();
  var email = document.getElementById('authEmail').value.trim();
  var password = document.getElementById('authPassword').value;
  if(!email || !password){ showAuthError('Enter both email and password.'); return; }
  if(password.length < 6){ showAuthError('Password needs to be at least 6 characters.'); return; }
  var btn = document.getElementById('authSubmitBtn');
  btn.textContent = 'Please wait...'; btn.disabled = true;

  var authCall = authMode === 'signin'
    ? sb.auth.signInWithPassword({ email: email, password: password })
    : sb.auth.signUp({ email: email, password: password });

  authCall.then(function(result){
    btn.disabled = false;
    btn.textContent = authMode === 'signin' ? 'Sign In' : 'Create Account';
    if(result.error){
      showAuthError(result.error.message);
      return;
    }
    if(authMode === 'signup' && result.data.user && !result.data.session){
      showAuthError('Account created — check your email to confirm, then sign in.');
      authMode = 'signin';
      document.getElementById('authSubmitBtn').textContent = 'Sign In';
      document.getElementById('authToggleModeBtn').textContent = 'Already have an account? Sign in';
      return;
    }
    onAuthSuccess(result.data.user);
  }).catch(function(err){
    btn.disabled = false;
    btn.textContent = authMode === 'signin' ? 'Sign In' : 'Create Account';
    showAuthError('Connection error — check your internet and try again.');
  });
};

function onAuthSuccess(user){
  currentUser = user;
  loadUserDataFromSupabase().then(function(){
    document.getElementById('authOverlay').style.display = 'none';
  });
}

// Check for an existing session on load (keeps people signed in between visits)
sb.auth.getSession().then(function(result){
  if(result.data.session && result.data.session.user){
    onAuthSuccess(result.data.session.user);
  }
});

// ================= LOAD REAL DATA FROM SUPABASE INTO appState =================
function loadUserDataFromSupabase(){
  var uid = currentUser.id;
  return Promise.all([
    sb.from('profiles').select('*').eq('user_id', uid).single(),
    sb.from('entries').select('*').eq('user_id', uid).order('created_at', {ascending:false}),
    sb.from('tasks').select('*').eq('user_id', uid),
    sb.from('subtasks').select('*').eq('user_id', uid)
  ]).then(function(results){
    var profileRes = results[0], entriesRes = results[1], tasksRes = results[2], subtasksRes = results[3];

    if(profileRes.data){
      appState.userHasTherapist = profileRes.data.has_therapist || false;
      appState.therapistName = profileRes.data.therapist_name || '';
      appState.hasOutsideTherapist = profileRes.data.has_outside_therapist || false;
      appState.userHasSupportGroup = profileRes.data.has_support_group || false;
      appState.dontShowPitch = profileRes.data.dismissed_pitch || false;
      appState.dontShowSupportPitch = profileRes.data.dismissed_support_pitch || false;
      appState.lastBadgeCount = profileRes.data.last_badge_count || 0;
    }

    appState.entries = (entriesRes.data || []).map(function(row){
      return {
        id: row.id, date: row.created_at, moods: row.moods || [], text: row.text || '',
        type: row.type, worksheetName: row.worksheet_name, categoryName: row.category_name,
        color: row.category_color, sharedWithTherapist: row.shared_with_therapist
      };
    });

    var subsByTask = {};
    (subtasksRes.data || []).forEach(function(s){
      if(!subsByTask[s.task_id]) subsByTask[s.task_id] = [];
      subsByTask[s.task_id].push({ id: s.id, title: s.title, done: s.done });
    });
    appState.tasksByDate = {};
    (tasksRes.data || []).forEach(function(t){
      if(!appState.tasksByDate[t.date_key]) appState.tasksByDate[t.date_key] = [];
      appState.tasksByDate[t.date_key].push({
        id: t.id, title: t.title, done: t.done, priority: t.priority,
        deadline: t.deadline, duration: t.duration, repeat: t.repeat,
        subtasks: subsByTask[t.id] || []
      });
    });

    saveState(); // keep localStorage as an offline fallback cache
  }).catch(function(err){
    console.error('Failed to load data from Supabase:', err);
    showToast('Could not load your data — check your connection');
  });
}
```

```
document.getElementById('sheetSaveTaskBtn').onclick = function(){
  var title = document.getElementById('sheetTaskInput').value.trim();
  if(!title) return;
  var deadlineVal = document.getElementById('sheetDeadlineInput').value;
  var subInputs = document.querySelectorAll('#sheetSubtaskArea input');
  var subtaskTitles = [];
  subInputs.forEach(function(inp){
    if(inp.value.trim()) subtaskTitles.push(inp.value.trim());
  });
  var deadlineIso = deadlineVal ? new Date(deadlineVal).toISOString() : null;

  var localTask = {
    id: 'temp_' + uidGen(), title: title, duration: sheetDuration, repeat: sheetRepeat,
    priority: sheetPriority, deadline: deadlineIso, done: false,
    subtasks: subtaskTitles.map(function(st){ return { id: 'temp_' + uidGen(), title: st, done:false }; })
  };
  getTasks(sheetTargetKey).push(localTask);
  saveState();
  closeAddTaskSheet();
  if(sheetTargetKey === bdSelectedKey) renderBodyDoubleTaskList();
  if(sheetTargetKey === activeDayKey) renderTaskListCal();

  sb.from('tasks').insert({
    user_id: currentUser.id, date_key: sheetTargetKey, title: title, duration: sheetDuration,
    repeat: sheetRepeat, priority: sheetPriority, deadline: deadlineIso, done: false
  }).select().single().then(function(result){
    if(result.error){ showToast('Task saved locally — sync failed'); return; }
    localTask.id = result.data.id; // swap temp ID for the real one
    if(subtaskTitles.length){
      var rows = subtaskTitles.map(function(st){ return { user_id: currentUser.id, task_id: result.data.id, title: st, done:false }; });
      sb.from('subtasks').insert(rows).select().then(function(subResult){
        if(!subResult.error){
          localTask.subtasks.forEach(function(st, i){ if(subResult.data[i]) st.id = subResult.data[i].id; });
        }
      });
    }
  });
};

// ================= TIPS =================
```

```
# Installing HOBS Companion (Beta)

Thanks for helping test the HOBS Companion app! Here's how to get it installed — takes about 2 minutes.

## Option 1: Install the App (try this first)

1. Open this link on your phone: **[Drive link goes here]**
2. Tap **Download**
3. Once downloaded, tap the file to open it
4. Android will ask permission to "install unknown apps" — tap **Settings**, then turn on **Allow from this source**, then go back and tap **Install**
5. That's it — open "HOBS Companion" from your home screen like any other app

**This one popup asking to allow the install is completely normal** for any app installed outside the Play Store — it's not a sign anything is wrong.

## If you see "App blocked by Advanced Protection"

This means your Google account has Google's **Advanced Protection Program** turned on (a high-security mode, off by default for almost everyone). If you see this:

**Don't worry about fixing that setting — just use this instead:**

1. Open this link in your phone's browser (Chrome works best): **[Same link, web version]**
2. Tap the **menu (⋮)** in your browser
3. Tap **"Add to Home Screen"** (or "Install app" if you see that option)
4. It'll now sit on your home screen with an icon, and opens full-screen just like the installed version

Both versions work identically — same features, same data, just a different way of getting it onto your phone.

## Questions or something not working?

Message [your contact info here] — screenshots of anything unexpected are always helpful.

```

NEW (exact):
