```
var IS_NATIVE_APP = !!(window.Capacitor && window.Capacitor.isNativePlatform && window.Capacitor.isNativePlatform());
var WEB_APP_URL = 'https://lovely-monstera-df97ae.netlify.app/';
var NATIVE_CALLBACK_URL = 'hobscompanion://callback';

document.getElementById('authGoogleBtn').onclick = function(){
  hideAuthError();
  sb.auth.signInWithOAuth({
    provider: 'google',
    options: { redirectTo: IS_NATIVE_APP ? NATIVE_CALLBACK_URL : WEB_APP_URL }
  }).then(function(result){
    if(result.error) showAuthError(result.error.message);
    // On success, the browser navigates away to Google and back — no further code runs here.
  });
};

// When running inside the native app, catch the OAuth callback being handed back via the
// custom URL scheme (hobscompanion://callback#access_token=...) and manually establish the
// Supabase session from the tokens in that URL, since the native shell doesn't process the
// URL fragment the way a normal browser page load would.
if(IS_NATIVE_APP && window.Capacitor.Plugins && window.Capacitor.Plugins.App){
  window.Capacitor.Plugins.App.addListener('appUrlOpen', function(data){
    var url = data.url || '';
    var hashIndex = url.indexOf('#');
    if(hashIndex === -1) return;
    var params = new URLSearchParams(url.substring(hashIndex + 1));
    var accessToken = params.get('access_token');
    var refreshToken = params.get('refresh_token');
    if(accessToken && refreshToken){
      sb.auth.setSession({ access_token: accessToken, refresh_token: refreshToken }).then(function(result){
        if(result.error){ showAuthError('Sign-in failed: ' + result.error.message); return; }
        onAuthSuccess(result.data.user);
      });
    }
  });
}
```

````
# HOBS Companion — Complete Project Handoff
Last updated: July 6, 2026

This package contains everything needed to continue development, deployment, or debugging of the HOBS Companion app with any AI assistant or developer — without needing prior conversation history.

## What this app is

A mental health companion app for Home of Beautiful Souls Foundation (HOBS), an Ahmedabad-based NGO. Features: mood check-ins, journaling, task management with subtasks, 16 real mental health screening tests (ported from homeofbeautifulsouls.com), therapy worksheets, grounding/relaxation exercises, downloadable PDF screening reports, and a rewards system. Currently in closed beta (~25 testers).

## Folder structure

```
/web/          → The actual app (single-file HTML/CSS/JS). This is the source of truth.
/mobile/       → Capacitor Android project that wraps /web/ into an installable APK
/backend/      → Supabase database schema
/docs/         → Tester-facing install instructions
```

## Live infrastructure — all credentials included

**Web app (live, primary source of truth):**
`https://hobscompanion.netlify.app/`
Hosted via Netlify Drop — to update, drag the contents of `/web/` into https://app.netlify.com/drop, targeting this same existing site (not a new one).

**Backend — Supabase:**
- Project URL: `https://adjvptkzyckkvewbfmzf.supabase.co`
- Publishable/anon key: `sb_publishable_OfcfAkUyxd9oXKeGvVxBIw_KxUV9TzE`
  (safe for client-side code — protected by Row Level Security policies on every table)
- Dashboard login: homeofbeautifulsouls@gmail.com's account
- Schema: see `/backend/supabase_schema.sql` — 8 tables (entries, tasks, subtasks, worksheet_responses, test_results, who5_entries, profiles, credit_log), all with RLS so users can only ever access their own rows.
- Auth providers enabled: Email/password, Google OAuth
- Auth → URL Configuration must have:
  - Site URL: `https://hobscompanion.netlify.app`
  - Redirect URLs allow-list includes: `hobscompanion://callback`

**Google OAuth:**
- Google Cloud project: "home-of-beautiful-souls"
- OAuth client (Web application) created under APIs & Services → Credentials
- Authorized redirect URI (in Google Cloud, not changeable without breaking auth): `https://adjvptkzyckkvewbfmzf.supabase.co/auth/v1/callback`
- Client ID + Secret are pasted into Supabase → Authentication → Providers → Google (not duplicated here — check Supabase dashboard directly)

**Android app:**
- Package name: `com.hobsfoundation.companion`
- Native OAuth deep-link scheme: `hobscompanion://callback`
- Signing keystore: `/mobile/android/hobs-release.keystore`
  - Store password: `<REDACTED:known_credential>`
  - Key alias: `hobs`
  - Key password: `<REDACTED:known_credential>`
  - ⚠️ This exact file must be used for all future builds, or Android will treat it as a different app and existing installs can't update — they'd need full uninstall/reinstall.
- Distribution: direct APK via shared link (not Play Store — no developer account purchased yet)

## Architecture — how it all fits together

The Android app is a **thin native shell** (built with Capacitor) that loads its actual content live from the Netlify URL above — it does NOT bundle the web code inside the package. This means:
- **Code/UI changes**: edit `/web/index.html`, re-deploy to the same Netlify site → done. No APK rebuild, no reinstall needed for existing testers.
- **APK rebuild only needed for**: native-level changes (permissions, deep-link config, app icon, signing).

Data flows through Supabase, not localStorage. The app keeps a local in-memory cache (`appState`) that's hydrated from Supabase on login and pushed to Supabase on every change (optimistic-update pattern — UI updates instantly with a temporary ID, then swaps to the real database ID once the write completes).

## How to rebuild the APK (if ever needed)

Requires: Node.js, a JDK (full JDK, not just JRE — needs `javac`), Android SDK (platform-tools, `platforms;android-34`, `build-tools;34.0.0`).

```bash
cd mobile
npm install
npx cap sync android
cd android
./gradlew assembleRelease
# Output: android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk
```
The `capacitor.config.json` already points `server.url` at the live Netlify site — don't remove this unless intentionally switching back to bundled-assets mode.

## What's fully working (tested, not just built)

- Real authentication: email/password + Google OAuth (including native deep-link handling back into the installed app)
- Mood check-ins, journal entries (including retroactive calendar entries), tasks + subtasks, worksheet completions — all synced to real Supabase tables
- Sign out
- 16 real screening tests with exact scoring matching the live website, PDF report generation
- Full task/subtask/mood/journal UI flows — audited end-to-end, no known broken navigation paths as of this handoff

## What's NOT yet wired to the backend (still local-only / not persisted per-account)

- Screening test results (schema table `test_results` exists, app doesn't write to it yet)
- WHO-5 bi-weekly check-ins (table `who5_entries` exists, not wired)
- Profile fields — therapist connection status, support group membership (table `profiles` exists and partially reads, but the app doesn't write updates to it yet)
- Credits/rewards (table `credit_log` exists, rewards are still computed client-side only, no persistence)

## Other known pending items

- Worksheet library is still small (6 worksheets across 3 categories) — was meant to be expanded
- Calm Room needs real background image + music file from Akash
- YouTube slider on Home page still has placeholder content — needs real video links
- Mascot artwork for Kunnu, Cookie, and Po are Claude-generated placeholders — Akash wants custom official art eventually
- PDF report font is Helvetica (jsPDF default) — brand font is Plus Jakarta Sans, would need font embedding to match exactly
- Custom domain (e.g. app.homeofbeautifulsouls.com) was discussed but intentionally deferred — currently on default Netlify domain

## Design/brand reference

Navy #2E5090, gold #FDB913, cream #FEF3D8, DES-II teal #0F766E. Font: Plus Jakarta Sans (web), Helvetica (PDF reports, limitation noted above). Brand rule: never use the phrase "free of cost" anywhere in copy.

````

```
}

var AFFIRMATIONS_BY_TIME = {
  morning: [
    "However today goes, you get to start again right now.",
    "You don't need to have it figured out yet. Just begin.",
    "Whatever pace feels right today is the right pace.",
    "A new day doesn't ask you to be different than you were yesterday."

  ],
  evening: [

    "Whatever today looked like, you're still here. That matters.",
    "Showing up messy still counts as showing up.",
    "The day doesn't need a perfect ending to have been worth living."
  ],
  night: [
    "If sleep isn't coming easily, that's okay too. You're not doing anything wrong.",
    "Whatever kept you up, you don't have to carry it alone.",
    "It's alright to just be still for a while.",
    "Tomorrow isn't asking anything of you yet. Not tonight."
  ]
};

function renderHomeGreeting(){
  var hour = new Date().getHours();
  var timeKey = hour < 12 ? 'morning' : hour < 17 ? 'afternoon' : hour < 22 ? 'evening' : 'night';
  var name = getDisplayName();
  var greetingEl = document.getElementById('homeGreeting');
  greetingEl.textContent = name ? ('Welcome home, ' + name) : 'Welcome home';

  var pool = AFFIRMATIONS_BY_TIME[timeKey];
  document.getElementById('bobAffirmation').textContent = pool[Math.floor(Math.random()*pool.length)];
}
renderHomeGreeting();
</script>
```

```
function onAuthSuccess(user){
  currentUser = user;
  loadUserDataFromSupabase().then(function(){
    document.getElementById('authOverlay').style.display = 'none';
    if(!appState.onboardingComplete){
      showOnboarding();
    } else {
      renderHomeGreeting();
    }
  });
}

var PRONOUN_OPTIONS = ['She/Her', 'He/Him', 'They/Them', 'Prefer not to say', 'Self-describe'];
function showOnboarding(){
  var meta = (currentUser.user_metadata || {});
  document.getElementById('obName').value = appState.displayName || meta.full_name || meta.name || '';
  document.getElementById('obPhone').value = appState.phoneNumber || '';
  document.getElementById('obDob').value = appState.dateOfBirth || '';
  document.getElementById('obPronounCustom').style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('obPronounCustom').value = '';

  var selectedPronoun = appState.pronouns || '';
  var chipsWrap = document.getElementById('obPronounChips');
  chipsWrap.innerHTML = '';
  PRONOUN_OPTIONS.forEach(function(opt){
    var chip = document.createElement('button');
    chip.type = 'button';
    chip.textContent = opt;
    var isSelected = (opt === 'Self-describe' && selectedPronoun && PRONOUN_OPTIONS.indexOf(selectedPronoun) === -1) || opt === selectedPronoun;
    chip.style.cssText = 'padding:9px 14px;border-radius:20px;border:2px solid ' + (isSelected ? '#6690D6' : '#EEE0C4') + ';background:' + (isSelected ? '#6690D6' : '#FFFFFF') + ';color:' + (isSelected ? '#fff' : '#2A2013') + ';font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;';
    chip.onclick = function(){
      Array.from(chipsWrap.children).forEach(function(c){ c.style.background = '#FFFFFF'; c.style.color = '#2A2013'; c.style.borderColor = '#EEE0C4'; });
      chip.style.background = '#6690D6'; chip.style.color = '#fff'; chip.style.borderColor = '#6690D6';
      chipsWrap.dataset.selected = opt;
      document.getElementById('obPronounCustom').style.display = (opt === 'Self-describe') ? 'block' : 'none';
    };
    chipsWrap.appendChild(chip);
  });
  chipsWrap.dataset.selected = selectedPronoun && PRONOUN_OPTIONS.indexOf(selectedPronoun) !== -1 ? selectedPronoun : (selectedPronoun ? 'Self-describe' : '');
  if(chipsWrap.dataset.selected === 'Self-describe') document.getElementById('obPronounCustom').value = selectedPronoun;

  document.getElementById('obError').style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('onboardingOverlay').style.display = 'flex';
}

document.getElementById('obSaveBtn').onclick = function(){
  var name = document.getElementById('obName').value.trim();
  var phone = document.getElementById('obPhone').value.trim();
  var dob = document.getElementById('obDob').value;
  var chipsWrap = document.getElementById('obPronounChips');
  var selected = chipsWrap.dataset.selected;
  var pronouns = selected === 'Self-describe' ? document.getElementById('obPronounCustom').value.trim() : selected;

  var errEl = document.getElementById('obError');
  if(!name || !pronouns || !phone || !dob){
    errEl.textContent = 'Please fill in all four fields to continue.';
    errEl.style.display = 'block';
    return;
  }

  var btn = document.getElementById('obSaveBtn');
  btn.textContent = 'Saving...'; btn.disabled = true;

  sb.from('profiles').update({
    name: name, pronouns: pronouns, phone_number: phone, date_of_birth: dob, onboarding_complete: true
  }).eq('user_id', currentUser.id).then(function(result){
    btn.textContent = 'Continue'; btn.disabled = false;
    if(result.error){
      errEl.textContent = 'Could not save — check your connection and try again.';
      errEl.style.display = 'block';
      return;
    }
    appState.displayName = name;
    appState.pronouns = pronouns;
    appState.phoneNumber = phone;
    appState.dateOfBirth = dob;
    appState.onboardingComplete = true;
    document.getElementById('onboardingOverlay').style.display = 'none';
    renderHomeGreeting();
  });
};
```

```
var SPLASH_START_TIME = Date.now();
var MIN_SPLASH_MS = 1200;
function afterSplashMinimum(fn){
  var elapsed = Date.now() - SPLASH_START_TIME;
  var wait = Math.max(0, MIN_SPLASH_MS - elapsed);

}
```

```
function renderWalkthroughSlide(){
  var s = WALKTHROUGH_SLIDES[walkthroughIdx];
  var wrap = document.getElementById('walkthroughSlides');
  wrap.style.opacity = '0';
  setTimeout(function(){
    wrap.innerHTML =
      '<img src="'+s.image+'" alt="'+(s.name||'HOBS')+'" style="'+s.imgStyle+'margin-bottom:22px;filter:drop-shadow(0 10px 18px rgba(40,70,140,0.18));" onerror="this.style.display=\'none\'">'+
      '<p style="font-size:19px;font-weight:800;color:#2E5090;margin:0 0 10px;">'+s.heading+'</p>'+
      '<p style="font-size:14px;color:#5C6B94;line-height:1.6;max-width:280px;margin:0;">'+s.body+'</p>';
    wrap.style.opacity = '1';
  }, 150);

  var dotsWrap = document.getElementById('walkthroughDots');
  dotsWrap.innerHTML = '';
  WALKTHROUGH_SLIDES.forEach(function(_, i){
    var dot = document.createElement('div');
    dot.style.cssText = 'width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:'+(i===walkthroughIdx?'#6690D6':'#EEE0C4')+';';
    dotsWrap.appendChild(dot);
  });

  var isLast = walkthroughIdx === WALKTHROUGH_SLIDES.length - 1;
  document.getElementById('walkthroughSwipeHint').style.display = isLast ? 'none' : 'flex';
  document.getElementById('walkthroughFinishBtn').style.display = isLast ? 'block' : 'none';
}

function finishWalkthrough(){
  appState.hasSeenIntro = true;
  document.getElementById('walkthroughOverlay').style.display = 'none';
  renderHomeGreeting();
  sb.from('profiles').update({ has_seen_intro: true }).eq('user_id', currentUser.id).then(function(result){
    if(result.error) console.error('Could not save intro-seen flag:', result.error);
  });
}

document.getElementById('walkthroughFinishBtn').onclick = finishWalkthrough;

// Swipe gesture navigation — left advances to the next companion, right goes back.
// Works for both real touch and mouse-drag (useful for desktop testing too).
(function(){
  var slidesEl = document.getElementById('walkthroughSlides');
  var startX = null, startY = null;
  slidesEl.addEventListener('pointerdown', function(e){
    startX = e.clientX; startY = e.clientY;
  });
  slidesEl.addEventListener('pointerup', function(e){
    if(startX === null) return;
    var dx = e.clientX - startX, dy = e.clientY - startY;
    startX = null;
    if(Math.abs(dx) < 40 || Math.abs(dx) < Math.abs(dy)) return; // ignore small or vertical-ish gestures
    if(dx < 0 && walkthroughIdx < WALKTHROUGH_SLIDES.length - 1){
      walkthroughIdx++;
      renderWalkthroughSlide();
    } else if(dx > 0 && walkthroughIdx > 0){
      walkthroughIdx--;
      renderWalkthroughSlide();
    }
  });
})();
```

```
var MASCOT_MINI_SVG = {
  bob: '<img class="mascot-mini" src="bob.png" alt="Bob">',
  kunnu: '<img class="mascot-mini" src="kunnu.png" alt="Kunnu">',
  cookie: '<img class="mascot-mini" src="cookie.png" alt="Cookie">',
  po: '<img class="mascot-mini" src="po.png" alt="Po">'
};

// Reusable mascot companion tip — drops a small dismissible card with a mascot's photo and a
// short line into any container. Each tipId is remembered once dismissed (per device), so a
// tip that's been dismissed doesn't keep resurfacing and become noise.
var MASCOT_IMG_SRC = { bob:'bob.png', kunnu:'kunnu.png', cookie:'cookie.png', po:'po.png' };
function renderMascotTip(containerId, tipId, mascotKey, message){
  var container = document.getElementById(containerId);
  if(!container) return;
  var dismissed = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('hobs_dismissed_tips') || '[]');
  if(dismissed.indexOf(tipId) !== -1){ container.innerHTML = ''; return; }
  container.innerHTML =
    '<div class="mascot-tip">' +
      '<img src="' + MASCOT_IMG_SRC[mascotKey] + '" alt="' + mascotKey + '">' +
      '<p class="mascot-tip-text">' + message + '</p>' +
      '<button class="mascot-tip-close" data-tip-id="' + tipId + '">&times;</button>' +
    '</div>';
  container.querySelector('.mascot-tip-close').onclick = function(){
    var d = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('hobs_dismissed_tips') || '[]');
    if(d.indexOf(tipId) === -1) d.push(tipId);
    localStorage.setItem('hobs_dismissed_tips', JSON.stringify(d));
    container.innerHTML = '';
  };
}
```

```
      '</div>';
  }).join('') + '<div style="flex:0 0 4px;"></div>';
```
```
  wrap.querySelectorAll('.team-card').forEach(function(card){
    card.onclick = function(){ openExpertDetail(parseInt(card.dataset.idx)); };
  });
}

    '</div>'+

    '<div style="display:flex;gap:10px;margin-bottom:20px;">'+
      '<div style="flex:1;background:#FFFFFF;border:1px solid #EEE0C4;border-radius:14px;padding:14px 10px;text-align:center;">'+
        '<p style="font-size:9.5px;color:#9AABCE;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.03em;margin:0 0 4px;">Qualification</p>'+
        '<p style="font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;color:#2A2013;margin:0;">'+m.credential+'</p>'+
      '</div>'+
      '<div style="flex:1;background:#FFFFFF;border:1px solid #EEE0C4;border-radius:14px;padding:14px 10px;text-align:center;">'+
```

```
function getActiveBookingForCategory(category){
  return (appState.expertBookings || []).find(function(b){ return b.role_category === category && b.status === 'active'; }) || null;
}

function bookExpert(m){
  var waMessage = encodeURIComponent("Hi! I'd like to book a session with " + m.name + " at HOBS.");
  var newBooking = { id: 'temp_' + uidGen(), expert_name: m.name, role_category: m.roleCategory, status: 'active' };
  appState.expertBookings.push(newBooking);
  renderTeamList();
  window.open('https://wa.me/918320470976?text=' + waMessage, '_blank');
  sb.from('expert_bookings').insert({
    user_id: currentUser.id, expert_name: m.name, role_category: m.roleCategory, status: 'active'
  }).select().single().then(function(result){
    if(!result.error) newBooking.id = result.data.id;
  });
}

function requestExpertChange(m, currentExpertName){
  var waMessage = encodeURIComponent("Hi! I'd currently connected with " + currentExpertName + " (" + m.roleCategory + ") and would like to request a change. Could we talk through options?");
  var booking = getActiveBookingForCategory(m.roleCategory);
  if(booking){
    booking.status = 'change_requested';
    if(String(booking.id).indexOf('temp_') !== 0){
      sb.from('expert_bookings').update({ status: 'change_requested' }).eq('id', booking.id).then(function(){});
    }
  }
  window.open('https://wa.me/918320470976?text=' + waMessage, '_blank');
  renderTeamList();
}

function renderTeamList(){
  var wrap = document.getElementById('teamList');
  wrap.innerHTML = TEAM_MEMBERS.map(function(m, idx){
    var initials = m.name.split(' ').filter(function(w){ return w!=='Dr.'; }).map(function(w){ return w[0]; }).slice(0,2).join('');
    var photoInner = m.photo
      ? '<img src="'+m.photo+'" alt="'+m.name+'" id="teamPhoto'+idx+'" style="width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;" onerror="teamPhotoFallback(this, \''+initials+'\')">'
      : '<div style="width:100%;height:100%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:#E7EEFB;color:#4A6FB5;font-weight:700;font-size:24px;">'+initials+'</div>';

    var activeBooking = getActiveBookingForCategory(m.roleCategory);
    var isThisPersonBooked = activeBooking && activeBooking.expert_name === m.name;
    var isSomeoneElseBooked = activeBooking && activeBooking.expert_name !== m.name;

    var actionHtml;
    if(isThisPersonBooked){
      actionHtml = '<div style="display:flex;gap:8px;margin-top:6px;">'+

        '<button class="request-change-btn" data-idx="'+idx+'" style="flex:0 0 auto;padding:11px 12px;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid #EEE0C4;background:transparent;color:#5C6B94;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;">Request Change</button>'+
      '</div>';
    } else if(isSomeoneElseBooked){
      actionHtml = '<div style="margin-top:6px;padding:11px;border-radius:12px;background:#F5F3EE;color:#B0AA98;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;text-align:center;">Connected with '+activeBooking.expert_name+' in this category</div>';
    } else {
      actionHtml = '<button class="book-session-btn" data-idx="'+idx+'" style="display:block;width:100%;margin-top:6px;padding:11px;border-radius:12px;border:1.5px solid #6690D6;background:transparent;color:#6690D6;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;">Book Session</button>';
    }

    return '<div class="team-list-card" style="background:#FFFFFF;border:1px solid #EEE0C4;border-radius:18px;padding:14px;margin-bottom:12px;">'+
      '<div style="display:flex;gap:14px;">'+
        '<div style="flex:0 0 100px;position:relative;">'+
          '<div class="team-card" data-idx="'+idx+'" style="width:100px;height:126px;border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden;cursor:pointer;">'+photoInner+'</div>'+
          '<button class="team-card" data-idx="'+idx+'" style="position:absolute;left:6px;right:6px;bottom:6px;padding:6px 4px;border-radius:8px;border:none;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.92);color:#2E5090;font-size:9.5px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;">View Profile</button>'+
        '</div>'+
        '<div style="flex:1;min-width:0;">'+
          '<div style="display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:space-between;gap:6px;">'+
            '<p style="font-size:14.5px;font-weight:800;color:#2A2013;margin:0;">'+m.name+'</p>'+
            '<span style="flex-shrink:0;font-size:9px;font-weight:700;color:#3B8F63;background:#EAF4EE;padding:3px 7px;border-radius:8px;white-space:nowrap;">✓ Verified</span>'+
          '</div>'+
          '<p style="font-size:11px;color:#9AABCE;margin:2px 0 8px;">'+m.role+' ('+m.years+')</p>'+
          '<p style="font-size:11px;color:#5C6B94;margin:0 0 3px;">General mental health support</p>'+
          '<p style="font-size:11px;color:#5C6B94;margin:0 0 10px;">English</p>'+
        '</div>'+
      '</div>'+
      actionHtml+
    '</div>';
  }).join('');
  wrap.querySelectorAll('.team-card').forEach(function(card){
    card.onclick = function(){ openExpertDetail(parseInt(card.dataset.idx)); };
  });
  wrap.querySelectorAll('.book-session-btn').forEach(function(btn){
    btn.onclick = function(){ bookExpert(TEAM_MEMBERS[parseInt(btn.dataset.idx)]); };
  });
  wrap.querySelectorAll('.request-change-btn').forEach(function(btn){
    btn.onclick = function(){
      var m = TEAM_MEMBERS[parseInt(btn.dataset.idx)];
      requestExpertChange(m, m.name);

  });
}
```

```
function getActiveBookingForCategory(category){
  return (appState.expertBookings || []).find(function(b){ return b.role_category === category && b.status === 'active'; }) || null;
}

function showPolicyModal(onContinue){
  document.getElementById('policyModalBackdrop').style.display = 'block';
  document.getElementById('policyModal').style.display = 'block';
  var closeModal = function(){
    document.getElementById('policyModalBackdrop').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('policyModal').style.display = 'none';
  };
  document.getElementById('policyContinueBtn').onclick = function(){ closeModal(); onContinue(); };
  document.getElementById('policyCancelBtn').onclick = closeModal;
  document.getElementById('policyModalBackdrop').onclick = closeModal;
}

function bookExpert(m){
  showPolicyModal(function(){
    var newBooking = { id: 'temp_' + uidGen(), expert_name: m.name, role_category: m.roleCategory, status: 'active', cancellation_count: 0 };
    appState.expertBookings.push(newBooking);
    renderTeamList();
    if(m.bookingLink){
      window.open(m.bookingLink, '_blank');
    } else {
      var waMessage = encodeURIComponent("Hi! I'd like to book a session with " + m.name + " at HOBS.");
      window.open('https://wa.me/918320470976?text=' + waMessage, '_blank');
    }
    sb.from('expert_bookings').insert({
      user_id: currentUser.id, expert_name: m.name, role_category: m.roleCategory, status: 'active', cancellation_count: 0
    }).select().single().then(function(result){
      if(!result.error) newBooking.id = result.data.id;
    });
  });
}

function requestExpertChange(m, currentExpertName){
  var waMessage = encodeURIComponent("Hi! I'm currently connected with " + currentExpertName + " (" + m.roleCategory + ") and would like to request a change. Could we talk through options?");
  var booking = getActiveBookingForCategory(m.roleCategory);
  if(booking){
    booking.status = 'change_requested';
    if(String(booking.id).indexOf('temp_') !== 0){
      sb.from('expert_bookings').update({ status: 'change_requested' }).eq('id', booking.id).then(function(){});
    }
  }
  window.open('https://wa.me/918320470976?text=' + waMessage, '_blank');
  renderTeamList();
}

function cancelSession(m){
  var booking = getActiveBookingForCategory(m.roleCategory);
  if(!booking) return;
  var count = booking.cancellation_count || 0;

  if(count >= 1){
    // Second+ cancellation attempt — not self-service, must go through admin.
    var waMessage = encodeURIComponent("Hi! I need to cancel my session with " + m.name + " again (this would be my 2nd+ cancellation for this booking). I understand this needs to go through you directly, including the 50% cancellation charge that applies.");
    window.open('https://wa.me/918320470976?text=' + waMessage, '_blank');
    showToast("This is a repeat cancellation — it can't be self-service. We've opened a message to our team for you.");
    return;
  }

  // First cancellation — allowed, free, self-service.
  booking.cancellation_count = 1;
  booking.last_cancelled_at = new Date().toISOString();
  if(String(booking.id).indexOf('temp_') !== 0){
    sb.from('expert_bookings').update({
      cancellation_count: 1, last_cancelled_at: new Date().toISOString()
    }).eq('id', booking.id).then(function(){});
  }
  showToast("Session cancelled — this was your one free cancellation for this booking.");
  renderTeamList();
}
```

````
# HOBS Companion — Complete Project Handoff (v2)
Last updated: July 8, 2026

This package contains everything needed to continue development, deployment, or debugging of the HOBS Companion app — without needing prior conversation history.

## What changed since the last handoff

- **Migrated from Netlify to GitHub Pages** for web hosting, after Netlify's free tier ran out of usage credits and blocked new deploys. GitHub Pages isn't credit-metered.
- Mascot artwork is now real (not placeholder SVGs), booking/cancellation system added, onboarding flow added, and more — see `/docs/` for the full changelog document, or the Google Doc "HOBS Companion App — Infrastructure Update v14" in Drive.

## Folder structure

```
/web/          → The actual app (single-file HTML/CSS/JS + images). Source of truth.
/mobile/       → Capacitor Android project that wraps /web/ into an installable APK
/backend/      → All Supabase schema + migration files, in order
/docs/         → Tester-facing install instructions
```

## Live infrastructure — all credentials included

**Web app (live, primary source of truth):**
`https://homeofbeautifulsouls-sys.github.io/hobs-companion-app/`

Hosted via GitHub Pages from this repo: `https://github.com/homeofbeautifulsouls-sys/hobs-companion-app` (public repo, branch `main`, root path). To update: edit `/web/index.html` (and/or images), commit, push to `main` — GitHub Pages rebuilds automatically within about a minute. No manual upload step, unlike the old Netlify workflow.

**GitHub account:** username `homeofbeautifulsouls-sys`. A personal access token was used to create/push this repo — if that token has expired or been revoked, a new one needs to be generated (GitHub → Settings → Developer settings → Personal access tokens) with `repo` scope.

**Backend — Supabase:**
- Project URL: `https://adjvptkzyckkvewbfmzf.supabase.co`
- Publishable/anon key: `sb_publishable_OfcfAkUyxd9oXKeGvVxBIw_KxUV9TzE` (safe for client-side code — protected by Row Level Security on every table)
- Dashboard login: homeofbeautifulsouls@gmail.com's account
- **Run all files in `/backend/` in order** if setting this up fresh: `supabase_schema.sql` first (base 8 tables), then the `migration_*.sql` files in filename order (profile fields → intro flag → bookings table → cancellation columns)
- Auth providers enabled: Email/password, Google OAuth
- Auth → URL Configuration must have:
  - **Site URL: `https://homeofbeautifulsouls-sys.github.io/hobs-companion-app/`** (this changed from the old Netlify URL — if this doesn't match, auth redirects will break)
  - Redirect URLs allow-list includes: `hobscompanion://callback`

**Google OAuth:**
- Google Cloud project: "home-of-beautiful-souls"
- Authorized redirect URI (fixed, doesn't change): `https://adjvptkzyckkvewbfmzf.supabase.co/auth/v1/callback`
- Client ID + Secret are in Supabase → Authentication → Providers → Google

**Android app:**
- Package name: `com.hobsfoundation.companion`
- Native OAuth deep-link scheme: `hobscompanion://callback`
- Signing keystore: `/mobile/android/hobs-release.keystore`
  - Store password: `<REDACTED:known_credential>` / Key alias: `hobs` / Key password: `<REDACTED:known_credential>`
  - This exact file must be used for all future builds, or existing installs can't update — they'd need full uninstall/reinstall.
- Distribution: direct APK via shared link (not Play Store)

## Architecture — how it all fits together

The Android app is a **thin native shell** (Capacitor) loading its content live from the GitHub Pages URL above — not bundled inside the package. Code/UI changes: edit `/web/index.html`, push to GitHub, done — no APK rebuild needed for existing installs. APK rebuild only needed for native-level changes (permissions, deep-link config, the loaded URL itself, signing).

Data flows through Supabase. Local `appState` is hydrated from Supabase on login, pushed on every change (optimistic-update pattern).

## How to rebuild the APK (if ever needed)

Requires: Node.js, a full JDK (not just JRE), Android SDK (`platforms;android-34`, `build-tools;34.0.0`).

```bash
cd mobile
npm install
npx cap sync android
cd android
./gradlew assembleRelease
# Output: android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk
```

## What's fully working (tested, not just built)

- Real authentication: email/password + Google OAuth, including native deep-link handling
- Mood check-ins, journal entries, tasks + subtasks, worksheet completions — all synced to Supabase
- Mandatory onboarding (name/pronouns/phone/DOB) before first Home access
- First-time mascot walkthrough with swipe navigation
- 16 real screening tests with PDF report generation
- Meet Our Experts — real team data, honest placeholders where real bios don't exist yet
- Booking lock system — one active booking per role category per client, verified with real test numbers
- Cancellation policy disclosure + enforcement (first free, second blocked + routed to admin via WhatsApp)
- Mascot companion tips on Grounding, Worksheets, Support, and elevated test results

## What's NOT yet wired to the backend / not yet built

- Screening test results, WHO-5 check-ins, credits/rewards — still local-only, not persisted to Supabase
- Per-therapist real Google Calendar booking links — field exists in code (`bookingLink`), empty for all 10 team members currently
- Real payment gateway (the 50% cancellation charge is disclosed as policy but can't actually be charged yet)
- Admin dashboard — booking/cancellation data is real and live in Supabase's `expert_bookings` table, viewable via Supabase's own Table Editor, but no dedicated admin UI exists
- Therapist-facing app — explicitly a future phase
- Real bios/approaches/specializations per expert — a Google Form was drafted for collecting this but not yet sent to the team
- Custom domain, Calm Room assets, YouTube links, expanded worksheet library — all still pending from earlier

## Design/brand reference

Navy #2E5090, gold #FDB913, cream #FEF3D8, DES-II teal #0F766E. Font: Plus Jakarta Sans (web), Helvetica (PDF reports — brand-font embedding not yet done). Brand rule: never use the phrase "free of cost" anywhere in copy.
````

```
function openAdminDashboard(){
  showOnly('panel-admin');
  document.getElementById('adminBookingsList').innerHTML = '<p style="text-align:center;color:#9AABCE;font-size:12.5px;">Loading...</p>';
  Promise.all([
    sb.from('expert_bookings').select('*').order('created_at', {ascending:false}),
    sb.from('profiles').select('user_id,name')
  ]).then(function(results){
    var bookingsRes = results[0], profilesRes = results[1];
    if(bookingsRes.error){
      document.getElementById('adminBookingsList').innerHTML = '<p style="text-align:center;color:#C77B7B;font-size:12.5px;">Could not load bookings: ' + bookingsRes.error.message + '</p>';
      return;
    }
    var nameByUserId = {};
    (profilesRes.data || []).forEach(function(p){ nameByUserId[p.user_id] = p.name; });
    var bookings = bookingsRes.data || [];

    var activeCount = bookings.filter(function(b){ return b.status === 'active'; }).length;
    var changeReqCount = bookings.filter(function(b){ return b.status === 'change_requested'; }).length;
    var chargeOwedCount = bookings.filter(function(b){ return b.cancellation_charge_owed; }).length;
    document.getElementById('adminStatsRow').innerHTML =
      '<div style="flex:1;background:#EAF4EE;border-radius:12px;padding:10px;text-align:center;"><p style="font-size:18px;font-weight:800;color:#3B8F63;margin:0;">'+activeCount+'</p><p style="font-size:9.5px;color:#5C6B94;margin:0;">Active</p></div>'+
      '<div style="flex:1;background:#FEF3D8;border-radius:12px;padding:10px;text-align:center;"><p style="font-size:18px;font-weight:800;color:#7B4F00;margin:0;">'+changeReqCount+'</p><p style="font-size:9.5px;color:#5C6B94;margin:0;">Change Requests</p></div>'+
      '<div style="flex:1;background:#FBE8E8;border-radius:12px;padding:10px;text-align:center;"><p style="font-size:18px;font-weight:800;color:#C77B7B;margin:0;">'+chargeOwedCount+'</p><p style="font-size:9.5px;color:#5C6B94;margin:0;">Charges Owed</p></div>';

    if(bookings.length === 0){
      document.getElementById('adminBookingsList').innerHTML = '<p style="text-align:center;color:#9AABCE;font-size:12.5px;">No bookings yet.</p>';
      return;
    }

    document.getElementById('adminBookingsList').innerHTML = bookings.map(function(b){
      var clientName = nameByUserId[b.user_id] || 'Unknown client';
      var statusColor = b.status === 'active' ? '#3B8F63' : '#7B4F00';
      var statusBg = b.status === 'active' ? '#EAF4EE' : '#FEF3D8';
      return '<div style="background:#FFFFFF;border:1px solid #EEE0C4;border-radius:14px;padding:14px;margin-bottom:10px;">'+
        '<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;margin-bottom:6px;">'+
          '<p style="font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:#2A2013;margin:0;">'+clientName+' → '+b.expert_name+'</p>'+
          '<span style="font-size:9px;font-weight:700;color:'+statusColor+';background:'+statusBg+';padding:3px 7px;border-radius:8px;white-space:nowrap;">'+b.status.replace('_',' ')+'</span>'+
        '</div>'+
        '<p style="font-size:11px;color:#9AABCE;margin:0 0 6px;">'+b.role_category+' · Cancelled '+(b.cancellation_count||0)+' time(s)</p>'+
        (b.cancellation_charge_owed ?
          '<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;background:#FBE8E8;border-radius:10px;padding:8px 10px;margin-top:6px;">'+
            '<span style="font-size:11px;color:#C77B7B;font-weight:700;">50% charge owed</span>'+
            '<button class="admin-resolve-charge-btn" data-id="'+b.id+'" style="font-size:10px;font-weight:700;color:#3B8F63;background:none;border:1px solid #3B8F63;border-radius:8px;padding:4px 8px;cursor:pointer;">Mark Collected</button>'+
          '</div>' : ''
        )+
      '</div>';
    }).join('');

    document.querySelectorAll('.admin-resolve-charge-btn').forEach(function(btn){
```

```
function renderCalendar(){
  document.getElementById('monthTitle').textContent = MONTH_NAMES[viewMonth] + ' ' + viewYear;
  var grid = document.getElementById('dayGrid');
  grid.innerHTML = '';
  var firstDay = new Date(viewYear, viewMonth, 1).getDay();
  var daysInMonth = new Date(viewYear, viewMonth+1, 0).getDate();
  for(var i=0; i<firstDay; i++){
    var empty = document.createElement('div'); empty.className = 'day-cell empty'; grid.appendChild(empty);
  }
  for(var day=1; day<=daysInMonth; day++){
    (function(day){
      var key = viewYear+'-'+pad2(viewMonth+1)+'-'+pad2(day);
      var cell = document.createElement('div');
      cell.className = 'day-cell' + ((viewYear===TODAY_DATE.getFullYear() && viewMonth===TODAY_DATE.getMonth() && day===TODAY_DATE.getDate()) ? ' today' : '');
      var num = document.createElement('div'); num.className = 'day-num'; num.textContent = day; cell.appendChild(num);
      cell.onclick = function(){ openDay(key); };
      grid.appendChild(cell);
    })(day);
  }
  renderCalendarPendingTasks();
}

function renderCalendarPendingTasks(){
  var wrap = document.getElementById('calendarPendingTasks');
  var pending = [];
  Object.keys(appState.tasksByDate || {}).forEach(function(dateKey){
    (appState.tasksByDate[dateKey] || []).forEach(function(t){
      if(!t.done) pending.push({ task: t, dateKey: dateKey });
    });
  });
  if(pending.length === 0){
    wrap.innerHTML = '<p style="text-align:center;font-size:12px;color:#B0AA98;padding:10px 0;">Nothing pending — you\'re all caught up.</p>';
    return;
  }
  pending.sort(function(a, b){ return a.dateKey < b.dateKey ? -1 : 1; });
  wrap.innerHTML = pending.map(function(item){
    var parts = item.dateKey.split('-').map(Number);
    var dObj = new Date(parts[0], parts[1]-1, parts[2]);
    var dateLabel = dObj.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month:'short', day:'numeric' });
    return '<div class="pending-task-row" data-key="'+item.dateKey+'" style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;background:#FFFFFF;border:1px solid #EEE0C4;border-radius:12px;padding:12px 14px;margin-bottom:8px;cursor:pointer;">'+
      '<span style="font-size:12.5px;color:#2A2013;font-weight:600;">'+item.task.title+'</span>'+
      '<span style="font-size:10.5px;color:#9AABCE;flex-shrink:0;">'+dateLabel+'</span>'+
    '</div>';
  }).join('');
  wrap.querySelectorAll('.pending-task-row').forEach(function(row){
    row.onclick = function(){ openDay(row.dataset.key); };
  });
}
```

```
function renderCalendarUpcomingSessions(){
  var wrap = document.getElementById('calendarUpcomingSessions');
  wrap.innerHTML = '<p style="text-align:center;font-size:12px;color:#B0AA98;padding:6px 0;">Loading...</p>';
  var nowIso = new Date().toISOString();

  Promise.all([
    sb.from('expert_bookings').select('*').eq('user_id', currentUser.id).eq('status', 'active').not('session_date', 'is', null).gte('session_date', nowIso).order('session_date', {ascending:true}),

    var items = [];
    (expertRes.data || []).forEach(function(b){
      items.push({ label: 'Session with ' + b.expert_name, sublabel: b.role_category, date: new Date(b.session_date) });
    });
    (groupRes.data || []).forEach(function(g){
      items.push({ label: 'Support Group Session', sublabel: g.notes || 'Group session', date: new Date(g.session_date) });
    });

      wrap.innerHTML = '<p style="text-align:center;font-size:12px;color:#B0AA98;padding:10px 0;">No upcoming sessions scheduled yet.</p>';

    items.sort(function(a, b){ return a.date - b.date; });
    wrap.innerHTML = items.map(function(item){
      var dateLabel = item.date.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month:'short', day:'numeric' }) + ' · ' + item.date.toLocaleTimeString('en-US', { hour:'numeric', minute:'2-digit' });
      return '<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;background:#EAF0FB;border:1px solid #D5E2F7;border-radius:12px;padding:12px 14px;margin-bottom:8px;">'+
        '<div><p style="font-size:12.5px;color:#2A2013;font-weight:700;margin:0 0 2px;">'+item.label+'</p><p style="font-size:10.5px;color:#9AABCE;margin:0;">'+item.sublabel+'</p></div>'+
        '<span style="font-size:10.5px;color:#6690D6;font-weight:700;flex-shrink:0;">'+dateLabel+'</span>'+
      '</div>';
    }).join('');
  }).catch(function(){
    wrap.innerHTML = '<p style="text-align:center;font-size:12px;color:#B0AA98;padding:10px 0;">Couldn\'t load sessions right now.</p>';

}
```

```
function renderAdminGroupSessions(){
  var wrap = document.getElementById('adminGroupSessionsList');
  wrap.innerHTML = '<p style="font-size:11px;color:#B0AA98;">Loading...</p>';
  sb.from('support_group_sessions').select('*').gte('session_date', new Date().toISOString()).order('session_date', {ascending:true}).then(function(result){
    if(result.error){ wrap.innerHTML = ''; return; }

        '<span style="font-size:11.5px;color:#2A2013;font-weight:600;">'+dateLabel+'</span>'+
        '<button class="admin-remove-group-session-btn" data-id="'+s.id+'" style="font-size:10px;color:#C77B7B;background:none;border:none;cursor:pointer;font-weight:700;">Remove</button>'+
      '</div>';

    document.querySelectorAll('.admin-remove-group-session-btn').forEach(function(btn){

    });
  });
```

- result: applied
- Claude's words just before this edit: "Confirmed and proven — GitHub Pages caches for 10 minutes (`max-age=600`), and I can see `x-cache: HIT` on this exact request right now. Netlify never cached at all. This is a genuine gap I introduced during the migration and didn't account for — the "close and reopen to see updates" promise silently broke. Let me fix this properly at the native level so it can't recur."

OLD (exact):
```
package com.hobsfoundation.companion;

import com.getcapacitor.BridgeActivity;

public class MainActivity extends BridgeActivity {}
```

NEW (exact):
```
package com.hobsfoundation.companion;

import android.os.Bundle;
import android.webkit.WebSettings;
import com.getcapacitor.BridgeActivity;

public class MainActivity extends BridgeActivity {
    @Override
    public void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
        // GitHub Pages sends cache-control: max-age=600, unlike Netlify which never cached.
        // Force the WebView to always fetch fresh so "close and reopen" reliably shows updates.
        this.getBridge().getWebView().getSettings().setCacheMode(WebSettings.LOAD_NO_CACHE);
    }
}
```

```
function showPaymentModal(purposeText, notifyMessage, onConfirmed){
  document.getElementById('paymentModalPurpose').textContent = purposeText;
  var qrImg = document.getElementById('paymentQrImage');
  var qrFallback = document.getElementById('paymentQrFallback');
  if(qrImg.complete && qrImg.naturalWidth === 0){
    qrImg.style.display = 'none';
    qrFallback.style.display = 'block';
  } else {
    qrImg.style.display = 'block';
    qrFallback.style.display = 'none';
  }
  document.getElementById('paymentModalBackdrop').style.display = 'block';
  document.getElementById('paymentModal').style.display = 'block';
  var closeModal = function(){
    document.getElementById('paymentModalBackdrop').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('paymentModal').style.display = 'none';
  };
  document.getElementById('paymentConfirmBtn').onclick = function(){
    closeModal();
    showToast("Thanks! We'll verify your payment and confirm shortly.");
    if(typeof onConfirmed === 'function') onConfirmed();
  };
```

```
function buildGoogleCalendarLink(title, dateObj, details){
  var start = dateObj.toISOString().replace(/[-:]/g, '').split('.')[0] + 'Z';
  var endObj = new Date(dateObj.getTime() + 50*60000); // default 50-min session
  var end = endObj.toISOString().replace(/[-:]/g, '').split('.')[0] + 'Z';
  return 'https://calendar.google.com/calendar/render?action=TEMPLATE&text=' + encodeURIComponent(title) +
    '&dates=' + start + '/' + end + '&details=' + encodeURIComponent(details || '');
}

function renderCalendarUpcomingSessions(){
  var wrap = document.getElementById('calendarUpcomingSessions');
  if(!currentUser){ wrap.innerHTML = ''; return; }
  wrap.innerHTML = '<p style="text-align:center;font-size:12px;color:#B0AA98;padding:6px 0;">Loading...</p>';
  var nowIso = new Date().toISOString();

  Promise.all([
    sb.from('expert_bookings').select('*').eq('user_id', currentUser.id).eq('status', 'active').not('session_date', 'is', null).gte('session_date', nowIso).order('session_date', {ascending:true}),
    appState.userHasSupportGroup ? sb.from('support_group_sessions').select('*').gte('session_date', nowIso).order('session_date', {ascending:true}).limit(1) : Promise.resolve({data:[], error:null})
  ]).then(function(results){
    var expertRes = results[0], groupRes = results[1];
    var items = [];
    (expertRes.data || []).forEach(function(b){
      items.push({ label: 'Session with ' + b.expert_name, sublabel: b.role_category, date: new Date(b.session_date) });
    });
    (groupRes.data || []).forEach(function(g){
      items.push({ label: 'Support Group Session', sublabel: g.notes || 'Group session', date: new Date(g.session_date) });
    });

    if(items.length === 0){
      wrap.innerHTML = '<p style="text-align:center;font-size:12px;color:#B0AA98;padding:10px 0;">No upcoming sessions scheduled yet.</p>';
      return;
    }
    items.sort(function(a, b){ return a.date - b.date; });
    wrap.innerHTML = items.map(function(item){
      var dateLabel = item.date.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month:'short', day:'numeric' }) + ' · ' + item.date.toLocaleTimeString('en-US', { hour:'numeric', minute:'2-digit' });
      var calLink = buildGoogleCalendarLink(item.label, item.date, item.sublabel + ' — via HOBS Companion');
      return '<div style="background:#EAF0FB;border:1px solid #D5E2F7;border-radius:12px;padding:12px 14px;margin-bottom:8px;">'+
        '<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;margin-bottom:8px;">'+
          '<div><p style="font-size:12.5px;color:#2A2013;font-weight:700;margin:0 0 2px;">'+item.label+'</p><p style="font-size:10.5px;color:#9AABCE;margin:0;">'+item.sublabel+'</p></div>'+
          '<span style="font-size:10.5px;color:#6690D6;font-weight:700;flex-shrink:0;">'+dateLabel+'</span>'+
        '</div>'+
        '<a href="'+calLink+'" target="_blank" rel="noopener" style="display:block;text-align:center;font-size:10.5px;font-weight:700;color:#6690D6;background:#FFFFFF;border:1px solid #D5E2F7;border-radius:8px;padding:7px;text-decoration:none;">+ Add to Calendar</a>'+
      '</div>';
    }).join('');
  }).catch(function(){
    wrap.innerHTML = '<p style="text-align:center;font-size:12px;color:#B0AA98;padding:10px 0;">Couldn\'t load sessions right now.</p>';
  });
}
```

```
function populateAdminAvailabilitySelect(){
  var sel = document.getElementById('adminAvailabilityExpertSelect');
  if(sel.dataset.populated) { renderAdminSlots(); return; }
  sel.innerHTML = TEAM_MEMBERS.map(function(m){ return '<option value="'+m.name+'">'+m.name+' ('+m.roleCategory+')</option>'; }).join('');
  sel.dataset.populated = '1';
  sel.onchange = renderAdminSlots;
  renderAdminSlots();
}

function renderAdminSlots(){
  var expertName = document.getElementById('adminAvailabilityExpertSelect').value;
  var wrap = document.getElementById('adminSlotsList');
  wrap.innerHTML = '<p style="font-size:11px;color:#B0AA98;">Loading...</p>';
  sb.from('expert_availability_slots').select('*').eq('expert_name', expertName).gte('slot_date', new Date().toISOString()).order('slot_date', {ascending:true}).then(function(result){
    if(result.error){ wrap.innerHTML = ''; return; }
    var slots = result.data || [];
    if(slots.length === 0){
      wrap.innerHTML = '<p style="font-size:11px;color:#B0AA98;">No upcoming slots added for '+expertName+' yet.</p>';
      return;
    }
    wrap.innerHTML = slots.map(function(s){
      var dateLabel = new Date(s.slot_date).toLocaleString('en-US', { month:'short', day:'numeric', hour:'numeric', minute:'2-digit' });
      var statusLabel = s.is_booked ? '<span style="font-size:9px;font-weight:700;color:#C77B7B;background:#FBE8E8;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:6px;margin-left:6px;">Booked</span>' : '';
      return '<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;background:#EAF0FB;border-radius:10px;padding:9px 12px;margin-bottom:6px;">'+
        '<span style="font-size:11.5px;color:#2A2013;font-weight:600;">'+dateLabel+statusLabel+'</span>'+
        (s.is_booked ? '' : '<button class="admin-remove-slot-btn" data-id="'+s.id+'" style="font-size:10px;color:#C77B7B;background:none;border:none;cursor:pointer;font-weight:700;">Remove</button>')+
      '</div>';
    }).join('');
    document.querySelectorAll('.admin-remove-slot-btn').forEach(function(btn){
      btn.onclick = function(){
        sb.from('expert_availability_slots').delete().eq('id', btn.dataset.id).then(function(){ renderAdminSlots(); });
      };
    });
  });
}
document.getElementById('adminAddSlotBtn').onclick = function(){
  var input = document.getElementById('adminNewSlotDate');
```

```
function showSlotPicker(m, onSlotChosen, onNoSlots){
  sb.from('expert_availability_slots').select('*').eq('expert_name', m.name).eq('is_booked', false).gte('slot_date', new Date().toISOString()).order('slot_date', {ascending:true}).then(function(result){
    var slots = (result.error ? [] : result.data) || [];
    if(slots.length === 0){
      onNoSlots();
      return;
    }
    document.getElementById('slotPickerSubtitle').textContent = 'Available times with ' + m.name;
    document.getElementById('slotPickerList').innerHTML = slots.map(function(s){
      var dateLabel = new Date(s.slot_date).toLocaleString('en-US', { weekday:'short', month:'short', day:'numeric', hour:'numeric', minute:'2-digit' });
      return '<button class="slot-picker-option" data-id="'+s.id+'" data-date="'+s.slot_date+'" style="display:block;width:100%;text-align:left;padding:13px 14px;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid #EEE0C4;background:#FFFFFF;color:#2A2013;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;margin-bottom:8px;">'+dateLabel+'</button>';
    }).join('');
    document.getElementById('slotPickerModalBackdrop').style.display = 'block';
    document.getElementById('slotPickerModal').style.display = 'block';
    var closeModal = function(){
      document.getElementById('slotPickerModalBackdrop').style.display = 'none';
      document.getElementById('slotPickerModal').style.display = 'none';
    };
    document.querySelectorAll('.slot-picker-option').forEach(function(btn){
      btn.onclick = function(){
        closeModal();
        onSlotChosen({ id: btn.dataset.id, slot_date: btn.dataset.date });
      };
    });
    document.getElementById('slotPickerCloseBtn').onclick = closeModal;
    document.getElementById('slotPickerModalBackdrop').onclick = closeModal;
  });
}

function bookExpert(m){
  showSlotPicker(m, function(chosenSlot){
    // A real slot was picked — book it, mark it taken, and set the session date immediately.
    showPolicyModal(function(){
      var newBooking = { id: 'temp_' + uidGen(), expert_name: m.name, role_category: m.roleCategory, status: 'active', cancellation_count: 0, payment_confirmed: false, session_date: chosenSlot.slot_date };

      }).select().single().then(function(result){
        if(!result.error) newBooking.id = result.data.id;
      });
      sb.from('expert_availability_slots').update({ is_booked: true, booked_by: currentUser.id }).eq('id', chosenSlot.id).then(function(){});

        function(){
          showToast("Your time is booked. We'll confirm once payment is verified.");

      );

  }, function(){
```

```
function onAuthSuccess(user){
  currentUser = user;
  loadUserDataFromSupabase().then(function(){
    var overlay = document.getElementById('authOverlay');
    overlay.style.display = 'none';
    void overlay.offsetHeight; // force immediate reflow so the change paints right away
    claimTherapistInviteIfAny();
    if(!appState.onboardingComplete){
      showOnboarding();
    } else if(!appState.hasSeenIntro){
      showWalkthrough();
    } else {
      renderHomeGreeting();
    }
  });
}

// Checks whether an admin has granted this exact email therapist access ahead of time.
// If so, claims it — unlocking the Therapist Dashboard on their Profile immediately.
function claimTherapistInviteIfAny(){
  if(appState.isTherapist) return; // already a therapist, nothing to claim
  sb.from('therapist_invites').select('*').eq('email', currentUser.email).eq('claimed', false).then(function(result){
    if(result.error || !result.data || result.data.length === 0) return;
    var invite = result.data[0];
    sb.from('profiles').update({ is_therapist: true, therapist_expert_name: invite.expert_name }).eq('user_id', currentUser.id).then(function(updateResult){
      if(updateResult.error) return;
      sb.from('therapist_invites').update({ claimed: true }).eq('id', invite.id).then(function(){});
      appState.isTherapist = true;
      appState.therapistExpertName = invite.expert_name;
      showToast("You now have therapist access for " + invite.expert_name + ".");
    });
  });
}
```

```
function populateAdminTherapistSelect(){
  var sel = document.getElementById('adminTherapistExpertSelect');
  if(!sel.dataset.populated){
    sel.innerHTML = TEAM_MEMBERS.map(function(m){ return '<option value="'+m.name+'">'+m.name+'</option>'; }).join('');
    sel.dataset.populated = '1';
  }
  renderAdminTherapistInvites();
}

function renderAdminTherapistInvites(){
  var wrap = document.getElementById('adminTherapistInvitesList');
  wrap.innerHTML = '<p style="font-size:11px;color:#B0AA98;">Loading...</p>';
  sb.from('therapist_invites').select('*').order('created_at', {ascending:false}).then(function(result){
    if(result.error){ wrap.innerHTML = ''; return; }
    var invites = result.data || [];
    if(invites.length === 0){
      wrap.innerHTML = '<p style="font-size:11px;color:#B0AA98;">No therapist accounts granted yet.</p>';
      return;
    }
    wrap.innerHTML = invites.map(function(inv){
      var statusLabel = inv.claimed
        ? '<span style="font-size:9px;font-weight:700;color:#3B8F63;background:#EAF4EE;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:6px;">Active</span>'
        : '<span style="font-size:9px;font-weight:700;color:#7B4F00;background:#FEF3D8;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:6px;">Pending sign-in</span>';
      return '<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;background:#EAF0FB;border-radius:10px;padding:9px 12px;margin-bottom:6px;">'+
        '<div><p style="font-size:11.5px;color:#2A2013;font-weight:600;margin:0 0 2px;">'+inv.email+'</p><p style="font-size:10px;color:#9AABCE;margin:0;">'+inv.expert_name+'</p></div>'+
        statusLabel+
      '</div>';
    }).join('');
  });
}
document.getElementById('adminGrantTherapistBtn').onclick = function(){
  var emailInput = document.getElementById('adminTherapistEmail');
  var email = emailInput.value.trim().toLowerCase();
  var expertName = document.getElementById('adminTherapistExpertSelect').value;
  if(!email) return;
  sb.from('therapist_invites').insert({ email: email, expert_name: expertName, claimed: false }).then(function(result){
    if(result.error){
      showToast(result.error.message.indexOf('duplicate') !== -1 ? 'That email already has access granted.' : 'Could not grant access.');
      return;
    }
    emailInput.value = '';
    showToast('Access granted — they\'ll get it the moment they sign in.');
    renderAdminTherapistInvites();
  });
};
```

```
  wrap.innerHTML = '<p style="font-size:11px;color:#B0AA98;">Loading...</p>';
  Promise.all([
    sb.from('expert_bookings').select('*').eq('status', 'active').not('session_date', 'is', null).gte('session_date', new Date().toISOString()).order('session_date', {ascending:true}),
    sb.from('profiles').select('user_id,name')
  ]).then(function(results){
    var bookingsRes = results[0], profilesRes = results[1];
    if(bookingsRes.error){ wrap.innerHTML = '<p style="font-size:11px;color:#C77B7B;">Could not load sessions.</p>'; return; }
    var nameByUserId = {};
    (profilesRes.data || []).forEach(function(p){ nameByUserId[p.user_id] = p.name; });
    var sessions = bookingsRes.data || [];
    if(sessions.length === 0){
      wrap.innerHTML = '<p style="font-size:11px;color:#B0AA98;">No upcoming sessions scheduled.</p>';
      return;
    }
    wrap.innerHTML = sessions.map(function(s){
      var clientName = nameByUserId[s.user_id] || 'A client';
      var dateLabel = new Date(s.session_date).toLocaleString('en-US', { weekday:'short', month:'short', day:'numeric', hour:'numeric', minute:'2-digit' });
      var confirmedBadge = s.payment_confirmed
        ? '<span style="font-size:9px;font-weight:700;color:#3B8F63;background:#EAF4EE;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:6px;">Confirmed</span>'
        : '<span style="font-size:9px;font-weight:700;color:#7B4F00;background:#FEF3D8;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:6px;">Pending</span>';
      return '<div style="background:#EAF0FB;border:1px solid #D5E2F7;border-radius:12px;padding:12px 14px;margin-bottom:8px;">'+
        '<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;">'+
          '<p style="font-size:12.5px;color:#2A2013;font-weight:700;margin:0;">'+clientName+'</p>'+
          confirmedBadge+
        '</div>'+
        '<p style="font-size:10.5px;color:#6690D6;font-weight:700;margin:4px 0 0;">'+dateLabel+'</p>'+
      '</div>';
    }).join('');
  });
}

function renderTherapistSlots(){
  var wrap = document.getElementById('therapistSlotsList');
  wrap.innerHTML = '<p style="font-size:11px;color:#B0AA98;">Loading...</p>';
  sb.from('expert_availability_slots').select('*').gte('slot_date', new Date().toISOString()).order('slot_date', {ascending:true}).then(function(result){
    if(result.error){ wrap.innerHTML = ''; return; }
    var slots = result.data || [];
    if(slots.length === 0){
      wrap.innerHTML = '<p style="font-size:11px;color:#B0AA98;">No upcoming slots added yet.</p>';
      return;
    }
    wrap.innerHTML = slots.map(function(s){
      var dateLabel = new Date(s.slot_date).toLocaleString('en-US', { month:'short', day:'numeric', hour:'numeric', minute:'2-digit' });
      var statusLabel = s.is_booked ? '<span style="font-size:9px;font-weight:700;color:#C77B7B;background:#FBE8E8;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:6px;margin-left:6px;">Booked</span>' : '';
      return '<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;background:#EAF4EE;border-radius:10px;padding:9px 12px;margin-bottom:6px;">'+
        '<span style="font-size:11.5px;color:#2A2013;font-weight:600;">'+dateLabel+statusLabel+'</span>'+
        (s.is_booked ? '' : '<button class="therapist-remove-slot-btn" data-id="'+s.id+'" style="font-size:10px;color:#C77B7B;background:none;border:none;cursor:pointer;font-weight:700;">Remove</button>')+
      '</div>';
    }).join('');
    document.querySelectorAll('.therapist-remove-slot-btn').forEach(function(btn){
      btn.onclick = function(){
        sb.from('expert_availability_slots').delete().eq('id', btn.dataset.id).then(function(){ renderTherapistSlots(); });
      };
    });
  });
}
document.getElementById('therapistAddSlotBtn').onclick = function(){
  var input = document.getElementById('therapistNewSlotDate');
  if(!input.value) return;
  sb.from('expert_availability_slots').insert({ expert_name: appState.therapistExpertName, slot_date: new Date(input.value).toISOString(), is_booked: false }).then(function(result){
    if(!result.error){
      input.value = '';
      renderTherapistSlots();
    }
  });
};
```

```
document.getElementById('authToggleModeBtn').onclick = function(){
  authMode = authMode === 'signin' ? 'signup' : 'signin';
  document.getElementById('authSubmitBtn').textContent = authMode === 'signin' ? 'Sign In' : 'Create Account';
  document.getElementById('authToggleModeBtn').textContent = authMode === 'signin' ? "Don't have an account? Sign up" : 'Already have an account? Sign in';
  document.getElementById('authSubtitle').textContent = authMode === 'signin' ? 'Sign in to sync your data across devices.' : 'Create an account so your data is never lost.';
  hideAuthError();
};

document.getElementById('forgotPasswordBtn').onclick = function(){
  document.getElementById('authFormContent').style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('forgotPasswordEmail').value = document.getElementById('authEmail').value || '';
  document.getElementById('forgotPasswordMsg').style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('forgotPasswordOverlay').style.display = 'flex';

document.getElementById('forgotPasswordBackBtn').onclick = function(){
  document.getElementById('forgotPasswordOverlay').style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('authFormContent').style.display = 'block';
};
document.getElementById('forgotPasswordSendBtn').onclick = function(){
  var email = document.getElementById('forgotPasswordEmail').value.trim();
  var msgEl = document.getElementById('forgotPasswordMsg');
  if(!email){ return; }
  var btn = document.getElementById('forgotPasswordSendBtn');
  btn.textContent = 'Sending...'; btn.disabled = true;
  sb.auth.resetPasswordForEmail(email, { redirectTo: WEB_APP_URL }).then(function(result){
    btn.textContent = 'Send Reset Link'; btn.disabled = false;
    msgEl.style.display = 'block';
    if(result.error){
      msgEl.style.color = '#C77B7B';
      msgEl.textContent = 'Something went wrong — please try again.';
    } else {
      msgEl.style.color = '#3B8F63';
      msgEl.textContent = 'Check your email for a reset link.';
    }
  });
};
document.getElementById('setNewPasswordBtn').onclick = function(){
  var newPass = document.getElementById('setNewPasswordInput').value;
  var msgEl = document.getElementById('setNewPasswordMsg');
  if(!newPass || newPass.length < 6){
    msgEl.style.display = 'block'; msgEl.style.color = '#C77B7B';
    msgEl.textContent = 'Password needs to be at least 6 characters.';
    return;
  }
  var btn = document.getElementById('setNewPasswordBtn');
  btn.textContent = 'Saving...'; btn.disabled = true;
  sb.auth.updateUser({ password: newPass }).then(function(result){
    btn.textContent = 'Save New Password'; btn.disabled = false;
    msgEl.style.display = 'block';
    if(result.error){
      msgEl.style.color = '#C77B7B';
      msgEl.textContent = 'Could not update password — try requesting a new reset link.';
      return;
    }
    document.getElementById('setNewPasswordOverlay').style.display = 'none';
    if(result.data && result.data.user) onAuthSuccess(result.data.user);
  });
};

if(window.location.hash.indexOf('type=recovery') !== -1){

  document.getElementById('setNewPasswordOverlay').style.display = 'flex';
}
```

```
    elevated: elevated,
    self_harm_flagged: selfHarmFlagged
```

```
  ]).then(function(results){
```

```
        '<p style="font-size:10.5px;color:#6690D6;font-weight:700;margin:4px 0 8px;">'+dateLabel+'</p>'+
        '<button class="therapist-cancel-session-btn" data-id="'+s.id+'" style="width:100%;padding:8px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid #EEE0C4;background:transparent;color:#C77B7B;font-size:10.5px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;">Cancel / Reschedule</button>'+

function therapistCancelBooking(bookingId){
  var startOfMonth = new Date();
  startOfMonth.setDate(1);
  startOfMonth.setHours(0,0,0,0);
  sb.from('therapist_cancellation_log').select('id').eq('therapist_expert_name', appState.therapistExpertName).gte('cancelled_at', startOfMonth.toISOString()).then(function(result){
    if(result.error) return;
    var usedThisMonth = (result.data || []).length;
    if(usedThisMonth >= 1){
      showToast("You've already used your one cancellation for this month — please message our team directly for this one.");
      return;
    }
    sb.from('expert_bookings').update({ status: 'change_requested' }).eq('id', bookingId).then(function(updateResult){
      if(updateResult.error){ showToast('Could not cancel — please try again.'); return; }
      sb.from('therapist_cancellation_log').insert({ therapist_expert_name: appState.therapistExpertName, booking_id: bookingId }).then(function(){});
      showToast('Session cancelled. This was your one cancellation for this month.');
      renderTherapistUpcoming();
    });
  });
}
```

```
function populateAdminTherapistSelect(){
  var sel = document.getElementById('adminTherapistExpertSelect');
  if(!sel.dataset.populated){
    sel.innerHTML = TEAM_MEMBERS.map(function(m){ return '<option value="'+m.name+'">'+m.name+'</option>'; }).join('');
    sel.dataset.populated = '1';
  }
  renderAdminTherapistInvites();
}

function renderAdminTherapistInvites(){
  var wrap = document.getElementById('adminTherapistInvitesList');
  wrap.innerHTML = '<p style="font-size:11px;color:#B0AA98;">Loading...</p>';
  sb.from('therapist_invites').select('*').order('created_at', {ascending:false}).then(function(result){
    if(result.error){ wrap.innerHTML = ''; return; }
    var invites = result.data || [];
    if(invites.length === 0){
      wrap.innerHTML = '<p style="font-size:11px;color:#B0AA98;">No therapist accounts granted yet.</p>';
      return;
    }
    wrap.innerHTML = invites.map(function(inv){
      var statusLabel = inv.claimed
        ? '<span style="font-size:9px;font-weight:700;color:#3B8F63;background:#EAF4EE;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:6px;">Active</span>'
        : '<span style="font-size:9px;font-weight:700;color:#7B4F00;background:#FEF3D8;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:6px;">Pending sign-in</span>';
      return '<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;background:#EAF0FB;border-radius:10px;padding:9px 12px;margin-bottom:6px;">'+
        '<div><p style="font-size:11.5px;color:#2A2013;font-weight:600;margin:0 0 2px;">'+inv.email+'</p><p style="font-size:10px;color:#9AABCE;margin:0;">'+inv.expert_name+'</p></div>'+
        statusLabel+
      '</div>';
    }).join('');
  });
}
document.getElementById('adminGrantTherapistBtn').onclick = function(){
  var emailInput = document.getElementById('adminTherapistEmail');
  var email = emailInput.value.trim().toLowerCase();
  var expertName = document.getElementById('adminTherapistExpertSelect').value;
  if(!email) return;
  sb.from('therapist_invites').insert({ email: email, expert_name: expertName, claimed: false }).then(function(result){

      showToast(result.error.message.indexOf('duplicate') !== -1 ? 'That email already has access granted.' : 'Could not grant access.');
      return;

  });
};
```

```
document.getElementById('adminCreateExpertBtn').onclick = function(){
  var name = document.getElementById('newExpertName').value.trim();
  var role = document.getElementById('newExpertRole').value.trim();
  var roleCategory = document.getElementById('newExpertCategory').value;
  var credential = document.getElementById('newExpertCredential').value.trim();
  var years = document.getElementById('newExpertYears').value.trim();
  var photo = document.getElementById('newExpertPhoto').value.trim();
  var email = document.getElementById('newExpertEmail').value.trim().toLowerCase();

  if(!name || !role || !email){
    showToast('Name, role, and email are required.');
    return;
  }

  var btn = document.getElementById('adminCreateExpertBtn');
  btn.textContent = 'Creating...'; btn.disabled = true;

  sb.from('experts').insert({
    name: name, role: role, role_category: roleCategory, credential: credential,
    years: years, photo_url: photo || null, display_order: 99
  }).select().single().then(function(expertResult){

      btn.textContent = 'Create Profile & Generate Invite'; btn.disabled = false;
      showToast('Could not create profile: ' + expertResult.error.message);
      return;
    }
    sb.from('therapist_invites').insert({ email: email, expert_name: name, claimed: false }).then(function(inviteResult){
      btn.textContent = 'Create Profile & Generate Invite'; btn.disabled = false;

      }
      var message = "Hi " + name.split(' ')[0] + "! You've been added to HOBS Companion as a " + role + ". "+
        "Download the app and sign up (or sign in with Google) using this exact email: " + email + " — "+
        "your therapist dashboard will unlock automatically the moment you sign in.";
      document.getElementById('adminInviteMessageText').textContent = message;
      document.getElementById('adminInviteMessageBox').style.display = 'block';
      document.getElementById('adminCopyInviteBtn').onclick = function(){
        navigator.clipboard.writeText(message).then(function(){ showToast('Copied — paste it into WhatsApp or email.'); });
      };
      ['newExpertName','newExpertRole','newExpertCredential','newExpertYears','newExpertPhoto','newExpertEmail'].forEach(function(id){
        document.getElementById(id).value = '';
      });
      loadExpertsFromSupabase();
      renderAdminTherapistInvites();
      showToast('Profile created and invite ready to send.');
    });
  });
};
```

```
var therapistDetailExpanded = false;
function renderTherapistSummaryAndDetail(){
  var now = new Date();
  var monthStart = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), 1);
  var monthEnd = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth()+1, 1);

  Promise.all([
    sb.from('expert_bookings').select('*').eq('status', 'active').not('session_date', 'is', null).order('session_date', {ascending:false}),
    sb.from('profiles').select('user_id,name')
  ]).then(function(results){
    var bookingsRes = results[0], profilesRes = results[1];
    if(bookingsRes.error){ return; }
    var nameByUserId = {};
    (profilesRes.data || []).forEach(function(p){ nameByUserId[p.user_id] = p.name; });
    var allSessions = bookingsRes.data || [];

    var thisMonthSessions = allSessions.filter(function(s){
      var d = new Date(s.session_date);
      return d >= monthStart && d < monthEnd;
    });
    var confirmedIncome = thisMonthSessions
      .filter(function(s){ return s.payment_locked && s.therapist_payout_amount; })
      .reduce(function(sum, s){ return sum + parseFloat(s.therapist_payout_amount); }, 0);

    document.getElementById('therapistSummaryCount').textContent = thisMonthSessions.length + ' session' + (thisMonthSessions.length === 1 ? '' : 's') + ' this month';
    document.getElementById('therapistSummaryIncome').textContent = '₹' + confirmedIncome + ' confirmed income';

    var detailWrap = document.getElementById('therapistSessionDetailList');
    if(thisMonthSessions.length === 0){
      detailWrap.innerHTML = '<p style="font-size:11px;color:#B0AA98;text-align:center;">No sessions this month yet.</p>';
      return;
    }
    detailWrap.innerHTML = thisMonthSessions.map(function(s){
      var clientName = nameByUserId[s.user_id] || 'A client';
      var dateLabel = new Date(s.session_date).toLocaleString('en-US', { weekday:'short', month:'short', day:'numeric', hour:'numeric', minute:'2-digit' });
      var payoutLabel = s.therapist_payout_amount ? '₹' + s.therapist_payout_amount : 'Not set yet';
      var lockedBadge = s.payment_locked
        ? '<span style="font-size:9px;font-weight:700;color:#3B8F63;background:#EAF4EE;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:6px;">Payment Locked</span>'
        : '<span style="font-size:9px;font-weight:700;color:#B0AA98;background:#F5F3EE;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:6px;">Notes Needed to Lock</span>';
      return '<div style="background:#FFFFFF;border:1px solid '+(s.payment_locked?'#D5E2F7':'#EEE0C4')+';border-radius:14px;padding:14px;margin-bottom:10px;'+(s.payment_locked?'':'opacity:0.85;')+'">'+
        '<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;margin-bottom:4px;">'+
          '<p style="font-size:13px;color:#2A2013;font-weight:700;margin:0;">'+clientName+'</p>'+
          lockedBadge+
        '</div>'+
        '<p style="font-size:10.5px;color:#6690D6;font-weight:700;margin:0 0 4px;">'+dateLabel+'</p>'+
        '<p style="font-size:11px;color:#5C6B94;margin:0 0 10px;">You receive: '+payoutLabel+'</p>'+
        (s.payment_locked ?
          '<p style="font-size:11px;color:#2A2013;background:#F5F3EE;border-radius:8px;padding:8px;margin:0 0 8px;">'+(s.session_notes||'')+'</p>'+
          (s.session_note_file_url ? '<a href="#" class="therapist-view-file-btn" data-path="'+s.session_note_file_url+'" style="font-size:10.5px;color:#6690D6;font-weight:700;">View attached file</a>' : '')
          :
          '<textarea class="therapist-session-notes-input" data-id="'+s.id+'" placeholder="Session notes... (required to lock payment)" rows="2" style="width:100%;padding:8px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid #EEE0C4;font-size:11px;font-family:inherit;margin-bottom:6px;box-sizing:border-box;resize:vertical;">'+(s.session_notes||'')+'</textarea>'+
          '<input type="file" class="therapist-session-file-input" data-id="'+s.id+'" accept="image/*,.pdf,.doc,.docx" style="width:100%;font-size:10px;margin-bottom:8px;">'+
          '<button class="therapist-lock-payment-btn" data-id="'+s.id+'" style="width:100%;padding:9px;border-radius:8px;border:none;background:#3B8F63;color:#fff;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;margin-bottom:6px;">Save Notes &amp; Lock Payment</button>'+
          '<button class="therapist-cancel-session-btn" data-id="'+s.id+'" style="width:100%;padding:8px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid #EEE0C4;background:transparent;color:#C77B7B;font-size:10.5px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;">Cancel / Reschedule</button>'
        )+
      '</div>';
    }).join('');

    document.querySelectorAll('.therapist-cancel-session-btn').forEach(function(btn){
      btn.onclick = function(){ therapistCancelBooking(btn.dataset.id); };
    });
    document.querySelectorAll('.therapist-view-file-btn').forEach(function(btn){
      btn.onclick = function(e){
        e.preventDefault();
        sb.storage.from('session-attachments').createSignedUrl(btn.dataset.path, 300).then(function(result){
          if(result.data) window.open(result.data.signedUrl, '_blank');
        });
      };
    });
    document.querySelectorAll('.therapist-lock-payment-btn').forEach(function(btn){
      btn.onclick = function(){ therapistLockPayment(btn.dataset.id); };
    });
  });
}
document.getElementById('therapistSummaryTile').onclick = function(){
  therapistDetailExpanded = !therapistDetailExpanded;
  document.getElementById('therapistSessionDetailList').style.display = therapistDetailExpanded ? 'block' : 'none';
};

function therapistLockPayment(bookingId){
  var notesInput = document.querySelector('.therapist-session-notes-input[data-id="'+bookingId+'"]');
  var fileInput = document.querySelector('.therapist-session-file-input[data-id="'+bookingId+'"]');
  var notes = notesInput ? notesInput.value.trim() : '';

  if(!notes){
    showToast('Session notes are required to lock payment.');
    return;
  }

  var btn = document.querySelector('.therapist-lock-payment-btn[data-id="'+bookingId+'"]');
  btn.textContent = 'Saving...'; btn.disabled = true;

  var doSave = function(fileUrl){
    var updateData = { session_notes: notes, payment_locked: true };
    if(fileUrl) updateData.session_note_file_url = fileUrl;
    sb.from('expert_bookings').update(updateData).eq('id', bookingId).then(function(result){
      if(result.error){
        showToast('Could not save — please try again.');
        btn.textContent = 'Save Notes & Lock Payment'; btn.disabled = false;
        return;
      }
      showToast('Notes saved and payment locked.');
      renderTherapistSummaryAndDetail();
    });
  };

  if(fileInput && fileInput.files && fileInput.files[0]){
    var file = fileInput.files[0];
    var path = bookingId + '/' + Date.now() + '_' + file.name;
    sb.storage.from('session-attachments').upload(path, file).then(function(uploadResult){
      if(uploadResult.error){
        showToast('Notes will save, but the file upload failed.');
        doSave(null);
        return;
      }
      doSave(path);
    });
  } else {
    doSave(null);
  }
}
```
