var therapistCalMonth = new Date().getMonth();
var therapistCalYear = new Date().getFullYear();
var therapistCalSlotsByDay = {}; // 'YYYY-MM-DD' -> [{id, time, is_booked}]
var therapistCalActiveDayKey = null;

function renderTherapistSlots(){
  renderTherapistAvailabilityGrid();
}

function renderTherapistAvailabilityGrid(){
  document.getElementById('therapistCalMonthTitle').textContent = MONTH_NAMES[therapistCalMonth] + ' ' + therapistCalYear;
  sb.from('expert_availability_slots').select('*').eq('expert_name', appState.therapistExpertName).order('slot_date', {ascending:true}).then(function(result){
    therapistCalSlotsByDay = {};
    (result.error ? [] : result.data || []).forEach(function(s){
      var d = new Date(s.slot_date);
      var key = d.getFullYear()+'-'+pad2(d.getMonth()+1)+'-'+pad2(d.getDate());
      if(!therapistCalSlotsByDay[key]) therapistCalSlotsByDay[key] = [];
      therapistCalSlotsByDay[key].push({ id: s.id, time: d.toLocaleTimeString('en-US',{hour:'numeric',minute:'2-digit'}), rawDate: s.slot_date, is_booked: s.is_booked });
    });

    var grid = document.getElementById('therapistAvailabilityGrid');
    grid.innerHTML = '';
    var firstDay = new Date(therapistCalYear, therapistCalMonth, 1).getDay();
    var daysInMonth = new Date(therapistCalYear, therapistCalMonth+1, 0).getDate();
    for(var i=0; i<firstDay; i++){
      var empty = document.createElement('div'); empty.className = 'day-cell empty'; grid.appendChild(empty);
    }
    var todayObj = new Date();
    for(var day=1; day<=daysInMonth; day++){
      (function(day){
        var key = therapistCalYear+'-'+pad2(therapistCalMonth+1)+'-'+pad2(day);
        var isToday = todayObj.getFullYear()===therapistCalYear && todayObj.getMonth()===therapistCalMonth && todayObj.getDate()===day;
        var cell = document.createElement('div');
        cell.className = 'day-cell' + (isToday ? ' today' : '');
        var count = (therapistCalSlotsByDay[key] || []).length;
        cell.innerHTML = '<span style="font-size:12px;font-weight:600;">'+day+'</span>' +
          (count > 0 ? '<span style="width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:50%;background:#3B8F63;"></span>' : '');
        cell.onclick = function(){ openTherapistDayEditor(key); };
        grid.appendChild(cell);
      })(day);
    }
  });
}
document.getElementById('therapistCalPrevBtn').onclick = function(){
  therapistCalMonth--; if(therapistCalMonth < 0){ therapistCalMonth = 11; therapistCalYear--; }
  renderTherapistAvailabilityGrid();
};
document.getElementById('therapistCalNextBtn').onclick = function(){
  therapistCalMonth++; if(therapistCalMonth > 11){ therapistCalMonth = 0; therapistCalYear++; }
  renderTherapistAvailabilityGrid();
};

function openTherapistDayEditor(dateKey){
  therapistCalActiveDayKey = dateKey;
  var parts = dateKey.split('-').map(Number);
  var dObj = new Date(parts[0], parts[1]-1, parts[2]);
  document.getElementById('therapistDayEditorTitle').textContent = dObj.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { weekday:'long', month:'long', day:'numeric' });
  renderTherapistDaySlotsList();
  document.getElementById('therapistDayEditorBackdrop').style.display = 'block';
  document.getElementById('therapistDayEditor').style.display = 'block';
}
function renderTherapistDaySlotsList(){
  var slots = therapistCalSlotsByDay[therapistCalActiveDayKey] || [];
  var wrap = document.getElementById('therapistDaySlotsList');
  if(slots.length === 0){
    wrap.innerHTML = '<p style="font-size:12px;color:#B0AA98;text-align:center;">No times added for this day yet.</p>';
    return;
  }
  wrap.innerHTML = slots.map(function(s){
    var statusLabel = s.is_booked ? '<span style="font-size:9px;font-weight:700;color:#C77B7B;background:#FBE8E8;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:6px;margin-left:6px;">Booked</span>' : '';
    return '<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;background:#EAF4EE;border-radius:10px;padding:10px 12px;margin-bottom:6px;">'+
      '<span style="font-size:13px;color:#2A2013;font-weight:600;">'+s.time+statusLabel+'</span>'+
      (s.is_booked ? '' : '<button class="therapist-remove-daytime-btn" data-id="'+s.id+'" style="font-size:11px;color:#C77B7B;background:none;border:none;cursor:pointer;font-weight:700;">Remove</button>')+
    '</div>';
  }).join('');
  document.querySelectorAll('.therapist-remove-daytime-btn').forEach(function(btn){
    btn.onclick = function(){
      sb.from('expert_availability_slots').delete().eq('id', btn.dataset.id).then(function(){
        renderTherapistAvailabilityGrid();
        setTimeout(function(){
          var parts = therapistCalActiveDayKey.split('-').map(Number);
          therapistCalSlotsByDay[therapistCalActiveDayKey] = (therapistCalSlotsByDay[therapistCalActiveDayKey]||[]).filter(function(s){ return s.id !== btn.dataset.id; });
          renderTherapistDaySlotsList();
        }, 400);
      });
    };
  });
}
document.getElementById('therapistDayAddTimeBtn').onclick = function(){
  var timeInput = document.getElementById('therapistDayNewTime');
  if(!timeInput.value) return;
  var parts = therapistCalActiveDayKey.split('-').map(Number);
  var timeParts = timeInput.value.split(':').map(Number);
  var fullDate = new Date(parts[0], parts[1]-1, parts[2], timeParts[0], timeParts[1]);
  sb.from('expert_availability_slots').insert({ expert_name: appState.therapistExpertName, slot_date: fullDate.toISOString(), is_booked: false }).select().single().then(function(result){
    if(result.error) return;
    timeInput.value = '';
    if(!therapistCalSlotsByDay[therapistCalActiveDayKey]) therapistCalSlotsByDay[therapistCalActiveDayKey] = [];
    therapistCalSlotsByDay[therapistCalActiveDayKey].push({ id: result.data.id, time: fullDate.toLocaleTimeString('en-US',{hour:'numeric',minute:'2-digit'}), is_booked: false });
    renderTherapistDaySlotsList();
    renderTherapistAvailabilityGrid();
  });
};
document.getElementById('therapistDayEditorCloseBtn').onclick = function(){
  document.getElementById('therapistDayEditorBackdrop').style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('therapistDayEditor').style.display = 'none';
};
document.getElementById('therapistDayEditorBackdrop').onclick = function(){
  document.getElementById('therapistDayEditorBackdrop').style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('therapistDayEditor').style.display = 'none';
};

function requestExpertChange(m, currentExpertName){
  document.getElementById('changeReasonInput').value = '';
  document.getElementById('changeReasonError').style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('changeReasonModalBackdrop').style.display = 'block';
  document.getElementById('changeReasonModal').style.display = 'block';

  var closeModal = function(){
    document.getElementById('changeReasonModalBackdrop').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('changeReasonModal').style.display = 'none';
  };
  document.getElementById('changeReasonCancelBtn').onclick = closeModal;
  document.getElementById('changeReasonModalBackdrop').onclick = closeModal;
  document.getElementById('changeReasonSubmitBtn').onclick = function(){
    var reason = document.getElementById('changeReasonInput').value.trim();
    if(!reason){
      document.getElementById('changeReasonError').style.display = 'block';
      return;
    }
    var booking = getActiveBookingForCategory(m.roleCategory);
    if(booking){
      booking.status = 'change_requested';
      booking.change_reason = reason;
      booking.change_approved = false;
      if(String(booking.id).indexOf('temp_') !== 0){
        sb.from('expert_bookings').update({ status: 'change_requested', change_reason: reason, change_approved: false }).eq('id', booking.id).then(function(){});
      }
    }
    closeModal();
    showToast("Request sent — we'll review it and reach out. You'll stay connected with " + currentExpertName + " until then.");
    renderTeamList();
  };
}


```

NEW (exact):
```
function openAdminDashboard(){
  showOnly('panel-admin');
  document.getElementById('adminBookingsList').innerHTML = '<p style="text-align:center;color:#9AABCE;font-size:12.5px;">Loading...</p>';
  renderAdminGroupSessions();
  populateAdminAvailabilitySelect();
  populateAdminTherapistSelect();
  Promise.all([
    sb.from('expert_bookings').select('*').order('created_at', {ascending:false}),
    sb.from('profiles').select('user_id,name,email,phone_number')
  ]).then(function(results){
    var bookingsRes = results[0], profilesRes = results[1];
    if(bookingsRes.error){
      document.getElementById('adminBookingsList').innerHTML = '<p style="text-align:center;color:#C77B7B;font-size:12.5px;">Could not load bookings: ' + bookingsRes.error.message + '</p>';
      return;
    }
    var profileByUserId = {};
    (profilesRes.data || []).forEach(function(p){ profileByUserId[p.user_id] = p; });
    var nameByUserId = {};
    (profilesRes.data || []).forEach(function(p){ nameByUserId[p.user_id] = p.name; });
    var bookings = bookingsRes.data || [];

    var pendingChanges = bookings.filter(function(b){ return b.status === 'change_requested' && !b.change_approved; });
    var changeSection = document.getElementById('adminChangeRequestsSection');
    if(pendingChanges.length === 0){
      changeSection.style.display = 'none';
    } else {
      changeSection.style.display = 'block';
      document.getElementById('adminChangeRequestsList').innerHTML = pendingChanges.map(function(b){
        var prof = profileByUserId[b.user_id] || {};
        return '<div style="background:#FEF3D8;border:1.5px solid #F0D48A;border-radius:14px;padding:14px;margin-bottom:10px;">'+
          '<p style="font-size:13.5px;font-weight:800;color:#2A2013;margin:0 0 4px;">'+(prof.name||'Unknown client')+'</p>'+
          '<p style="font-size:11px;color:#5C6B94;margin:0 0 2px;">✉ '+(prof.email||'—')+'</p>'+
          '<p style="font-size:11px;color:#5C6B94;margin:0 0 10px;">☎ '+(prof.phone_number||'—')+'</p>'+
          '<p style="font-size:11px;color:#9AABCE;margin:0 0 4px;">Currently with '+b.expert_name+' ('+b.role_category+')</p>'+
          '<div style="background:#FFFFFF;border-radius:10px;padding:10px;margin-bottom:10px;">'+
            '<p style="font-size:9.5px;font-weight:700;color:#9AABCE;text-transform:uppercase;margin:0 0 4px;">Reason given</p>'+
            '<p style="font-size:12px;color:#2A2013;margin:0;">'+(b.change_reason||'No reason given')+'</p>'+
          '</div>'+
          '<button class="admin-approve-change-btn" data-id="'+b.id+'" style="width:100%;padding:10px;border-radius:10px;border:none;background:#7B4F00;color:#fff;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;">Approve Change</button>'+
        '</div>';
      }).join('');
      document.querySelectorAll('.admin-approve-change-btn').forEach(function(btn){
        btn.onclick = function(){
          sb.from('expert_bookings').update({ status: 'cancelled', change_approved: true }).eq('id', btn.dataset.id).then(function(result){
            if(!result.error){ showToast('Change approved — this category is now open for a new booking.'); openAdminDashboard(); }
          });
        };
      });
    }

var LANGUAGE_OPTIONS = ['Hindi','English','Bengali','Telugu','Marathi','Tamil','Odia','Kannada','Urdu','Gujarati'];

function renderLanguageCheckboxes(containerId, selectedCsv){
  var selected = (selectedCsv || '').split(',').map(function(s){ return s.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
  var wrap = document.getElementById(containerId);
  wrap.innerHTML = LANGUAGE_OPTIONS.map(function(lang){
    var isChecked = selected.indexOf(lang) !== -1;
    return '<label style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;background:'+(isChecked?'#EAF4EE':'#FFFFFF')+';border:1px solid '+(isChecked?'#3B8F63':'#EEE0C4')+';border-radius:20px;padding:6px 12px;font-size:11px;color:#2A2013;cursor:pointer;">'+
      '<input type="checkbox" class="lang-checkbox" value="'+lang+'" '+(isChecked?'checked':'')+' style="accent-color:#3B8F63;">'+lang+
    '</label>';
  }).join('');
  wrap.querySelectorAll('.lang-checkbox').forEach(function(cb){
    cb.onchange = function(){
      cb.closest('label').style.background = cb.checked ? '#EAF4EE' : '#FFFFFF';
      cb.closest('label').style.borderColor = cb.checked ? '#3B8F63' : '#EEE0C4';
    };
  });
}
function getSelectedLanguagesFromCheckboxes(containerId){
  var checked = document.querySelectorAll('#'+containerId+' .lang-checkbox:checked');
  return Array.from(checked).map(function(cb){ return cb.value; }).join(', ');
}

```

NEW (exact):
```
var teamActiveLanguageFilter = null;
function renderTeamList(){
  // Derive real, currently-available languages from actual expert data — not a fixed list.
  var availableLanguages = [];
  TEAM_MEMBERS.forEach(function(m){
    (m.languages || '').split(',').forEach(function(l){
      var trimmed = l.trim();
      if(trimmed && availableLanguages.indexOf(trimmed) === -1) availableLanguages.push(trimmed);
    });
  });
  var filterWrap = document.getElementById('teamLanguageFilterRow');
  if(availableLanguages.length === 0){
    filterWrap.innerHTML = '';
  } else {
    filterWrap.innerHTML = availableLanguages.map(function(lang){
      var isActive = teamActiveLanguageFilter === lang;
      return '<button class="team-lang-filter-chip" data-lang="'+lang+'" style="flex-shrink:0;padding:7px 14px;border-radius:20px;border:1.5px solid '+(isActive?'#6690D6':'#EEE0C4')+';background:'+(isActive?'#6690D6':'#FFFFFF')+';color:'+(isActive?'#fff':'#2A2013')+';font-size:11.5px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap;">'+lang+'</button>';
    }).join('');
    filterWrap.querySelectorAll('.team-lang-filter-chip').forEach(function(chip){
      chip.onclick = function(){
        teamActiveLanguageFilter = (teamActiveLanguageFilter === chip.dataset.lang) ? null : chip.dataset.lang;
        renderTeamList();
      };
    });
  }

  var filteredMembers = teamActiveLanguageFilter
    ? TEAM_MEMBERS.filter(function(m){ return (m.languages || '').indexOf(teamActiveLanguageFilter) !== -1; })
    : TEAM_MEMBERS;

  var wrap = document.getElementById('teamList');
  if(filteredMembers.length === 0){
    wrap.innerHTML = '<p style="text-align:center;color:#9AABCE;font-size:12.5px;padding:20px 0;">No experts match that language yet.</p>';
    return;
  }
  wrap.innerHTML = filteredMembers.map(function(m){
    var idx = TEAM_MEMBERS.indexOf(m);
    var initials = m.name.split(' ').filter(function(w){ return w!=='Dr.'; }).map(function(w){ return w[0]; }).slice(0,2).join('');
    var photoInner = m.photo
      ? '<img src="'+m.photo+'" alt="'+m.name+'" id="teamPhoto'+idx+'" style="width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;" onerror="teamPhotoFallback(this, \''+initials+'\')">'
      : '<div style="width:100%;height:100%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:#E7EEFB;color:#4A6FB5;font-weight:700;font-size:24px;">'+initials+'</div>';

    var activeBooking = getActiveBookingForCategory(m.roleCategory);
    var isThisPersonBooked = activeBooking && activeBooking.expert_name === m.name;
```

  document.getElementById('therapistDashboardSubtitle').textContent = 'Your sessions and availability, as ' + appState.therapistExpertName + '.';
  therapistDetailExpanded = false;
  document.getElementById('therapistSessionDetailList').style.display = 'none';
  renderTherapistSummaryAndDetail();
  renderTherapistSlots();
  populateHomeworkClientSelect();
  var myProfile = TEAM_MEMBERS.find(function(m){ return m.name === appState.therapistExpertName; });
  document.getElementById('therapistBioInput').value = myProfile ? (myProfile.bio||'') : '';
  document.getElementById('therapistApproachesInput').value = myProfile ? (myProfile.approaches||'') : '';
  document.getElementById('therapistSpecializationsInput').value = myProfile ? (myProfile.specializations||'') : '';
  document.getElementById('therapistSuperpowersInput').value = myProfile ? (myProfile.superpowers||'') : '';
  document.getElementById('therapistWhyInput').value = myProfile ? (myProfile.whyTherapist||'') : '';
  document.getElementById('therapistQualificationsInput').value = myProfile ? (myProfile.qualificationsDetail||'') : '';
  renderLanguageCheckboxes('therapistLanguagesCheckboxes', myProfile ? myProfile.languages : '');
}

function populateHomeworkClientSelect(){
  var sel = document.getElementById('homeworkClientSelect');
  sel.innerHTML = '<option value="">Loading clients...</option>';
  Promise.all([
    sb.from('expert_bookings').select('user_id').eq('expert_name', appState.therapistExpertName).in('status', ['active','change_requested']),
    sb.from('profiles').select('user_id,name')
  ]).then(function(results){
    var bookingsRes = results[0], profilesRes = results[1];
    if(bookingsRes.error){ sel.innerHTML = '<option value="">Could not load clients</option>'; return; }
    var nameByUserId = {};
    (profilesRes.data || []).forEach(function(p){ nameByUserId[p.user_id] = p.name; });
    var uniqueClientIds = Array.from(new Set((bookingsRes.data || []).map(function(b){ return b.user_id; })));
    if(uniqueClientIds.length === 0){
      sel.innerHTML = '<option value="">No clients connected yet</option>';
      return;
    }
    sel.innerHTML = uniqueClientIds.map(function(uid){
      return '<option value="'+uid+'">'+(nameByUserId[uid] || 'Client')+'</option>';
    }).join('');
  });
}

document.getElementById('homeworkSendBtn').onclick = function(){
  var clientId = document.getElementById('homeworkClientSelect').value;
  var title = document.getElementById('homeworkTitleInput').value.trim();
  var deadlineInput = document.getElementById('homeworkDeadlineInput').value;

  if(!clientId || !title){
    showToast('Pick a client and write what you\'d like them to try.');
    return;
  }

  var dateKey = deadlineInput || (function(){
    var d = new Date();
    return d.getFullYear()+'-'+pad2(d.getMonth()+1)+'-'+pad2(d.getDate());
  })();

  var btn = document.getElementById('homeworkSendBtn');
  btn.textContent = 'Sending...'; btn.disabled = true;

  sb.from('tasks').insert({
    user_id: clientId,
    date_key: dateKey,
    title: title,
    done: false,
    deadline: deadlineInput ? new Date(deadlineInput).toISOString() : null,
    assigned_by_therapist: appState.therapistExpertName
  }).then(function(result){
    btn.textContent = 'Send Homework'; btn.disabled = false;
    if(result.error){
      showToast('Could not send — please try again.');
      return;
    }
    document.getElementById('homeworkTitleInput').value = '';
    document.getElementById('homeworkDeadlineInput').value = '';
    showToast('Sent — it\'ll appear in their tasks automatically.');
  });
};
```

- Claude's words just before this edit: "This confirms the auth overlay properly gates the UI on both cold start and logout — so the crash shouldn't be reachable in normal use, but it's still a real landmine if it ever is. Rather than chase the exact trigger, let me build a robust, defensive fix: saves should never silently vanish, regardless of cause."

OLD (exact):
```
var currentUser = null;
```

NEW (exact):
```
var currentUser = null;
var pendingSyncQueue = [];
try {
  var storedQueue = localStorage.getItem('hobs_pending_sync');
  if(storedQueue) pendingSyncQueue = JSON.parse(storedQueue);
} catch(e){}

function savePendingSyncQueue(){
  try { localStorage.setItem('hobs_pending_sync', JSON.stringify(pendingSyncQueue)); } catch(e){}
}

// Guarantees a save is never silently lost, even if currentUser is unexpectedly
// unavailable at the moment of saving (e.g. mid-reload, session hiccup).
// If we can save now, we do. If not, it's queued and retried automatically
// the moment a session is confirmed again.
function syncToSupabase(table, payload, onSuccess){
  if(currentUser && currentUser.id){
    var fullPayload = Object.assign({}, payload, { user_id: currentUser.id });
    sb.from(table).insert(fullPayload).select().single().then(function(result){
      if(result.error){
        pendingSyncQueue.push({ table: table, payload: payload, queuedAt: new Date().toISOString() });
        savePendingSyncQueue();
        return;
      }
      if(onSuccess) onSuccess(result.data);
    });
  } else {
    pendingSyncQueue.push({ table: table, payload: payload, queuedAt: new Date().toISOString() });
    savePendingSyncQueue();
  }
}

function retryPendingSync(){
  if(!currentUser || !currentUser.id || pendingSyncQueue.length === 0) return;
  var queue = pendingSyncQueue;
  pendingSyncQueue = [];
  savePendingSyncQueue();
  queue.forEach(function(item){
    sb.from(item.table).insert(Object.assign({}, item.payload, { user_id: currentUser.id })).then(function(result){
      if(result.error){
        pendingSyncQueue.push(item);
        savePendingSyncQueue();
      }
    });
  });
  if(queue.length > 0) showToast('Caught up on ' + queue.length + ' unsaved item(s) from earlier.');
}

```

function saveEntryToSupabase(entry){
  return new Promise(function(resolve){
    syncToSupabase('entries', {
      moods: entry.moods, text: entry.text || '',
      type: entry.type || 'journal', worksheet_name: entry.worksheetName || null,
      category_name: entry.categoryName || null, category_color: entry.color || null,
      shared_with_therapist: entry.sharedWithTherapist || false,
      created_at: entry.date || new Date().toISOString()
    }, function(savedRow){
      entry.id = savedRow.id;
      entry.date = savedRow.created_at;
      resolve(savedRow);
    });
    if(!currentUser || !currentUser.id) resolve(null); // saved locally + queued; don't block the caller
  });
}

package com.hobsfoundation.companion;

import android.os.Bundle;
import android.webkit.WebSettings;
import com.getcapacitor.BridgeActivity;

public class MainActivity extends BridgeActivity {
    @Override
    public void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
        // LOAD_NO_CACHE previously forced every reload (including the unavoidable ones Android
        // triggers when it reclaims the WebView process under memory pressure) to fetch
        // everything fresh over the network, making the resulting white-screen period longer
        // than necessary. LOAD_DEFAULT still validates freshness with the server on each load,
        // but can serve cached resources instantly when nothing's changed, restoring fast resume
        // while still checking for updates rather than silently going stale.
        this.getBridge().getWebView().getSettings().setCacheMode(WebSettings.LOAD_DEFAULT);
    }
}

NEW (exact):

var PRIORITY_COLORS = { low:'#9AABCE', medium:'#D9A536', high:'#C77B7B' };

// Genuine touch-based drag-and-drop reordering (native HTML5 drag doesn't work
// reliably on mobile browsers/WebViews, so this uses raw touch events instead).
// Call once per container after rendering its items. Each item needs a child
// element with class "drag-handle" to grab. onDrop receives (fromIndex, toIndex).
function makeListDraggable(container, itemSelector, onDrop){
  var dragEl = null, startY = 0, placeholder = null, items = [];

  container.querySelectorAll(itemSelector).forEach(function(item){
    var handle = item.querySelector('.drag-handle');
    if(!handle) return;

    handle.addEventListener('touchstart', function(e){
      dragEl = item;
      startY = e.touches[0].clientY;
      items = Array.from(container.querySelectorAll(itemSelector));
      placeholder = document.createElement('div');
      placeholder.style.height = item.offsetHeight + 'px';
      placeholder.style.background = '#EEF1F6';
      placeholder.style.borderRadius = '12px';
      placeholder.style.margin = getComputedStyle(item).margin;
      item.parentNode.insertBefore(placeholder, item.nextSibling);
      item.style.position = 'relative';
      item.style.zIndex = '50';
      item.style.boxShadow = '0 6px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.15)';
      item.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
    }, {passive:true});

    handle.addEventListener('touchmove', function(e){
      if(!dragEl) return;
      e.preventDefault();
      var y = e.touches[0].clientY;
      var deltaY = y - startY;
      dragEl.style.transform = 'translateY(' + deltaY + 'px)';

      var dragRect = dragEl.getBoundingClientRect();
      var dragMidY = dragRect.top + dragRect.height / 2;
      var others = items.filter(function(el){ return el !== dragEl; });
      for(var i=0; i<others.length; i++){
        var rect = others[i].getBoundingClientRect();
        var midY = rect.top + rect.height / 2;
        if(dragMidY < midY){
          container.insertBefore(placeholder, others[i]);
          return;
        }
      }
      container.appendChild(placeholder);
    }, {passive:false});

    handle.addEventListener('touchend', function(){
      if(!dragEl) return;
      var fromIndex = items.indexOf(dragEl);
      container.insertBefore(dragEl, placeholder);
      placeholder.remove();
      dragEl.style.transform = '';
      dragEl.style.position = '';
      dragEl.style.zIndex = '';
      dragEl.style.boxShadow = '';
      dragEl.style.pointerEvents = '';
      var toIndex = Array.from(container.querySelectorAll(itemSelector)).indexOf(dragEl);
      var el = dragEl;
      dragEl = null;
      if(fromIndex !== toIndex) onDrop(fromIndex, toIndex);
    });
  });
}

```

  makeListDraggable(listEl, '.task-item', function(fromIdx, toIdx){
    var items = Array.from(listEl.querySelectorAll('.task-item'));
    var droppedEl = items[toIdx];
    var taskId = droppedEl.dataset.taskId;
    // The dragged element's own data-priority is stale (unchanged since it's the one being moved) —
    // infer the new priority from whichever neighbor it landed next to instead.
    var neighbor = items[toIdx - 1] || items[toIdx + 1];
    var newPriority = neighbor ? (neighbor.dataset.priority || null) : null;
    var task = tasks.find(function(t){ return t.id === taskId; });
    if(task){
      task.priority = newPriority;
      saveState();
      if(String(task.id).indexOf('temp_') !== 0){
        sb.from('tasks').update({ priority: newPriority }).eq('id', task.id).then(function(){});
      }
    }
    renderTaskListCal();
  });
```

NEW (exact):
```
// ================= CALM ROOM — generated ambient soundscape =================
// No licensed audio file needed: this builds a genuinely calming, softly evolving
// drone from scratch using the Web Audio API (detuned oscillators for warmth,
// a slow LFO so the volume gently breathes rather than sitting static, a lowpass
// filter to keep it soft, and a layer of filtered noise for a soft room-tone texture).
var ambientAudioCtx = null;
var ambientNodes = [];
var ambientMasterGain = null;

function startAmbientSound(){
  ambientAudioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
  var ctx = ambientAudioCtx;

  ambientMasterGain = ctx.createGain();
  ambientMasterGain.gain.value = 0;
  ambientMasterGain.connect(ctx.destination);
  ambientMasterGain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.16, ctx.currentTime + 2.5); // gentle fade in

  var lowpass = ctx.createBiquadFilter();
  lowpass.type = 'lowpass';
  lowpass.frequency.value = 900;
  lowpass.connect(ambientMasterGain);

  // A soft, open drone — low C, G a fifth above, E an octave+third above.
  // Two slightly-detuned oscillators per note for a warm, chorused feel.
  var notes = [130.81, 196.00, 329.63];
  notes.forEach(function(freq){
    [-4, 4].forEach(function(detune){
      var osc = ctx.createOscillator();
      osc.type = 'sine';
      osc.frequency.value = freq;
      osc.detune.value = detune;
      var noteGain = ctx.createGain();
      noteGain.gain.value = 0.5;
      osc.connect(noteGain);
      noteGain.connect(lowpass);
      osc.start();
      ambientNodes.push(osc);
    });
  });

  // Slow LFO on the master volume so it breathes instead of droning flatly.
  var lfo = ctx.createOscillator();
  lfo.frequency.value = 0.06; // one gentle swell roughly every 16 seconds
  var lfoGain = ctx.createGain();
  lfoGain.gain.value = 0.05;
  lfo.connect(lfoGain);
  lfoGain.connect(ambientMasterGain.gain);
  lfo.start();
  ambientNodes.push(lfo);

  // Soft filtered noise layer for a gentle room-tone texture underneath the drone.
  var bufferSize = 2 * ctx.sampleRate;
  var noiseBuffer = ctx.createBuffer(1, bufferSize, ctx.sampleRate);
  var output = noiseBuffer.getChannelData(0);
  for(var i=0; i<bufferSize; i++){ output[i] = (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * 0.15; }
  var noise = ctx.createBufferSource();
  noise.buffer = noiseBuffer;
  noise.loop = true;
  var noiseFilter = ctx.createBiquadFilter();
  noiseFilter.type = 'lowpass';
  noiseFilter.frequency.value = 400;
  var noiseGain = ctx.createGain();
  noiseGain.gain.value = 0.3;
  noise.connect(noiseFilter);
  noiseFilter.connect(noiseGain);
  noiseGain.connect(ambientMasterGain);
  noise.start();
  ambientNodes.push(noise);
}

function stopAmbientSound(){
  if(!ambientAudioCtx) return;
  var ctx = ambientAudioCtx;
  if(ambientMasterGain){
    ambientMasterGain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0, ctx.currentTime + 0.8);
  }
  setTimeout(function(){
    ambientNodes.forEach(function(node){
      try { node.stop(); } catch(e){}
    });
    ambientNodes = [];
    if(ambientAudioCtx){ ambientAudioCtx.close(); ambientAudioCtx = null; }
  }, 850);
}

// ================= CALM ROOM =================
function openCalmRoom(){ showOnly('panel-calmroom'); }
document.getElementById('groundingCalmLinkBtn').onclick = openCalmRoom;
document.getElementById('sheetCalmLinkBtn').onclick = function(){ closeAddTaskSheet(); openCalmRoom(); };
document.getElementById('calmRoomCloseBtn').onclick = function(){
  stopAmbientSound();
  document.getElementById('calmRoomPlayIcon').innerHTML = '<path d="M8 5v14l11-7z"/>';
  showOnly('panel-calendar');
};
document.getElementById('calmRoomPlayBtn').onclick = function(){
  var icon = document.getElementById('calmRoomPlayIcon');
  if(!ambientAudioCtx){
    startAmbientSound();
    icon.innerHTML = '<path d="M6 5h4v14H6zM14 5h4v14h-4z"/>';
  } else {
    stopAmbientSound();
    icon.innerHTML = '<path d="M8 5v14l11-7z"/>';
  }
};
```

function renderHomeGreeting(){
  var hour = new Date().getHours();
  var timeKey = hour < 12 ? 'morning' : hour < 17 ? 'afternoon' : hour < 22 ? 'evening' : 'night';
  var name = getDisplayName();
  var greetingEl = document.getElementById('homeGreeting');
  greetingEl.textContent = name ? ('Welcome home, ' + name) : 'Welcome home';

  var pool = AFFIRMATIONS_BY_TIME[timeKey];
  document.getElementById('bobAffirmation').textContent = pool[Math.floor(Math.random()*pool.length)];
  renderHomeUpdatesBanner();
}

// Since there's no push notification system yet, this is the honest substitute:
// check for real status changes (booking confirmed) the client hasn't seen,
// and show a dismissible banner right on Home where they'll actually see it.
function renderHomeUpdatesBanner(){
  var wrap = document.getElementById('homeUpdatesBanner');
  if(!wrap || !currentUser) return;
  var seenIds = [];
  try { seenIds = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('hobs_seen_confirmations') || '[]'); } catch(e){}

  sb.from('expert_bookings').select('id,expert_name,payment_confirmed').eq('user_id', currentUser.id).eq('status','active').then(function(result){
    if(result.error) return;
    var unseen = (result.data || []).filter(function(b){
      return b.payment_confirmed && seenIds.indexOf(b.id) === -1;
    });
    if(unseen.length === 0){ wrap.innerHTML = ''; return; }
    wrap.innerHTML = unseen.map(function(b){
      return '<div class="home-update-banner" style="background:#EAF4EE;border:1px solid #B8DFC7;border-radius:14px;padding:12px 14px;margin-bottom:10px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:10px;">'+
        '<span style="font-size:12.5px;color:#2A2013;font-weight:600;">✓ Your session with '+b.expert_name+' is confirmed!</span>'+
        '<button class="home-update-dismiss-btn" data-id="'+b.id+'" style="background:none;border:none;color:#3B8F63;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;flex-shrink:0;">Got it</button>'+
      '</div>';
    }).join('');
    wrap.querySelectorAll('.home-update-dismiss-btn').forEach(function(btn){
      btn.onclick = function(){
        seenIds.push(btn.dataset.id);
        try { localStorage.setItem('hobs_seen_confirmations', JSON.stringify(seenIds)); } catch(e){}
        renderHomeUpdatesBanner();
      };
    });
  });
}
```

// ================= EDIT PROFILE (post-onboarding self-service) =================
function openEditProfile(){
  document.getElementById('epName').value = appState.displayName || '';
  document.getElementById('epPhone').value = appState.phoneNumber || '';
  document.getElementById('epDob').value = appState.dateOfBirth || '';
  document.getElementById('epPronounCustom').style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('epPronounCustom').value = '';

  var selectedPronoun = appState.pronouns || '';
  var chipsWrap = document.getElementById('epPronounChips');
  chipsWrap.innerHTML = '';
  PRONOUN_OPTIONS.forEach(function(opt){
    var chip = document.createElement('button');
    chip.type = 'button';
    chip.textContent = opt;
    var isSelected = (opt === 'Self-describe' && selectedPronoun && PRONOUN_OPTIONS.indexOf(selectedPronoun) === -1) || opt === selectedPronoun;
    chip.style.cssText = 'padding:9px 14px;border-radius:20px;border:2px solid ' + (isSelected ? '#6690D6' : '#EEE0C4') + ';background:' + (isSelected ? '#6690D6' : '#FFFFFF') + ';color:' + (isSelected ? '#fff' : '#2A2013') + ';font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;';
    chip.onclick = function(){
      Array.from(chipsWrap.children).forEach(function(c){ c.style.background = '#FFFFFF'; c.style.color = '#2A2013'; c.style.borderColor = '#EEE0C4'; });
      chip.style.background = '#6690D6'; chip.style.color = '#fff'; chip.style.borderColor = '#6690D6';
      chipsWrap.dataset.selected = opt;
      document.getElementById('epPronounCustom').style.display = (opt === 'Self-describe') ? 'block' : 'none';
    };
    chipsWrap.appendChild(chip);
  });
  chipsWrap.dataset.selected = selectedPronoun && PRONOUN_OPTIONS.indexOf(selectedPronoun) !== -1 ? selectedPronoun : (selectedPronoun ? 'Self-describe' : '');
  if(chipsWrap.dataset.selected === 'Self-describe') document.getElementById('epPronounCustom').value = selectedPronoun;

  document.getElementById('epError').style.display = 'none';
  showOnly('panel-edit-profile');
}
document.getElementById('editProfileBtn').onclick = openEditProfile;
document.getElementById('editProfileBackBtn').onclick = function(){ showOnly('panel-profile'); };

document.getElementById('epSaveBtn').onclick = function(){
  var name = document.getElementById('epName').value.trim();
  var phone = document.getElementById('epPhone').value.trim();
  var dob = document.getElementById('epDob').value;
  var chipsWrap = document.getElementById('epPronounChips');
  var selected = chipsWrap.dataset.selected;
  var pronouns = selected === 'Self-describe' ? document.getElementById('epPronounCustom').value.trim() : selected;

  var errEl = document.getElementById('epError');
  if(!name || !pronouns || !phone || !dob){
    errEl.textContent = 'Please fill in all four fields.';
    errEl.style.display = 'block';
    return;
  }

  var btn = document.getElementById('epSaveBtn');
  btn.textContent = 'Saving...'; btn.disabled = true;

  sb.from('profiles').update({
    name: name, pronouns: pronouns, phone_number: phone, date_of_birth: dob
  }).eq('user_id', currentUser.id).then(function(result){
    btn.textContent = 'Save Changes'; btn.disabled = false;
    if(result.error){
      errEl.textContent = 'Could not save — check your connection and try again.';
      errEl.style.display = 'block';
      return;
    }
    appState.displayName = name;
    appState.pronouns = pronouns;
    appState.phoneNumber = phone;
    appState.dateOfBirth = dob;
    showToast('Profile updated.');
    renderHomeGreeting();
    showOnly('panel-profile');
  });
};

// ================= MY SESSIONS & CANCELLATIONS (client self-service view) =================
function openMyBookings(){
  showOnly('panel-my-bookings');
  var wrap = document.getElementById('myBookingsList');
  wrap.innerHTML = '<p style="text-align:center;color:#9AABCE;font-size:12.5px;">Loading...</p>';
  sb.from('expert_bookings').select('*').eq('user_id', currentUser.id).order('created_at', {ascending:false}).then(function(result){
    if(result.error){ wrap.innerHTML = '<p style="text-align:center;color:#C77B7B;font-size:12.5px;">Could not load your sessions.</p>'; return; }
    var bookings = result.data || [];
    if(bookings.length === 0){
      wrap.innerHTML = '<p style="text-align:center;color:#9AABCE;font-size:12.5px;">No sessions booked yet.</p>';
      return;
    }
    wrap.innerHTML = bookings.map(function(b){
      var statusLabel, statusBg, statusColor;
      if(b.status === 'change_requested'){ statusLabel = 'Change requested — under review'; statusBg = '#FEF3D8'; statusColor = '#7B4F00'; }
      else if(b.status === 'cancelled'){ statusLabel = 'Ended'; statusBg = '#F5F3EE'; statusColor = '#9AABCE'; }
      else if(b.payment_confirmed){ statusLabel = 'Confirmed'; statusBg = '#EAF4EE'; statusColor = '#3B8F63'; }
      else { statusLabel = 'Pending confirmation'; statusBg = '#FEF3D8'; statusColor = '#7B4F00'; }
      var cancelCount = b.cancellation_count || 0;
      var cancelText = cancelCount === 0
        ? 'You have 1 free cancellation available for this booking.'
        : 'You\'ve used your free cancellation for this booking — a further one would need to go through our team, with a 50% charge.';
      return '<div style="background:#FFFFFF;border:1px solid #EEE0C4;border-radius:14px;padding:14px;margin-bottom:10px;">'+
        '<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;margin-bottom:6px;">'+
          '<p style="font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:#2A2013;margin:0;">'+b.expert_name+'</p>'+
          '<span style="font-size:9px;font-weight:700;color:'+statusColor+';background:'+statusBg+';padding:3px 7px;border-radius:8px;white-space:nowrap;">'+statusLabel+'</span>'+
        '</div>'+
        '<p style="font-size:11px;color:#9AABCE;margin:0 0 8px;">'+b.role_category+'</p>'+
        (b.status === 'active' ? '<p style="font-size:11px;color:#5C6B94;margin:0;">'+cancelText+'</p>' : '')+
      '</div>';
    }).join('');
  });
}
document.getElementById('myBookingsBtn').onclick = openMyBookings;
document.getElementById('myBookingsBackBtn').onclick = function(){ showOnly('panel-profile'); };
```

# HOBS Database Backup — Manual Snapshot
Taken: July 10, 2026

## Why this exists

Your Supabase project is currently on the **Free tier**. I looked this up directly rather than assume, and confirmed two real risks that come with that:

1. **No automatic backups at all.** If something ever goes wrong — a bad accidental change, data corruption, anything — there is currently no way to restore to an earlier state.
2. **The project automatically pauses after 7 days with zero API activity.** If the app ever goes quiet for a full week (unlikely with real users, but worth knowing), the whole backend goes offline until manually resumed from the Supabase dashboard.

Neither of these is something I can fix from inside the app — they're tied to your billing plan. This folder is a real, immediate stopgap: an actual export of every table's data, taken directly from your live database, so there's at least *something* to fall back on right now.

## What's in here

One JSON file per table, containing every row exactly as it existed at the time this was taken. Some files are genuinely empty (e.g. `test_results.json`, `who5_entries.json`) — that's accurate, not a failure; those features are newer and don't have real data yet.

## My actual recommendation

Upgrade to Supabase's **Pro plan ($25/month)**. This gets you:
- 7 days of automatic daily backups, restorable from the dashboard yourself, no manual export needed
- The project never auto-pauses
- Given this app now handles real people's bookings, payments, and mental health data, this is the one piece of infrastructure spending I'd genuinely consider non-optional rather than nice-to-have.

## In the meantime

This snapshot is a point-in-time backup, not an ongoing system — it won't update itself. If you want, ask me to generate a fresh one anytime, or let's talk about setting up a recurring version once we're ready.

function renderTherapistAllSlotsList(){
  var wrap = document.getElementById('therapistAllSlotsList');
  var now = new Date();
  var allSlots = [];
  Object.keys(therapistCalSlotsByDay).forEach(function(dateKey){
    therapistCalSlotsByDay[dateKey].forEach(function(s){
      if(new Date(s.rawDate) >= now) allSlots.push(s);
    });
  });
  allSlots.sort(function(a, b){ return new Date(a.rawDate) - new Date(b.rawDate); });

  if(allSlots.length === 0){
    wrap.innerHTML = '<p style="font-size:11px;color:#B0AA98;text-align:center;">No upcoming slots added yet — tap a day above to add some.</p>';
    return;
  }
  wrap.innerHTML = allSlots.map(function(s){
    var d = new Date(s.rawDate);
    var dateLabel = d.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { weekday:'short', month:'short', day:'numeric' });
    var statusLabel = s.is_booked
      ? '<span style="font-size:9px;font-weight:700;color:#C77B7B;background:#FBE8E8;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:6px;margin-left:6px;">Booked</span>'
      : '';
    return '<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;background:#EAF4EE;border-radius:10px;padding:9px 12px;margin-bottom:6px;">'+
      '<span style="font-size:11.5px;color:#2A2013;font-weight:600;">'+dateLabel+' · '+s.time+statusLabel+'</span>'+
      (s.is_booked ? '' : '<button class="therapist-remove-allslot-btn" data-id="'+s.id+'" style="font-size:11px;color:#C77B7B;background:none;border:none;cursor:pointer;font-weight:700;">Remove</button>')+
    '</div>';
  }).join('');
  wrap.querySelectorAll('.therapist-remove-allslot-btn').forEach(function(btn){
    btn.onclick = function(){
      sb.from('expert_availability_slots').delete().eq('id', btn.dataset.id).then(function(){
        renderTherapistAvailabilityGrid();
      });
    };
  });
}

Written: July 10, 2026 — read this first in any new chat

═══════════════════════════════════════
HOW TO WORK ON THIS PROJECT SAFELY
═══════════════════════════════════════
1. The real source of truth is live and inspectable directly — don't trust old chat summaries (including this file) over what's actually deployed:
   - GitHub repo: https://github.com/homeofbeautifulsouls-sys/hobs-companion-app (branch: main)

2. Verify current state before changing anything — you already did this correctly by checking the repo, Pages build status, and database directly rather than assuming. Keep doing that for every future change too.
3. GitHub Pages builds sometimes get stuck for several minutes for no code-related reason (happened repeatedly across sessions). If a deploy seems to "not show up," check build status directly at api.github.com/repos/homeofbeautifulsouls-sys/hobs-companion-app/pages/builds/latest before assuming something's broken — a fresh trigger commit (a trivial comment change + push) fixes it.

═══════════════════════════════════════
CREDENTIALS IN USE (Akash's own, already granted in prior sessions)
═══════════════════════════════════════
- GitHub personal access token — repo pushes and Pages management
- Supabase Management API token (sbp_...) — all schema changes and admin-level queries, bypasses RLS entirely, treat carefully
- Supabase anon/publishable key — the safe, client-facing key already embedded in the app
- Still outstanding: Supabase service_role key (asked for, not yet received) — needed to build real automated invite emails via a proper server-side Edge Function. Ask Akash directly if that work resumes.

═══════════════════════════════════════
ARCHITECTURE IN ONE PARAGRAPH
═══════════════════════════════════════
Single-file HTML/CSS/JS web app (index.html), deployed as a static site to GitHub Pages, wrapped in a thin native Android shell via Capacitor for the installable APK. The native shell loads the app live from the GitHub Pages URL — most updates are pure web deploys needing zero reinstall. Only native-level changes (WebView settings, permissions, deep links) need a new APK build, and that should be flagged clearly and rarely. Backend is entirely Supabase: Postgres + Auth + Storage, no custom server. Real users are on this app now — treat data correctness and RLS security as genuinely load-bearing, not theoretical.

═══════════════════════════════════════
HARD-WON LESSONS — DO NOT REPEAT THESE
═══════════════════════════════════════
1. RLS RECURSION: a policy on table X that queries table X itself (even via an alias) causes infinite recursion in Postgres and silently breaks ALL access to that table for ALL users, not just the specific case being handled. This happened twice this project and both times looked like "the whole booking system is randomly broken" before the real cause was found. Fix: use a SECURITY DEFINER function (is_admin_user() and get_my_therapist_expert_name() already exist in the database) instead of inline subqueries when a policy needs to check a role stored on the same table.
2. NEVER query auth.users directly in an RLS policy — the anon role lacks permission and it'll fail with a permission error. Use auth.email() / auth.uid() instead, which are built-in and safe.
3. AFTER ANY NEW RLS POLICY, verify directly with a plain curl against the REST API using the anon key — don't just trust that policy creation succeeded without error. This exact verification step caught the two recursion bugs above before they shipped further.
4. TOUCH-BASED DRAG-AND-DROP: native HTML5 draggable barely works on mobile WebViews — this app uses raw touch events instead (see makeListDraggable() in the code). When testing or extending drag logic: inserting a placeholder shifts subsequent elements' layout, which needs accounting for both in the app code's position math and in any test simulating drags (a real bug here was initially mistaken as "the drag doesn't work" when it was actually reading a stale attribute off the wrong element).
5. NEVER TRUST A "SUCCESSFUL" SAVE without confirming currentUser was actually populated at that moment. A serious silent-data-loss bug came from exactly this — the UI looked completely successful (form closes, no error) while the database write silently crashed underneath. All critical save paths now route through syncToSupabase(), a safe wrapper that queues and automatically retries rather than losing data. Use this exact pattern for any new save path — never write a raw sb.from().insert() with currentUser.id directly without it.
6. GITHUB PAGES CACHES for ~10 minutes by default, unlike Netlify which never cached. The native Android WebView cache mode is deliberately set to LOAD_DEFAULT, not LOAD_NO_CACHE — the latter was tried first and made the "white screen when switching apps" problem worse, since it forced every unavoidable Android-triggered reload to skip cache entirely, making the white screen linger longer.

═══════════════════════════════════════
WHAT'S FULLY BUILT AND WORKING (verified with real tests, not aspirational)
═══════════════════════════════════════
- Full client app: mood check-ins, journaling, tasks/subtasks (with drag-reorder and drag-to-reprioritize between priority zones), 16 screening tests, worksheets, grounding exercises, Calm Room with a generated ambient soundscape (Web Audio API, no licensed file needed)
- Real auth: email/password + Google OAuth, password reset flow, session handling
- In-app booking calendar: admin/therapists manage real availability slots, clients pick real times — no external calendar dependency except an optional "Add to Calendar" convenience link after confirmation
- Three-role system in one app: Client / Therapist / Admin, gated by profile flags, therapist access granted by admin via email invite (auto-claims the moment that email signs in for the first time)
- Full payment flow (QR-based, manually confirmed by admin — no payment gateway integration yet) with a genuine "pending confirmation" to "confirmed" state transition, not instant
- Change-request flow requires a written reason, blocks the booking category until admin explicitly approves or rejects it
- Therapist dashboard: session summary + income (only counts sessions where notes are actually locked, not just booked), session notes + optional file upload required to lock payment, monthly cancellation limit, self-editable public profile (bio/superpowers/approaches/languages rendering as real tag chips), homework assignment that appears as real tasks directly in the client's account
- Admin dashboard: booking oversight, change-request approval/rejection with full client contact info (name/email/phone), expert profile creation + invite generation, analytics overview (revenue this month/new clients/active clients), real error log viewer
- Client self-service: Edit Profile screen, "My Sessions & Cancellations" history view
- Client data sharing: journal entries and test results can be explicitly shared with the assigned therapist only, respects consent, enforced at the database level (not just hidden in the UI)
- Consolidated "All Upcoming Slots" list on the therapist availability calendar (most recent change) — shows every slot across every day in one place, not just via the per-day calendar drill-down

═══════════════════════════════════════
STILL PENDING (accurate as of this writing)
═══════════════════════════════════════
- Push notifications — Firebase setup instructions given to Akash, not yet started on his end
- Real automated invite emails — blocked on the service_role key
- HDFC SmartGateway merchant onboarding — Akash's action, for real payment processing (chosen over Razorpay since HOBS already banks with HDFC)
- Privacy Policy / Terms of Service — explicitly deferred by Akash, kept as a standing reminder, not forgotten
- Pipeline roadmap: Chatbot, Donations/Fundraiser, Letters to Self, Mental Health Stories — discussed only, not scoped or built
- Supabase is on the Free tier: no automatic backups, and the project auto-pauses after 7 days of zero activity. A manual backup snapshot was taken July 10, 2026 and given to Akash. Recommended: upgrade to Pro ($25/mo) given real user data is now genuinely at stake.

═══════════════════════════════════════
TESTING DISCIPLINE ESTABLISHED — KEEP THIS UP
═══════════════════════════════════════
Every feature in this project was verified with actual Playwright tests (including real touch-event simulation for drag-and-drop, and direct curl checks against the live database after every RLS change) before being called done — not just visual inspection or assumption. Keep this standard for any new work: validate JS syntax, test the actual user flow including edge cases (signed-out states, empty data), run a full navigation regression, and verify live deployment by checking the actual served content directly — not just trusting a successful git push, since GitHub Pages has shown real, unrelated build delays this project.

function commitSheetTaskIfDirty(){
  var titleEl = document.getElementById('sheetTaskInput');
  var title = titleEl.value.trim();
  if(!title) return false;
  var deadlineVal = document.getElementById('sheetDeadlineInput').value;
  var subInputs = document.querySelectorAll('#sheetSubtaskArea input');
  var subtaskTitles = [];
  subInputs.forEach(function(inp){
    if(inp.value.trim()) subtaskTitles.push(inp.value.trim());
  });
  var deadlineIso = deadlineVal ? new Date(deadlineVal).toISOString() : null;

  var localTask = {
    id: 'temp_' + uidGen(), title: title, duration: sheetDuration, repeat: sheetRepeat,
    priority: sheetPriority, deadline: deadlineIso, done: false,
    subtasks: subtaskTitles.map(function(st){ return { id: 'temp_' + uidGen(), title: st, done:false }; })
  };
  getTasks(sheetTargetKey).push(localTask);
  saveState();
  if(sheetTargetKey === bdSelectedKey) renderBodyDoubleTaskList();
  if(sheetTargetKey === activeDayKey) renderTaskListCal();

  syncToSupabase('tasks', {
    date_key: sheetTargetKey, title: title, duration: sheetDuration,
    repeat: sheetRepeat, priority: sheetPriority, deadline: deadlineIso, done: false
  }, function(savedRow){
    localTask.id = savedRow.id; // swap temp ID for the real one
    if(subtaskTitles.length && currentUser && currentUser.id){
      var rows = subtaskTitles.map(function(st){ return { user_id: currentUser.id, task_id: savedRow.id, title: st, done:false }; });
      sb.from('subtasks').insert(rows).select().then(function(subResult){
        if(!subResult.error){
          localTask.subtasks.forEach(function(st, i){ if(subResult.data[i]) st.id = subResult.data[i].id; });
        }
      });
    }
  });
  titleEl.value = ''; // clear so a subsequent close doesn't re-save the same task
  return true;
}

  window.Capacitor.Plugins.App.addListener('backButton', function(){
    // addTaskSheet gets its own case (not the generic modal list below) so the hardware
    // back button triggers the same autosave-on-close as the X button and backdrop tap.
    if(document.getElementById('addTaskSheet').style.display === 'block'){
      closeAddTaskSheet();
      return;
    }
    var openModals = [
      { backdrop: 'policyModalBackdrop', modal: 'policyModal' },
      { backdrop: 'paymentModalBackdrop', modal: 'paymentModal' },
      { backdrop: 'slotPickerModalBackdrop', modal: 'slotPickerModal' },
      { backdrop: 'changeReasonModalBackdrop', modal: 'changeReasonModal' },
      { backdrop: 'therapistDayEditorBackdrop', modal: 'therapistDayEditor' }
    ];
    for(var i=0; i<openModals.length; i++){
      var m = openModals[i];
      var modalEl = document.getElementById(m.modal);
      if(modalEl && modalEl.style.display === 'block'){
        modalEl.style.display = 'none';
        var backdropEl = document.getElementById(m.backdrop);
        if(backdropEl) backdropEl.style.display = 'none';
        return;
      }
    }
    // These full-screen panels hold typed-but-unsaved content -- autosave it before
    // stepping back, same as their own in-panel Back buttons do.
    var currentPanel = panelHistoryStack[panelHistoryStack.length - 1];
    if(currentPanel === 'panel-journal' && commitMainJournalIfDirty()){
      resetJournalState();
      showToast('Saved');
    } else if(currentPanel === 'panel-quick-journal' && commitQuickJournalIfDirty()){
      showToast('Saved');
    } else if(currentPanel === 'panel-worksheet-detail' && commitWorksheetIfDirty()){
      showToast('Saved');
    }
    if(panelHistoryStack.length > 1){
      panelHistoryStack.pop(); // discard current
      var previousPanel = panelHistoryStack.pop() || 'panel-bubbles'; // this becomes current again via showOnly
      showOnly(previousPanel);
      if(previousPanel === 'panel-bubbles') setActiveNav('navHome');
    } else {
      window.Capacitor.Plugins.App.exitApp();
    }
  });

```

// Opens the same sheet pre-filled with an existing task's data, so tapping a task lets you edit
// it directly rather than only being able to add new ones.
function openEditTaskSheet(task, dateKey){
  sheetEditingTaskId = task.id;
  sheetTargetKey = dateKey || bdSelectedKey || TODAY_KEY;
  document.getElementById('sheetTaskInput').value = task.title || '';
  document.getElementById('sheetTaskInput').placeholder = 'Edit your task...';
  sheetDuration = task.duration || 30;
  sheetRepeat = !!task.repeat;
  sheetPriority = task.priority || null;
  document.getElementById('sheetDurationChip').lastChild.textContent = ' ' + sheetDuration + 'm';
  var dLabel = (sheetTargetKey === TODAY_KEY) ? 'Today' : sheetTargetKey;
  document.getElementById('sheetDayChip').lastChild.textContent = ' ' + dLabel;
  document.getElementById('sheetRepeatChip').style.background = sheetRepeat ? '#E9F0FB' : '#F0EEE8';
  document.getElementById('sheetRepeatChip').style.color = sheetRepeat ? '#6690D6' : '#9AABCE';
  document.querySelectorAll('.priority-chip').forEach(function(c){
    c.style.outline = 'none'; c.style.boxShadow = 'none';
    if(c.getAttribute('data-priority') === sheetPriority) c.style.boxShadow = 'inset 0 0 0 2px ' + PRIORITY_COLORS[sheetPriority];
  });
  if(task.deadline){
    document.getElementById('sheetDeadlineToggle').style.display = 'none';
    var dlInput = document.getElementById('sheetDeadlineInput');
    dlInput.style.display = 'block';
    var d = new Date(task.deadline);
    var pad = function(n){ return String(n).padStart(2,'0'); };
    dlInput.value = d.getFullYear() + '-' + pad(d.getMonth()+1) + '-' + pad(d.getDate()) + 'T' + pad(d.getHours()) + ':' + pad(d.getMinutes());
  } else {
    document.getElementById('sheetDeadlineToggle').style.display = 'block';
    document.getElementById('sheetDeadlineInput').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('sheetDeadlineInput').value = '';
  }
  var subtaskArea = document.getElementById('sheetSubtaskArea');
  subtaskArea.innerHTML = '';
  var existingSubtasks = (task.subtasks || []).slice().sort(function(a,b){ return (a.sortOrder||0) - (b.sortOrder||0); });
  if(existingSubtasks.length){
    document.getElementById('sheetBreakdownToggle').style.display = 'none';
    subtaskArea.style.display = 'block';
    existingSubtasks.forEach(function(st){ addSheetSubtaskRow(st.title, st.id); });
  } else {
    document.getElementById('sheetBreakdownToggle').style.display = 'block';
    subtaskArea.style.display = 'none';
  }
  document.getElementById('sheetDeleteTaskBtn').style.display = 'block';
  document.getElementById('addTaskSheetBackdrop').style.display = 'block';
  document.getElementById('addTaskSheet').style.display = 'block';
}

function addSheetSubtaskRow(prefillText, existingId){
  var area = document.getElementById('sheetSubtaskArea');
  var existingAddBtn = document.getElementById('sheetAddStepBtn');
  if(existingAddBtn) existingAddBtn.remove();
  var stepNum = area.querySelectorAll('input').length + 1;
  var row = document.createElement('div');
  row.style.cssText = 'display:flex;gap:6px;margin-bottom:6px;align-items:center;';
  if(existingId) row.dataset.subtaskId = existingId;
  var input = document.createElement('input');
  input.type = 'text';
  input.placeholder = 'Step ' + stepNum + '...';
  if(prefillText) input.value = prefillText;
  input.style.cssText = 'flex:1;border:1px solid #EEE0C4;border-radius:10px;padding:9px 10px;font-size:12.5px;font-family:inherit;';
  row.appendChild(input);
  var delBtn = document.createElement('button');
  delBtn.innerHTML = '&times;';
  delBtn.style.cssText = 'background:none;border:none;color:#C7BFA8;font-size:16px;cursor:pointer;padding:0 4px;line-height:1;flex-shrink:0;';
  delBtn.onclick = function(){ row.remove(); renumberSheetSteps(); };
  row.appendChild(delBtn);
  area.appendChild(row);
  var addMoreBtn = document.createElement('button');
  addMoreBtn.id = 'sheetAddStepBtn';
  addMoreBtn.textContent = '+ Add another step';
  addMoreBtn.style.cssText = 'background:none;border:none;color:#6690D6;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;padding:2px 0;';
  addMoreBtn.onclick = function(){ addSheetSubtaskRow(); };
  area.appendChild(addMoreBtn);
  if(!prefillText) input.focus(); // don't steal focus away when pre-populating existing steps for an edit
  return row;
}

function commitSheetTaskIfDirty(){
  var titleEl = document.getElementById('sheetTaskInput');
  var title = titleEl.value.trim();
  if(!title) return false;
  var deadlineVal = document.getElementById('sheetDeadlineInput').value;
  var deadlineIso = deadlineVal ? new Date(deadlineVal).toISOString() : null;
  var subtaskRows = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#sheetSubtaskArea > div'));

  if(sheetEditingTaskId){
    return commitTaskEdit(title, deadlineIso, subtaskRows);
  }

  var subtaskTitles = [];
  subtaskRows.forEach(function(row){
    var inp = row.querySelector('input');
    if(inp && inp.value.trim()) subtaskTitles.push(inp.value.trim());
  });

  var localTask = {
    id: 'temp_' + uidGen(), title: title, duration: sheetDuration, repeat: sheetRepeat,
    priority: sheetPriority, deadline: deadlineIso, done: false,
    subtasks: subtaskTitles.map(function(st){ return { id: 'temp_' + uidGen(), title: st, done:false }; })
  };
  getTasks(sheetTargetKey).push(localTask);
  saveState();
  if(sheetTargetKey === bdSelectedKey) renderBodyDoubleTaskList();
  if(sheetTargetKey === activeDayKey) renderTaskListCal();

  syncToSupabase('tasks', {
    date_key: sheetTargetKey, title: title, duration: sheetDuration,
    repeat: sheetRepeat, priority: sheetPriority, deadline: deadlineIso, done: false
  }, function(savedRow){
    localTask.id = savedRow.id; // swap temp ID for the real one
    if(subtaskTitles.length && currentUser && currentUser.id){
      var rows = subtaskTitles.map(function(st){ return { user_id: currentUser.id, task_id: savedRow.id, title: st, done:false }; });
      sb.from('subtasks').insert(rows).select().then(function(subResult){
        if(!subResult.error){
          localTask.subtasks.forEach(function(st, i){ if(subResult.data[i]) st.id = subResult.data[i].id; });
        }
      });
    }
  });
  titleEl.value = ''; // clear so a subsequent close doesn't re-save the same task
  return true;
}

// Applies edits to an existing task in place -- updates fields, and reconciles the subtask rows
// (kept/edited, newly added, or removed) against what's actually in the sheet right now.
function commitTaskEdit(title, deadlineIso, subtaskRows){
  var taskId = sheetEditingTaskId;
  var task = getTasks(sheetTargetKey).find(function(t){ return t.id === taskId; });
  if(!task) return false;

  task.title = title;
  task.duration = sheetDuration;
  task.repeat = sheetRepeat;
  task.priority = sheetPriority;
  task.deadline = deadlineIso;
  task.subtasks = task.subtasks || [];

  var keptIds = [];
  var newSubtaskTitles = [];
  var updatedSubtasks = [];
  subtaskRows.forEach(function(row){
    var inp = row.querySelector('input');
    var text = inp ? inp.value.trim() : '';
    if(!text) return; // blank row -- treated the same as removing that step
    var existingId = row.dataset.subtaskId;
    if(existingId){
      keptIds.push(existingId);
      var existingSub = task.subtasks.find(function(s){ return String(s.id) === existingId; });
      if(existingSub){ existingSub.title = text; updatedSubtasks.push(existingSub); }
    } else {
      newSubtaskTitles.push(text);
    }
  });
  var removedSubtasks = task.subtasks.filter(function(s){ return keptIds.indexOf(String(s.id)) === -1; });
  var newSubtaskObjs = newSubtaskTitles.map(function(t){ return { id: 'temp_' + uidGen(), title: t, done:false }; });
  task.subtasks = task.subtasks.filter(function(s){ return keptIds.indexOf(String(s.id)) !== -1; }).concat(newSubtaskObjs);

  saveState();
  if(sheetTargetKey === bdSelectedKey) renderBodyDoubleTaskList();
  if(sheetTargetKey === activeDayKey) renderTaskListCal();

  if(String(taskId).indexOf('temp_') !== 0){
    sb.from('tasks').update({
      title: title, duration: sheetDuration, repeat: sheetRepeat,
      priority: sheetPriority, deadline: deadlineIso
    }).eq('id', taskId).then(function(result){ if(result.error) console.error(result.error); });
  }
  updatedSubtasks.forEach(function(s){
    if(String(s.id).indexOf('temp_') !== 0){
      sb.from('subtasks').update({ title: s.title }).eq('id', s.id).then(function(){});
    }
  });
  removedSubtasks.forEach(function(s){
    if(String(s.id).indexOf('temp_') !== 0){
      sb.from('subtasks').delete().eq('id', s.id).then(function(){});
    }
  });
  if(newSubtaskObjs.length && currentUser && currentUser.id){
    var rows = newSubtaskObjs.map(function(s){ return { user_id: currentUser.id, task_id: taskId, title: s.title, done:false }; });
    sb.from('subtasks').insert(rows).select().then(function(subResult){
      if(!subResult.error){
        newSubtaskObjs.forEach(function(s, i){ if(subResult.data[i]) s.id = subResult.data[i].id; });
      }
    });
  }

  document.getElementById('sheetTaskInput').value = '';
  sheetEditingTaskId = null;
  return true;
}
```

function onAuthSuccess(user){
  currentUser = user;
  Promise.all([loadUserDataFromSupabase(), loadExpertsFromSupabase()]).then(function(){
    var overlay = document.getElementById('authOverlay');
    overlay.style.display = 'none';
    void overlay.offsetHeight; // force immediate reflow so the change paints right away
    claimTherapistInviteIfAny();
    retryPendingSync();
    initPushNotifications();
    if(!appState.onboardingComplete){
      showOnboarding();
    } else if(!appState.hasSeenIntro){
      showWalkthrough();
    } else {
      renderHomeGreeting();
    }
  });
}

// Registers this device for push notifications (native app only) and keeps the resulting
// FCM token synced onto the signed-in user's profile row so a server-side sender can target it.
var pushListenersAttached = false;
function initPushNotifications(){
  if(!IS_NATIVE_APP) return;
  if(!window.Capacitor || !window.Capacitor.Plugins || !window.Capacitor.Plugins.PushNotifications) return;
  if(appState.notificationsEnabled === false) return; // user has explicitly turned this off in their profile
  var Push = window.Capacitor.Plugins.PushNotifications;

  if(!pushListenersAttached){
    pushListenersAttached = true;
    Push.addListener('registration', function(tokenData){
      var token = tokenData && tokenData.value;
      if(!currentUser || !currentUser.id || !token) return;
      sb.from('profiles').update({ push_token: token }).eq('user_id', currentUser.id).then(function(result){
        if(result.error) console.error('Failed to save push token:', result.error);
      });
    });
    Push.addListener('registrationError', function(err){
      console.error('Push registration error:', err);
    });
    Push.addListener('pushNotificationReceived', function(notification){
      // App was already open in the foreground -- surface it gently instead of relying on the system tray.
      if(notification && notification.title){
        showToast(notification.title + (notification.body ? ': ' + notification.body : ''));
      }
    });
    Push.addListener('pushNotificationActionPerformed', function(){
      // User tapped a notification from the tray. No deep-link routing yet -- land safely on Home.
      showOnly('panel-bubbles');
      setActiveNav('navHome');
    });
  }

  Push.requestPermissions().then(function(result){
    if(result && result.receive === 'granted') Push.register();
  }).catch(function(err){ console.error('Push permission request failed:', err); });
}
```

function onAuthSuccess(user){
  currentUser = user;
  Promise.all([loadUserDataFromSupabase(), loadExpertsFromSupabase()]).then(function(){
    var overlay = document.getElementById('authOverlay');
    overlay.style.display = 'none';
    void overlay.offsetHeight; // force immediate reflow so the change paints right away
    claimTherapistInviteIfAny();
    retryPendingSync();
    initPushNotifications();
    if(!appState.onboardingComplete){

    } else if(!appState.hasSeenIntro){
      showWalkthrough();
    } else {
      renderHomeGreeting();
    }

// Registers this device for push notifications (native app only) and keeps the resulting
// FCM token synced onto the signed-in user's profile row so a server-side sender can target it.
var pushListenersAttached = false;
function initPushNotifications(){
  if(!IS_NATIVE_APP) return;
  if(!window.Capacitor || !window.Capacitor.Plugins || !window.Capacitor.Plugins.PushNotifications) return;
  if(appState.notificationsEnabled === false) return; // user has explicitly turned this off in their profile
  var Push = window.Capacitor.Plugins.PushNotifications;

  if(!pushListenersAttached){
    pushListenersAttached = true;
    Push.addListener('registration', function(tokenData){
      var token = tokenData && tokenData.value;
      if(!currentUser || !currentUser.id || !token) return;
      sb.from('profiles').update({ push_token: token }).eq('user_id', currentUser.id).then(function(result){
        if(result.error) console.error('Failed to save push token:', result.error);
      });
    });
    Push.addListener('registrationError', function(err){
      console.error('Push registration error:', err);
    });
    Push.addListener('pushNotificationReceived', function(notification){
      // App was already open in the foreground -- surface it gently instead of relying on the system tray.
      if(notification && notification.title){
        showToast(notification.title + (notification.body ? ': ' + notification.body : ''));
      }
    });
    Push.addListener('pushNotificationActionPerformed', function(){
      // User tapped a notification from the tray. No deep-link routing yet -- land safely on Home.
      showOnly('panel-bubbles');
      setActiveNav('navHome');
    });
  }

  Push.requestPermissions().then(function(result){
    if(result && result.receive === 'granted') Push.register();
  }).catch(function(err){ console.error('Push permission request failed:', err); });
}

// send-push-notification
//
// Sends a push notification via Firebase Cloud Messaging (HTTP v1 API) to one user, a list of
// users, or everyone with a registered device -- using the profiles.push_token column that the
// HOBS Companion app writes to on sign-in.
//
// Auth: requires a valid Supabase user JWT (default Edge Function verification). Beyond that,
// the caller must be an admin or therapist, UNLESS they are sending only to themselves (used for
// a self-test send from the app). This is intentionally conservative -- broadening who can
// trigger a broadcast is a product decision, not something to default open.
//
// Request body:
//   { "title": string, "body": string, "data"?: object,
//     "userId"?: string, "userIds"?: string[], "all"?: true }
// Exactly one of userId / userIds / all must be provided.

import { createClient } from "https://esm.sh/@supabase/supabase-js@2";

const FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID = "hobs-companion";

const SA_EMAIL = Deno.env.get("FIREBASE_CLIENT_EMAIL")!;
const SA_PRIVATE_KEY = (Deno.env.get("FIREBASE_PRIVATE_KEY") || "").replace(/\\n/g, "\n");

// Auto-injected by Supabase into every Edge Function at deploy time -- not something we set ourselves.
const SUPABASE_URL = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_URL")!;
const SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY")!;
const SUPABASE_ANON_KEY = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_ANON_KEY")!;

const encoder = new TextEncoder();

function base64url(input: ArrayBuffer | string): string {
  const bytes = typeof input === "string" ? encoder.encode(input) : new Uint8Array(input);
  let str = "";
  bytes.forEach((b) => (str += String.fromCharCode(b)));
  return btoa(str).replace(/\+/g, "-").replace(/\//g, "_").replace(/=+$/, "");
}

async function getFcmAccessToken(): Promise<string> {
  const header = { alg: "RS256", typ: "JWT" };
  const now = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);
  const claimSet = {
    iss: SA_EMAIL,
    scope: "https://www.googleapis.com/auth/firebase.messaging",
    aud: "https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token",
    iat: now,
    exp: now + 3600,
  };

  const toSign = `${base64url(JSON.stringify(header))}.${base64url(JSON.stringify(claimSet))}`;

  const keyData = SA_PRIVATE_KEY
    .replace("<REDACTED:private_key>", "")
    .replace(/\s/g, "");
  const binaryKey = Uint8Array.from(atob(keyData), (c) => c.charCodeAt(0));

  const cryptoKey = await crypto.subtle.importKey(
    "pkcs8",
    binaryKey,
    { name: "RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5", hash: "SHA-256" },
    false,
    ["sign"]
  );

  const signature = await crypto.subtle.sign("RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5", cryptoKey, encoder.encode(toSign));
  const jwt = `${toSign}.${base64url(signature)}`;

  const tokenRes = await fetch("https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token", {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded" },
    body: new URLSearchParams({
      grant_type: "urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:jwt-bearer",
      assertion: jwt,
    }),
  });
  const tokenJson = await tokenRes.json();
  if (!tokenRes.ok) throw new Error("FCM token exchange failed: " + JSON.stringify(tokenJson));
  return tokenJson.access_token;
}

async function sendToToken(
  accessToken: string,
  token: string,
  title: string,
  body: string,
  data?: Record<string, string>
) {
  const res = await fetch(
    `https://fcm.googleapis.com/v1/projects/${FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID}/messages:send`,
    {
      method: "POST",
      headers: {
        Authorization: `Bearer ${accessToken}`,
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        message: {
          token,
          notification: { title, body },
          data: data || {},
          android: { priority: "high" },
        },
      }),
    }
  );
  const json = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
  return { ok: res.ok, status: res.status, body: json };
}

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  if (req.method !== "POST") {
    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "POST only" }), { status: 405 });
  }

  try {
    const authHeader = req.headers.get("Authorization") || "";
    if (!authHeader) {
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "Missing Authorization header" }), { status: 401 });
    }

    // Client bound to the CALLER's own JWT -- used only to find out who they are and whether
    // they're an admin/therapist. Never used to read or write other people's data.
    const callerClient = createClient(SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, {
      global: { headers: { Authorization: authHeader } },
    });
    const { data: callerAuth, error: callerAuthErr } = await callerClient.auth.getUser();
    if (callerAuthErr || !callerAuth?.user) {
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "Invalid or expired session" }), { status: 401 });
    }
    const callerId = callerAuth.user.id;

    const payload = await req.json();
    const { title, body, data, userId, userIds, all } = payload;

    if (!title || !body) {
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "title and body are required" }), { status: 400 });
    }
    const specifiedTargets = [userId, userIds, all].filter((v) => v !== undefined);
    if (specifiedTargets.length !== 1) {
      return new Response(
        JSON.stringify({ error: "Provide exactly one of userId, userIds, or all:true" }),
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    // Admin client (service role) -- used for everything past this point, since we've already
    // established who the caller is and what they're allowed to do above.
    const adminClient = createClient(SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY);

    const isSelfOnly = userId === callerId && !userIds && !all;
    if (!isSelfOnly) {
      const { data: callerProfile } = await adminClient
        .from("profiles")
        .select("is_admin, is_therapist")
        .eq("user_id", callerId)
        .single();
      if (!callerProfile || (!callerProfile.is_admin && !callerProfile.is_therapist)) {
        return new Response(
          JSON.stringify({ error: "Only admins/therapists can send to other users" }),
          { status: 403 }
        );
      }
    }

    let query = adminClient
      .from("profiles")
      .select("user_id, push_token, notifications_enabled, notifications_paused_until")
      .not("push_token", "is", null);

    if (userId) query = query.eq("user_id", userId);
    else if (userIds) query = query.in("user_id", userIds);
    // all:true -- no extra filter, every profile with a push_token is eligible

    const { data: profiles, error: profilesErr } = await query;
    if (profilesErr) throw profilesErr;

    const now = new Date();
    const targets = (profiles || []).filter((p: any) => {
      if (!p.push_token) return false;
      if (p.notifications_enabled === false) return false;
      if (p.notifications_paused_until && new Date(p.notifications_paused_until) > now) return false;
      return true;
    });

    if (targets.length === 0) {
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ sent: 0, message: "No eligible recipients" }), { status: 200 });
    }

    const accessToken = await getFcmAccessToken();

    const results: any[] = [];
    const invalidTokenUserIds: string[] = [];
    for (const p of targets) {
      const result = await sendToToken(accessToken, p.push_token, title, body, data);
      results.push({ userId: p.user_id, ok: result.ok, status: result.status });
      if (!result.ok) {
        const errCode = (result.body as any)?.error?.status;
        // Dead/uninstalled-app tokens -- stop retrying them going forward.
        if (errCode === "NOT_FOUND" || errCode === "UNREGISTERED" || errCode === "INVALID_ARGUMENT") {
          invalidTokenUserIds.push(p.user_id);
        }
      }
    }

    if (invalidTokenUserIds.length > 0) {
      await adminClient.from("profiles").update({ push_token: null }).in("user_id", invalidTokenUserIds);
    }

    const sentCount = results.filter((r) => r.ok).length;
    return new Response(
      JSON.stringify({ sent: sentCount, failed: results.length - sentCount, results }),
      { status: 200, headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" } }
    );
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("send-push-notification error:", err);
    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: String(err) }), { status: 500 });
  }
});

// Self-test: asks the send-push-notification Edge Function to send a notification to the
// currently signed-in user only. Safe to expose to anyone since the function only allows
// sending to yourself unless you're an admin/therapist sending to someone else.
function sendTestPushNotification(){
  if(!currentUser || !currentUser.id) return;
  showToast('Sending test notification...');
  sb.functions.invoke('send-push-notification', {
    body: { title: 'HOBS Companion', body: 'This is a test notification — if you see this, push is working!', userId: currentUser.id }
  }).then(function(result){
    if(result.error){
      console.error('Test push failed:', result.error);
      showToast('Could not send — check your connection and try again');
      return;
    }
    var data = result.data;
    if(data && data.sent > 0){
      showToast('Sent! It should arrive any moment.');
    } else if(data && data.message){
      showToast(data.message + ' — try re-registering by signing out and back in.');
    } else {
      showToast('No notification was sent — your device may not be registered yet.');
    }
  }).catch(function(err){
    console.error('Test push error:', err);
    showToast('Something went wrong sending the test notification');
  });
}

    return new Response(
      JSON.stringify({ sent: sentCount, failed: results.length - sentCount, results }),
      { status: 200, headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" } }
    );
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("send-push-notification error:", err);
    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: String(err) }), {
      status: 500,
      headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    });
  }
});
```
