FULL FILE TEXT (exact):
```
// notification-scheduler
//
// Invoked every 15 minutes by pg_cron (via pg_net). For every user with push notifications
// enabled, computes THEIR local time (from profiles.timezone) and checks whether any of the
// four recurring notification types are due right now, in their timezone -- not a fixed
// server timezone. This is what makes "9pm journaling reminder" mean 9pm for each person,
// not 9pm IST for everyone.
//
// Recurring types and their rules:
//   book_session   - Sunday & Thursday, ~10:00 local. Sunday checks the upcoming Mon-Sat week;
//                    Thursday checks the current (already-started) Mon-Sat week. Only sent if
//                    they have no booking in that window.
//   task_reminder  - ~11:00 and ~18:00 local. Only if they have incomplete tasks due today.
//   mood_check     - ~15:00 local. Only if they haven't logged a mood yet today.
//   journal_reminder - ~21:00 local, every day, unconditionally (per explicit product decision).
//
// Global rule: no user receives more than one notification within any 3-hour window, across
// ALL types combined (not just within a type). If someone's already due for two things at once,
// whichever is checked first in this run wins for this cycle; the other picks up on its next go.
//
// Every notification type gets a single notification_log row per run (a "batch"), with one
// notification_recipients row per person who actually got sent something -- so the admin
// dashboard sees one logical send with many recipients, not hundreds of individual log rows.

import { createClient } from "https://esm.sh/@supabase/supabase-js@2";

const FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID = "hobs-companion";
const SA_EMAIL = Deno.env.get("FIREBASE_CLIENT_EMAIL")!;
const SA_PRIVATE_KEY = (Deno.env.get("FIREBASE_PRIVATE_KEY") || "").replace(/\\n/g, "\n");
const SUPABASE_URL = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_URL")!;
const SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY")!;
const SCHEDULER_SECRET = Deno.env.get("SCHEDULER_SECRET")!; // shared secret so only pg_cron can trigger this

const encoder = new TextEncoder();
function base64url(input: ArrayBuffer | string): string {
  const bytes = typeof input === "string" ? encoder.encode(input) : new Uint8Array(input);
  let str = "";
  bytes.forEach((b) => (str += String.fromCharCode(b)));
  return btoa(str).replace(/\+/g, "-").replace(/\//g, "_").replace(/=+$/, "");
}

async function getFcmAccessToken(): Promise<string> {
  const header = { alg: "RS256", typ: "JWT" };
  const now = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);
  const claimSet = {
    iss: SA_EMAIL,
    scope: "https://www.googleapis.com/auth/firebase.messaging",
    aud: "https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token",
    iat: now,
    exp: now + 3600,
  };
  const toSign = `${base64url(JSON.stringify(header))}.${base64url(JSON.stringify(claimSet))}`;
  const keyData = SA_PRIVATE_KEY.replace("<REDACTED:private_key>", "").replace(/\s/g, "");
  const binaryKey = Uint8Array.from(atob(keyData), (c) => c.charCodeAt(0));
  const cryptoKey = await crypto.subtle.importKey("pkcs8", binaryKey, { name: "RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5", hash: "SHA-256" }, false, ["sign"]);
  const signature = await crypto.subtle.sign("RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5", cryptoKey, encoder.encode(toSign));
  const jwt = `${toSign}.${base64url(signature)}`;
  const tokenRes = await fetch("https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token", {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded" },
    body: new URLSearchParams({ grant_type: "urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:jwt-bearer", assertion: jwt }),
  });
  const tokenJson = await tokenRes.json();
  if (!tokenRes.ok) throw new Error("FCM token exchange failed: " + JSON.stringify(tokenJson));
  return tokenJson.access_token;
}

async function sendToToken(accessToken: string, token: string, title: string, body: string, data?: Record<string, string>) {
  const res = await fetch(`https://fcm.googleapis.com/v1/projects/${FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID}/messages:send`, {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${accessToken}`, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    body: JSON.stringify({ message: { token, notification: { title, body }, data: data || {}, android: { priority: "high" } } }),
  });
  const json = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
  return { ok: res.ok, status: res.status, body: json };
}

// ---- Timezone-local date/time helpers ----
// Returns { hour, minute, weekday (0=Sun..6=Sat), dateKey ('YYYY-MM-DD') } for "now" in the given IANA tz.
function localNow(tz: string) {
  const fmt = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US", {
    timeZone: tz, hour12: false,
    year: "numeric", month: "2-digit", day: "2-digit", hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit", weekday: "short",
  });
  const parts: Record<string, string> = {};
  fmt.formatToParts(new Date()).forEach((p) => (parts[p.type] = p.value));
  const weekdayMap: Record<string, number> = { Sun: 0, Mon: 1, Tue: 2, Wed: 3, Thu: 4, Fri: 5, Sat: 6 };
  return {
    hour: parseInt(parts.hour, 10),
    minute: parseInt(parts.minute, 10),
    weekday: weekdayMap[parts.weekday],
    dateKey: `${parts.year}-${parts.month}-${parts.day}`,
  };
}
function inWindow(local: { hour: number; minute: number }, targetHour: number): boolean {
  // Fires once, in the first 15 minutes of the target hour (this function runs every 15 min).
  return local.hour === targetHour && local.minute < 15;
}
// Returns the Mon-Sat date range (as 'YYYY-MM-DD' strings) containing today, per the given local date.
function mondayToSaturdayRange(dateKey: string, weekday: number): { start: string; end: string } {
  const d = new Date(dateKey + "T00:00:00Z");
  const diffToMonday = weekday === 0 ? -6 : 1 - weekday; // Sunday counts as "before" this Mon-Sat block
  const monday = new Date(d);
  monday.setUTCDate(d.getUTCDate() + diffToMonday);
  const saturday = new Date(monday);
  saturday.setUTCDate(monday.getUTCDate() + 5);
  const fmt = (x: Date) => x.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  return { start: fmt(monday), end: fmt(saturday) };
}
// For Sunday specifically, we check the *upcoming* Mon-Sat (starting tomorrow), not the one that just ended.
function upcomingMondayToSaturdayRange(dateKey: string): { start: string; end: string } {
  const d = new Date(dateKey + "T00:00:00Z");
  const monday = new Date(d);
  monday.setUTCDate(d.getUTCDate() + 1); // Sunday + 1 = Monday
  const saturday = new Date(monday);
  saturday.setUTCDate(monday.getUTCDate() + 5);
  const fmt = (x: Date) => x.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  return { start: fmt(monday), end: fmt(saturday) };
}

// ---- Mascot-voice copy for each notification type ----
const COPY: Record<string, { title: string; body: string }> = {
  book_session: {
    title: "Bob here 🐘",
    body: "No pressure at all — but if you'd like some company this week, I'd love to help you find a time. Tap whenever feels right.",
  },
  task_reminder: {
    title: "Bob here 🐘",
    body: "Just checking in — there's a little something on today's list whenever you're ready for it. Tell me more if you want a hand.",
  },
  mood_check: {
    title: "Bob here 🐘",
    body: "How are you doing right now? No wrong answer — just curious how today's feeling for you.",
  },
  journal_reminder: {
    title: "Kunnu here 🐾",
    body: "Come sit with me for a minute? However today went, it might feel good to get it down before you rest.",
  },
};

async function alreadyNotifiedToday(admin: any, userId: string, type: string, sinceIso: string): Promise<boolean> {
  const { data } = await admin
    .from("notification_recipients")
    .select("id, notification_log!inner(notification_type)")
    .eq("user_id", userId)
    .eq("notification_log.notification_type", type)
    .gte("sent_at", sinceIso)
    .limit(1);
  return !!(data && data.length > 0);
}

async function withinLastThreeHours(admin: any, userId: string): Promise<boolean> {
  const threeHoursAgo = new Date(Date.now() - 3 * 60 * 60 * 1000).toISOString();
  const { data } = await admin
    .from("notification_recipients")
    .select("id")
    .eq("user_id", userId)
    .gte("sent_at", threeHoursAgo)
    .limit(1);
  return !!(data && data.length > 0);
}

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  // Only pg_cron (via pg_net, carrying this shared secret) should ever be able to trigger this.
  const providedSecret = req.headers.get("x-scheduler-secret");
  if (providedSecret !== SCHEDULER_SECRET) {
    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "Unauthorized" }), { status: 401 });
  }

  const admin = createClient(SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY);
  const now = new Date();

  const { data: profiles, error } = await admin
    .from("profiles")
    .select("user_id, push_token, timezone, notifications_enabled, notifications_paused_until")
    .not("push_token", "is", null);
  if (error) {
    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: String(error) }), { status: 500 });
  }

  const eligibleProfiles = (profiles || []).filter((p: any) => {
    if (p.notifications_enabled === false) return false;
    if (p.notifications_paused_until && new Date(p.notifications_paused_until) > now) return false;
    return true;
  });

  // Figure out which (user, type) pairs are due right now, in each user's own local time.
  const dueByType: Record<string, string[]> = { book_session: [], task_reminder: [], mood_check: [], journal_reminder: [] };

  for (const p of eligibleProfiles) {
    const tz = p.timezone || "Asia/Kolkata";
    let local;
    try {
      local = localNow(tz);
    } catch {
      local = localNow("Asia/Kolkata"); // bad/unrecognized timezone string -- fall back rather than skip the user entirely
    }

    if ((local.weekday === 0 || local.weekday === 4) && inWindow(local, 10)) {
      dueByType.book_session.push(p.user_id);
    }
    if (inWindow(local, 11) || inWindow(local, 18)) {
      dueByType.task_reminder.push(p.user_id);
    }
    if (inWindow(local, 15)) {
      dueByType.mood_check.push(p.user_id);
    }
    if (inWindow(local, 21)) {
      dueByType.journal_reminder.push(p.user_id);
    }
  }

  const profileById = new Map(eligibleProfiles.map((p: any) => [p.user_id, p]));
  const summary: Record<string, any> = {};
  let accessToken: string | null = null;

  for (const type of Object.keys(dueByType)) {
    const candidateIds = dueByType[type];
    if (candidateIds.length === 0) { summary[type] = { candidates: 0, sent: 0 }; continue; }

    const finalTargets: string[] = [];
    for (const userId of candidateIds) {
      // Dedup: already got this exact type sent today (their local day)? Skip.
      const tz = (profileById.get(userId) as any)?.timezone || "Asia/Kolkata";
      const local = localNow(tz);
      const localMidnightUtc = new Date(new Date(`${local.dateKey}T00:00:00`).toLocaleString("en-US", { timeZone: "UTC" }));
      const sinceIso = new Date(Date.now() - 20 * 60 * 60 * 1000).toISOString(); // conservative 20h lookback covers "today" regardless of tz math edge cases
      if (await alreadyNotifiedToday(admin, userId, type, sinceIso)) continue;

      // Global 3-hour spacing rule, across all types.
      if (await withinLastThreeHours(admin, userId)) continue;

      // Per-type conditional check.
      if (type === "book_session") {
        const range = local.weekday === 0 ? upcomingMondayToSaturdayRange(local.dateKey) : mondayToSaturdayRange(local.dateKey, local.weekday);
        const { data: bookings } = await admin
          .from("expert_bookings")
          .select("id")
          .eq("user_id", userId)
          .gte("session_date", range.start)
          .lte("session_date", range.end)
          .limit(1);
        if (bookings && bookings.length > 0) continue; // already booked for that week
      } else if (type === "task_reminder") {
        const { data: tasks } = await admin
          .from("tasks")
          .select("id")
          .eq("user_id", userId)
          .eq("date_key", local.dateKey)
          .eq("done", false)
          .limit(1);
        if (!tasks || tasks.length === 0) continue; // nothing outstanding today
      } else if (type === "mood_check") {
        const { data: entries } = await admin
          .from("entries")
          .select("id")
          .eq("user_id", userId)
          .not("moods", "eq", "[]")
          .gte("date", sinceIso)
          .limit(1);
        if (entries && entries.length > 0) continue; // already logged a mood today
      }
      // journal_reminder: unconditional, no extra check.

      finalTargets.push(userId);
    }

    if (finalTargets.length === 0) { summary[type] = { candidates: candidateIds.length, sent: 0 }; continue; }

    if (!accessToken) accessToken = await getFcmAccessToken();
    const copy = COPY[type];

    const { data: logRow, error: logErr } = await admin
      .from("notification_log")
      .insert({
        notification_type: type, title: copy.title, body: copy.body,
        data: { type }, sent_by: null, target_type: "segment",
        target_description: `Automated ${type} reminder (timezone-local batch)`,
      })
      .select("id").single();
    if (logErr) { summary[type] = { error: String(logErr) }; continue; }

    let sentCount = 0;
    for (const userId of finalTargets) {
      const token = (profileById.get(userId) as any)?.push_token;
      if (!token) continue;
      const result = await sendToToken(accessToken, token, copy.title, copy.body, { type, notification_id: logRow.id });
      await admin.from("notification_recipients").insert({
        notification_id: logRow.id, user_id: userId,
        fcm_ok: result.ok, fcm_status: result.status,
      });
      if (result.ok) sentCount++;
      else {
        const errCode = (result.body as any)?.error?.status;
        if (errCode === "NOT_FOUND" || errCode === "UNREGISTERED" || errCode === "INVALID_ARGUMENT") {
          await admin.from("profiles").update({ push_token: null }).eq("user_id", userId);
        }
      }
    }
    summary[type] = { candidates: candidateIds.length, sent: sentCount };
  }

  return new Response(JSON.stringify({ ranAt: now.toISOString(), summary }), {
    status: 200, headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
  });
});

```

```
    const isSelfOnly = userId === callerId && !userIds && !all;
    if (!isSelfOnly) {
```

```
        .single();
      if (!callerProfile || (!callerProfile.is_admin && !callerProfile.is_therapist)) {
        return new Response(
          JSON.stringify({ error: "Only admins/therapists can send to other users" }),
          { status: 403, headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" } }
        );
      }
    }

    let query = adminClient
      .from("profiles")
      .select("user_id, push_token, notifications_enabled, notifications_paused_until")
      .not("push_token", "is", null);

    if (userId) query = query.eq("user_id", userId);
    else if (userIds) query = query.in("user_id", userIds);
    // all:true -- no extra filter, every profile with a push_token is eligible

    const { data: profiles, error: profilesErr } = await query;
    if (profilesErr) throw profilesErr;

    const now = new Date();
    const targets = (profiles || []).filter((p: any) => {
      if (!p.push_token) return false;
      if (p.notifications_enabled === false) return false;
      if (p.notifications_paused_until && new Date(p.notifications_paused_until) > now) return false;
      return true;
    });

    if (targets.length === 0) {
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ sent: 0, message: "No eligible recipients" }), {
        status: 200,
        headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      });
    }

    const accessToken = await getFcmAccessToken();

    // Log the send itself before dispatching -- so even a partial failure mid-loop still leaves
    // a record of what was attempted, not just what fully succeeded.
    const { data: logRow, error: logErr } = await adminClient
      .from("notification_log")
      .insert({
        notification_type: notificationType || (isSelfOnly ? "self_test" : "admin_manual"),
        title, body, data: data || {},
        sent_by: isSelfOnly ? null : callerId,
        target_type: all ? "all" : (userIds ? "segment" : "user"),
        target_description: targetDescription || (all ? "All users" : (userIds ? `${userIds.length} selected users` : "Single user")),
      })
      .select("id").single();
    if (logErr) throw logErr;

    const results: any[] = [];
    const invalidTokenUserIds: string[] = [];
    for (const p of targets) {
      const result = await sendToToken(accessToken, p.push_token, title, body, { ...(data || {}), notification_id: logRow.id });
      results.push({ userId: p.user_id, ok: result.ok, status: result.status });
      await adminClient.from("notification_recipients").insert({
        notification_id: logRow.id, user_id: p.user_id,
        fcm_ok: result.ok, fcm_status: result.status,
      });
      if (!result.ok) {
        const errCode = (result.body as any)?.error?.status;
        // Dead/uninstalled-app tokens -- stop retrying them going forward.
        if (errCode === "NOT_FOUND" || errCode === "UNREGISTERED" || errCode === "INVALID_ARGUMENT") {

        }
      }

    if (invalidTokenUserIds.length > 0) {
      await adminClient.from("profiles").update({ push_token: null }).in("user_id", invalidTokenUserIds);
    }

    const sentCount = results.filter((r) => r.ok).length;
    return new Response(
      JSON.stringify({ sent: sentCount, failed: results.length - sentCount, notificationId: logRow.id, results }),
      { status: 200, headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" } }
    );
```

```
name: Notification Scheduler

# Runs every 15 minutes and asks the notification-scheduler Edge Function to check every user's
# LOCAL time and send any recurring reminder (book a session, task reminder, mood check, journal)
# that's due right now for them. All the actual logic (timezone math, conditions, 3-hour spacing,
# dedup) lives in the Edge Function itself -- this workflow's only job is to trigger it reliably.
#
# Why GitHub Actions and not Supabase's own pg_cron: pg_cron/pg_net calls made through Supabase's
# Management API SQL endpoint are blocked by a WAF layer there, and using a direct Postgres
# connection would have meant handling/rotating the raw database password. This reuses
# infrastructure already available to this project instead.

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '*/15 * * * *'
  workflow_dispatch: {} # lets it be triggered manually from the Actions tab too, for testing

jobs:
  trigger-scheduler:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Call notification-scheduler
        run: |
          response=$(curl -s -o /tmp/response.json -w "%{http_code}" -X POST \
            "https://adjvptkzyckkvewbfmzf.supabase.co/functions/v1/notification-scheduler" \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            -H "x-scheduler-secret: ${{ secrets.SCHEDULER_SECRET }}")
          echo "HTTP status: $response"
          cat /tmp/response.json
          if [ "$response" -ge 400 ]; then
            echo "::error::Scheduler call failed with status $response"
            exit 1
          fi
```

```
// Registers this device for push notifications (native app only) and keeps the resulting
// FCM token synced onto the signed-in user's profile row so a server-side sender can target it.
var pushListenersAttached = false;
function initPushNotifications(){
  if(!IS_NATIVE_APP) return;
  if(!window.Capacitor || !window.Capacitor.Plugins || !window.Capacitor.Plugins.PushNotifications) return;
  if(appState.notificationsEnabled === false) return; // user has explicitly turned this off in their profile
  var Push = window.Capacitor.Plugins.PushNotifications;

  if(!pushListenersAttached){
    pushListenersAttached = true;
    Push.addListener('registration', function(tokenData){
      var token = tokenData && tokenData.value;
      if(!currentUser || !currentUser.id || !token) return;
      sb.from('profiles').update({ push_token: token }).eq('user_id', currentUser.id).then(function(result){
        if(result.error) console.error('Failed to save push token:', result.error);
      });
    });
    Push.addListener('registrationError', function(err){
      console.error('Push registration error:', err);
    });
    Push.addListener('pushNotificationReceived', function(notification){
      // App was already open in the foreground -- surface it gently instead of relying on the system tray.
      if(notification && notification.title){
        showToast(notification.title + (notification.body ? ': ' + notification.body : ''));
      }
    });
    Push.addListener('pushNotificationActionPerformed', function(){
      // User tapped a notification from the tray. No deep-link routing yet -- land safely on Home.
      showOnly('panel-bubbles');
      setActiveNav('navHome');
    });
  }

  Push.requestPermissions().then(function(result){
    if(result && result.receive === 'granted') Push.register();
  }).catch(function(err){ console.error('Push permission request failed:', err); });
}
```

```
function onAuthSuccess(user){
  currentUser = user;
  Promise.all([loadUserDataFromSupabase(), loadExpertsFromSupabase()]).then(function(){

// Reports this device's timezone (so scheduled reminders fire at the right LOCAL time for this
// person, not a fixed server timezone) and app version (so the update-nudge job knows who's
// behind) back onto their profile. Runs quietly on every sign-in.
function syncDeviceInfo(){
  if(!currentUser || !currentUser.id) return;
  var updates = {};
  try{
    var tz = Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions().timeZone;
    if(tz) updates.timezone = tz;
  } catch(e){ /* very old WebView -- leave the existing/default timezone alone */ }

  function applyUpdate(){
    if(Object.keys(updates).length === 0) return;
    sb.from('profiles').update(updates).eq('user_id', currentUser.id).then(function(result){
      if(result.error) console.error('Failed to sync device info:', result.error);
    });
  }

  if(IS_NATIVE_APP && window.Capacitor && window.Capacitor.Plugins && window.Capacitor.Plugins.App){
    window.Capacitor.Plugins.App.getInfo().then(function(info){
      if(info){
        if(info.version) updates.app_version_name = info.version;
        if(info.build) updates.app_version_code = parseInt(info.build, 10) || null;
      }
      applyUpdate();
    }).catch(function(){ applyUpdate(); });
  } else {
    applyUpdate();
  }
}

// Registers this device for push notifications (native app only) and keeps the resulting
// FCM token synced onto the signed-in user's profile row so a server-side sender can target it.
var pushListenersAttached = false;
// While non-null, the next relevant action the user takes (booking, completing a task, logging a
// mood, writing a journal entry) gets attributed back to the notification they just tapped --
// this is what "opened -> and then what did they do" tracking in the admin dashboard is based on.
var pendingNotificationInteraction = null;

function markNotificationOpened(notificationId){
  if(!notificationId || !currentUser || !currentUser.id) return;
  pendingNotificationInteraction = { notificationId: notificationId, openedAt: Date.now() };
  sb.from('notification_recipients')
    .update({ opened_at: new Date().toISOString() })
    .eq('notification_id', notificationId)
    .eq('user_id', currentUser.id)
    .then(function(result){ if(result.error) console.error('Failed to mark notification opened:', result.error); });
}

// Call this from wherever a relevant action actually completes (booking made, task completed,
// mood logged, journal written). Only attributes if the user opened a notification recently
// (within the last 24h) -- an action a week after tapping isn't really "because of" that nudge.
function trackNotificationAction(actionType){
  if(!pendingNotificationInteraction || !currentUser || !currentUser.id) return;
  var ageMs = Date.now() - pendingNotificationInteraction.openedAt;
  if(ageMs > 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000){ pendingNotificationInteraction = null; return; }
  var notificationId = pendingNotificationInteraction.notificationId;
  pendingNotificationInteraction = null; // one attribution per tap, first matching action wins
  sb.from('notification_recipients')
    .update({ action_taken: actionType, action_taken_at: new Date().toISOString() })
    .eq('notification_id', notificationId)
    .eq('user_id', currentUser.id)
    .then(function(result){ if(result.error) console.error('Failed to record notification action:', result.error); });
}

function initPushNotifications(){
  if(!IS_NATIVE_APP) return;
  if(!window.Capacitor || !window.Capacitor.Plugins || !window.Capacitor.Plugins.PushNotifications) return;
  if(appState.notificationsEnabled === false) return; // user has explicitly turned this off in their profile
  var Push = window.Capacitor.Plugins.PushNotifications;

  if(!pushListenersAttached){
    pushListenersAttached = true;
    Push.addListener('registration', function(tokenData){
      var token = tokenData && tokenData.value;
      if(!currentUser || !currentUser.id || !token) return;
      sb.from('profiles').update({ push_token: token }).eq('user_id', currentUser.id).then(function(result){
        if(result.error) console.error('Failed to save push token:', result.error);
      });
    });
    Push.addListener('registrationError', function(err){
      console.error('Push registration error:', err);
    });
    Push.addListener('pushNotificationReceived', function(notification){
      // App was already open in the foreground -- surface it gently instead of relying on the system tray.
      if(notification && notification.title){
        showToast(notification.title + (notification.body ? ': ' + notification.body : ''));
      }
      var notifId = notification && notification.data && notification.data.notification_id;
      if(notifId) markNotificationOpened(notifId);
    });
    Push.addListener('pushNotificationActionPerformed', function(action){
      // User tapped a notification from the tray. No deep-link routing yet -- land safely on Home.
      showOnly('panel-bubbles');
      setActiveNav('navHome');
      var notifId = action && action.notification && action.notification.data && action.notification.data.notification_id;
      if(notifId) markNotificationOpened(notifId);
    });
  }

  Push.requestPermissions().then(function(result){
    if(result && result.receive === 'granted') Push.register();
  }).catch(function(err){ console.error('Push permission request failed:', err); });
}
```

```
function renderAdminErrorLogs(){
  var wrap = document.getElementById('adminErrorLogsList');
  wrap.innerHTML = '<p style="font-size:11px;color:#B0AA98;">Loading...</p>';
  sb.from('error_logs').select('*').order('created_at', {ascending:false}).limit(20).then(function(result){
    if(result.error){ wrap.innerHTML = '<p style="font-size:11px;color:#B0AA98;">Could not load error logs.</p>'; return; }
    var logs = result.data || [];
    if(logs.length === 0){
      wrap.innerHTML = '<p style="font-size:11px;color:#3B8F63;">No errors logged — clean so far.</p>';
      return;
    }
    wrap.innerHTML = logs.map(function(l){
      var dateLabel = new Date(l.created_at).toLocaleString('en-US', { month:'short', day:'numeric', hour:'numeric', minute:'2-digit' });
      return '<div style="background:#FBE8E8;border-radius:10px;padding:10px 12px;margin-bottom:6px;">'+
```

```
var NOTIF_TYPE_LABELS = {
  book_session: 'Book a session', task_reminder: 'Task reminder', mood_check: 'Mood check',
  journal_reminder: 'Journal reminder', admin_manual: 'Manual (admin)', self_test: 'Self test', app_update: 'App update'
};

document.getElementById('notifComposeTarget').onchange = function(){
  document.getElementById('notifComposeTargetEmail').style.display = this.value === 'user' ? 'block' : 'none';
};

document.getElementById('notifComposeSendBtn').onclick = function(){
  var title = document.getElementById('notifComposeTitle').value.trim();
  var body = document.getElementById('notifComposeBody').value.trim();
  var target = document.getElementById('notifComposeTarget').value;
  var statusEl = document.getElementById('notifComposeStatus');
  if(!title || !body){ statusEl.textContent = 'Title and message are both required.'; statusEl.style.color = '#C77B7B'; return; }

  function doSend(payload){
    statusEl.textContent = 'Sending...'; statusEl.style.color = '#5C6B94';
    sb.functions.invoke('send-push-notification', { body: payload }).then(function(result){
      if(result.error){ statusEl.textContent = 'Failed: ' + result.error.message; statusEl.style.color = '#C77B7B'; return; }
      var data = result.data;
      if(data && typeof data.sent === 'number'){
        statusEl.textContent = 'Sent to ' + data.sent + ' of ' + (data.sent + (data.failed||0)) + ' recipient(s).';
      } else {
        statusEl.textContent = (data && data.message) || 'Sent.';
      }
      statusEl.style.color = '#3B8F63';
      document.getElementById('notifComposeTitle').value = '';
      document.getElementById('notifComposeBody').value = '';
      renderAdminNotifHistory();
    }).catch(function(err){ statusEl.textContent = 'Error: ' + err; statusEl.style.color = '#C77B7B'; });
  }

  if(target === 'all'){
    doSend({ title: title, body: body, all: true, notificationType: 'admin_manual', targetDescription: 'All users (manual send)' });
  } else {
    var email = document.getElementById('notifComposeTargetEmail').value.trim();
    if(!email){ statusEl.textContent = 'Enter their email.'; statusEl.style.color = '#C77B7B'; return; }
    statusEl.textContent = 'Looking up that person...'; statusEl.style.color = '#5C6B94';
    sb.from('profiles').select('user_id').eq('email', email).single().then(function(result){
      if(result.error || !result.data){ statusEl.textContent = 'No user found with that email.'; statusEl.style.color = '#C77B7B'; return; }
      doSend({ title: title, body: body, userId: result.data.user_id, notificationType: 'admin_manual', targetDescription: 'Manual send to ' + email });
    });
  }
};

function renderAdminNotifHistory(){
  var listEl = document.getElementById('adminNotifHistoryList');
  listEl.innerHTML = '<p style="text-align:center;color:#9AABCE;font-size:12.5px;">Loading...</p>';
  Promise.all([
    sb.from('notification_log').select('*').order('sent_at', {ascending:false}).limit(30),
    sb.from('notification_recipients').select('notification_id, opened_at, action_taken')
  ]).then(function(results){
    var logRes = results[0], recipRes = results[1];
    if(logRes.error){ listEl.innerHTML = '<p style="color:#C77B7B;font-size:12px;">Could not load: '+logRes.error.message+'</p>'; return; }
    var logs = logRes.data || [];
    var recipients = recipRes.data || [];
    var statsByNotif = {};
    recipients.forEach(function(r){
      if(!statsByNotif[r.notification_id]) statsByNotif[r.notification_id] = { sent:0, opened:0, acted:0 };
      statsByNotif[r.notification_id].sent++;
      if(r.opened_at) statsByNotif[r.notification_id].opened++;
      if(r.action_taken) statsByNotif[r.notification_id].acted++;
    });
    if(logs.length === 0){ listEl.innerHTML = '<p style="text-align:center;color:#9AABCE;font-size:12.5px;">No notifications sent yet.</p>'; return; }
    listEl.innerHTML = logs.map(function(n){
      var stats = statsByNotif[n.id] || {sent:0,opened:0,acted:0};
      var typeLabel = NOTIF_TYPE_LABELS[n.notification_type] || n.notification_type;
      var when = new Date(n.sent_at).toLocaleString('en-IN', { dateStyle:'medium', timeStyle:'short' });
      return '<div class="notif-history-row" data-id="'+n.id+'" style="background:#FFFFFF;border:1px solid #EEE0C4;border-radius:14px;padding:14px;margin-bottom:10px;cursor:pointer;">'+
        '<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;gap:8px;margin-bottom:4px;">'+
        '<p style="font-size:13px;font-weight:800;color:#2A2013;margin:0;">'+n.title+'</p>'+
        '<span style="flex-shrink:0;font-size:9.5px;font-weight:700;color:#6690D6;background:#E9F0FB;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:8px;white-space:nowrap;">'+typeLabel+'</span>'+
        '</div>'+
        '<p style="font-size:11.5px;color:#5C6B94;margin:0 0 8px;">'+n.body+'</p>'+
        '<p style="font-size:10.5px;color:#9AABCE;margin:0;">'+when+' · Sent '+stats.sent+' · Opened '+stats.opened+' · Acted on '+stats.acted+'</p>'+
        '</div>';
    }).join('');
    listEl.querySelectorAll('.notif-history-row').forEach(function(row){
      row.onclick = function(){ viewNotificationRecipients(row.dataset.id, logs.find(function(n){ return n.id === row.dataset.id; })); };
    });
  });
}

function viewNotificationRecipients(notificationId, notifRow){
  document.getElementById('notifDetailTitle').textContent = notifRow ? notifRow.title : 'Notification';
  document.getElementById('notifDetailSubtitle').textContent = notifRow ? notifRow.body : '';
  var listEl = document.getElementById('notifDetailRecipientsList');
  listEl.innerHTML = '<p style="text-align:center;color:#9AABCE;font-size:12px;">Loading...</p>';
  document.getElementById('notifDetailModalBackdrop').style.display = 'block';
  document.getElementById('notifDetailModal').style.display = 'block';

  Promise.all([
    sb.from('notification_recipients').select('*').eq('notification_id', notificationId),
    sb.from('profiles').select('user_id,name,email')
  ]).then(function(results){
    var recipRes = results[0], profRes = results[1];
    if(recipRes.error){ listEl.innerHTML = '<p style="color:#C77B7B;font-size:12px;">Could not load recipients.</p>'; return; }
    var profileByUserId = {};
    (profRes.data||[]).forEach(function(p){ profileByUserId[p.user_id] = p; });
    var recipients = recipRes.data || [];
    if(recipients.length === 0){ listEl.innerHTML = '<p style="text-align:center;color:#9AABCE;font-size:12px;">No recipients recorded.</p>'; return; }
    listEl.innerHTML = recipients.map(function(r){
      var prof = profileByUserId[r.user_id] || {};
      var statusLabel, statusColor;
      if(r.action_taken){ statusLabel = 'Acted: ' + r.action_taken.replace(/_/g,' '); statusColor = '#3B8F63'; }
      else if(r.opened_at){ statusLabel = 'Opened, no follow-through yet'; statusColor = '#6690D6'; }
      else if(r.fcm_ok){ statusLabel = 'Delivered, not opened'; statusColor = '#9AABCE'; }
      else { statusLabel = 'Failed to deliver'; statusColor = '#C77B7B'; }
      return '<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:9px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #F5F0E4;">'+
        '<div><p style="font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;color:#2A2013;margin:0;">'+(prof.name||prof.email||'Unknown')+'</p>'+
        (prof.email ? '<p style="font-size:10.5px;color:#9AABCE;margin:0;">'+prof.email+'</p>' : '')+'</div>'+
        '<span style="font-size:10.5px;font-weight:700;color:'+statusColor+';white-space:nowrap;margin-left:8px;">'+statusLabel+'</span>'+
        '</div>';
    }).join('');
  });
}
document.getElementById('notifDetailCloseBtn').onclick = function(){
  document.getElementById('notifDetailModalBackdrop').style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('notifDetailModal').style.display = 'none';
};
document.getElementById('notifDetailModalBackdrop').onclick = function(){
  document.getElementById('notifDetailModalBackdrop').style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('notifDetailModal').style.display = 'none';
};

function openAdminDashboard(){
```

```
function logScreenView(panelId){

}
function logAnalyticsEvent(eventName, params){

  window.Capacitor.Plugins.FirebaseAnalytics.logEvent({ name: eventName, params: params || {} }).catch(function(){});
}
```

NEW (exact):
```
function startAmbientSound(){
  ambientAudioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
  var ctx = ambientAudioCtx;

  ambientMasterGain = ctx.createGain();
  ambientMasterGain.gain.value = 0;
  ambientMasterGain.connect(ctx.destination);
  ambientMasterGain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.12, ctx.currentTime + 3.5); // slower, gentler fade in

  var lowpass = ctx.createBiquadFilter();
  lowpass.type = 'lowpass';
  lowpass.frequency.value = 650; // softer/rounder than before
  lowpass.connect(ambientMasterGain);

  // A soft, open drone — low C, G a fifth above, E an octave+third above.
  // Two slightly-detuned oscillators per note for a warm, chorused feel.
  var notes = [130.81, 196.00, 329.63];
  notes.forEach(function(freq){
    [-3, 3].forEach(function(detune){ // slightly less detune = smoother, less "wobbly"
      var osc = ctx.createOscillator();
      osc.type = 'sine';
      osc.frequency.value = freq;
      osc.detune.value = detune;
      var noteGain = ctx.createGain();
      noteGain.gain.value = 0.42;
      osc.connect(noteGain);
      noteGain.connect(lowpass);
      osc.start();
      ambientNodes.push(osc);
    });
  });

  // Slow LFO on the master volume so it breathes instead of droning flatly.
  var lfo = ctx.createOscillator();
  lfo.frequency.value = 0.045; // even slower, gentler swell
  var lfoGain = ctx.createGain();
  lfoGain.gain.value = 0.04;
  lfo.connect(lfoGain);
  lfoGain.connect(ambientMasterGain.gain);
  lfo.start();
  ambientNodes.push(lfo);

  // Soft filtered noise layer for a gentle room-tone texture underneath the drone -- toned down
  // further so it reads as "warm air" rather than hiss.
  var bufferSize = 2 * ctx.sampleRate;
  var noiseBuffer = ctx.createBuffer(1, bufferSize, ctx.sampleRate);
  var output = noiseBuffer.getChannelData(0);
  for(var i=0; i<bufferSize; i++){ output[i] = (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * 0.08; }
  var noise = ctx.createBufferSource();
  noise.buffer = noiseBuffer;
  noise.loop = true;
  var noiseFilter = ctx.createBiquadFilter();
  noiseFilter.type = 'lowpass';
  noiseFilter.frequency.value = 280;
  var noiseGain = ctx.createGain();
  noiseGain.gain.value = 0.22;
  noise.connect(noiseFilter);
  noiseFilter.connect(noiseGain);
  noiseGain.connect(ambientMasterGain);
  noise.start();
  ambientNodes.push(noise);

  // Gentle chime shimmer -- sparse, soft high notes from a pentatonic scale (always sounds
  // pleasant together, never dissonant), each with a slow attack/release like a wind chime.
  // This is what turns a flat drone into something that feels alive and lightly magical.
  var chimeScale = [523.25, 587.33, 659.25, 783.99, 880.00]; // C5 pentatonic
  var chimeStopped = false;
  ambientNodes.push({ stop: function(){ chimeStopped = true; } }); // fake node so stopAmbientSound's loop doesn't error
  function scheduleChime(){
    if(chimeStopped || !ambientAudioCtx) return;
    var freq = chimeScale[Math.floor(Math.random() * chimeScale.length)];
    var chimeOsc = ctx.createOscillator();
    chimeOsc.type = 'sine';
    chimeOsc.frequency.value = freq;
    var chimeGain = ctx.createGain();
    chimeGain.gain.value = 0;
    chimeOsc.connect(chimeGain);
    chimeGain.connect(ambientMasterGain);
    var now = ctx.currentTime;
    chimeGain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.05, now + 1.5); // slow, soft attack
    chimeGain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0, now + 5.5); // long, gentle release
    chimeOsc.start(now);
    chimeOsc.stop(now + 6);
    var nextIn = 9000 + Math.random() * 9000; // next chime somewhere between 9-18s later
    setTimeout(scheduleChime, nextIn);
  }
  setTimeout(scheduleChime, 4000); // let the drone settle in first
}
```

```
  var path = currentUser.id + '/' + uidGen() + '.' + ext;
  sb.storage.from('task-images').upload(path, file, { contentType: file.type }).then(function(result){
```

NEW (exact):
```
// Long-press a task row to arm it for deletion: the drag handle swaps to a trash icon and the
// row highlights, so a stray tap can't delete anything -- only tapping the trash icon while
// armed actually does. Tapping anywhere else (another row, blank space) disarms it again.
var armedTaskItemEl = null;
function disarmTaskDelete(){
  if(armedTaskItemEl){
    armedTaskItemEl.style.background = '';
    armedTaskItemEl.style.borderRadius = '';
    var wrap = armedTaskItemEl.querySelector('.drag-handle-wrap');
    if(wrap) wrap.innerHTML = '<span class="drag-handle" style="color:#D9CFB8;font-size:15px;cursor:grab;touch-action:none;">⠿</span>';
    armedTaskItemEl = null;
  }
}
document.addEventListener('click', function(e){
  if(armedTaskItemEl && !armedTaskItemEl.contains(e.target)) disarmTaskDelete();
});

function deleteTaskDirectly(task, dateKey, rerenderFn){
  var list = getTasks(dateKey);
  var idx = list.findIndex(function(t){ return t.id === task.id; });
  if(idx !== -1) list.splice(idx, 1);
  saveState();
  rerenderFn();
  showToast('Task deleted');
  if(String(task.id).indexOf('temp_') !== 0){
    sb.from('tasks').delete().eq('id', task.id).then(function(r){ if(r.error) console.error(r.error); });
  }
}

function armTaskForDelete(item, row, handleWrap, task, dateKey, rerenderFn){
  disarmTaskDelete(); // only one row armed at a time
  armedTaskItemEl = item;
  item.style.background = '#FBE8E8';
  item.style.borderRadius = '10px';
  handleWrap.innerHTML = '';
  var trashBtn = document.createElement('button');
  trashBtn.innerHTML = '<svg width="15" height="15" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><polyline points="3 6 5 6 21 6"/><path d="M19 6l-1 14a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H8a2 2 0 0 1-2-2L5 6"/><path d="M10 11v6M14 11v6"/><path d="M9 6V4a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h2a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v2"/></svg>';
  trashBtn.style.cssText = 'background:none;border:none;color:#C77B7B;cursor:pointer;padding:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;';
  trashBtn.onclick = function(e){
    e.stopPropagation();
    armedTaskItemEl = null;
    deleteTaskDirectly(task, dateKey, rerenderFn);
  };
  handleWrap.appendChild(trashBtn);
}

function attachLongPressDelete(item, row, handleWrap, task, dateKey, rerenderFn){
  var pressTimer = null;
  var startX = 0, startY = 0;
  var longPressFired = false;

  row.addEventListener('touchstart', function(e){
    if(armedTaskItemEl && armedTaskItemEl !== item) disarmTaskDelete();
    var t = e.touches[0];
    startX = t.clientX; startY = t.clientY;
    longPressFired = false;
    pressTimer = setTimeout(function(){
      longPressFired = true;
      armTaskForDelete(item, row, handleWrap, task, dateKey, rerenderFn);
    }, 550);
  }, {passive:true});

  row.addEventListener('touchmove', function(e){
    var t = e.touches[0];
    if(Math.abs(t.clientX - startX) > 10 || Math.abs(t.clientY - startY) > 10) clearTimeout(pressTimer);
  }, {passive:true});

  row.addEventListener('touchend', function(e){
    clearTimeout(pressTimer);
    if(longPressFired) e.preventDefault(); // swallow the click that would otherwise fire on release (e.g. toggling the checkbox)
  });
  row.addEventListener('touchcancel', function(){ clearTimeout(pressTimer); });
}
```

```
};
```

```
  if(c) document.getElementById('notifComposeTitle').value = c.name + ' here ' + c.emoji;
};

document.getElementById('notifComposeTarget').onchange = function(){
  document.getElementById('notifComposeTargetEmail').style.display = this.value === 'user' ? 'block' : 'none';
};
```

```
    Push.addListener('pushNotificationReceived', function(notification){
      // App was already open in the foreground. Previously this only showed a toast, which
      // meant foreground notifications felt like they "didn't arrive" compared to background
      // ones landing in the system tray -- now it does both, for consistency either way.
      if(notification && notification.title){
        showToast(notification.title + (notification.body ? ': ' + notification.body : ''));
      }
      if(window.Capacitor.Plugins.LocalNotifications){
        window.Capacitor.Plugins.LocalNotifications.schedule({
          notifications: [{
            id: Math.floor(Math.random() * 2147483647),
            title: notification.title || 'HOBS Companion',
            body: notification.body || '',
            extra: notification.data || {}
          }]
        }).catch(function(err){ console.error('Local notification post failed:', err); });
      }
      // Note: receiving it (even while foregrounded) isn't the same as the person actually
      // engaging with it -- "opened" is tracked only on an actual tap, in the action handlers below.
    });
```

```
    Push.addListener('pushNotificationActionPerformed', function(action){
      var notifData = action && action.notification && action.notification.data;
      handleNotificationTap(notifData);
    });

    if(window.Capacitor.Plugins.LocalNotifications){
      window.Capacitor.Plugins.LocalNotifications.addListener('localNotificationActionPerformed', function(action){

      });
    }
  }

    if(result && result.receive === 'granted') Push.register();
  }).catch(function(err){ console.error('Push permission request failed:', err); });

  if(window.Capacitor.Plugins.LocalNotifications){
    window.Capacitor.Plugins.LocalNotifications.requestPermissions().catch(function(err){
      console.error('Local notification permission request failed:', err);
    });
  }
}

// Shared by both a tapped system-tray push (background) and a tapped local notification
// (foreground receipt, posted by pushNotificationReceived above) -- same outcome either way.
function handleNotificationTap(notifData){
  if(notifData && notifData.type === 'app_update' && notifData.url){
    // Open the APK link directly so the browser/download manager takes over -- not an in-app screen.
    window.open(notifData.url, '_system');
  } else {
    // No deep-link routing yet for other types -- land safely on Home.
    showOnly('panel-bubbles');
    setActiveNav('navHome');
  }
  if(notifData && notifData.notification_id) markNotificationOpened(notifData.notification_id);
}
```

```
function openMyNotifInbox(){
  var listEl = document.getElementById('myNotifInboxList');

    .order('sent_at', {ascending: false})

        return;
      }
      var rows = result.data || [];
      if(rows.length === 0){
        listEl.innerHTML = '<p style="text-align:center;color:#9AABCE;font-size:12.5px;">Nothing here yet — this is where reminders and updates from HOBS will show up.</p>';
        return;
      }
      listEl.innerHTML = rows.map(function(r){
        var log = r.notification_log || {};
        var when = new Date(r.sent_at).toLocaleString('en-IN', { dateStyle:'medium', timeStyle:'short' });
        var unreadDot = !r.opened_at ? '<span style="display:inline-block;width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:#FDB913;margin-right:6px;"></span>' : '';
        return '<div class="my-notif-row" data-notif-id="'+r.notification_id+'" style="padding:11px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #F5F0E4;cursor:pointer;">'+
          '<p style="font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:#2A2013;margin:0 0 3px;">'+unreadDot+(log.title||'HOBS Companion')+'</p>'+
          '<p style="font-size:11.5px;color:#5C6B94;margin:0 0 4px;">'+(log.body||'')+'</p>'+
          '<p style="font-size:10px;color:#9AABCE;margin:0;">'+when+'</p>'+
          '</div>';
      }).join('');
      listEl.querySelectorAll('.my-notif-row').forEach(function(row){
        row.onclick = function(){
          var notifData = { notification_id: row.dataset.notifId };
          markNotificationOpened(row.dataset.notifId);
          row.querySelector('span')?.remove(); // clear the unread dot visually right away
        };
      });
      // Unread dot on the bell itself reflects whether anything in this batch is still unopened.
      var anyUnread = rows.some(function(r){ return !r.opened_at; });
      document.getElementById('notifBellDot').style.display = anyUnread ? 'block' : 'none';
    });
}

// Quiet check on sign-in so the bell shows its unread dot without the user having to open the inbox first.
function checkUnreadNotifications(){
  if(!currentUser || !currentUser.id) return;
  sb.from('notification_recipients')
    .select('id', { count: 'exact', head: true })
    .eq('user_id', currentUser.id)
    .is('opened_at', null)
    .then(function(result){
      if(!result.error && result.count > 0){
        document.getElementById('notifBellDot').style.display = 'block';
      }
    });
}
```

```
function renderAdminAllUsers(){

  ]).then(function(results){

      bookingCountByUser[b.user_id].total++;
      if(b.status === 'active') bookingCountByUser[b.user_id].active++;
    });
    adminAllUsersCache = { users: profilesRes.data || [], bookingCounts: bookingCountByUser };
    renderAdminAllUsersFiltered('');
  });
}
function renderAdminAllUsersFiltered(query){
  var listEl = document.getElementById('adminAllUsersList');
  if(!adminAllUsersCache) return;
  var q = (query || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  var users = adminAllUsersCache.users.filter(function(u){
    if(!q) return true;
    return (u.name||'').toLowerCase().indexOf(q) !== -1 || (u.email||'').toLowerCase().indexOf(q) !== -1;
  });
  if(users.length === 0){
    listEl.innerHTML = '<p style="text-align:center;color:#9AABCE;font-size:12.5px;">No users match that search.</p>';
    return;
  }
  listEl.innerHTML = '<p style="font-size:10.5px;color:#9AABCE;margin:0 0 8px;">'+users.length+' user'+(users.length===1?'':'s')+'</p>' + users.map(function(u){

    var badges = '';
    if(u.is_admin) badges += '<span style="font-size:9px;font-weight:700;color:#7B4F00;background:#FEF3D8;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:6px;margin-left:4px;">Admin</span>';
    if(u.is_therapist) badges += '<span style="font-size:9px;font-weight:700;color:#3B8F63;background:#EAF4EE;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:6px;margin-left:4px;">Therapist</span>';
    if(!u.onboarding_complete) badges += '<span style="font-size:9px;font-weight:700;color:#9AABCE;background:#F5F0E4;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:6px;margin-left:4px;">Onboarding incomplete</span>';
    var joined = u.created_at ? new Date(u.created_at).toLocaleDateString('en-IN', {day:'numeric', month:'short', year:'numeric'}) : 'unknown';
    var bookingText = counts.total === 0 ? 'No bookings yet' : (counts.active + ' active, ' + counts.total + ' total booking' + (counts.total===1?'':'s'));
    return '<div style="background:#FFFFFF;border:1px solid #EEE0C4;border-radius:12px;padding:11px 13px;margin-bottom:7px;">'+
      '<p style="font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;color:#2A2013;margin:0 0 2px;">'+(u.name||'(no name set)')+badges+'</p>'+
      '<p style="font-size:11px;color:#5C6B94;margin:0 0 2px;">'+(u.email||'')+'</p>'+
      '<p style="font-size:10px;color:#9AABCE;margin:0;">Joined '+joined+' · '+bookingText+'</p>'+
      '</div>';
  }).join('');
}

};
```

```
        '<p style="font-size:10px;color:#9AABCE;margin:0;">'+sessionText+'</p>'+
        '</div>';
    }).join('');
  });
}
```

```
function renderTherapistClientsList(){
  var listEl = document.getElementById('therapistClientsList');
  listEl.innerHTML = '<p style="text-align:center;color:#9AABCE;font-size:12.5px;">Loading...</p>';
  Promise.all([
    sb.from('expert_bookings').select('user_id,status,session_date,created_at').eq('expert_name', appState.therapistExpertName).in('status', ['active','change_requested']),
    sb.from('profiles').select('user_id,name,email,therapist_expert_name')
  ]).then(function(results){
    var bookingsRes = results[0], profilesRes = results[1];
    if(bookingsRes.error){
      listEl.innerHTML = '<p style="color:#C77B7B;font-size:12px;">Could not load clients: '+bookingsRes.error.message+'</p>';
      return;
    }
    var profileByUserId = {};
    (profilesRes.data || []).forEach(function(p){ profileByUserId[p.user_id] = p; });

    // Exclude self-bookings -- i.e. bookings made by whoever actually OWNS this therapist identity
    // testing/booking themselves, not just "whoever happens to be logged in right now" (that
    // distinction matters: an admin viewing someone else's client list, for instance).
    var selfUserIds = (profilesRes.data || [])
      .filter(function(p){ return p.therapist_expert_name === appState.therapistExpertName; })
      .map(function(p){ return p.user_id; });

    var byClient = {};
    (bookingsRes.data || []).forEach(function(b){
      if(selfUserIds.indexOf(b.user_id) !== -1) return;
      if(!byClient[b.user_id]) byClient[b.user_id] = { count: 0, latestSessionDate: null };
      byClient[b.user_id].count++;
      if(b.session_date && (!byClient[b.user_id].latestSessionDate || b.session_date > byClient[b.user_id].latestSessionDate)){
        byClient[b.user_id].latestSessionDate = b.session_date;
      }
    });

    var clientIds = Object.keys(byClient);
    if(clientIds.length === 0){
      listEl.innerHTML = '<p style="text-align:center;color:#9AABCE;font-size:12.5px;">No clients connected yet.</p>';
      return;
    }
    listEl.innerHTML = clientIds.map(function(uid){
      var profile = profileByUserId[uid] || {};
      var info = byClient[uid];
      var sessionText = info.latestSessionDate
        ? 'Next/latest session: ' + new Date(info.latestSessionDate).toLocaleDateString('en-IN', {day:'numeric', month:'short'})
        : (info.count + ' booking' + (info.count===1?'':'s') + ', no date set yet');
      return '<div style="background:#FFFFFF;border:1px solid #EEE0C4;border-radius:12px;padding:11px 13px;margin-bottom:7px;">'+
        '<p style="font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;color:#2A2013;margin:0 0 2px;">'+(profile.name||'Unknown client')+'</p>'+
        '<p style="font-size:11px;color:#5C6B94;margin:0 0 2px;">'+(profile.email||'')+'</p>'+
        '<p style="font-size:10px;color:#9AABCE;margin:0;">'+sessionText+'</p>'+
```

```
};

var adminAllUsersCache = null; // so the search filter doesn't need to re-fetch on every keystroke
function renderAdminAllUsers(){
  var listEl = document.getElementById('adminAllUsersList');
  listEl.innerHTML = '<p style="text-align:center;color:#9AABCE;font-size:12.5px;">Loading...</p>';
  Promise.all([
    sb.from('profiles').select('user_id,name,email,is_admin,is_therapist,created_at,onboarding_complete').order('created_at', {ascending:false}),
    sb.from('expert_bookings').select('user_id,status')
  ]).then(function(results){
    var profilesRes = results[0], bookingsRes = results[1];
    if(profilesRes.error){
      listEl.innerHTML = '<p style="color:#C77B7B;font-size:12px;">Could not load users: '+profilesRes.error.message+'</p>';
      return;
    }
    var bookingCountByUser = {};
    (bookingsRes.data || []).forEach(function(b){
      if(!bookingCountByUser[b.user_id]) bookingCountByUser[b.user_id] = { total:0, active:0 };
      bookingCountByUser[b.user_id].total++;
      if(b.status === 'active') bookingCountByUser[b.user_id].active++;
    });
    adminAllUsersCache = { users: profilesRes.data || [], bookingCounts: bookingCountByUser };
    renderAdminAllUsersFiltered('');
  });
}
function renderAdminAllUsersFiltered(query){
  var listEl = document.getElementById('adminAllUsersList');
  if(!adminAllUsersCache) return;
  var q = (query || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  var users = adminAllUsersCache.users.filter(function(u){
    if(!q) return true;
    return (u.name||'').toLowerCase().indexOf(q) !== -1 || (u.email||'').toLowerCase().indexOf(q) !== -1;
  });
  if(users.length === 0){
    listEl.innerHTML = '<p style="text-align:center;color:#9AABCE;font-size:12.5px;">No users match that search.</p>';
    return;
  }
  listEl.innerHTML = '<p style="font-size:10.5px;color:#9AABCE;margin:0 0 8px;">'+users.length+' user'+(users.length===1?'':'s')+'</p>' + users.map(function(u){
    var counts = adminAllUsersCache.bookingCounts[u.user_id] || { total:0, active:0 };
    var badges = '';
    if(u.is_admin) badges += '<span style="font-size:9px;font-weight:700;color:#7B4F00;background:#FEF3D8;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:6px;margin-left:4px;">Admin</span>';
    if(u.is_therapist) badges += '<span style="font-size:9px;font-weight:700;color:#3B8F63;background:#EAF4EE;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:6px;margin-left:4px;">Therapist</span>';
    if(!u.onboarding_complete) badges += '<span style="font-size:9px;font-weight:700;color:#9AABCE;background:#F5F0E4;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:6px;margin-left:4px;">Onboarding incomplete</span>';
    var joined = u.created_at ? new Date(u.created_at).toLocaleDateString('en-IN', {day:'numeric', month:'short', year:'numeric'}) : 'unknown';
    var bookingText = counts.total === 0 ? 'No bookings yet' : (counts.active + ' active, ' + counts.total + ' total booking' + (counts.total===1?'':'s'));
    return '<div style="background:#FFFFFF;border:1px solid #EEE0C4;border-radius:12px;padding:11px 13px;margin-bottom:7px;">'+
      '<p style="font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;color:#2A2013;margin:0 0 2px;">'+(u.name||'(no name set)')+badges+'</p>'+
      '<p style="font-size:11px;color:#5C6B94;margin:0 0 2px;">'+(u.email||'')+'</p>'+
      '<p style="font-size:10px;color:#9AABCE;margin:0;">Joined '+joined+' · '+bookingText+'</p>'+
      '</div>';
  }).join('');
}
document.getElementById('adminUserSearchInput').oninput = function(){
  renderAdminAllUsersFiltered(this.value);
};
```

```
function renderTherapistClientsList(){
  var listEl = document.getElementById('therapistClientsList');
  listEl.innerHTML = '<p style="text-align:center;color:#9AABCE;font-size:12.5px;">Loading...</p>';
  Promise.all([
    sb.from('expert_bookings').select('user_id,status,session_date,created_at').eq('expert_name', appState.therapistExpertName).in('status', ['active','change_requested']),
    sb.from('profiles').select('user_id,name,email,therapist_expert_name')
  ]).then(function(results){
    var bookingsRes = results[0], profilesRes = results[1];
    if(bookingsRes.error){
      listEl.innerHTML = '<p style="color:#C77B7B;font-size:12px;">Could not load clients: '+bookingsRes.error.message+'</p>';
      return;
    }
    var profileByUserId = {};
    (profilesRes.data || []).forEach(function(p){ profileByUserId[p.user_id] = p; });

    // Exclude self-bookings -- i.e. bookings made by whoever actually OWNS this therapist identity
    // testing/booking themselves, not just "whoever happens to be logged in right now" (that
    // distinction matters: an admin viewing someone else's client list, for instance).
    var selfUserIds = (profilesRes.data || [])
      .filter(function(p){ return p.therapist_expert_name === appState.therapistExpertName; })
      .map(function(p){ return p.user_id; });

    var byClient = {};
    (bookingsRes.data || []).forEach(function(b){
      if(selfUserIds.indexOf(b.user_id) !== -1) return;
      if(!byClient[b.user_id]) byClient[b.user_id] = { count: 0, latestSessionDate: null };
      byClient[b.user_id].count++;
      if(b.session_date && (!byClient[b.user_id].latestSessionDate || b.session_date > byClient[b.user_id].latestSessionDate)){
        byClient[b.user_id].latestSessionDate = b.session_date;
      }
    });

    var clientIds = Object.keys(byClient);
    if(clientIds.length === 0){
      listEl.innerHTML = '<p style="text-align:center;color:#9AABCE;font-size:12.5px;">No clients connected yet.</p>';
      return;
    }
    listEl.innerHTML = clientIds.map(function(uid){
      var profile = profileByUserId[uid] || {};
      var info = byClient[uid];
      var sessionText = info.latestSessionDate
        ? 'Next/latest session: ' + new Date(info.latestSessionDate).toLocaleDateString('en-IN', {day:'numeric', month:'short'})
        : (info.count + ' booking' + (info.count===1?'':'s') + ', no date set yet');
      return '<div style="background:#FFFFFF;border:1px solid #EEE0C4;border-radius:12px;padding:11px 13px;margin-bottom:7px;">'+
        '<p style="font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;color:#2A2013;margin:0 0 2px;">'+(profile.name||'Unknown client')+'</p>'+
        '<p style="font-size:11px;color:#5C6B94;margin:0 0 2px;">'+(profile.email||'')+'</p>'+
        '<p style="font-size:10px;color:#9AABCE;margin:0;">'+sessionText+'</p>'+
        '</div>';
    }).join('');
  });
}

function populateHomeworkClientSelect(){
  var sel = document.getElementById('homeworkClientSelect');
```

NEW (exact):
```
// Client taps "Book Session" on a specific professional -- this used to create an active booking
// immediately. Now it submits a request for admin to review and assign (possibly to this person,
// possibly to someone else better suited) -- see renderAdminPendingRequests(). No slot-picking or
// payment happens at this stage; that comes later via pickSessionTimeForBooking, once assigned.
function bookExpert(m){
  showPolicyModal(function(){
    var newBooking = { id: 'temp_' + uidGen(), expert_name: m.name, role_category: m.roleCategory, status: 'pending', cancellation_count: 0, payment_confirmed: false, session_date: null };
    appState.expertBookings.push(newBooking);
    renderTeamList();
    logAnalyticsEvent('booking_requested');
    sb.from('expert_bookings').insert({
      user_id: currentUser.id, expert_name: m.name, role_category: m.roleCategory, status: 'pending', cancellation_count: 0, payment_confirmed: false
    }).select().single().then(function(result){
      if(!result.error) newBooking.id = result.data.id;
    });
    showToast("Request sent — we'll match you with the right person and let you know.");
    var idx = TEAM_MEMBERS.findIndex(function(tm){ return tm.name === m.name; });
    if(idx !== -1) openExpertDetail(idx);
  });
}

// Once admin has assigned a client to a professional (booking status is 'active' but no
// session_date yet, since the request stage doesn't pick a time), this lets the client actually
// schedule their first session -- reuses the same slot-picker + payment flow bookExpert used to
// run immediately; it just happens later now, after a real person has been matched to them.
function pickSessionTimeForBooking(booking, m){
  showSlotPicker(m, function(chosenSlot){
    sb.from('expert_bookings').update({ session_date: chosenSlot.slot_date }).eq('id', booking.id).then(function(){});
    sb.from('expert_availability_slots').update({ is_booked: true, booked_by: currentUser.id }).eq('id', chosenSlot.id).then(function(){});
    booking.session_date = chosenSlot.slot_date;
    trackNotificationAction('booked_session');
    logAnalyticsEvent('booking_made');
    showPaymentModal(
      "Session with " + m.name,
      "Hi! I've paid for my session with " + m.name + " and wanted to let you know.",
      function(){
        showToast("Your time is booked. We'll confirm once payment is verified.");
      }
    );
    var idx = TEAM_MEMBERS.findIndex(function(tm){ return tm.name === m.name; });
    if(idx !== -1) openExpertDetail(idx);
  }, function(){
    showToast("No times available right now — we'll reach out to schedule.");
  });
}
```

### E-019f52e6-76
- when: 2026-07-11T20:42:55.969184Z
- chat: C26-AppContinuation
- tool: str_replace
- file: `/home/claude/work/booking_redesign_working.html`
- result: applied
- Claude's words just before this edit: "Now let's write the admin function itself."

OLD (exact):
```
var adminAllUsersCache = null; // so the search filter doesn't need to re-fetch on every keystroke
```

NEW (exact):
```
// Pending requests: clients who tapped "Book Session" on someone but haven't been formally
// assigned yet. Admin reviews and picks the actual professional (defaults to whoever the client
// requested, but can be changed) -- confirming moves the booking to 'active' and the client then
// gets to pick their session time from the calendar.
function renderAdminPendingRequests(){
  var listEl = document.getElementById('adminPendingRequestsList');
  listEl.innerHTML = '<p style="text-align:center;color:#9AABCE;font-size:12.5px;">Loading...</p>';
  Promise.all([
    sb.from('expert_bookings').select('id,user_id,expert_name,role_category,created_at').eq('status', 'pending').order('created_at', {ascending:true}),
    sb.from('profiles').select('user_id,name,email'),
    sb.from('experts').select('name,role_category')
  ]).then(function(results){
    var bookingsRes = results[0], profilesRes = results[1], expertsRes = results[2];
    if(bookingsRes.error){
      listEl.innerHTML = '<p style="color:#C77B7B;font-size:12px;">Could not load requests: '+bookingsRes.error.message+'</p>';
      return;
    }
    var requests = bookingsRes.data || [];
    if(requests.length === 0){
      listEl.innerHTML = '<p style="text-align:center;color:#9AABCE;font-size:12.5px;">No pending requests right now.</p>';
      return;
    }
    var profileByUserId = {};
    (profilesRes.data || []).forEach(function(p){ profileByUserId[p.user_id] = p; });
    var expertsByCategory = {};
    (expertsRes.data || []).forEach(function(e){
      if(!expertsByCategory[e.role_category]) expertsByCategory[e.role_category] = [];
      expertsByCategory[e.role_category].push(e.name);
    });

    listEl.innerHTML = requests.map(function(r){
      var profile = profileByUserId[r.user_id] || {};
      var when = new Date(r.created_at).toLocaleDateString('en-IN', {day:'numeric', month:'short'});
      var options = (expertsByCategory[r.role_category] || []).map(function(name){
        return '<option value="'+name+'"'+(name === r.expert_name ? ' selected' : '')+'>'+name+'</option>';
      }).join('');
      return '<div style="background:#FFFFFF;border:1px solid #EEE0C4;border-radius:12px;padding:12px;margin-bottom:8px;">'+
        '<p style="font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;color:#2A2013;margin:0 0 2px;">'+(profile.name||'Unknown client')+'</p>'+
        '<p style="font-size:11px;color:#5C6B94;margin:0 0 2px;">'+(profile.email||'')+'</p>'+
        '<p style="font-size:10px;color:#9AABCE;margin:0 0 8px;">Requested '+r.role_category+' · '+when+' · originally asked for '+r.expert_name+'</p>'+
        '<div style="display:flex;gap:6px;">'+
          '<select class="pending-assign-select" data-booking-id="'+r.id+'" data-user-id="'+r.user_id+'" data-category="'+r.role_category+'" style="flex:1;padding:9px;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid #EEE0C4;font-size:11.5px;font-family:inherit;">'+options+'</select>'+
          '<button class="pending-assign-btn" data-booking-id="'+r.id+'" style="font-size:11px;font-weight:700;color:#fff;background:#3B8F63;border:none;border-radius:10px;padding:9px 14px;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap;">Assign</button>'+
        '</div>'+
      '</div>';
    }).join('');

    listEl.querySelectorAll('.pending-assign-btn').forEach(function(btn){
      btn.onclick = function(){
        var bookingId = btn.dataset.bookingId;
        var select = listEl.querySelector('.pending-assign-select[data-booking-id="'+bookingId+'"]');
        assignPendingBooking(bookingId, select.value, select.dataset.userId, select.dataset.category);
      };
    });
  });
}

function assignPendingBooking(bookingId, expertName, clientUserId, category){
  sb.from('expert_bookings').update({ status: 'active', expert_name: expertName }).eq('id', bookingId).then(function(result){
    if(result.error){
      showToast('Could not assign — please try again.');
      return;
    }
    showToast('Assigned to ' + expertName + '.');
    renderAdminPendingRequests();
    // Let the client know so they can come back and pick a session time.
    sb.functions.invoke('send-push-notification', {
      body: {
        title: 'Bob here 🐘',
        body: "You've been matched with " + expertName + " for " + category.toLowerCase() + " support — come pick a time that works for you!",
        userId: clientUserId,
        notificationType: 'admin_manual',
        targetDescription: 'Therapist assignment confirmation'
      }
    }).catch(function(){}); // best-effort -- don't block the assignment on notification delivery
  });
}

var adminAllUsersCache = null; // so the search filter doesn't need to re-fetch on every keystroke
```

NEW (exact):

```
// send-push-notification
//
// Sends a push notification via Firebase Cloud Messaging (HTTP v1 API) to one user, a list of
// users, or everyone with a registered device -- using the profiles.push_token column that the
// HOBS Companion app writes to on sign-in.
//
// Auth: requires a valid Supabase user JWT (default Edge Function verification). Beyond that,
// the caller must be an admin or therapist, UNLESS they are sending only to themselves (used for
// a self-test send from the app). This is intentionally conservative -- broadening who can
// trigger a broadcast is a product decision, not something to default open.
//
// One narrow, deliberate exception: alertAdminsNewRequest -- lets ANY signed-in client trigger a
// notification to admins about their OWN new booking request. This is safe specifically because
// the client cannot control the message content or the recipient list -- both are fixed
// server-side -- so there's no way to abuse this to spam or impersonate.
//
// Request body:
//   { "title": string, "body": string, "data"?: object,
//     "userId"?: string, "userIds"?: string[], "all"?: true,
//     "notificationType"?: string, "targetDescription"?: string }
//   OR: { "alertAdminsNewRequest": true, "category": string }
// Exactly one of userId / userIds / all / alertAdminsNewRequest must be provided.
// Every send is logged to notification_log (+ one notification_recipients row per person),
// which is what powers the admin dashboard's send history.
```

```
    const callerId = callerAuth.user.id;

    const payload = await req.json();

    // Narrow exception: any signed-in client can trigger this specific, fixed-content alert to
    // admins about their own new request. Content and recipients are entirely server-controlled.
    if (payload.alertAdminsNewRequest === true) {
      const adminClient2 = createClient(SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY);
      const { data: callerProfile } = await adminClient2
        .from("profiles").select("name, email").eq("user_id", callerId).single();
      const { data: admins } = await adminClient2
        .from("profiles").select("user_id, push_token, notifications_enabled, notifications_paused_until")
        .eq("is_admin", true).not("push_token", "is", null);

      const now2 = new Date();
      const adminTargets = (admins || []).filter((p: any) => {
        if (p.notifications_enabled === false) return false;
        if (p.notifications_paused_until && new Date(p.notifications_paused_until) > now2) return false;
        return true;
      });

      const callerName = callerProfile?.name || callerProfile?.email || "A client";
      const category = typeof payload.category === "string" ? payload.category : "support";
      const alertTitle = "New request 🔔";
      const alertBody = callerName + " has requested " + category.toLowerCase() + " support — check Pending Requests to assign someone.";

      if (adminTargets.length === 0) {
        return new Response(JSON.stringify({ sent: 0, message: "No admins with notifications enabled" }), {
          status: 200, headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        });
      }

      const accessToken2 = await getFcmAccessToken();
      const { data: logRow2, error: logErr2 } = await adminClient2
        .from("notification_log")
        .insert({
          notification_type: "new_booking_request", title: alertTitle, body: alertBody,
          data: {}, sent_by: callerId, target_type: "segment", target_description: "Admins (new request alert)",
        })
        .select("id").single();
      if (logErr2) throw logErr2;

      let sent2 = 0;
      for (const p of adminTargets) {
        const result = await sendToToken(accessToken2, p.push_token, alertTitle, alertBody, { notification_id: logRow2.id });
        await adminClient2.from("notification_recipients").insert({
          notification_id: logRow2.id, user_id: p.user_id, fcm_ok: result.ok, fcm_status: result.status,
        });
        if (result.ok) sent2++;
      }
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ sent: sent2 }), {
        status: 200, headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      });
    }

    const { title, body, data, userId, userIds, all, notificationType, targetDescription } = payload;
```

```
function renderAdminAllUsersFiltered(query){
```

```
  var users = adminAllUsersCache.users.filter(function(u){
    if(q && (u.name||'').toLowerCase().indexOf(q) === -1 && (u.email||'').toLowerCase().indexOf(q) === -1) return false;
    if(unassignedOnly){
      var connected = adminAllUsersCache.connectedCategories[u.user_id];
      if(connected && Object.keys(connected).length > 0) return false;
    }
    return true;
  });

    listEl.innerHTML = '<p style="text-align:center;color:#9AABCE;font-size:12.5px;">No users match.</p>';

    if(!u.onboarding_complete) badges += '<span style="font-size:9px;font-weight:700;color:#9AABCE;background:#F5F0E4;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:6px;margin-left:4px;">Onboarding incomplete</span>';
    var joined = u.created_at ? new Date(u.created_at).toLocaleDateString('en-IN', {day:'numeric', month:'short', year:'numeric'}) : 'unknown';

// Full profile view for a single user, opened by tapping their row in All Users. Shows their
// connection status in every professional category, with a direct assign control for any
// category they're not yet connected in -- doesn't require them to have submitted a request first.
function showAdminUserProfile(userId){
  document.getElementById('adminUserProfileName').textContent = 'Loading...';
  document.getElementById('adminUserProfileEmail').textContent = '';
  document.getElementById('adminUserProfileMeta').textContent = '';
  document.getElementById('adminUserProfileConnections').innerHTML = '';
  document.getElementById('adminUserProfileModalBackdrop').style.display = 'block';
  document.getElementById('adminUserProfileModal').style.display = 'block';

  Promise.all([
    sb.from('profiles').select('*').eq('user_id', userId).single(),
    sb.from('expert_bookings').select('*').eq('user_id', userId),
    sb.from('experts').select('name,role_category')
  ]).then(function(results){
    var profileRes = results[0], bookingsRes = results[1], expertsRes = results[2];
    if(profileRes.error || !profileRes.data){
      document.getElementById('adminUserProfileName').textContent = 'Could not load this profile';
      return;
    }
    var p = profileRes.data;
    document.getElementById('adminUserProfileName').textContent = p.name || '(no name set)';
    document.getElementById('adminUserProfileEmail').textContent = p.email || '';
    var joined = p.created_at ? new Date(p.created_at).toLocaleDateString('en-IN', {day:'numeric', month:'short', year:'numeric'}) : 'unknown';
    var metaParts = ['Joined ' + joined];
    if(p.phone_number) metaParts.push(p.phone_number);
    if(p.pronouns) metaParts.push(p.pronouns);
    document.getElementById('adminUserProfileMeta').textContent = metaParts.join(' · ');

    var bookingsByCategory = {};
    (bookingsRes.data || []).forEach(function(b){
      if(b.status === 'active' || b.status === 'pending'){
        // If multiple exist (shouldn't normally), prefer active over pending for display.
        if(!bookingsByCategory[b.role_category] || b.status === 'active') bookingsByCategory[b.role_category] = b;
      }
    });
    var expertsByCategory = {};
    (expertsRes.data || []).forEach(function(e){
      if(!expertsByCategory[e.role_category]) expertsByCategory[e.role_category] = [];
      expertsByCategory[e.role_category].push(e.name);
    });

    var connEl = document.getElementById('adminUserProfileConnections');
    connEl.innerHTML = ROLE_CATEGORIES.map(function(cat){
      var b = bookingsByCategory[cat];
      var statusHtml;
      if(b && b.status === 'active'){
        statusHtml = '<p style="font-size:12px;color:#3B8F63;margin:0;">Connected with '+b.expert_name+(b.session_date ? '' : ' — no session time picked yet')+'</p>';
      } else if(b && b.status === 'pending'){
        statusHtml = '<p style="font-size:12px;color:#7B4F00;margin:0;">Pending request (asked for '+b.expert_name+')</p>';
      } else {
        var options = (expertsByCategory[cat] || []).map(function(name){ return '<option value="'+name+'">'+name+'</option>'; }).join('');
        statusHtml = '<div style="display:flex;gap:6px;margin-top:4px;">'+
          '<select class="admin-direct-assign-select" data-category="'+cat+'" style="flex:1;padding:8px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid #EEE0C4;font-size:11px;font-family:inherit;">'+options+'</select>'+
          '<button class="admin-direct-assign-btn" data-category="'+cat+'" style="font-size:10.5px;font-weight:700;color:#fff;background:#3B8F63;border:none;border-radius:8px;padding:8px 12px;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap;">Assign</button>'+
        '</div>';
      }
      return '<div style="margin-bottom:14px;"><p style="font-size:11px;font-weight:700;color:#9AABCE;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.03em;margin:0 0 4px;">'+cat+'</p>'+statusHtml+'</div>';
    }).join('');

    connEl.querySelectorAll('.admin-direct-assign-btn').forEach(function(btn){
      btn.onclick = function(){
        var cat = btn.dataset.category;
        var select = connEl.querySelector('.admin-direct-assign-select[data-category="'+cat+'"]');
        if(!select || !select.value) return;
        directAssignUser(userId, cat, select.value);
      };
    });
  });
}
document.getElementById('adminUserProfileCloseBtn').onclick = function(){
  document.getElementById('adminUserProfileModalBackdrop').style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('adminUserProfileModal').style.display = 'none';
};
document.getElementById('adminUserProfileModalBackdrop').onclick = document.getElementById('adminUserProfileCloseBtn').onclick;

// Admin proactively assigns a professional to a user who never submitted a request at all --
// inserts a fresh active booking rather than updating an existing pending one.
function directAssignUser(userId, category, expertName){
  sb.from('expert_bookings').insert({
    user_id: userId, expert_name: expertName, role_category: category,
    status: 'active', cancellation_count: 0, payment_confirmed: false
  }).then(function(result){
    if(result.error){
      showToast('Could not assign — please try again.');
      return;
    }
    showToast('Assigned to ' + expertName + '.');
    showAdminUserProfile(userId); // refresh the modal to reflect the new connection
    renderAdminAllUsers();
    sb.functions.invoke('send-push-notification', {
      body: {
        title: 'Bob here 🐘',
        body: "You've been matched with " + expertName + " for " + category.toLowerCase() + " support — come pick a time that works for you!",
        userId: userId, notificationType: 'admin_manual', targetDescription: 'Direct therapist assignment'
      }
    }).catch(function(){});
    notifyProfessionalByName(expertName, 'New client connected 🎉', "You've been connected with a new " + category.toLowerCase() + " client — check My Clients on your dashboard.");
  });
}
```
