document.getElementById('saveNoteBtn').onclick = function(){
  // This used to duplicate commitMainJournalIfDirty's logic inline, but an older, incomplete
  // copy that was missing the actual Supabase sync call entirely -- entries saved via this
  // button (the primary, explicit "Save entry" action) were only ever written to local
  // storage, never the server. That meant they could vanish entirely on logout, reinstall, or
  // switching devices, and never appeared for anyone using the app on a second device. Fixed
  // by routing through the same shared function every other save path already correctly uses.
  var distressMoods = ['Anxious', 'Restless', 'Heavy'];
  var isDistressed = selected.some(function(b){ return distressMoods.indexOf(b.label) !== -1; });
  var saved = commitMainJournalIfDirty();
  if(!saved){ showToast('Write something or pick a mood first'); return; }
  document.getElementById('panel-journal').style.display = 'none';
  resetJournalState();

  if(isDistressed){
    renderGroundingList();
    showOnly('panel-grounding');
    setActiveNav('navBreathe');
    showToast("That sounded like a lot — here's something that might help");
  } else {
    renderSavedPanel();
    document.getElementById('panel-saved').style.display = 'block';
  }
};

// Free-text self-harm/suicide signal detection for journal entries. Deliberately broad rather
// than narrow -- a false positive just shows a supportive resource banner (low cost), while a
// missed real signal could genuinely matter. Mirrors the same crisis messaging already used for
// screening test results, so the experience is consistent wherever it appears.
//
// IMPORTANT LIMITATION, stated honestly: this is keyword/phrase matching, and real research on
// suicidal ideation detection (crisis text line studies, clinical NLP literature) is clear that
// pure pattern matching cannot reliably catch truly indirect, metaphorical, or poetic expression
// -- people often don't state things directly. This list is organized around the broader
// thematic categories that research identifies as actually predictive (hopelessness, burden,
// absolutist language, death-focus, farewell signals), not just literal "I want to die" phrases,
// which meaningfully widens the net beyond the first version -- but it is still pattern matching,
// not understanding, and will still miss things a human (or a real language model) would catch.
// See maybeCheckJournalRiskViaAI() below for the more robust check this is paired with.
var SELF_HARM_SIGNAL_PATTERNS = [
  // Direct statements
  /kill(ing)?\s+myself/i, /suicid/i, /end(ing)?\s+(my\s+)?life/i, /end(ing)?\s+it\s+all/i,
  /want(ed|ing)?\s+to\s+die/i, /wish(ed|ing)?\s+i\s+(was|were)\s+dead/i,
  /hurt(ing)?\s+myself/i, /harm(ing)?\s+myself/i, /self[\s-]?harm/i, /cut(ting)?\s+myself/i,
  // Death-focus / wishful, not just literal "want to die"
  /don'?t\s+want\s+to\s+(be\s+here|live|exist|wake\s+up)/i, /wish\s+i\s+(could\s+)?disappear/i,
  /wonder(ing)?\s+what\s+it'?s?\s+like\s+to\s+(not\s+exist|die|be\s+dead)/i,
  /(want|wish)(ed|ing)?\s+to\s+(disappear|not\s+exist|stop\s+existing|vanish)/i,
  /wish\s+i\s+(was|were)\s+never\s+born/i, /(fade|drift)\s+away\s+forever/i,
  /just\s+want(ed)?\s+(it|everything)\s+to\s+stop/i, /wish\s+(this|it)\s+would\s+just\s+end/i,
  // Burden / worthlessness
  /(everyone|everybody|they)\s+('?d|would)\s+be\s+better\s+(off\s+)?without\s+me/i,
  /(i'?m|i\s+am)\s+(such\s+a\s+)?burden/i, /no\s?one\s+(would\s+)?(miss|need)s?\s+me/i,
  /world\s+would\s+be\s+(quieter|better|easier)\s+without\s+me/i,
  // Farewell / finality signals
  /this\s+is\s+(my\s+)?goodbye/i, /say(ing)?\s+goodbye\s+to\s+everyone/i,
  /won'?t\s+be\s+(here|around)\s+much\s+longer/i, /running\s+out\s+of\s+time/i,
  /(last|final)\s+(entry|time|goodbye|letter)/i, /giving\s+away\s+(my\s+)?(things|stuff|belongings)/i,
  // Hopelessness / absolutist language (research-backed marker even without explicit death mention)
  /nothing\s+will\s+ever\s+(get\s+better|change|matter)/i, /no\s+point\s+(in\s+)?(anymore|any\s?more|trying)/i,
  /no\s+reason\s+to\s+(live|keep\s+going|go\s+on)/i, /(no|can'?t\s+see\s+a)\s+way\s+out/i,
  /trapped\s+forever/i, /can'?t\s+go\s+on/i, /can'?t\s+(take|do)\s+this\s+any\s?more/i,
  /(so\s+)?tired\s+of\s+(living|life|everything|trying|existing)/i, /done\s+with\s+(life|everything)/i,
  /better\s+off\s+dead/i,
  // Void / emptiness / disappearing themes common in indirect poetic language
  /(swallowed|consumed)\s+by\s+(the\s+)?(dark|void|emptiness)/i, /empty\s+inside\s+forever/i,
  /nothing\s+left\s+(in|of)\s+me/i
];
function containsSelfHarmSignal(text){

  return SELF_HARM_SIGNAL_PATTERNS.some(function(re){ return re.test(text); });

// check-journal-risk
//
// A more robust companion to the client-side keyword matching in the app -- that regex-based
// approach is fast and free but, per real research on suicidal ideation detection, fundamentally
// cannot reliably catch indirect, metaphorical, or poetic expression, which is often exactly how
// people express this. This function asks an actual language model to read the text the way a
// thoughtful, safety-aware person would: not just literal phrases, but the pattern-of-mind behind
// abstract, wishful, or death-focused writing.
//
// This is a genuinely safety-positive use of the API -- classification only, no user-facing
// generation, no data retained beyond the single request/response.
//
// Auth: requires a valid Supabase user JWT. Any signed-in user can call this for their OWN
// journal text -- there's no reason to restrict it further, and restricting it would only slow
// down exactly the check meant to help quickly.
//
// Request body: { "text": string }
// Response: { "riskDetected": boolean }
// On any failure (missing API key, API error, malformed response), fails CLOSED to riskDetected:
// false rather than erroring the caller -- the client-side keyword check is still the first line
// of defense either way, and this is a supplementary safety net, not the only check.

import { createClient } from "https://esm.sh/@supabase/supabase-js@2";

const ANTHROPIC_API_KEY = Deno.env.get("ANTHROPIC_API_KEY");
const SUPABASE_URL = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_URL")!;
const SUPABASE_ANON_KEY = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_ANON_KEY")!;

const corsHeaders = {
  "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
  "Access-Control-Allow-Headers": "authorization, x-client-info, apikey, content-type",
  "Access-Control-Allow-Methods": "POST, OPTIONS",
};

const CLASSIFIER_SYSTEM_PROMPT = `You are a careful, safety-focused reader for a mental health journaling app. You will be shown a single journal entry written by someone using the app. Your only job is to decide whether the entry contains ANY signal -- direct or indirect, literal or metaphorical, explicit or merely wishful -- of:
- suicidal ideation (wanting to die, wishing to not exist, thoughts of ending one's life)
- self-harm (current, past, or urges toward it)
- a wish to disappear, stop existing, or not wake up
- hopelessness expressed in absolutist terms ("nothing will ever get better", "no way out") when paired with any death or self-harm adjacent theme
- farewell/finality language that could indicate planning (giving away belongings, "this is goodbye", "won't be here much longer")

Read for the pattern of mind, not just literal keywords. Poetry, metaphor, and abstraction count just as much as direct statements -- someone writing about "sinking into the quiet dark forever" or "wondering if anyone would notice I stopped showing up" is expressing the same thing as someone writing "I want to die," even though neither phrase appears.

Do NOT flag: ordinary sadness, frustration, grief, or venting that doesn't touch the above themes; discussion of death in an unrelated context (e.g. a relative's illness, a news event) with no self-referential wish; creative writing or lyrics being drafted that are clearly about a fictional character, not the writer themselves (use judgment -- if ambiguous, flag it).

Respond with ONLY a JSON object, nothing else, no markdown formatting, no explanation: {"riskDetected": true} or {"riskDetected": false}`;

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  if (req.method === "OPTIONS") {
    return new Response("ok", { headers: corsHeaders });
  }
  if (req.method !== "POST") {
    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "POST only" }), {
      status: 405,
      headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    });
  }

  try {
    const authHeader = req.headers.get("Authorization") || "";
    if (!authHeader) {
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "Missing Authorization header" }), {
        status: 401,
        headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      });
    }
    const callerClient = createClient(SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, {
      global: { headers: { Authorization: authHeader } },
    });
    const { data: callerAuth, error: callerAuthErr } = await callerClient.auth.getUser();
    if (callerAuthErr || !callerAuth?.user) {
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "Invalid or expired session" }), {
        status: 401,
        headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      });
    }

    const { text } = await req.json();
    if (typeof text !== "string" || !text.trim()) {
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ riskDetected: false }), {
        status: 200,
        headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      });
    }

    if (!ANTHROPIC_API_KEY) {
      // Not configured yet -- fail closed, don't block the caller, don't error loudly for
      // something that isn't the user's fault.
      console.error("check-journal-risk: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY not set");
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ riskDetected: false, configured: false }), {
        status: 200,
        headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      });
    }

    const anthropicRes = await fetch("https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: {
        "x-api-key": ANTHROPIC_API_KEY,
        "anthropic-version": "2023-06-01",
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        model: "claude-haiku-4-5-20251001",
        max_tokens: 50,
        system: CLASSIFIER_SYSTEM_PROMPT,
        messages: [{ role: "user", content: text.slice(0, 4000) }],
      }),
    });

    if (!anthropicRes.ok) {
      const errBody = await anthropicRes.text().catch(() => "");
      console.error("check-journal-risk: Anthropic API error", anthropicRes.status, errBody);
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ riskDetected: false, apiError: true }), {
        status: 200,
        headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      });
    }

    const result = await anthropicRes.json();
    const rawText = result?.content?.[0]?.text || "";
    let riskDetected = false;
    try {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(rawText.trim());
      riskDetected = parsed.riskDetected === true;
    } catch {
      // Malformed response from the model -- fail closed rather than guess.
      console.error("check-journal-risk: could not parse model response:", rawText);
    }

    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ riskDetected }), {
      status: 200,
      headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    });
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("check-journal-risk error:", err);
    // Fail closed -- never let this function's own error surface as a scary failure to the user
    // mid-journal-entry.
    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ riskDetected: false, error: String(err) }), {
      status: 200,
      headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    });
  }
});

```

// Repeat picker: when enabled, shows the next several occurrences of the SAME weekday as the
// day currently being edited, so a therapist can check off exactly which future dates should
// also get this same time slot -- matches "I choose 7-7:45pm, then add the option to repeat,
// add the same slot to a different date, I just have to select them."
document.getElementById('therapistRepeatToggle').onchange = function(){
  var area = document.getElementById('therapistRepeatDatesArea');
  if(!this.checked){ area.style.display = 'none'; area.innerHTML = ''; return; }
  area.style.display = 'block';
  var parts = therapistCalActiveDayKey.split('-').map(Number);
  var baseDate = new Date(parts[0], parts[1]-1, parts[2]);
  var weekdayName = baseDate.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { weekday: 'long' });
  var rows = [];
  for(var i=1; i<=10; i++){
    var d = new Date(baseDate);
    d.setDate(d.getDate() + i*7); // same weekday, one week apart each
    var key = d.getFullYear()+'-'+pad2(d.getMonth()+1)+'-'+pad2(d.getDate());
    var label = d.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month:'short', day:'numeric', year:'numeric' });
    rows.push('<label style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:12.5px;color:#2A2013;padding:6px 0;cursor:pointer;">'+
      '<input type="checkbox" class="therapist-repeat-date-check" data-key="'+key+'" style="accent-color:#6690D6;">'+
      'Next '+weekdayName+' — '+label+
    '</label>');
  }
  area.innerHTML = '<p style="font-size:10.5px;color:#9AABCE;margin:0 0 6px;">Same time, same weekday — pick which future dates to add it to:</p>' + rows.join('');
};

document.getElementById('therapistDayAddTimeBtn').onclick = function(){
  var timeInput = document.getElementById('therapistDayNewTime');
  if(!timeInput.value) return;
  var duration = parseInt(document.getElementById('therapistDayNewDuration').value, 10);
  var timeParts = timeInput.value.split(':').map(Number);

  var targetDateKeys = [therapistCalActiveDayKey];
  if(document.getElementById('therapistRepeatToggle').checked){
    document.querySelectorAll('.therapist-repeat-date-check:checked').forEach(function(cb){
      targetDateKeys.push(cb.dataset.key);
    });
  }

  var rows = targetDateKeys.map(function(dateKey){
    var parts = dateKey.split('-').map(Number);
    var fullDate = new Date(parts[0], parts[1]-1, parts[2], timeParts[0], timeParts[1]);
    return { expert_name: appState.therapistExpertName, slot_date: fullDate.toISOString(), is_booked: false, duration_minutes: duration, dateKey: dateKey };
  });
  var insertRows = rows.map(function(r){ return { expert_name: r.expert_name, slot_date: r.slot_date, is_booked: r.is_booked, duration_minutes: r.duration_minutes }; });

  sb.from('expert_availability_slots').insert(insertRows).select().then(function(result){
    if(result.error){ showToast('Could not add — please try again.'); return; }
    timeInput.value = '';
    document.getElementById('therapistRepeatToggle').checked = false;
    document.getElementById('therapistRepeatDatesArea').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('therapistRepeatDatesArea').innerHTML = '';
    result.data.forEach(function(savedRow, i){
      var dateKey = rows[i].dateKey;
      if(!therapistCalSlotsByDay[dateKey]) therapistCalSlotsByDay[dateKey] = [];
      var d = new Date(savedRow.slot_date);
      therapistCalSlotsByDay[dateKey].push({ id: savedRow.id, time: d.toLocaleTimeString('en-US',{hour:'numeric',minute:'2-digit'}), rawDate: savedRow.slot_date, is_booked: false, duration: duration });
    });
    showToast(rows.length > 1 ? ('Added to ' + rows.length + ' dates') : 'Time added');
    renderTherapistDaySlotsList();
    renderTherapistAvailabilityGrid();
  });
};
```

var adminActiveCampaignId = null;
function renderAdminCampaign(){
  sb.from('donation_campaigns').select('*').eq('is_active', true).order('created_at', {ascending:false}).limit(1).then(function(result){
    var infoEl = document.getElementById('adminCampaignCurrentInfo');
    if(result.error || !result.data || result.data.length === 0){
      adminActiveCampaignId = null;
      infoEl.innerHTML = '<p style="font-size:11px;color:#B0AA98;">No active campaign yet — fill in the fields below to start one.</p>';
      return;
    }
    var c = result.data[0];
    adminActiveCampaignId = c.id;
    document.getElementById('adminCampaignTitle').value = c.title;
    document.getElementById('adminCampaignDescription').value = c.description || '';
    document.getElementById('adminCampaignGoal').value = c.goal_amount;

    sb.from('donations').select('amount').eq('campaign_id', c.id).eq('payment_confirmed', true).then(function(donResult){
      var raised = (donResult.data || []).reduce(function(sum, d){ return sum + parseFloat(d.amount); }, 0);
      infoEl.innerHTML = '<div style="background:#EAF4EE;border-radius:10px;padding:10px;"><p style="font-size:12px;color:#3B8F63;font-weight:700;margin:0;">₹'+raised.toLocaleString('en-IN')+' raised of ₹'+parseFloat(c.goal_amount).toLocaleString('en-IN')+' goal</p></div>';
    });
  });
  renderAdminDonationsList();
}

document.getElementById('adminCampaignSaveBtn').onclick = function(){
  var title = document.getElementById('adminCampaignTitle').value.trim();
  var description = document.getElementById('adminCampaignDescription').value.trim();
  var goal = parseFloat(document.getElementById('adminCampaignGoal').value);
  if(!title || !goal || goal <= 0){
    showToast('Add a title and a goal amount first.');
    return;
  }
  if(adminActiveCampaignId){
    sb.from('donation_campaigns').update({ title: title, description: description, goal_amount: goal }).eq('id', adminActiveCampaignId).then(function(result){
      if(result.error){ showToast('Could not save — please try again.'); return; }
      showToast('Campaign updated.');
      renderAdminCampaign();
    });
  } else {
    sb.from('donation_campaigns').insert({ title: title, description: description, goal_amount: goal, is_active: true }).then(function(result){

function renderAdminDonationsList(){
  var listEl = document.getElementById('adminDonationsList');
  listEl.innerHTML = '<p style="text-align:center;color:#9AABCE;font-size:12px;">Loading...</p>';
  sb.from('donations').select('*').eq('payment_confirmed', false).order('created_at', {ascending:false}).then(function(result){
    if(result.error){
      listEl.innerHTML = '<p style="color:#C77B7B;font-size:12px;">Could not load: '+result.error.message+'</p>';
      return;
    }
    var pending = result.data || [];
    if(pending.length === 0){
      listEl.innerHTML = '<p style="text-align:center;color:#9AABCE;font-size:12px;">Nothing waiting on confirmation.</p>';
      return;
    }
    listEl.innerHTML = pending.map(function(d){
      var when = new Date(d.created_at).toLocaleDateString('en-IN', {day:'numeric', month:'short'});
      return '<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;background:#FFFFFF;border:1px solid #EEE0C4;border-radius:10px;padding:10px 12px;margin-bottom:6px;">'+
        '<span style="font-size:12px;color:#2A2013;"><strong>₹'+parseFloat(d.amount).toLocaleString('en-IN')+'</strong> — '+(d.donor_name||'Anonymous')+' · '+when+'</span>'+
        '<button class="admin-confirm-donation-btn" data-id="'+d.id+'" style="font-size:10.5px;font-weight:700;color:#fff;background:#3B8F63;border:none;border-radius:8px;padding:6px 10px;cursor:pointer;">Confirm</button>'+
      '</div>';
    }).join('');
    listEl.querySelectorAll('.admin-confirm-donation-btn').forEach(function(btn){
      btn.onclick = function(){
        sb.from('donations').update({ payment_confirmed: true }).eq('id', btn.dataset.id).then(function(result){
          if(result.error){ showToast('Could not confirm — please try again.'); return; }
          showToast('Donation confirmed — thank them!');
          renderAdminCampaign();
        });
      };
    });
  });
}

var DONATE_PUBLIC_URL = 'https://homeofbeautifulsouls-sys.github.io/hobs-companion-app/donate.html';
var currentDonateCampaign = null;

// Shown on every professional's profile -- a compact campaign progress widget with a Donate
// button and a Share button (uses the public donate.html page so it's viewable and shareable by
// people who don't have the app at all, per "they can also share it outside the app").
function renderExpertDetailDonationWidget(){
  var widget = document.getElementById('expertDetailDonationWidget');
  widget.innerHTML = '';
  Promise.all([
    sb.from('donation_campaigns').select('*').eq('is_active', true).order('created_at', {ascending:false}).limit(1),
    sb.from('donations').select('amount, campaign_id').eq('payment_confirmed', true)
  ]).then(function(results){
    var campaignRes = results[0], donationsRes = results[1];
    if(campaignRes.error || !campaignRes.data || campaignRes.data.length === 0) return; // no active campaign -- show nothing, not an error state
    var c = campaignRes.data[0];
    currentDonateCampaign = c;
    var raised = (donationsRes.data || []).filter(function(d){ return d.campaign_id === c.id; }).reduce(function(sum, d){ return sum + parseFloat(d.amount); }, 0);
    var pct = Math.min(100, Math.round((raised / parseFloat(c.goal_amount)) * 100));

    widget.innerHTML =
      '<div style="background:#FFF8F0;border:1px solid #EEE0C4;border-radius:16px;padding:16px;">'+
        '<p style="font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:#9AABCE;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.03em;margin:0 0 6px;">Support HOBS</p>'+
        '<p style="font-size:14px;font-weight:800;color:#2A2013;margin:0 0 6px;">'+c.title+'</p>'+
        (c.description ? '<p style="font-size:11.5px;color:#5C6B94;margin:0 0 12px;">'+c.description+'</p>' : '')+
        '<div style="background:#EEE0C4;border-radius:20px;height:10px;overflow:hidden;margin-bottom:8px;">'+
          '<div style="background:#3B8F63;height:100%;width:'+pct+'%;border-radius:20px;"></div>'+
        '</div>'+
        '<p style="font-size:11.5px;color:#3B8F63;font-weight:700;margin:0 0 14px;">₹'+raised.toLocaleString('en-IN')+' raised of ₹'+parseFloat(c.goal_amount).toLocaleString('en-IN')+' goal</p>'+
        '<div style="display:flex;gap:8px;">'+
          '<button id="expertDetailDonateBtn" style="flex:1;padding:12px;border-radius:12px;border:none;background:#6690D6;color:#FFF8F0;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;">Donate</button>'+
          '<button id="expertDetailShareCampaignBtn" style="padding:12px 16px;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid #EEE0C4;background:transparent;color:#5C6B94;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;">Share</button>'+
        '</div>'+
      '</div>';

    document.getElementById('expertDetailDonateBtn').onclick = function(){ openDonateModal(c); };
    document.getElementById('expertDetailShareCampaignBtn').onclick = function(){ shareCampaign(c); };
  });
}

function shareCampaign(c){
  var shareText = 'Help support ' + c.title + ' with Home of Beautiful Souls Foundation: ' + DONATE_PUBLIC_URL;
  if(navigator.share){
    navigator.share({ title: c.title, text: 'Help support ' + c.title + ' with Home of Beautiful Souls Foundation', url: DONATE_PUBLIC_URL }).catch(function(){});
  } else if(navigator.clipboard){
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(shareText).then(function(){ showToast('Link copied — paste it anywhere to share'); });
  } else {
    showToast(DONATE_PUBLIC_URL);
  }
}

function openDonateModal(c){
  document.getElementById('donateModalTitle').textContent = c.title;
  document.getElementById('donateModalDescription').textContent = c.description || '';
  document.getElementById('donateDonorName').value = appState.displayName || '';
  document.getElementById('donateAmount').value = '';
  document.getElementById('donateModalBackdrop').style.display = 'block';
  document.getElementById('donateModal').style.display = 'block';
}
document.querySelectorAll('.donate-preset-btn').forEach(function(btn){
  btn.onclick = function(){ document.getElementById('donateAmount').value = btn.dataset.amt; };
});
document.getElementById('donateCancelBtn').onclick = function(){
  document.getElementById('donateModalBackdrop').style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('donateModal').style.display = 'none';
};
document.getElementById('donateModalBackdrop').onclick = document.getElementById('donateCancelBtn').onclick;
document.getElementById('donateContinueBtn').onclick = function(){
  var amount = parseFloat(document.getElementById('donateAmount').value);
  if(!amount || amount <= 0){ showToast('Enter an amount first.'); return; }
  var donorName = document.getElementById('donateDonorName').value.trim();
  document.getElementById('donateModalBackdrop').style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('donateModal').style.display = 'none';

  showPaymentModal(
    'Donation of ₹' + amount.toLocaleString('en-IN') + ' — ' + currentDonateCampaign.title,
    "Hi! I've donated ₹" + amount + " to " + currentDonateCampaign.title + " and wanted to let you know.",
    function(){
      sb.from('donations').insert({
        campaign_id: currentDonateCampaign.id, donor_name: donorName || null, amount: amount,
        payment_confirmed: false, user_id: (currentUser && currentUser.id) || null
      }).then(function(result){
        if(!result.error){
          logAnalyticsEvent('donation_pledged');
          renderExpertDetailDonationWidget();
        }
      });
    }
  );
};

    var profileRes = results[0], entriesRes = results[1], tasksRes = results[2], subtasksRes = results[3], bookingsRes = results[4], worksheetRes = results[5];

    appState.expertBookings = (bookingsRes && !bookingsRes.error && bookingsRes.data) ? bookingsRes.data : [];

    // worksheet_responses was being written on every save but never read back anywhere --
    // appState.worksheetEntries only ever got populated in-memory at the moment of saving, so
    // past worksheet answers looked empty on any fresh session (new device, reinstall, or just
    // reopening the app after local state was cleared) even though the data was safely on the
    // server the whole time. Same root pattern as the journal save bug from an earlier session,
    // caught by specifically checking other save paths for the same "write-only, never read
    // back" shape after finding it once.
    appState.worksheetEntries = {};
    (worksheetRes && !worksheetRes.error && worksheetRes.data ? worksheetRes.data : []).forEach(function(row){
      appState.worksheetEntries[row.worksheet_key] = row.answers || {};
    });

// Worksheet saves used to always INSERT a new row via the generic syncToSupabase helper, even
// when re-saving the exact same worksheet -- meaning revising an answer a second time created a
// duplicate row instead of updating the existing one, and which copy "won" on load was
// non-deterministic. Fixed with a real upsert against a new unique constraint on
// (user_id, worksheet_key).
function upsertWorksheetResponse(worksheetKey, categoryKey, data){
  if(!currentUser || !currentUser.id) return;
  sb.from('worksheet_responses').upsert({
    user_id: currentUser.id, worksheet_key: worksheetKey, category_key: categoryKey,
    answers: data, updated_at: new Date().toISOString()
  }, { onConflict: 'user_id,worksheet_key' }).then(function(result){
    if(result.error) console.error('worksheet upsert failed:', result.error);
  });
}


```

// Rebuilt to actually match the real policy published in the Terms of Service (it didn't
// before -- the old version never checked session timing at all, never actually marked the
// booking cancelled, and tracked a lifetime count instead of resetting each calendar month).
function cancelSession(m){
  var booking = getActiveBookingForCategory(m.roleCategory);
  if(!booking) return;

  var now = new Date();
  var sessionDate = booking.session_date ? new Date(booking.session_date) : null;
  var hoursUntilSession = sessionDate ? (sessionDate - now) / (1000*60*60) : null;
  var isLateCancellation = hoursUntilSession !== null && hoursUntilSession < 24;

  var lastCancelled = booking.last_cancelled_at ? new Date(booking.last_cancelled_at) : null;
  var alreadyUsedLateAllowanceThisMonth = !!(lastCancelled &&
    lastCancelled.getFullYear() === now.getFullYear() &&
    lastCancelled.getMonth() === now.getMonth() &&
    booking.cancellation_charge_percent === 50);

  var chargePercent, message;
  if(!isLateCancellation){
    chargePercent = 0;
    message = "More than 24 hours out, so the full amount carries forward to your next session — no charge. Cancel this session?";
  } else if(!alreadyUsedLateAllowanceThisMonth){
    chargePercent = 50;
    message = "This is within 24 hours of your session, so a 50% cancellation charge applies (the rest carries forward). This is your one late cancellation for this month. Continue?";
  } else {
    chargePercent = 100;
    message = "This is a second late cancellation this month, so the full amount is charged this time, with nothing carried forward. Continue?";
  }

  if(!confirm(message)) return;

  booking.status = 'cancelled';
  booking.cancellation_count = (booking.cancellation_count || 0) + 1;
  booking.last_cancelled_at = now.toISOString();
  booking.cancellation_charge_percent = chargePercent;
  booking.cancellation_charge_owed = chargePercent > 0;
  saveState();

  if(String(booking.id).indexOf('temp_') !== 0){
    sb.from('expert_bookings').update({
      status: 'cancelled',
      cancellation_count: booking.cancellation_count,
      last_cancelled_at: booking.last_cancelled_at,
      cancellation_charge_percent: chargePercent,
      cancellation_charge_owed: chargePercent > 0
    }).eq('id', booking.id).then(function(){});
  }

  if(chargePercent > 0){
    showPaymentModal(
      chargePercent + '% cancellation charge — ' + m.name,
      "Hi! I've cancelled my session with " + m.name + " and paid the " + chargePercent + "% cancellation charge.",
      function(){ showToast('Cancelled — thanks for letting us know about the payment.'); }
    );
  } else {
    showToast('Session cancelled — the full amount carries forward to your next booking.');
  }

  renderTeamList();
  renderProfile();
}
```

FULL FILE TEXT (exact):
```
// delete-user-account
//
// Fully deletes a user's account: all their data across every table, and their actual login
// (auth.users row) via the Supabase Auth Admin API, which requires the service role key and
// cannot be done from client-side JS with just RLS permissions, regardless of how permissive
// the RLS policies are -- auth.users itself isn't something RLS governs.
//
// Auth: caller must be a signed-in admin. Deletes everything for the target user_id: entries,
// tasks, subtasks, expert_bookings, test_results, worksheet_responses, notification_recipients,
// donations (where they're the donor), profiles, and finally the auth user itself.
//
// Request body: { "userId": string }
// Response: { "success": true } or { "error": string }

import { createClient } from "https://esm.sh/@supabase/supabase-js@2";

const SUPABASE_URL = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_URL")!;
const SUPABASE_ANON_KEY = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_ANON_KEY")!;
const SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY")!;

const corsHeaders = {
  "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
  "Access-Control-Allow-Headers": "authorization, x-client-info, apikey, content-type",
  "Access-Control-Allow-Methods": "POST, OPTIONS",
};

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  if (req.method === "OPTIONS") return new Response("ok", { headers: corsHeaders });

  try {
    const authHeader = req.headers.get("Authorization") || "";
    if (!authHeader) {
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "Missing Authorization header" }), {
        status: 401, headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      });
    }
    const callerClient = createClient(SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, {
      global: { headers: { Authorization: authHeader } },
    });
    const { data: callerAuth, error: callerAuthErr } = await callerClient.auth.getUser();
    if (callerAuthErr || !callerAuth?.user) {
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "Invalid or expired session" }), {
        status: 401, headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      });
    }

    const adminClient = createClient(SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY);
    const { data: callerProfile } = await adminClient
      .from("profiles").select("is_admin").eq("user_id", callerAuth.user.id).single();
    if (!callerProfile?.is_admin) {
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "Admin access required" }), {
        status: 403, headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      });
    }

    const { userId } = await req.json();
    if (!userId || typeof userId !== "string") {
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "userId is required" }), {
        status: 400, headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      });
    }
    if (userId === callerAuth.user.id) {
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "Cannot delete your own account through this tool" }), {
        status: 400, headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      });
    }

    // Delete related data first (children before the profile itself, though most of these
    // aren't actually FK-cascading, so being explicit here rather than relying on it).
    const tables = [
      "notification_recipients", "subtasks", "tasks", "entries", "expert_bookings",
      "test_results", "worksheet_responses", "donations",
    ];
    for (const table of tables) {
      await adminClient.from(table).delete().eq("user_id", userId);
    }
    await adminClient.from("profiles").delete().eq("user_id", userId);

    // Finally, remove the actual login -- this is the step that genuinely requires the service
    // role key and the Auth Admin API, not just a table delete.
    const { error: authDeleteErr } = await adminClient.auth.admin.deleteUser(userId);
    if (authDeleteErr) {
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "Data deleted, but removing the login failed: " + authDeleteErr.message }), {
        status: 500, headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      });
    }

    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ success: true }), {
      status: 200, headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    });
  } catch (err) {
    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: String(err) }), {
      status: 500, headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    });
  }
});

```

// REQUEST a time, and the therapist reviews it -- accept, propose a different time, or reject.
// The slot is reserved (is_booked=true) the moment it's requested, so nobody else can also

    sb.from('expert_bookings').update({

NEW (exact):
```
function renderTherapistTimeRequests(){
  var listEl = document.getElementById('therapistTimeRequestsList');
  listEl.innerHTML = '<p style="text-align:center;color:#9AABCE;font-size:12.5px;">Loading...</p>';
  Promise.all([
    sb.from('expert_bookings').select('id,user_id,requested_session_date,created_at').eq('expert_name', appState.therapistExpertName).eq('time_request_status', 'pending'),
    sb.from('profiles').select('user_id,name,email')
  ]).then(function(results){
    var bookingsRes = results[0], profilesRes = results[1];
    if(bookingsRes.error){
      listEl.innerHTML = '<p style="color:#C77B7B;font-size:12px;">Could not load: '+bookingsRes.error.message+'</p>';
      return;
    }
    var requests = bookingsRes.data || [];
    if(requests.length === 0){
      listEl.innerHTML = '<p style="text-align:center;color:#9AABCE;font-size:12.5px;">No time requests waiting right now.</p>';
      return;
    }
    var profileByUserId = {};
    (profilesRes.data || []).forEach(function(p){ profileByUserId[p.user_id] = p; });

    listEl.innerHTML = requests.map(function(r){
      var profile = profileByUserId[r.user_id] || {};
      var reqLabel = r.requested_session_date ? new Date(r.requested_session_date).toLocaleString('en-IN', {weekday:'short', month:'short', day:'numeric', hour:'numeric', minute:'2-digit'}) : 'unknown time';
      return '<div style="background:#FFFFFF;border:1px solid #EEE0C4;border-radius:12px;padding:12px;margin-bottom:8px;">'+
        '<p style="font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;color:#2A2013;margin:0 0 2px;">'+(profile.name||'Unknown client')+'</p>'+
        '<p style="font-size:11px;color:#5C6B94;margin:0 0 8px;">Requested: '+reqLabel+'</p>'+
        '<div style="display:flex;gap:6px;margin-bottom:6px;">'+
          '<button class="therapist-accept-time-btn" data-id="'+r.id+'" style="flex:1;font-size:10.5px;font-weight:700;color:#fff;background:#3B8F63;border:none;border-radius:8px;padding:8px;cursor:pointer;">Accept</button>'+
          '<button class="therapist-reject-time-btn" data-id="'+r.id+'" data-uid="'+r.user_id+'" style="flex:1;font-size:10.5px;font-weight:700;color:#C77B7B;background:none;border:1px solid #F0C7C7;border-radius:8px;padding:8px;cursor:pointer;">Decline</button>'+
        '</div>'+
        '<div style="display:flex;gap:6px;">'+
          '<input type="datetime-local" class="therapist-propose-time-input" data-id="'+r.id+'" style="flex:1;padding:8px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid #EEE0C4;font-size:11px;font-family:inherit;">'+
          '<button class="therapist-propose-time-btn" data-id="'+r.id+'" data-uid="'+r.user_id+'" style="font-size:10.5px;font-weight:700;color:#6690D6;background:#E9F0FB;border:none;border-radius:8px;padding:8px 10px;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap;">Propose instead</button>'+
        '</div>'+
      '</div>';
    }).join('');

    listEl.querySelectorAll('.therapist-accept-time-btn').forEach(function(btn){
      btn.onclick = function(){
        var req = requests.find(function(r){ return r.id === btn.dataset.id; });
        sb.from('expert_bookings').update({
          session_date: req.requested_session_date, time_request_status: 'accepted', requested_session_date: null
        }).eq('id', btn.dataset.id).then(function(result){
          if(result.error){ showToast('Could not accept — please try again.'); return; }
          showToast('Time confirmed.');
          renderTherapistTimeRequests();
          renderTherapistClientsList();
          sb.functions.invoke('send-push-notification', {
            body: {
              title: 'Bob here 🐘', body: appState.therapistExpertName + " confirmed your session time!",
              userId: req.user_id, notificationType: 'admin_manual', targetDescription: 'Session time confirmed'
            }
          }).catch(function(){});
        });
      };
    });

    listEl.querySelectorAll('.therapist-reject-time-btn').forEach(function(btn){
      btn.onclick = function(){
        if(!confirm('Decline this time? The slot will be released and the client will need to request a different one.')) return;
        var req = requests.find(function(r){ return r.id === btn.dataset.id; });
        // Release the availability slot that was held for this request, if any.
        if(req.requested_session_date){
          sb.from('expert_availability_slots').update({ is_booked: false, booked_by: null })
            .eq('expert_name', appState.therapistExpertName).eq('slot_date', req.requested_session_date).then(function(){});
        }
        sb.from('expert_bookings').update({
          time_request_status: 'rejected', requested_session_date: null
        }).eq('id', btn.dataset.id).then(function(result){
          if(result.error){ showToast('Could not decline — please try again.'); return; }
          showToast('Declined.');
          renderTherapistTimeRequests();
          sb.functions.invoke('send-push-notification', {
            body: {
              title: 'Bob here 🐘', body: "That time didn't work for " + appState.therapistExpertName + " — come pick another.",
              userId: btn.dataset.uid, notificationType: 'admin_manual', targetDescription: 'Session time declined'
            }
          }).catch(function(){});
        });
      };
    });

    listEl.querySelectorAll('.therapist-propose-time-btn').forEach(function(btn){
      btn.onclick = function(){
        var input = listEl.querySelector('.therapist-propose-time-input[data-id="'+btn.dataset.id+'"]');
        if(!input || !input.value){ showToast('Pick a date and time first.'); return; }
        var newDate = new Date(input.value).toISOString();
        sb.from('expert_bookings').update({
          session_date: newDate, time_request_status: 'accepted', requested_session_date: null
        }).eq('id', btn.dataset.id).then(function(result){
          if(result.error){ showToast('Could not propose — please try again.'); return; }
          showToast('New time set — client has been notified.');
          renderTherapistTimeRequests();
          renderTherapistClientsList();
          sb.functions.invoke('send-push-notification', {
            body: {
              title: 'Bob here 🐘',
              body: appState.therapistExpertName + " proposed a different time for your session — check the app for details.",
              userId: btn.dataset.uid, notificationType: 'admin_manual', targetDescription: 'Session time proposed'
            }
          }).catch(function(){});
        });
      };
    });
  });
}

// Rebuilt AGAIN after testing surfaced a real design gap: each cancelled session creates a
// fresh booking row for the next one, so checking "has this happened before this month" on the
// current booking's own history could never actually detect a repeat across different sessions
// -- the previous cancellation's history lives on a DIFFERENT row entirely. Fixed by querying
// the client's actual cancellation history across all their bookings with this expert, not just
// the one being cancelled right now.
function cancelSession(m){
  var booking = getActiveBookingForCategory(m.roleCategory);
  if(!booking || !currentUser || !currentUser.id) return;

  var now = new Date();
  var monthStart = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), 1).toISOString();

  sb.from('expert_bookings')
    .select('id')
    .eq('user_id', currentUser.id)
    .eq('expert_name', m.name)
    .eq('cancellation_charge_percent', 50)
    .gte('last_cancelled_at', monthStart)
    .then(function(historyResult){
      var alreadyUsedLateAllowanceThisMonth = !historyResult.error && historyResult.data && historyResult.data.length > 0;

      var sessionDate = booking.session_date ? new Date(booking.session_date) : null;
      var hoursUntilSession = sessionDate ? (sessionDate - now) / (1000*60*60) : null;
      var isLateCancellation = hoursUntilSession !== null && hoursUntilSession < 24;

      var chargePercent, message;
      if(!isLateCancellation){
        chargePercent = 0;
        message = "More than 24 hours out, so the full amount carries forward to your next session — no charge. Cancel this session?";
      } else if(!alreadyUsedLateAllowanceThisMonth){
        chargePercent = 50;
        message = "This is within 24 hours of your session, so a 50% cancellation charge applies (the rest carries forward). This is your one late cancellation for this month. Continue?";
      } else {
        chargePercent = 100;
        message = "You've already used your one late cancellation for this month, so the full amount is charged this time, with nothing carried forward. Continue?";
      }

      if(!confirm(message)) return;

      booking.status = 'cancelled';
      booking.cancellation_count = (booking.cancellation_count || 0) + 1;
      booking.last_cancelled_at = now.toISOString();
      booking.cancellation_charge_percent = chargePercent;
      booking.cancellation_charge_owed = chargePercent > 0;
      saveState();

      if(String(booking.id).indexOf('temp_') !== 0){
        sb.from('expert_bookings').update({
          status: 'cancelled',
          cancellation_count: booking.cancellation_count,
          last_cancelled_at: booking.last_cancelled_at,
          cancellation_charge_percent: chargePercent,
          cancellation_charge_owed: chargePercent > 0
        }).eq('id', booking.id).then(function(){});
      }

      if(chargePercent > 0){
        showPaymentModal(
          chargePercent + '% cancellation charge — ' + m.name,
          "Hi! I've cancelled my session with " + m.name + " and paid the " + chargePercent + "% cancellation charge.",
          function(){ showToast('Cancelled — thanks for letting us know about the payment.'); }
        );
      } else {
        showToast('Session cancelled — the full amount carries forward to your next booking.');
      }

      renderTeamList();
      renderProfile();
    });
}

function renderAdminExpertsManageList(){
  var listEl = document.getElementById('adminExpertsManageList');
  listEl.innerHTML = '<p style="text-align:center;color:#9AABCE;font-size:12px;">Loading...</p>';
  sb.from('experts').select('id,name,role,role_category,credential,years,photo_url').order('role_category').then(function(result){
    if(result.error){
      listEl.innerHTML = '<p style="color:#C77B7B;font-size:12px;">Could not load: '+result.error.message+'</p>';
      return;
    }
    var experts = result.data || [];
    if(experts.length === 0){
      listEl.innerHTML = '<p style="text-align:center;color:#9AABCE;font-size:12px;">No experts added yet.</p>';
      return;
    }
    listEl.innerHTML = experts.map(function(e){
      return '<div style="background:#FFFFFF;border:1px solid #EEE0C4;border-radius:10px;padding:10px 12px;margin-bottom:6px;">'+
        '<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:8px;">'+
          '<span style="font-size:12px;color:#2A2013;"><strong>'+e.name+'</strong><br><span style="color:#9AABCE;font-size:10.5px;">'+e.role+' · '+e.role_category+'</span></span>'+
        '</div>'+
        '<div style="display:flex;gap:6px;">'+
          '<button class="admin-edit-expert-btn" data-id="'+e.id+'" style="flex:1;font-size:10.5px;font-weight:700;color:#6690D6;background:#E9F0FB;border:none;border-radius:8px;padding:7px;cursor:pointer;">Edit</button>'+
          '<button class="admin-link-expert-btn" data-id="'+e.id+'" data-name="'+e.name+'" style="flex:1;font-size:10.5px;font-weight:700;color:#3B8F63;background:#EAF4EE;border:none;border-radius:8px;padding:7px;cursor:pointer;">Link Account</button>'+
          '<button class="admin-delete-expert-btn" data-id="'+e.id+'" data-name="'+e.name+'" style="flex:1;font-size:10.5px;font-weight:700;color:#C77B7B;background:none;border:1px solid #F0C7C7;border-radius:8px;padding:7px;cursor:pointer;">Remove</button>'+
        '</div>'+
        '<div class="admin-expert-edit-form" data-id="'+e.id+'" style="display:none;margin-top:10px;padding-top:10px;border-top:1px solid #F5F0E4;"></div>'+
      '</div>';
    }).join('');

    listEl.querySelectorAll('.admin-delete-expert-btn').forEach(function(btn){
      btn.onclick = function(){
        if(!confirm('Remove ' + btn.dataset.name + ' from the experts list? This only removes their public profile — it does not touch their account or booking history if they have one.')) return;
        sb.from('experts').delete().eq('id', btn.dataset.id).then(function(result){
          if(result.error){ showToast('Could not remove — please try again.'); return; }
          showToast('Removed.');
          renderAdminExpertsManageList();
        });
      };
    });

    // Link Account: for a professional whose public profile ALREADY exists (added once via
    // "Add New Expert"), this connects a real email to that SAME existing profile instead of
    // running through "Add New Expert & Invite" again, which would create a second, duplicate
    // experts-table row for the same person -- exactly the duplication Akash flagged.
    listEl.querySelectorAll('.admin-link-expert-btn').forEach(function(btn){
      btn.onclick = function(){
        var email = prompt('Link which email to ' + btn.dataset.name + \"'s existing profile? When they sign up or sign in with this email, their account will be connected automatically -- no new profile will be created.\");
        if(!email || !email.trim()) return;
        sb.from('therapist_invites').insert({ email: email.trim().toLowerCase(), expert_name: btn.dataset.name, claimed: false }).then(function(result){
          if(result.error){ showToast('Could not link — please try again.'); return; }
          showToast('Linked. ' + email.trim() + ' will connect to this profile on next sign-in.');
        });
      };
    });

    listEl.querySelectorAll('.admin-edit-expert-btn').forEach(function(btn){
      btn.onclick = function(){
        var expert = experts.find(function(e){ return e.id === btn.dataset.id; });
        var formEl = listEl.querySelector('.admin-expert-edit-form[data-id="'+btn.dataset.id+'"]');
        if(formEl.style.display === 'block'){ formEl.style.display = 'none'; return; }
        formEl.innerHTML =
          '<input type="text" class="edit-expert-name" value="'+expert.name.replace(/"/g,'&quot;')+'" placeholder="Full name" style="width:100%;padding:9px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid #EEE0C4;font-size:11.5px;font-family:inherit;margin-bottom:6px;box-sizing:border-box;">'+
          '<input type="text" class="edit-expert-role" value="'+(expert.role||'').replace(/"/g,'&quot;')+'" placeholder="Role" style="width:100%;padding:9px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid #EEE0C4;font-size:11.5px;font-family:inherit;margin-bottom:6px;box-sizing:border-box;">'+
          '<div style="display:flex;gap:6px;margin-bottom:6px;">'+
            '<input type="text" class="edit-expert-credential" value="'+(expert.credential||'').replace(/"/g,'&quot;')+'" placeholder="Credential" style="flex:1;padding:9px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid #EEE0C4;font-size:11.5px;font-family:inherit;box-sizing:border-box;">'+
            '<input type="text" class="edit-expert-years" value="'+(expert.years||'').replace(/"/g,'&quot;')+'" placeholder="Experience" style="flex:1;padding:9px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid #EEE0C4;font-size:11.5px;font-family:inherit;box-sizing:border-box;">'+
          '</div>'+
          '<button class="admin-save-expert-edit-btn" data-id="'+expert.id+'" style="width:100%;padding:9px;border-radius:8px;border:none;background:#6690D6;color:#fff;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;">Save Changes</button>';
        formEl.style.display = 'block';
        formEl.querySelector('.admin-save-expert-edit-btn').onclick = function(){
          var updates = {
            name: formEl.querySelector('.edit-expert-name').value.trim(),
            role: formEl.querySelector('.edit-expert-role').value.trim(),
            credential: formEl.querySelector('.edit-expert-credential').value.trim(),
            years: formEl.querySelector('.edit-expert-years').value.trim()
          };
          if(!updates.name){ showToast('Name can\'t be empty.'); return; }
          sb.from('experts').update(updates).eq('id', expert.id).then(function(result){

//                    they have no booking in that window.

// times too via the same shared check, so e.g. a 10am task-add reminder correctly blocks a

// Mandatory therapy consent + No Suicide Agreement gate. Required for every user except
// professionals (therapists), per Akash's explicit decision -- shown once, right after
// onboarding, blocking all other app access until every field is filled in.
function showConsentGate(){
  document.getElementById('consentPhone').value = appState.phoneNumber || '';
  document.getElementById('consentGateError').style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('consentGateOverlay').style.display = 'flex';
}

document.getElementById('consentGateSubmitBtn').onclick = function(){
  var fields = {
    residential_address: document.getElementById('consentAddress').value.trim(),
    contact_phone: document.getElementById('consentPhone').value.trim(),
    emergency_contact_1_name: document.getElementById('consentEC1Name').value.trim(),
    emergency_contact_1_phone: document.getElementById('consentEC1Phone').value.trim(),
    emergency_contact_2_name: document.getElementById('consentEC2Name').value.trim(),
    emergency_contact_2_phone: document.getElementById('consentEC2Phone').value.trim(),
    emergency_contact_3_name: document.getElementById('consentEC3Name').value.trim(),
    emergency_contact_3_phone: document.getElementById('consentEC3Phone').value.trim(),
    signature_name: document.getElementById('consentSignature').value.trim(),
    no_suicide_signature_name: document.getElementById('consentNoSuicideSignature').value.trim()
  };
  var consentChat = document.getElementById('consentChat').checked;
  var consentAudio = document.getElementById('consentAudio').checked;
  var consentVideo = document.getElementById('consentVideo').checked;

  // Every field is required -- at least one session type must be checked, and both signature
  // fields must be filled, per "they have to enter all the information or they won't be able
  // to move forward."
  var allTextFilled = Object.keys(fields).every(function(k){ return fields[k].length > 0; });
  var atLeastOneModality = consentChat || consentAudio || consentVideo;
  if(!allTextFilled || !atLeastOneModality){
    document.getElementById('consentGateError').style.display = 'block';
    document.getElementById('consentGateError').scrollIntoView({ behavior:'smooth', block:'center' });
    return;
  }
  document.getElementById('consentGateError').style.display = 'none';

  var todayStr = new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10);
  var btn = document.getElementById('consentGateSubmitBtn');
  btn.disabled = true;
  btn.textContent = 'Saving…';

  var payload = Object.assign({}, fields, {
    user_id: currentUser.id,
    consent_chat: consentChat, consent_audio: consentAudio, consent_video: consentVideo,
    signature_date: todayStr, no_suicide_signature_date: todayStr
  });

  sb.from('consent_agreements').insert(payload).then(function(result){
    if(result.error){
      btn.disabled = false;
      btn.textContent = 'I Agree & Continue';
      showToast('Could not save — please check your connection and try again.');
      return;
    }
    sb.from('profiles').update({ consent_signed: true }).eq('user_id', currentUser.id).then(function(){});
    appState.consentSigned = true;
    document.getElementById('consentGateOverlay').style.display = 'none';
    btn.disabled = false;
    btn.textContent = 'I Agree & Continue';
    if(!appState.hasSeenIntro){

      }
      statusEl.style.color = '#3B8F63';
      statusEl.textContent = 'Sent to ' + ((result.data && result.data.sent) || 0) + ' of ' + userIds.length + ' user(s).';

    listEl.querySelectorAll('.admin-link-expert-btn').forEach(function(btn){
      btn.onclick = function(){
        var email = prompt('Link which email to this existing profile for ' + btn.dataset.name + '? When they sign up or sign in with this email, their account will be connected automatically -- no new profile will be created.');
        if(!email || !email.trim()) return;

NEW (exact):
```
    listEl.querySelectorAll('.admin-link-expert-btn').forEach(function(btn){
      btn.onclick = function(){
        var email = prompt('Link which email to this existing profile for ' + btn.dataset.name + '? When they sign up or sign in with this email, their account will be connected automatically -- no new profile will be created.');
        if(!email || !email.trim()) return;
        // Upsert, not insert -- email has a unique constraint, so re-linking an email that was
        // already invited (even to a different profile, e.g. correcting a mistake) would
        // otherwise fail outright instead of just updating where it points. Confirmed this was
        // the actual cause of "Could not link" reports by checking the real data first.
        sb.from('therapist_invites').upsert({
          email: email.trim().toLowerCase(), expert_name: btn.dataset.name, claimed: false
        }, { onConflict: 'email' }).then(function(result){
          if(result.error){ showToast('Could not link — ' + result.error.message); return; }
          showToast('Linked. ' + email.trim() + ' will connect to this profile on next sign-in.');
        });
      };
    });
```

// Logs an appointment directly for a client who isn't on HOBS Companion at all (e.g. iPhone
// users, or anyone the therapist sees outside the app) -- still shows up in the therapist's own
// calendar and counts toward real booking history, just without a real user_id, since there's
// no app account to link it to.
document.getElementById('therapistLogExternalBtn').onclick = function(){
  var name = document.getElementById('therapistExternalClientName').value.trim();
  var contact = document.getElementById('therapistExternalClientContact').value.trim();
  var timeVal = document.getElementById('therapistExternalTime').value;
  if(!name || !timeVal){
    showToast('Add at least a client name and a time.');
    return;
  }
  var timeParts = timeVal.split(':').map(Number);
  var parts = therapistCalActiveDayKey.split('-').map(Number);
  var fullDate = new Date(parts[0], parts[1]-1, parts[2], timeParts[0], timeParts[1]);

  sb.from('experts').select('role_category').eq('name', appState.therapistExpertName).limit(1).then(function(expertResult){
    var roleCategory = (expertResult.data && expertResult.data[0] && expertResult.data[0].role_category) || 'Therapist';
    sb.from('expert_bookings').insert({
      user_id: null, is_external: true, external_client_name: name, external_client_contact: contact || null,
      expert_name: appState.therapistExpertName, role_category: roleCategory,
      status: 'active', session_date: fullDate.toISOString(), payment_confirmed: true, cancellation_count: 0
    }).then(function(result){
      if(result.error){ showToast('Could not log — please try again.'); return; }
      document.getElementById('therapistExternalClientName').value = '';
      document.getElementById('therapistExternalClientContact').value = '';
      document.getElementById('therapistExternalTime').value = '';
      showToast('Logged.');
      renderTherapistClientsList();
    });
  });
};

function renderTherapistClientsList(){
  var listEl = document.getElementById('therapistClientsList');
  listEl.innerHTML = '<p style="text-align:center;color:#9AABCE;font-size:12.5px;">Loading...</p>';
  Promise.all([
    sb.from('expert_bookings').select('user_id,status,session_date,created_at,is_external,external_client_name,external_client_contact').eq('expert_name', appState.therapistExpertName).in('status', ['active','change_requested']),
    sb.from('profiles').select('user_id,name,email,therapist_expert_name')
  ]).then(function(results){
    var bookingsRes = results[0], profilesRes = results[1];
    if(bookingsRes.error){
      listEl.innerHTML = '<p style="color:#C77B7B;font-size:12px;">Could not load clients: '+bookingsRes.error.message+'</p>';
      return;
    }
    var profileByUserId = {};
    (profilesRes.data || []).forEach(function(p){ profileByUserId[p.user_id] = p; });

    // Exclude self-bookings -- i.e. bookings made by whoever actually OWNS this therapist identity
    // testing/booking themselves, not just "whoever happens to be logged in right now" (that
    // distinction matters: an admin viewing someone else's client list, for instance).
    var selfUserIds = (profilesRes.data || [])
      .filter(function(p){ return p.therapist_expert_name === appState.therapistExpertName; })
      .map(function(p){ return p.user_id; });

    var byClient = {}; // real app users, keyed by user_id
    var externalRows = []; // clients outside the app -- no stable identity to group by beyond what was typed each time
    (bookingsRes.data || []).forEach(function(b){
      if(b.is_external){
        externalRows.push(b);
        return;
      }
      if(selfUserIds.indexOf(b.user_id) !== -1) return;
      if(!byClient[b.user_id]) byClient[b.user_id] = { count: 0, latestSessionDate: null };
      byClient[b.user_id].count++;
      if(b.session_date && (!byClient[b.user_id].latestSessionDate || b.session_date > byClient[b.user_id].latestSessionDate)){
        byClient[b.user_id].latestSessionDate = b.session_date;
      }
    });

    var clientIds = Object.keys(byClient);
    if(clientIds.length === 0 && externalRows.length === 0){
      listEl.innerHTML = '<p style="text-align:center;color:#9AABCE;font-size:12.5px;">No clients connected yet.</p>';
      return;
    }
    var appClientsHtml = clientIds.map(function(uid){
      var profile = profileByUserId[uid] || {};
      var info = byClient[uid];
      var sessionText = info.latestSessionDate
        ? 'Next/latest session: ' + new Date(info.latestSessionDate).toLocaleDateString('en-IN', {day:'numeric', month:'short'})
        : (info.count + ' booking' + (info.count===1?'':'s') + ', no date set yet');
      return '<div style="background:#FFFFFF;border:1px solid #EEE0C4;border-radius:12px;padding:11px 13px;margin-bottom:7px;">'+
        '<p style="font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;color:#2A2013;margin:0 0 2px;">'+(profile.name||'Unknown client')+'</p>'+
        '<p style="font-size:11px;color:#5C6B94;margin:0 0 2px;">'+(profile.email||'')+'</p>'+
        '<p style="font-size:10px;color:#9AABCE;margin:0;">'+sessionText+'</p>'+
        '</div>';

NEW (exact):
```
function handleNotificationTap(notifData){
  var type = notifData && notifData.type;
  if(type === 'app_update' && notifData.url){
    // Open the APK link directly so the browser/download manager takes over -- not an in-app screen.
    window.open(notifData.url, '_system');
  } else if(type === 'book_session'){
    renderTeamList(); showOnly('panel-team'); setActiveNav('navTasks');
  } else if(type === 'task_add_reminder' || type === 'task_complete_reminder'){
    showOnly('panel-calendar'); setActiveNav('navTasks');
  } else if(type === 'mood_check'){
    showOnly('panel-bubbles'); setActiveNav('navHome');
  } else if(type === 'journal_reminder'){
    renderHistory(); showOnly('panel-history'); setActiveNav('navJournal');
  } else if(type === 'new_booking_request' && appState.isAdmin){
    openAdminDashboard();
  } else if((type === 'therapist_assignment' || type === 'session_confirmed' || type === 'session_time_proposed') && appState.userHasTherapist){
    // Client-facing booking-lifecycle notifications -- land on their Profile, where the
    // Therapist card shows exactly what state they're in (pick a time / pay now / confirmed).
    renderProfile(); showOnly('panel-profile'); setActiveNav('navYou');
  } else if((type === 'new_client_connected' || type === 'session_booked_alert') && appState.isTherapist){
    openTherapistDashboard();
  } else {
    // Genuinely no specific destination for this type (or type wasn't set on an older/manual
    // send) -- land safely on Home rather than guessing wrong.
    showOnly('panel-bubbles');
    setActiveNav('navHome');
  }
  if(notifData && notifData.notification_id) markNotificationOpened(notifData.notification_id);
}
```

      listEl.innerHTML = rows.map(function(r){
        var log = r.notification_log || {};
        var when = new Date(r.sent_at).toLocaleString('en-IN', { dateStyle:'medium', timeStyle:'short' });
        var unreadDot = !r.opened_at ? '<span style="display:inline-block;width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:#FDB913;margin-right:6px;"></span>' : '';
        return '<div class="my-notif-row" data-notif-id="'+r.notification_id+'" data-nav="'+encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify(log.data||{}))+'" style="padding:11px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #F5F0E4;cursor:pointer;">'+
          '<p style="font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:#2A2013;margin:0 0 3px;">'+unreadDot+(log.title||'HOBS Companion')+'</p>'+
          '<p style="font-size:11.5px;color:#5C6B94;margin:0 0 4px;">'+(log.body||'')+'</p>'+
          '<p style="font-size:10px;color:#9AABCE;margin:0;">'+when+'</p>'+
          '</div>';
      }).join('');
      listEl.querySelectorAll('.my-notif-row').forEach(function(row){
        row.onclick = function(){
          // This used to only mark the notification read and clear the dot -- it never actually
          // took the person anywhere, even though tapping a real push notification (for the
          // same underlying event) did navigate. Now both paths go through the same routing
          // logic, closing the inbox modal first so the destination is actually visible.
          var navData;
          try { navData = JSON.parse(decodeURIComponent(row.dataset.nav)); } catch(e) { navData = {}; }
          navData.notification_id = row.dataset.notifId;
          document.getElementById('myNotifInboxBackdrop').style.display = 'none';
          document.getElementById('myNotifInboxModal').style.display = 'none';
          handleNotificationTap(navData);
        };
      });
```

document.getElementById('obSaveBtn').onclick = function(){
  var name = document.getElementById('obName').value.trim();
  var phone = document.getElementById('obPhone').value.trim();
  var dob = document.getElementById('obDob').value;
  var chipsWrap = document.getElementById('obPronounChips');
  var selected = chipsWrap.dataset.selected;
  var pronouns = selected === 'Self-describe' ? document.getElementById('obPronounCustom').value.trim() : selected;

  var errEl = document.getElementById('obError');
  if(!name || !pronouns || !phone || !dob){
    errEl.textContent = 'Please fill in all four fields to continue.';
    errEl.style.display = 'block';
    return;
  }

  var btn = document.getElementById('obSaveBtn');
  btn.textContent = 'Saving...'; btn.disabled = true;

  var updatePayload = {
    name: name, pronouns: pronouns, phone_number: phone, date_of_birth: dob, onboarding_complete: true, email: currentUser.email
  };
  if(justSignedUpWithChecksConfirmed){
    updatePayload.basic_tos_signed = true;
  }
  sb.from('profiles').update(updatePayload).eq('user_id', currentUser.id).then(function(result){
    btn.textContent = 'Continue'; btn.disabled = false;
    if(result.error){
      errEl.textContent = 'Could not save — check your connection and try again.';
      errEl.style.display = 'block';
      return;
    }
    appState.displayName = name;
    appState.pronouns = pronouns;
    appState.phoneNumber = phone;
    appState.dateOfBirth = dob;
    appState.onboardingComplete = true;
    if(justSignedUpWithChecksConfirmed){
      appState.basicTosSigned = true;
      justSignedUpWithChecksConfirmed = false;
    }
    document.getElementById('onboardingOverlay').style.display = 'none';
    if(!appState.basicTosSigned){
      // Also closes a real gap: Google OAuth signups never saw the email/password signup
      // screen's checkboxes, so this is their actual first checkpoint for this.
      showBasicTosGate();
    } else if(!appState.hasSeenIntro){
      showWalkthrough();
    } else {
      renderHomeGreeting();
    }
  });

  // clinical consent form when assigned a therapist), and date of birth was collecting more
  // than the actual purpose needed -- there's already a separate 18+ confirmation checkbox at
  // signup that does the real job an exact birthdate isn't necessary for.
  var updatePayload = { onboarding_complete: true, email: currentUser.email };
  if(name) updatePayload.name = name;
  if(pronouns) updatePayload.pronouns = pronouns;
  if(justSignedUpWithChecksConfirmed){
    updatePayload.basic_tos_signed = true;
  }
  sb.from('profiles').update(updatePayload).eq('user_id', currentUser.id).then(function(result){
    btn.textContent = 'Continue'; btn.disabled = false;
    if(result.error){
      errEl.textContent = 'Could not save — check your connection and try again.';
      errEl.style.display = 'block';
      return;
    }
    if(name) appState.displayName = name;
    if(pronouns) appState.pronouns = pronouns;
    appState.onboardingComplete = true;
    if(justSignedUpWithChecksConfirmed){
      appState.basicTosSigned = true;
      justSignedUpWithChecksConfirmed = false;
    }
    document.getElementById('onboardingOverlay').style.display = 'none';
    if(!appState.basicTosSigned){
      // Also closes a real gap: Google OAuth signups never saw the email/password signup
      // screen's checkboxes, so this is their actual first checkpoint for this.
      showBasicTosGate();
    } else if(!appState.hasSeenIntro){
      showWalkthrough();
    } else {
      renderHomeGreeting();
    }
  });

function getDisplayName(){
  if(appState.displayName) return appState.displayName.split(' ')[0];
  if(!currentUser) return '';
  var meta = currentUser.user_metadata || {};
  var full = meta.full_name || meta.name || '';
  if(full) return full.split(' ')[0];
  // Used to fall back to the email prefix here, but now that skipping the name field is
  // common and actively encouraged (not an edge case), showing someone's raw email-derived
  // string as their "name" throughout the app is worse than just having no name -- every
  // caller of this function already has its own graceful fallback (e.g. "You") for an empty
  // string, which reads better than an arbitrary email handle.
  return '';
}
```

```
function addSheetSubtaskRow(prefillText, existingId){
  var area = document.getElementById('sheetSubtaskArea');
  var existingAddBtn = document.getElementById('sheetAddStepBtn');
  if(existingAddBtn) existingAddBtn.remove();
  var stepNum = area.querySelectorAll('textarea').length + 1;
  var row = document.createElement('div');
  row.style.cssText = 'display:flex;gap:6px;margin-bottom:6px;align-items:flex-start;';
  if(existingId) row.dataset.subtaskId = existingId;
  // This used to be a single-line <input>, which was a real, separate instance of the same bug
  // fixed elsewhere in the app: long text scrolls out of view instead of wrapping, even though
  // it's all still saved correctly. This is the sheet where subtasks actually get typed in the
  // first place, so it's arguably the most important place to have gotten this right.
  var input = document.createElement('textarea');
  input.rows = 1;
  input.placeholder = 'Step ' + stepNum + '...';
  if(prefillText) input.value = prefillText;
  input.style.cssText = 'flex:1;border:1px solid #EEE0C4;border-radius:10px;padding:9px 10px;font-size:12.5px;font-family:inherit;resize:none;overflow:hidden;line-height:1.4;box-sizing:border-box;';
  var autoGrow = function(){ input.style.height = 'auto'; input.style.height = input.scrollHeight + 'px'; };
  input.addEventListener('input', autoGrow);
  input.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){ if(e.key === 'Enter'){ e.preventDefault(); addSheetSubtaskRow(); } });
  row.appendChild(input);
  var delBtn = document.createElement('button');
  delBtn.innerHTML = '&times;';
  delBtn.style.cssText = 'background:none;border:none;color:#C7BFA8;font-size:16px;cursor:pointer;padding:6px 4px 0;line-height:1;flex-shrink:0;';
  delBtn.onclick = function(){ row.remove(); renumberSheetSteps(); };
  row.appendChild(delBtn);
  area.appendChild(row);
  var addMoreBtn = document.createElement('button');
  addMoreBtn.id = 'sheetAddStepBtn';
  addMoreBtn.textContent = '+ Add another step';
  addMoreBtn.style.cssText = 'background:none;border:none;color:#6690D6;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;padding:2px 0;';
  addMoreBtn.onclick = function(){ addSheetSubtaskRow(); };
  area.appendChild(addMoreBtn);
  if(prefillText) autoGrow(); // resize to fit pre-loaded text when editing an existing step
  if(!prefillText) input.focus(); // don't steal focus away when pre-populating existing steps for an edit
  return row;
}
function renumberSheetSteps(){
  var inputs = document.querySelectorAll('#sheetSubtaskArea textarea');
  inputs.forEach(function(inp, i){
    if(!inp.value) inp.placeholder = 'Step ' + (i+1) + '...';
  });
```

function renderTaskListCal(){
  var listEl = document.getElementById('taskListCal');
  var tasks = getTasks(activeDayKey);
  // Completed tasks now move to their own section at the end, separate from priority zones,
  // instead of staying inline wherever they happened to be -- easier to see what's actually
  // still outstanding today, and completed tasks don't visually compete for attention.
  var activeTasks = tasks.filter(function(t){ return !t.done; });
  var completedTasks = tasks.filter(function(t){ return t.done; });
  var sortByPriority = function(a, b){
    var ai = PRIORITY_ORDER.indexOf(a.priority || null);
    var bi = PRIORITY_ORDER.indexOf(b.priority || null);
    if(ai !== bi) return ai - bi;
    return (a.sortOrder || 0) - (b.sortOrder || 0);
  };
  activeTasks.sort(sortByPriority);
  completedTasks.sort(sortByPriority);
  var sorted = activeTasks.concat(completedTasks);
  listEl.innerHTML = '';
  var lastPriorityShown = undefined;
  var completedHeaderShown = false;
  sorted.forEach(function(task){
    var thisPriority = task.priority || null;
    if(task.done && !completedHeaderShown){
      var completedLabel = document.createElement('p');
      completedLabel.className = 'task-priority-zone-label';
      completedLabel.textContent = '✓ Completed';
      completedLabel.style.cssText = 'font-size:10px;font-weight:700;color:#3B8F63;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.04em;margin:20px 0 6px;';
      listEl.appendChild(completedLabel);
      completedHeaderShown = true;
      lastPriorityShown = undefined; // reset so the first completed task's own priority zone label (if any) doesn't get suppressed by whatever was last shown among active tasks
    } else if(!task.done && thisPriority !== lastPriorityShown && activeTasks.some(function(t){ return (t.priority||null) !== (activeTasks[0].priority||null); })){
      var zoneLabel = document.createElement('p');
      zoneLabel.className = 'task-priority-zone-label';
      zoneLabel.textContent = PRIORITY_LABELS[thisPriority === null ? 'null' : thisPriority];
      zoneLabel.style.cssText = 'font-size:10px;font-weight:700;color:'+(thisPriority?PRIORITY_COLORS[thisPriority]:'#B0AA98')+';text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.04em;margin:14px 0 6px;';
      listEl.appendChild(zoneLabel);
      lastPriorityShown = thisPriority;
    }
```

NEW (exact):
```
function toggleTaskCal(taskId){
  var task = getTasks(activeDayKey).find(function(t){ return t.id === taskId; });
  task.done = !task.done;

  // Real bug found from a live screenshot: this used to just flip task.done in isolation, with
  // zero regard for subtask state. For a task with subtasks, that let task.done become true
  // while a subtask was still false -- and the render logic (reasonably) trusts task.done to
  // decide whether to show the WHOLE task under Completed with ALL subtasks, unfiltered. The
  // result was exactly what the screenshot showed: a task sitting fully under Completed with
  // an unchecked subtask still visible inside it. Fixed at the source: tapping the row on a
  // task WITH subtasks now cascades the same done-value to every subtask too, so task.done can
  // never again say something the subtasks don't actually agree with.
  var cascadedSubtaskIds = [];
  if(task.subtasks && task.subtasks.length > 0){
    task.subtasks.forEach(function(s){
      if(s.done !== task.done){ s.done = task.done; cascadedSubtaskIds.push(s.id); }
    });
  }

  saveState(); renderTaskListCal();
  if(String(taskId).indexOf('temp_') !== 0){
    sb.from('tasks').update({ done: task.done }).eq('id', taskId).then(function(r){ if(r.error) console.error(r.error); });
  }
  cascadedSubtaskIds.forEach(function(subId){
    if(String(subId).indexOf('temp_') !== 0){
      sb.from('subtasks').update({ done: task.done }).eq('id', subId).then(function(r){ if(r.error) console.error(r.error); });
    }
  });

  if(task.done){
    trackNotificationAction('completed_task');
    logAnalyticsEvent('task_completed');
    var newBadge = checkAchievements();
    if(newBadge) showAchievement(newBadge, function(){ showCelebration(task); });
    else showCelebration(task);
  }
}
```

function isTaskGenuinelyDone(t){
  // A task with subtasks is only genuinely done if every subtask actually is -- task.done alone
  // isn't trustworthy on its own for a task with subtasks, since it can (or could, before the
  // toggle-cascade fix) disagree with the subtasks. Used here and in the render/grouping logic
  // so credits and what's shown as "Completed" never disagree with each other.
  if(t.subtasks && t.subtasks.length > 0){
    return t.subtasks.every(function(s){ return s.done; });
  }
  return !!t.done;
}
function completedTasksOnDate(key){

}

NEW (exact):
```
function renderCalendarPendingTasks(){
  var wrap = document.getElementById('calendarPendingTasks');
  var pending = [], completed = [];
  Object.keys(appState.tasksByDate || {}).forEach(function(dateKey){
    (appState.tasksByDate[dateKey] || []).forEach(function(t){
      (isTaskGenuinelyDone(t) ? completed : pending).push({ task: t, dateKey: dateKey });
    });
  });
  if(pending.length === 0 && completed.length === 0){
    wrap.innerHTML = '<p style="text-align:center;font-size:12px;color:#B0AA98;padding:10px 0;">Nothing here yet.</p>';
    return;
  }
  var buildRow = function(item, isDone){
    var parts = item.dateKey.split('-').map(Number);
    var dObj = new Date(parts[0], parts[1]-1, parts[2]);
    var dateLabel = dObj.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month:'short', day:'numeric' });
    var homeworkBadge = item.task.assignedByTherapist
      ? '<div style="font-size:9.5px;font-weight:700;color:#6690D6;margin-top:3px;">📋 Homework from '+item.task.assignedByTherapist+'</div>'
      : '';
    var titleStyle = isDone ? 'font-size:12.5px;color:#3B8F63;font-weight:700;' : 'font-size:12.5px;color:#2A2013;font-weight:600;';
    return '<div class="pending-task-row" data-key="'+item.dateKey+'" style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;background:'+(isDone?'#EAF4EE':'#FFFFFF')+';border:1px solid '+(isDone?'#CFE8DA':(item.task.assignedByTherapist?'#D5E2F7':'#EEE0C4'))+';border-radius:12px;padding:12px 14px;margin-bottom:8px;cursor:pointer;">'+
      '<div><span style="'+titleStyle+'">'+item.task.title+'</span>'+homeworkBadge+'</div>'+
      '<span style="font-size:10.5px;color:#9AABCE;flex-shrink:0;">'+dateLabel+'</span>'+
    '</div>';
  };

  pending.sort(function(a, b){ return a.dateKey < b.dateKey ? -1 : 1; });
  completed.sort(function(a, b){ return a.dateKey < b.dateKey ? -1 : 1; });

  var html = '';
  if(pending.length === 0){
    html += '<p style="text-align:center;font-size:11.5px;color:#B0AA98;padding:6px 0 12px;">Nothing pending — you\'re all caught up.</p>';
  } else {
    html += pending.map(function(item){ return buildRow(item, false); }).join('');
  }
  if(completed.length > 0){
    html += '<p style="font-size:10px;font-weight:700;color:#3B8F63;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.04em;margin:16px 0 6px;">✓ Completed</p>';
    html += completed.map(function(item){ return buildRow(item, true); }).join('');
  }
  wrap.innerHTML = html;
  wrap.querySelectorAll('.pending-task-row').forEach(function(row){
    row.onclick = function(){ openDay(row.dataset.key); };
  });
}
```
