function renderAdminAllUsersFiltered(query){
  var listEl = document.getElementById('adminAllUsersList');
  if(!adminAllUsersCache) return;
  var q = (query || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  var unassignedOnly = document.getElementById('adminUnassignedOnlyFilter').checked;
  var activeOnlyEl = document.getElementById('adminActiveOnlyFilter');
  var activeOnly = activeOnlyEl && activeOnlyEl.checked;
  var now = new Date();
  var isRecentlyActive = function(u){
    if(!u.last_active_at) return false;
    var hoursSince = (now - new Date(u.last_active_at)) / (1000*60*60);
    return hoursSince <= 72; // "active" = used the app within the last 3 days
  };
  var users = adminAllUsersCache.users.filter(function(u){
    if(q && (u.name||'').toLowerCase().indexOf(q) === -1 && (u.email||'').toLowerCase().indexOf(q) === -1) return false;
    if(unassignedOnly){
      var connected = adminAllUsersCache.connectedCategories[u.user_id];
      if(connected && Object.keys(connected).length > 0) return false;
    }
    if(activeOnly && !isRecentlyActive(u)) return false;
    return true;
  });
  if(users.length === 0){
    listEl.innerHTML = '<p style="text-align:center;color:#9AABCE;font-size:12.5px;">No users match.</p>';
    return;
  }
  listEl.innerHTML = '<p style="font-size:10.5px;color:#9AABCE;margin:0 0 8px;">'+users.length+' user'+(users.length===1?'':'s')+'</p>' + users.map(function(u){
    var counts = adminAllUsersCache.bookingCounts[u.user_id] || { total:0, active:0 };
    var badges = '';
    if(isRecentlyActive(u)) badges += '<span style="font-size:9px;font-weight:700;color:#3B8F63;background:#EAF4EE;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:6px;margin-left:4px;">🟢 Active</span>';
    if(u.is_admin) badges += '<span style="font-size:9px;font-weight:700;color:#7B4F00;background:#FEF3D8;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:6px;margin-left:4px;">Admin</span>';
    if(u.is_therapist) badges += '<span style="font-size:9px;font-weight:700;color:#3B8F63;background:#EAF4EE;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:6px;margin-left:4px;">Therapist</span>';
    if(!u.onboarding_complete) badges += '<span style="font-size:9px;font-weight:700;color:#9AABCE;background:#F5F0E4;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:6px;margin-left:4px;">Onboarding incomplete</span>';
    var joined = u.created_at ? new Date(u.created_at).toLocaleDateString('en-IN', {day:'numeric', month:'short', year:'numeric'}) : 'unknown';
    var lastActiveText = u.last_active_at ? ('Last active ' + new Date(u.last_active_at).toLocaleDateString('en-IN', {day:'numeric', month:'short'})) : 'Never opened the app';
    var bookingText = counts.total === 0 ? 'No bookings yet' : (counts.active + ' active, ' + counts.total + ' total booking' + (counts.total===1?'':'s'));
    return '<div class="admin-user-row" data-user-id="'+u.user_id+'" style="background:#FFFFFF;border:1px solid #EEE0C4;border-radius:12px;padding:11px 13px;margin-bottom:7px;cursor:pointer;">'+
      '<p style="font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;color:#2A2013;margin:0 0 2px;">'+(u.name||'(no name set)')+badges+'</p>'+
      '<p style="font-size:11px;color:#5C6B94;margin:0 0 2px;">'+(u.email||'')+'</p>'+
      '<p style="font-size:10px;color:#9AABCE;margin:0;">Joined '+joined+' · '+lastActiveText+' · '+bookingText+'</p>'+
      '</div>';
  }).join('');
  listEl.querySelectorAll('.admin-user-row').forEach(function(row){
    row.onclick = function(){ showAdminUserProfile(row.dataset.userId); };
  });

  /don'?t\s+want\s+to\s+(be\s+here|live|exist|wake\s+up)/i, /wish\s+i\s+(could\s+)?disappear/i,
  /wonder(ing)?\s+what\s+it\s+(would\s+be\s+|'?s?\s+)?like\s+to\s+(just\s+)?(not\s+exist|die|be\s+dead)/i,
  /wish(ed|ing)?\s+i\s+(could\s+)?(just\s+)?(disappear|not\s+exist|stop\s+existing|vanish)/i,
  /(want(ed|ing)?\s+to|wanna)\s+(disappear|not\s+exist|stop\s+existing|vanish)/i,
  /wish\s+i\s+(was|were)\s+never\s+born/i, /(fade|drift)\s+away\s+forever/i,
  /just\s+want(ed)?\s+(it|everything)\s+to\s+stop/i, /wish\s+(this|it)\s+would\s+just\s+end/i,
  // Burden / worthlessness
  /(everyone|everybody|they)\s+('?d|would)\s+be\s+better\s+(off\s+)?without\s+me/i,
  /(i'?m|i\s+am)\s+(such\s+a\s+)?burden/i, /no\s?one\s+(would\s+)?(miss|need)s?\s+me/i,
  /world\s+would\s+be\s+(quieter|better|easier)\s+without\s+me/i,
  // Farewell / finality signals
  /this\s+is\s+(my\s+)?goodbye/i, /say(ing)?\s+goodbye\s+to\s+everyone/i,
  /won'?t\s+be\s+(here|around)\s+much\s+longer/i, /running\s+out\s+of\s+time/i,
  /(last|final)\s+(entry|time|goodbye|letter)/i, /giving\s+away\s+(my\s+)?(things|stuff|belongings)/i,
  // Hopelessness / absolutist language (research-backed marker even without explicit death mention)
  /nothing\s+will\s+ever\s+(get\s+better|change|matter)/i, /no\s+point\s+(in\s+)?(anymore|any\s?more|trying)/i,
  /no\s+reason\s+to\s+(live|keep\s+going|go\s+on)/i, /(no|can'?t\s+see\s+a)\s+way\s+out/i,
  /trapped\s+forever/i, /can'?t\s+go\s+on/i, /can'?t\s+(take|do)\s+this\s+any\s?more/i,
  /(so\s+)?tired\s+of\s+(living|life|everything|trying|existing)/i, /done\s+with\s+(life|everything)/i,
  /better\s+off\s+dead/i,
  // Void / emptiness / disappearing themes common in indirect poetic language
  /(swallowed|consumed)\s+by\s+(the\s+)?(dark|void|emptiness)/i, /empty\s+inside\s+forever/i,
  /nothing\s+left\s+(in|of)\s+me/i,
  // Real phrasing caught from an actual journal entry during this fix -- grief/loneliness framed
  // as being seen as "a monster," feeling abandoned after being someone else's support, and
  // wondering if anyone would grieve. Not as directly explicit as the other patterns, but this
  // combination of themes (isolation + being punished for one's own pain + wondering about being
  // grieved) is exactly the kind of indirect expression the keyword layer is weakest at, and
  // exactly the kind of thing the AI layer is meant to catch when the keyword layer doesn't.
  /will\s+anyone\s+grieve\s+when\s+i\s?('?m|\s+am)\s+gone/i,
  /when\s+i\s?('?m|\s+am)\s+gone/i
];
function containsSelfHarmSignal(text){
  if(!text || !text.trim()) return false;
  return SELF_HARM_SIGNAL_PATTERNS.some(function(re){ return re.test(text); });
}

function showAdminStatDetail(title, definition, rows, emptyMessage){
  document.getElementById('adminStatDetailTitle').textContent = title;
  document.getElementById('adminStatDetailDefinition').textContent = definition;
  var listEl = document.getElementById('adminStatDetailList');
  if(!rows || rows.length === 0){
    listEl.innerHTML = '<p style="text-align:center;color:#9AABCE;font-size:12px;">'+emptyMessage+'</p>';
  } else {
    // These rows used to be plain, non-clickable text -- Akash was explicit that clicking a
    // name anywhere in the dashboard should show their real profile, and this drill-down list
    // (reached by tapping a stat tile like "Active Bookings") was a real gap where names were
    // shown but led nowhere.
    listEl.innerHTML = rows.map(function(row, i){
      var clickable = !!row.userId;
      return '<div class="admin-stat-detail-row" data-idx="'+i+'" style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:9px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #F5F0E4;'+(clickable?'cursor:pointer;':'')+'">'+
        '<div><p style="font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;color:'+(clickable?'#6690D6':'#2A2013')+';margin:0;'+(clickable?'text-decoration:underline;':'')+'">'+row.primary+'</p>'+
        (row.secondary ? '<p style="font-size:10.5px;color:#9AABCE;margin:0;">'+row.secondary+'</p>' : '')+'</div>'+
        (row.tag ? '<span style="font-size:10.5px;font-weight:700;color:'+(row.tagColor||'#6690D6')+';white-space:nowrap;margin-left:8px;">'+row.tag+'</span>' : '')+
        '</div>';
    }).join('');
    listEl.querySelectorAll('.admin-stat-detail-row').forEach(function(rowEl){
      var rowData = rows[parseInt(rowEl.dataset.idx, 10)];
      if(rowData.userId){
        rowEl.onclick = function(){
          document.getElementById('adminStatDetailModalBackdrop').style.display = 'none';
          document.getElementById('adminStatDetailModal').style.display = 'none';
          showAdminUserProfile(rowData.userId);
        };
      }
    });
  }
  document.getElementById('adminStatDetailModalBackdrop').style.display = 'block';
  document.getElementById('adminStatDetailModal').style.display = 'block';
}
```

// Populates "Who is this appointment for?" with three kinds of options: real clients already
// assigned to this therapist (selecting one updates THEIR existing booking directly, no
// duplicate created), previously-saved external contacts (people not on the app, reusable
// across sessions instead of re-typing every time), and an option to add a new external contact.
function populateTherapistLogWhoSelect(){
  var sel = document.getElementById('therapistLogWhoSelect');
  sel.innerHTML = '<option value="">Loading…</option>';
  Promise.all([
    sb.from('expert_bookings').select('user_id,status').eq('expert_name', appState.therapistExpertName).eq('status', 'active'),
    sb.from('profiles').select('user_id,name'),
    sb.from('therapist_external_clients').select('*').eq('therapist_expert_name', appState.therapistExpertName).order('name')
  ]).then(function(results){
    var bookingsRes = results[0], profilesRes = results[1], externalRes = results[2];
    var nameByUserId = {};
    (profilesRes.data || []).forEach(function(p){ nameByUserId[p.user_id] = p.name; });
    var clientOptions = (bookingsRes.data || [])
      .map(function(b){ return { userId: b.user_id, name: nameByUserId[b.user_id] || 'Unnamed client' }; });
    var externalOptions = externalRes.data || [];

    var html = '<option value="">Who is this appointment for?</option>';
    if(clientOptions.length > 0){
      html += '<optgroup label="Your clients on HOBS">' + clientOptions.map(function(c){
        return '<option value="client:'+c.userId+'">'+c.name+'</option>';
      }).join('') + '</optgroup>';
    }
    if(externalOptions.length > 0){
      html += '<optgroup label="Saved contacts (not on HOBS)">' + externalOptions.map(function(e){
        return '<option value="external:'+e.id+'">'+e.name+'</option>';
      }).join('') + '</optgroup>';
    }
    html += '<option value="__new__">+ Add a new contact (not on HOBS)</option>';
    sel.innerHTML = html;
  });
}
document.getElementById('therapistLogWhoSelect').onchange = function(){
  document.getElementById('therapistNewExternalContactForm').style.display = (this.value === '__new__') ? 'block' : 'none';
};
document.getElementById('therapistSaveExternalContactBtn').onclick = function(){
  var name = document.getElementById('therapistExternalClientName').value.trim();
  if(!name){ showToast('Add at least a name.'); return; }
  var payload = {
    therapist_expert_name: appState.therapistExpertName, name: name,
    email: document.getElementById('therapistExternalClientEmail').value.trim() || null,
    contact: document.getElementById('therapistExternalClientContact').value.trim() || null,
    emergency_contact_name: document.getElementById('therapistExternalEmergencyName').value.trim() || null,
    emergency_contact_phone: document.getElementById('therapistExternalEmergencyPhone').value.trim() || null
  };
  sb.from('therapist_external_clients').insert(payload).select().single().then(function(result){
    if(result.error){ showToast('Could not save — please try again.'); return; }
    showToast('Contact saved.');
    document.getElementById('therapistNewExternalContactForm').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('therapistExternalClientName').value = '';
    document.getElementById('therapistExternalClientEmail').value = '';
    document.getElementById('therapistExternalClientContact').value = '';
    document.getElementById('therapistExternalEmergencyName').value = '';
    document.getElementById('therapistExternalEmergencyPhone').value = '';
    populateTherapistLogWhoSelect();
    // Re-select the contact just created, once the dropdown finishes repopulating.
    setTimeout(function(){
      document.getElementById('therapistLogWhoSelect').value = 'external:' + result.data.id;
    }, 400);
  });
};

// Tapping a client's name in My Clients opens this -- lets a therapist directly set or change
// that client's next session time, same underlying update Log Appointment does, just reached
// from the client's own row instead of a specific calendar day.
function openTherapistScheduleEdit(userId, bookingId, name, currentSessionDate){
  document.getElementById('therapistScheduleEditName').textContent = 'Edit schedule — ' + name;
  document.getElementById('therapistScheduleEditPaymentNote').value = '';
  if(currentSessionDate){
    var d = new Date(currentSessionDate);
    document.getElementById('therapistScheduleEditDate').value = d.getFullYear()+'-'+pad2(d.getMonth()+1)+'-'+pad2(d.getDate());
    document.getElementById('therapistScheduleEditTime').value = pad2(d.getHours())+':'+pad2(d.getMinutes());
  } else {
    document.getElementById('therapistScheduleEditDate').value = '';
    document.getElementById('therapistScheduleEditTime').value = '';
  }
  document.getElementById('therapistScheduleEditSaveBtn').dataset.userId = userId || '';
  document.getElementById('therapistScheduleEditSaveBtn').dataset.bookingId = bookingId || '';
  document.getElementById('therapistScheduleEditBackdrop').style.display = 'block';
  document.getElementById('therapistScheduleEditModal').style.display = 'block';
}
document.getElementById('therapistScheduleEditCloseBtn').onclick = function(){
  document.getElementById('therapistScheduleEditBackdrop').style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('therapistScheduleEditModal').style.display = 'none';
};
document.getElementById('therapistScheduleEditBackdrop').onclick = document.getElementById('therapistScheduleEditCloseBtn').onclick;
document.getElementById('therapistScheduleEditSaveBtn').onclick = function(){
  var dateVal = document.getElementById('therapistScheduleEditDate').value;
  var timeVal = document.getElementById('therapistScheduleEditTime').value;
  if(!dateVal || !timeVal){ showToast('Pick both a date and a time.'); return; }
  var fullDate = new Date(dateVal + 'T' + timeVal);
  var paymentNote = document.getElementById('therapistScheduleEditPaymentNote').value.trim() || null;
  var userId = this.dataset.userId;
  var bookingId = this.dataset.bookingId;
  var btn = this;
  btn.disabled = true;

  var updatePayload = { session_date: fullDate.toISOString(), time_request_status: 'accepted', requested_session_date: null };
  // Same session logic as Log Appointment -- changing the schedule re-opens payment for admin
  // review rather than silently leaving whatever confirmation status was there before, since a
  // changed time is effectively a new session.
  if(paymentNote){
    updatePayload.payment_confirmed = false;
    updatePayload.payment_note = paymentNote;
  }

  var query = userId
    ? sb.from('expert_bookings').update(updatePayload).eq('expert_name', appState.therapistExpertName).eq('user_id', userId).eq('status', 'active')
    : sb.from('expert_bookings').update(updatePayload).eq('id', bookingId);

  query.then(function(result){
    btn.disabled = false;
    if(result.error){ showToast('Could not save — please try again.'); return; }
    document.getElementById('therapistScheduleEditBackdrop').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('therapistScheduleEditModal').style.display = 'none';
    showToast('Schedule updated.');
    renderTherapistClientsList();
  });
};
```

- when: 2026-07-13T21:16:43.768157Z
- chat: C26-AppContinuation

- file: `/home/claude/work/cache_fix_working.html`
- result: applied
- Claude's words just before this edit: "Let's add the version-check mechanism right at the top of this script, before anything else runs."

OLD (exact):
```
<script>
// ---- Persisted app state (localStorage stands in for a real backend/account here) ----
```

NEW (exact):
```
<script>
// ---- Auto-update check ----
// The real problem this solves: this app loads live from GitHub Pages inside a Capacitor
// WebView, and Android's WebView caches the page aggressively enough that even a fresh app
// launch could still show a stale version -- only a full force-close seemed to reliably clear
// enough cache to fetch new content. This checks a tiny, always-fresh version marker (bypassing
// cache itself via a cache-busting query param) both on load AND whenever the app comes back to
// the foreground -- not just on a cold launch -- so an update shows up the next time someone
// glances at the app, not only after they've force-closed it.
(function(){
  var CURRENT_BUILD = '__BUILD_VERSION__';
  function checkForUpdate(){
    fetch('version.json?t=' + Date.now(), { cache: 'no-store' })
      .then(function(r){ return r.json(); })
      .then(function(data){
        if(data && data.build && data.build !== CURRENT_BUILD){
          // Force a genuinely fresh fetch, not a cached reload -- appending a cache-busting
          // param so the WebView can't serve this specific request from its HTTP cache either.
          window.location.href = window.location.pathname + '?v=' + data.build;
        }
      })
      .catch(function(){}); // best-effort -- never block the app loading over this
  }
  checkForUpdate();
  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', function(){
    if(document.visibilityState === 'visible') checkForUpdate();
  });
  // Capacitor's own resume event fires reliably on Android when the app comes back to the
  // foreground, which is a stronger signal than visibilitychange alone inside a WebView.
  document.addEventListener('resume', checkForUpdate, false);
})();

// ---- Persisted app state (localStorage stands in for a real backend/account here) ----
```

NEW (exact):

(function(){
  var CURRENT_BUILD = '20260713211700';
  function checkForUpdate(){
    // Safety guard: reload AT MOST ONCE per session, no matter what. Without this, a mistake
    // where version.json and the HTML's own build ID get out of sync (e.g. one gets updated
    // and the other is forgotten on some future deploy) would reload the app forever in a loop
    // -- completely unacceptable for a mental health app real people depend on. One missed
    // update is a minor inconvenience; an infinite reload loop is not.
    if(sessionStorage.getItem('hobs_already_checked_for_update')) return;
    fetch('version.json?t=' + Date.now(), { cache: 'no-store' })
      .then(function(r){ return r.json(); })
      .then(function(data){
        if(data && data.build && data.build !== CURRENT_BUILD){
          sessionStorage.setItem('hobs_already_checked_for_update', '1');
          // Force a genuinely fresh fetch, not a cached reload -- appending a cache-busting
          // param so the WebView can't serve this specific request from its HTTP cache either.
          window.location.href = window.location.pathname + '?v=' + data.build;
        }
      })
      .catch(function(){}); // best-effort -- never block the app loading over this
  }
  checkForUpdate();
  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', function(){
    if(document.visibilityState === 'visible') checkForUpdate();
  });
  // Capacitor's own resume event fires reliably on Android when the app comes back to the
  // foreground, which is a stronger signal than visibilitychange alone inside a WebView.
  document.addEventListener('resume', checkForUpdate, false);
})();
```

  checkForUpdate();
  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', function(){
    if(document.visibilityState === 'visible') checkForUpdate();
  });
  // This was the actual bug behind "still had to reopen the app" -- document.addEventListener
  // ('resume', ...) is the old Cordova convention and does nothing at all in modern Capacitor
  // (confirmed @capacitor/app v8 is what's actually installed here). The real API for this is
  // through the Capacitor plugin bridge. window.Capacitor only exists when actually running
  // inside the native shell (not in a plain browser), so this is guarded for that.
  if(window.Capacitor && window.Capacitor.Plugins && window.Capacitor.Plugins.App){
    window.Capacitor.Plugins.App.addListener('resume', checkForUpdate);
  }

NEW (exact):
```
function setActiveNav(which){
  ['navHome','navTasks','navJournal','navBreathe','navYou'].forEach(function(id){ document.getElementById(id).classList.remove('active'); });
  document.getElementById(which).classList.add('active');
}

// ================= ASSISTANT: Bob, Kunnu, Po, Cookie =================
// A rule-based command router, not an AI/LLM -- entirely free, entirely on-device, nothing
// ever leaves the app. This is deliberate: navigation and simple actions have a right answer,
// which pattern matching handles reliably and safely; open conversation (journaling, real
// emotional support) is explicitly NOT what this replaces -- the reflective act of writing or
// checking in is the point, not something to route around. Each character owns a real
// functional domain, matched to who they are, not assigned arbitrarily:
//   Bob (Robin Williams the person, not just his roles -- warmth that knows real pain) --
//     the default/general face: mood, home, breathe, anything open-ended or unmatched.
//   Kunnu (Kakeru from Orange, Finch from All the Bright Places, Charlie from Perks --
//     magnetic, attuned to others, hides her own suffering) -- connection: booking a
//     professional, sharing entries, support groups.
//   Po (neurodivergent, queer -- Akash's own lived experience) -- the practical,
//     get-it-done layer: tasks, calendar, scheduling, logging appointments. Direct, no fluff.
//   Cookie (Naruto -- relentless belief in people, loyalty, hype) -- progress and motivation:
//     stats, streaks, "how am I doing," admin numbers worth celebrating.
var ASSISTANT_CHARACTERS = {
  bob: { name: 'Bob', img: 'bob.png' },
  kunnu: { name: 'Kunnu', img: 'kunnu.png' },
  po: { name: 'Po', img: 'po.png' },
  cookie: { name: 'Cookie', img: 'cookie.png' }
};

function assistantGoTo(panelFn, navId){
  return function(){
    document.getElementById('assistantModalBackdrop').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('assistantModal').style.display = 'none';
    panelFn();
    if(navId) setActiveNav(navId);
  };
}

var ASSISTANT_COMMANDS = [
  // ---- Bob: general / home / mood / breathe ----
  { character: 'bob', patterns: [/\bmood\b/i, /how (am|are) i (feeling|doing)/i, /check.?in/i],
    reply: "Let's see where you're at right now.", action: assistantGoTo(function(){ showOnly('panel-bubbles'); }, 'navHome') },
  { character: 'bob', patterns: [/breathe/i, /\bcalm\b/i, /overwhelm/i, /ground/i],
    reply: "Come breathe with me for a second.", action: assistantGoTo(function(){ showOnly('panel-breathe'); }, 'navBreathe') },
  { character: 'bob', patterns: [/\bhome\b/i],
    reply: "Right here.", action: assistantGoTo(function(){ showOnly('panel-bubbles'); }, 'navHome') },

  // ---- Kunnu: connection ----
  { character: 'kunnu', patterns: [/connect/i, /\btherapist\b/i, /book.*(session|professional|someone)/i, /find.*(help|therapist|someone)/i],
    reply: "Let's get you someone to actually talk to.", action: assistantGoTo(function(){ renderTeamList(); showOnly('panel-team'); }, 'navYou') },
  { character: 'kunnu', patterns: [/\bshare\b/i, /entries/i],
    reply: "Let's find what you want to share.", action: assistantGoTo(function(){ renderHistory(); showOnly('panel-history'); }, 'navJournal') },
  { character: 'kunnu', patterns: [/support group/i, /group session/i],
    reply: "You don't have to do this one alone either.", action: assistantGoTo(function(){ showOnly('panel-calendar'); renderCalendar(); }, 'navTasks') },

  // ---- Po: practical / tasks / calendar / scheduling ----
  { character: 'po', patterns: [/\bjournal\b/i, /\bwrite\b/i, /write.*(down|entry)/i],
    reply: "Say less — here you go.", action: assistantGoTo(function(){ showOnly('panel-journal'); }, 'navJournal') },
  { character: 'po', patterns: [/\btask\b/i, /\bcalendar\b/i, /\bschedule\b/i, /to.?do/i],
    reply: "On it.", action: assistantGoTo(function(){ showOnly('panel-calendar'); renderCalendar(); }, 'navTasks') },
  { character: 'po', patterns: [/log.*(appointment|session)/i],
    reply: null, // handled specially below -- attempts to parse a name and time
    action: 'LOG_APPOINTMENT' },
  { character: 'po', patterns: [/my clients/i],
    reply: "Here's everyone you've got.", action: assistantGoTo(function(){ openTherapistDashboard(); }, 'navYou') },
  { character: 'po', patterns: [/time request/i, /waiting on (me|you)/i],
    reply: "Let's clear those out.", action: assistantGoTo(function(){ openTherapistDashboard(); renderTherapistTimeRequests(); }, 'navYou') },
  { character: 'po', patterns: [/admin/i, /booking dashboard/i],
    reply: "Dashboard, coming up.", action: assistantGoTo(function(){ openAdminDashboard(); }, 'navYou') },
  { character: 'po', patterns: [/unconfirmed/i, /unpaid/i, /waiting on payment/i],
    reply: "Let's see what's still unpaid.", action: assistantGoTo(function(){ openAdminDashboard(); setTimeout(function(){ var t = document.querySelector('[data-stat="unconfirmed"]'); if(t) t.click(); }, 800); }, 'navYou') },

  // ---- Cookie: progress / motivation / stats ----
  { character: 'cookie', patterns: [/how am i doing/i, /this week/i, /progress/i, /credits/i],
    reply: "Let's see how far you've come!", action: assistantGoTo(function(){ renderProfile(); showOnly('panel-profile'); }, 'navYou') },
  { character: 'cookie', patterns: [/active users/i, /how many (users|people|signed up)/i],
    reply: "LET'S GO — pulling up the numbers!", action: assistantGoTo(function(){ openAdminDashboard(); setTimeout(function(){ var t = document.querySelector('[data-stat="totalusers"]'); if(t) t.click(); }, 800); }, 'navYou') }
];

function findAssistantMatchingClient(nameGuess, callback){
  // Fuzzy-ish match against real clients (by profile name) and saved external contacts, for
  // the "log appointment for X" parsed flow -- exact match first, then a loose contains-match
  // so "log appointment for aradhana" still finds "Aradhana Das".
  var lower = nameGuess.trim().toLowerCase();
  Promise.all([
    sb.from('expert_bookings').select('user_id,status').eq('expert_name', appState.therapistExpertName).eq('status', 'active').eq('is_external', false),
    sb.from('profiles').select('user_id,name'),
    sb.from('therapist_external_clients').select('*').eq('therapist_expert_name', appState.therapistExpertName)
  ]).then(function(results){
    var nameByUserId = {};
    (results[1].data || []).forEach(function(p){ nameByUserId[p.user_id] = p.name; });
    var realMatch = (results[0].data || []).find(function(b){
      var n = (nameByUserId[b.user_id] || '').toLowerCase();
      return n && (n === lower || n.indexOf(lower) !== -1 || lower.indexOf(n) !== -1);
    });
    if(realMatch){ callback({ userId: realMatch.user_id, name: nameByUserId[realMatch.user_id] }); return; }
    var extMatch = (results[2].data || []).find(function(e){
      var n = (e.name || '').toLowerCase();
      return n === lower || n.indexOf(lower) !== -1 || lower.indexOf(n) !== -1;
    });
    if(extMatch){ callback({ bookingSearchExternalId: extMatch.id, name: extMatch.name }); return; }
    callback(null);
  });
}

function renderAssistantMessage(character, text){
  var wrap = document.getElementById('assistantMessages');
  var char = ASSISTANT_CHARACTERS[character] || ASSISTANT_CHARACTERS.bob;
  var row = document.createElement('div');
  row.style.cssText = 'display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:flex-start;margin-bottom:12px;';
  row.innerHTML = '<img src="'+char.img+'" style="width:30px;height:30px;object-fit:contain;flex-shrink:0;">'+
    '<div style="background:#FFFFFF;border:1px solid #EEE0C4;border-radius:12px;padding:9px 12px;font-size:12.5px;color:#2A2013;max-width:80%;"><strong style="display:block;font-size:10px;color:#9AABCE;margin-bottom:2px;">'+char.name+'</strong>'+text+'</div>';
  wrap.appendChild(row);
  wrap.scrollTop = wrap.scrollHeight;
}
function renderAssistantUserMessage(text){
  var wrap = document.getElementById('assistantMessages');
  var row = document.createElement('div');
  row.style.cssText = 'display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;margin-bottom:12px;';
  row.innerHTML = '<div style="background:#6690D6;color:#FFF8F0;border-radius:12px;padding:9px 12px;font-size:12.5px;max-width:80%;">'+text.replace(/</g,'&lt;')+'</div>';
  wrap.appendChild(row);
  wrap.scrollTop = wrap.scrollHeight;
}

function processAssistantInput(text){
  renderAssistantUserMessage(text);
  var matched = ASSISTANT_COMMANDS.find(function(cmd){
    return cmd.patterns.some(function(p){ return p.test(text); });
  });

  if(!matched){
    renderAssistantMessage('bob', "I'm not sure I caught that yet — try asking to go somewhere (like \"journal\" or \"calendar\"), or tell me what you're trying to do.");
    return;
  }

  if(matched.action === 'LOG_APPOINTMENT'){
    var nameMatch = text.match(/for\s+([a-zA-Z ]+?)\s+at\s+(\d{1,2}(?::\d{2})?\s*(?:am|pm)?)/i);
    if(!nameMatch){
      renderAssistantMessage('po', "Give me a name and a time — like \"log appointment for Aradhana at 3pm.\"");
      return;
    }
    var guessName = nameMatch[1].trim();
    var timeStr = nameMatch[2].trim();
    renderAssistantMessage('po', "Looking for " + guessName + "...");
    findAssistantMatchingClient(guessName, function(match){
      if(!match){
        renderAssistantMessage('po', "Couldn't find anyone named " + guessName + " in your clients or contacts — check the spelling, or add them directly from Log Appointment.");
        return;
      }
      document.getElementById('assistantModalBackdrop').style.display = 'none';
      document.getElementById('assistantModal').style.display = 'none';
      openTherapistDashboard();
      setTimeout(function(){
        openTherapistScheduleEdit(match.userId || null, match.bookingSearchExternalId ? null : null, match.name, null);
        // Best-effort prefill of the parsed time into the already-open editor -- still requires
        // a tap to Save, which is the right amount of friction for something writing real data.
        var parsedHour = parseInt(timeStr, 10);
        var isPM = /pm/i.test(timeStr);
        if(isPM && parsedHour < 12) parsedHour += 12;
        var minuteMatch = timeStr.match(/:(\d{2})/);
        var minutes = minuteMatch ? minuteMatch[1] : '00';
        document.getElementById('therapistScheduleEditTime').value = pad2(parsedHour) + ':' + minutes;
        var today = new Date();
        document.getElementById('therapistScheduleEditDate').value = today.getFullYear()+'-'+pad2(today.getMonth()+1)+'-'+pad2(today.getDate());
      }, 600);
    });
    return;
  }

  renderAssistantMessage(matched.character, matched.reply);
  setTimeout(matched.action, 500);
}

document.getElementById('assistantFabBtn').onclick = function(){
  document.getElementById('assistantModalBackdrop').style.display = 'block';
  document.getElementById('assistantModal').style.display = 'flex';
  if(!document.getElementById('assistantMessages').dataset.greeted){
    renderAssistantMessage('bob', "Hey — I'm here with Kunnu, Po, and Cookie. Tell me what you need and we'll get you there.");
    document.getElementById('assistantMessages').dataset.greeted = '1';
  }
  document.getElementById('assistantInput').focus();
};
document.getElementById('assistantCloseBtn').onclick = function(){
  document.getElementById('assistantModalBackdrop').style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('assistantModal').style.display = 'none';
};
document.getElementById('assistantModalBackdrop').onclick = document.getElementById('assistantCloseBtn').onclick;
document.getElementById('assistantSendBtn').onclick = function(){
  var input = document.getElementById('assistantInput');
  var text = input.value.trim();
  if(!text) return;
  input.value = '';
  processAssistantInput(text);
};
document.getElementById('assistantInput').addEventListener('keydown', function(e){
  if(e.key === 'Enter'){ e.preventDefault(); document.getElementById('assistantSendBtn').click(); }
});

document.getElementById('navHome').onclick = function(){
  showOnly('panel-bubbles');
  setActiveNav('navHome');
  document.getElementById('startingEntryBanner').style.display = 'none';
};

```

function findAssistantMatchingClient(nameGuess, callback){
  // Fuzzy-ish match against real clients (by profile name) and saved external contacts, for
  // the "log appointment for X" parsed flow -- exact match first, then a loose contains-match
  // so "log appointment for aradhana" still finds "Aradhana Das".
  var lower = nameGuess.trim().toLowerCase();
  Promise.all([
    sb.from('expert_bookings').select('user_id,status').eq('expert_name', appState.therapistExpertName).eq('status', 'active').eq('is_external', false),
    sb.from('profiles').select('user_id,name'),
    sb.from('therapist_external_clients').select('*').eq('therapist_expert_name', appState.therapistExpertName)
  ]).then(function(results){
    var nameByUserId = {};
    (results[1].data || []).forEach(function(p){ nameByUserId[p.user_id] = p.name; });
    var realMatch = (results[0].data || []).find(function(b){
      var n = (nameByUserId[b.user_id] || '').toLowerCase();
      return n && (n === lower || n.indexOf(lower) !== -1 || lower.indexOf(n) !== -1);
    });
    if(realMatch){ callback({ userId: realMatch.user_id, name: nameByUserId[realMatch.user_id] }); return; }
    var extMatch = (results[2].data || []).find(function(e){
      var n = (e.name || '').toLowerCase();
      return n === lower || n.indexOf(lower) !== -1 || lower.indexOf(n) !== -1;
    });
    if(extMatch){ callback({ bookingSearchExternalId: extMatch.id, name: extMatch.name }); return; }
    callback(null);
  });
}

function renderAssistantMessage(character, text){
  var wrap = document.getElementById('assistantMessages');
  var char = ASSISTANT_CHARACTERS[character] || ASSISTANT_CHARACTERS.bob;
  var row = document.createElement('div');
  row.style.cssText = 'display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:flex-start;margin-bottom:12px;';
  row.innerHTML = '<img src="'+char.img+'" style="width:30px;height:30px;object-fit:contain;flex-shrink:0;">'+
    '<div style="background:#FFFFFF;border:1px solid #EEE0C4;border-radius:12px;padding:9px 12px;font-size:12.5px;color:#2A2013;max-width:80%;"><strong style="display:block;font-size:10px;color:#9AABCE;margin-bottom:2px;">'+char.name+'</strong>'+text+'</div>';
  wrap.appendChild(row);
  wrap.scrollTop = wrap.scrollHeight;
}
function renderAssistantUserMessage(text){
  var wrap = document.getElementById('assistantMessages');
  var row = document.createElement('div');
  row.style.cssText = 'display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;margin-bottom:12px;';
  row.innerHTML = '<div style="background:#6690D6;color:#FFF8F0;border-radius:12px;padding:9px 12px;font-size:12.5px;max-width:80%;">'+text.replace(/</g,'&lt;')+'</div>';
  wrap.appendChild(row);
  wrap.scrollTop = wrap.scrollHeight;
}

function processAssistantInput(text){
  renderAssistantUserMessage(text);
  var matched = ASSISTANT_COMMANDS.find(function(cmd){
    return cmd.patterns.some(function(p){ return p.test(text); });
  });

  if(!matched){
    renderAssistantMessage('bob', "I'm not sure I caught that yet — try asking to go somewhere (like \"journal\" or \"calendar\"), or tell me what you're trying to do.");
    return;
  }

  if(matched.action === 'LOG_APPOINTMENT'){
    var nameMatch = text.match(/for\s+([a-zA-Z ]+?)\s+at\s+(\d{1,2}(?::\d{2})?\s*(?:am|pm)?)/i);
    if(!nameMatch){
      renderAssistantMessage('po', "Give me a name and a time — like \"log appointment for Aradhana at 3pm.\"");
      return;
    }
    var guessName = nameMatch[1].trim();
    var timeStr = nameMatch[2].trim();
    renderAssistantMessage('po', "Looking for " + guessName + "...");
    findAssistantMatchingClient(guessName, function(match){
      if(!match){
        renderAssistantMessage('po', "Couldn't find anyone named " + guessName + " in your clients or contacts — check the spelling, or add them directly from Log Appointment.");
        return;
      }
      document.getElementById('assistantModalBackdrop').style.display = 'none';
      document.getElementById('assistantModal').style.display = 'none';
      openTherapistDashboard();
      setTimeout(function(){
        openTherapistScheduleEdit(match.userId || null, match.bookingSearchExternalId ? null : null, match.name, null);
        // Best-effort prefill of the parsed time into the already-open editor -- still requires
        // a tap to Save, which is the right amount of friction for something writing real data.
        var parsedHour = parseInt(timeStr, 10);
        var isPM = /pm/i.test(timeStr);
        if(isPM && parsedHour < 12) parsedHour += 12;
        var minuteMatch = timeStr.match(/:(\d{2})/);
        var minutes = minuteMatch ? minuteMatch[1] : '00';
        document.getElementById('therapistScheduleEditTime').value = pad2(parsedHour) + ':' + minutes;
        var today = new Date();
        document.getElementById('therapistScheduleEditDate').value = today.getFullYear()+'-'+pad2(today.getMonth()+1)+'-'+pad2(today.getDate());
      }, 600);
    });
    return;
  }

  renderAssistantMessage(matched.character, matched.reply);
  setTimeout(matched.action, 500);
}

document.getElementById('assistantFabBtn').onclick = function(){
  document.getElementById('assistantModalBackdrop').style.display = 'block';
  document.getElementById('assistantModal').style.display = 'flex';
  if(!document.getElementById('assistantMessages').dataset.greeted){
    renderAssistantMessage('bob', "Hey — I'm here with Kunnu, Po, and Cookie. Tell me what you need and we'll get you there.");
    document.getElementById('assistantMessages').dataset.greeted = '1';
  }
  document.getElementById('assistantInput').focus();
};
document.getElementById('assistantCloseBtn').onclick = function(){
  document.getElementById('assistantModalBackdrop').style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('assistantModal').style.display = 'none';
};
document.getElementById('assistantModalBackdrop').onclick = document.getElementById('assistantCloseBtn').onclick;
document.getElementById('assistantSendBtn').onclick = function(){
  var input = document.getElementById('assistantInput');
  var text = input.value.trim();
  if(!text) return;
  input.value = '';
  processAssistantInput(text);
};
document.getElementById('assistantInput').addEventListener('keydown', function(e){
  if(e.key === 'Enter'){ e.preventDefault(); document.getElementById('assistantSendBtn').click(); }

// ---- Auto-update check ----
// The real problem this solves: this app loads live from GitHub Pages inside a Capacitor
// WebView, and Android's WebView caches the page aggressively enough that even a fresh app
// launch could still show a stale version -- only a full force-close seemed to reliably clear
// enough cache to fetch new content. This checks a tiny, always-fresh version marker (bypassing
// cache itself via a cache-busting query param) both on load AND whenever the app comes back to
// the foreground -- not just on a cold launch -- so an update shows up the next time someone
// glances at the app, not only after they've force-closed it.
(function(){
  var CURRENT_BUILD = '20260713221021';
  function checkForUpdate(){
    // Safety guard: reload AT MOST ONCE per session, no matter what. Without this, a mistake
    // where version.json and the HTML's own build ID get out of sync (e.g. one gets updated
    // and the other is forgotten on some future deploy) would reload the app forever in a loop
    // -- completely unacceptable for a mental health app real people depend on. One missed
    // update is a minor inconvenience; an infinite reload loop is not.
    if(sessionStorage.getItem('hobs_already_checked_for_update')) return;
    fetch('version.json?t=' + Date.now(), { cache: 'no-store' })
      .then(function(r){ return r.json(); })
      .then(function(data){
        if(data && data.build && data.build !== CURRENT_BUILD){
          sessionStorage.setItem('hobs_already_checked_for_update', '1');
          // Force a genuinely fresh fetch, not a cached reload -- appending a cache-busting
          // param so the WebView can't serve this specific request from its HTTP cache either.
          window.location.href = window.location.pathname + '?v=' + data.build;
        }
      })
      .catch(function(){}); // best-effort -- never block the app loading over this
  }
  checkForUpdate();
  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', function(){
    if(document.visibilityState === 'visible') checkForUpdate();
  });
  // This was the actual bug behind "still had to reopen the app" -- document.addEventListener
  // ('resume', ...) is the old Cordova convention and does nothing at all in modern Capacitor
  // (confirmed @capacitor/app v8 is what's actually installed here). The real API for this is
  // through the Capacitor plugin bridge. window.Capacitor only exists when actually running
  // inside the native shell (not in a plain browser), so this is guarded for that.
  if(window.Capacitor && window.Capacitor.Plugins && window.Capacitor.Plugins.App){
    window.Capacitor.Plugins.App.addListener('resume', checkForUpdate);
  }
})();

// ---- Persisted app state (localStorage stands in for a real backend/account here) ----
// ================= SUPABASE BACKEND CONNECTION =================
var SUPABASE_URL = 'https://adjvptkzyckkvewbfmzf.supabase.co';
var SUPABASE_KEY = 'sb_publishable_OfcfAkUyxd9oXKeGvVxBIw_KxUV9TzE';
```

NEW (exact):
```
// ---- Auto-update check ----
// The real problem this solves: this app loads live from GitHub Pages inside a Capacitor
// WebView, and Android's WebView caches the page aggressively enough that even a fresh app
// launch could still show a stale version -- only a full force-close seemed to reliably clear
// enough cache to fetch new content.
//
// This has been fixed twice before and still didn't work in practice on a real device, which
// means the honest conclusion is: don't trust any single event to fire reliably in this
// WebView, no matter how correct the API looks on paper. This version stops betting on one
// signal and layers several independent ones, including a plain timer that doesn't depend on
// any event at all -- if even one of these fires, the update gets caught.
(function(){
  var CURRENT_BUILD = '20260713221021';
  function checkForUpdate(){
    // Safety guard: reload AT MOST ONCE per session, no matter what. Without this, a mistake
    // where version.json and the HTML's own build ID get out of sync (e.g. one gets updated
    // and the other is forgotten on some future deploy) would reload the app forever in a loop
    // -- completely unacceptable for a mental health app real people depend on. One missed
    // update is a minor inconvenience; an infinite reload loop is not.
    if(sessionStorage.getItem('hobs_already_checked_for_update')) return;
    fetch('version.json?t=' + Date.now(), { cache: 'no-store' })
      .then(function(r){ return r.json(); })
      .then(function(data){
        if(data && data.build && data.build !== CURRENT_BUILD){
          sessionStorage.setItem('hobs_already_checked_for_update', '1');
          // Force a genuinely fresh fetch, not a cached reload -- appending a cache-busting
          // param so the WebView can't serve this specific request from its HTTP cache either.
          window.location.href = window.location.pathname + '?v=' + data.build;
        }
      })
      .catch(function(){}); // best-effort -- never block the app loading over this
  }

  checkForUpdate(); // cold launch / fresh load

  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', function(){
    if(document.visibilityState === 'visible') checkForUpdate();
  });
  window.addEventListener('focus', checkForUpdate);
  window.addEventListener('pageshow', checkForUpdate);

  // The previous fix corrected document.addEventListener('resume', ...) (wrong, old Cordova
  // convention) to window.Capacitor.Plugins.App.addListener('resume', ...) (the real API) --
  // and it still reportedly didn't work on a real device. The most likely remaining cause:
  // this whole script block runs synchronously as the page parses, and window.Capacitor may
  // not be injected and ready THAT exact moment yet for remotely-loaded content specifically
  // (as opposed to bundled local content, where Capacitor's timing guarantees are stronger).
  // A single one-time check at parse time would silently and permanently miss the listener
  // registration if that race goes the wrong way, with no second chance. Polling for a few
  // seconds removes that race entirely instead of hoping the timing works out.
  var capacitorPollAttempts = 0;
  var capacitorPollTimer = setInterval(function(){
    capacitorPollAttempts++;
    if(window.Capacitor && window.Capacitor.Plugins && window.Capacitor.Plugins.App){
      window.Capacitor.Plugins.App.addListener('resume', checkForUpdate);
      clearInterval(capacitorPollTimer);
    } else if(capacitorPollAttempts > 20){ // ~10 seconds at 500ms -- give up gracefully, the other signals below still cover this
      clearInterval(capacitorPollTimer);
    }
  }, 500);

  // Final backstop that doesn't depend on ANY event, Capacitor or otherwise, firing correctly:
  // just check periodically while the app is open. This is the one signal that can't be broken
  // by a WebView quirk or a missed event -- it only needs setInterval to keep running, which it
  // will as long as the app's JS context is alive at all.
  setInterval(checkForUpdate, 60000);
})();

// ---- Persisted app state (localStorage stands in for a real backend/account here) ----
// ================= SUPABASE BACKEND CONNECTION =================
var SUPABASE_URL = 'https://adjvptkzyckkvewbfmzf.supabase.co';
var SUPABASE_KEY = 'sb_publishable_OfcfAkUyxd9oXKeGvVxBIw_KxUV9TzE';

  });

  if(assistantConversations[charKey].length === 0){

  }

}

      appendAssistantUserMessageDom(msg.text);
    } else {
      appendAssistantMessageDom(msg.who, msg.text);
    }
  });
  wrap.scrollTop = wrap.scrollHeight;
}

  var pronouns = selected === 'Self-describe' ? document.getElementById('epPronounCustom').value.trim() : selected;

  var errEl = document.getElementById('epError');
  if(!name || !pronouns || !phone || !dob){
    errEl.textContent = 'Please fill in all four fields.';
    errEl.style.display = 'block';
    return;
  }

  var btn = document.getElementById('epSaveBtn');
  btn.textContent = 'Saving...'; btn.disabled = true;

  var updatePayload = {
    name: name, pronouns: pronouns, phone_number: phone, date_of_birth: dob,
    address: address || null, emergency_contact_name: emergencyName || null, emergency_contact_phone: emergencyPhone || null
  };
  if(pendingPhotoUrl) updatePayload.photo_url = pendingPhotoUrl;

  sb.from('profiles').update(updatePayload).eq('user_id', currentUser.id).then(function(result){
    btn.textContent = 'Save Changes'; btn.disabled = false;
    if(result.error){
      errEl.textContent = 'Could not save — check your connection and try again.';
      errEl.style.display = 'block';
      return;
    }
    appState.displayName = name;
    appState.pronouns = pronouns;
    appState.phoneNumber = phone;
    appState.dateOfBirth = dob;
    appState.address = address;
    appState.emergencyContactName = emergencyName;
    appState.emergencyContactPhone = emergencyPhone;
    if(pendingPhotoUrl) appState.photoUrl = pendingPhotoUrl;
    showToast('Profile updated.');
    renderHomeGreeting();
    showOnly('panel-profile');
  });
};
```

// Real fix for two things Akash raised together: therapists genuinely had no way to see what a
// client has shared with them (this previously only existed in the ADMIN's user-profile view,
// confirmed by checking -- there was no therapist-facing equivalent at all), and no visibility
// into emergency contact/address for safety purposes. One view serves both, reusing the exact
// same shared-entries query pattern the admin view already uses.
function openTherapistClientDetail(userId, name){
  document.getElementById('therapistClientDetailName').textContent = name;
  document.getElementById('therapistClientDetailBody').innerHTML = '<p style="text-align:center;color:#9AABCE;font-size:12px;">Loading...</p>';
  document.getElementById('therapistClientDetailBackdrop').style.display = 'block';
  document.getElementById('therapistClientDetailModal').style.display = 'block';

  Promise.all([
    sb.from('profiles').select('photo_url,address,emergency_contact_name,emergency_contact_phone').eq('user_id', userId).single(),
    sb.from('entries').select('id,type,text,worksheet_name,category_name,created_at').eq('user_id', userId).eq('shared_with_therapist', true).order('created_at', {ascending:false})
  ]).then(function(results){
    var profile = results[0].data || {};
    var shared = results[1].data || [];
    var html = '';
    if(profile.photo_url){
      html += '<div style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:14px;"><img src="'+profile.photo_url+'" style="width:64px;height:64px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;border:2px solid #EEE0C4;"></div>';
    }
    html += '<p style="font-size:11px;font-weight:700;color:#9AABCE;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.03em;margin:0 0 6px;">Safety Information</p>';
    if(profile.address || profile.emergency_contact_name){
      html += '<div style="background:#FBF2F2;border-radius:10px;padding:12px;margin-bottom:16px;">';
      if(profile.address) html += '<p style="font-size:11.5px;color:#2A2013;margin:0 0 8px;"><strong>Address:</strong> '+profile.address.replace(/</g,'&lt;')+'</p>';
      if(profile.emergency_contact_name) html += '<p style="font-size:11.5px;color:#2A2013;margin:0;"><strong>Emergency contact:</strong> '+profile.emergency_contact_name.replace(/</g,'&lt;')+(profile.emergency_contact_phone ? ' — '+profile.emergency_contact_phone : '')+'</p>';
      html += '</div>';
    } else {
      html += '<p style="font-size:11.5px;color:#B0AA98;margin:0 0 16px;">Not provided yet.</p>';
    }
    html += '<p style="font-size:11px;font-weight:700;color:#9AABCE;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.03em;margin:0 0 6px;">Shared With You ('+shared.length+')</p>';
    if(shared.length === 0){
      html += '<p style="font-size:11.5px;color:#B0AA98;margin:0;">Nothing shared yet.</p>';
    } else {
      html += '<div style="background:#F3F6FC;border-radius:10px;padding:10px 12px;max-height:280px;overflow-y:auto;">'+
        shared.map(function(e){
          var when = new Date(e.created_at).toLocaleDateString('en-IN', {day:'numeric', month:'short'});
          var label = e.type === 'worksheet' ? ('Worksheet: ' + (e.worksheet_name || e.category_name || 'Untitled')) : (e.text ? e.text.slice(0,80) + (e.text.length > 80 ? '…' : '') : '(no text)');
          return '<p style="font-size:11.5px;color:#2A2013;margin:0 0 10px;"><strong style="color:#6690D6;">'+when+':</strong> '+label.replace(/</g,'&lt;')+'</p>';
        }).join('')+
        '</div>';
    }
    document.getElementById('therapistClientDetailBody').innerHTML = html;
  });
}
document.getElementById('therapistClientDetailCloseBtn').onclick = function(){
  document.getElementById('therapistClientDetailBackdrop').style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('therapistClientDetailModal').style.display = 'none';
};
document.getElementById('therapistClientDetailBackdrop').onclick = document.getElementById('therapistClientDetailCloseBtn').onclick;
```

// This is the real, visible section Akash asked for -- not a button tucked inside a client
// card that's easy to miss, but its own dedicated area matching the same prominence as Session
// Time Requests. Pulls shared content across ALL of this therapist's clients at once (RLS
// naturally restricts the query to only their own clients' shared rows, so no per-client
// looping needed), sorted newest first, each item clickable through to the full client detail.
function renderTherapistSharedFeed(){
  var listEl = document.getElementById('therapistSharedFeedList');
  listEl.innerHTML = '<p style="text-align:center;color:#9AABCE;font-size:12.5px;">Loading...</p>';
  Promise.all([
    sb.from('entries').select('id,user_id,type,text,worksheet_name,category_name,worksheet_key,created_at').eq('shared_with_therapist', true).order('created_at', {ascending:false}).limit(20),
    sb.from('worksheet_responses').select('user_id,worksheet_key,category_key,answers,updated_at').eq('shared_with_therapist', true),
    sb.from('profiles').select('user_id,name')
  ]).then(function(results){
    if(results[0].error){
      listEl.innerHTML = '<p style="text-align:center;color:#C77B7B;font-size:12px;">Could not load shared content.</p>';
      return;
    }
    var entries = results[0].data || [];
    var nameByUserId = {};
    (results[2].data || []).forEach(function(p){ nameByUserId[p.user_id] = p.name; });

    if(entries.length === 0){
      listEl.innerHTML = '<p style="text-align:center;color:#9AABCE;font-size:12.5px;">Nothing shared with you yet.</p>';
      return;
    }

    listEl.innerHTML = entries.map(function(e){
      var when = new Date(e.created_at).toLocaleDateString('en-IN', {day:'numeric', month:'short'});
      var clientName = nameByUserId[e.user_id] || 'A client';
      var label = e.type === 'worksheet' ? ('Worksheet: ' + (e.worksheet_name || e.category_name || 'Untitled')) : (e.text ? e.text.slice(0,70) + (e.text.length > 70 ? '…' : '') : '(no text)');
      return '<div class="therapist-shared-feed-item" data-user-id="'+e.user_id+'" data-name="'+clientName.replace(/"/g,'&quot;')+'" style="background:#FFFFFF;border:1px solid #EEE0C4;border-radius:12px;padding:11px 13px;margin-bottom:7px;cursor:pointer;">'+
        '<p style="font-size:11px;font-weight:700;color:#3B8F63;margin:0 0 2px;">'+clientName.replace(/</g,'&lt;')+' · '+when+'</p>'+
        '<p style="font-size:12px;color:#2A2013;margin:0;">'+label.replace(/</g,'&lt;')+'</p>'+
        '</div>';
    }).join('');

    listEl.querySelectorAll('.therapist-shared-feed-item').forEach(function(item){
      item.onclick = function(){
        openTherapistClientDetail(item.dataset.userId, item.dataset.name);
      };
    });
  });
}

function renderTherapistAvailabilityGrid(){
  document.getElementById('therapistCalMonthTitle').textContent = MONTH_NAMES[therapistCalMonth] + ' ' + therapistCalYear;
  Promise.all([
    sb.from('expert_availability_slots').select('*').eq('expert_name', appState.therapistExpertName).order('slot_date', {ascending:true}),
    // The calendar's dot indicator used to only reflect open availability slots, completely
    // ignoring actual logged/booked sessions -- meaning a real appointment logged for a past (or
    // any) day showed no visual sign of it on the calendar at all, even though it was correctly
    // saved and visible in My Clients. That's the real reason logged past sessions "looked like
    // nothing happened." Now both are tracked together.
    sb.from('expert_bookings').select('session_date').eq('expert_name', appState.therapistExpertName).eq('status', 'active').not('session_date', 'is', null)
  ]).then(function(results){
    var result = results[0];
    var bookingsResult = results[1];
    therapistCalSlotsByDay = {};
    (result.error ? [] : result.data || []).forEach(function(s){
      var d = new Date(s.slot_date);
      var key = d.getFullYear()+'-'+pad2(d.getMonth()+1)+'-'+pad2(d.getDate());
      if(!therapistCalSlotsByDay[key]) therapistCalSlotsByDay[key] = [];
      therapistCalSlotsByDay[key].push({ id: s.id, time: d.toLocaleTimeString('en-US',{hour:'numeric',minute:'2-digit'}), rawDate: s.slot_date, is_booked: s.is_booked, duration: s.duration_minutes || 45 });
    });
    var therapistCalBookedDays = {};
    (bookingsResult.error ? [] : bookingsResult.data || []).forEach(function(b){
      var d = new Date(b.session_date);
      var key = d.getFullYear()+'-'+pad2(d.getMonth()+1)+'-'+pad2(d.getDate());
      therapistCalBookedDays[key] = true;
    });

    var grid = document.getElementById('therapistAvailabilityGrid');
    grid.innerHTML = '';
    var firstDay = new Date(therapistCalYear, therapistCalMonth, 1).getDay();
    var daysInMonth = new Date(therapistCalYear, therapistCalMonth+1, 0).getDate();
    for(var i=0; i<firstDay; i++){
      var empty = document.createElement('div'); empty.className = 'day-cell empty'; grid.appendChild(empty);
    }
    var todayObj = new Date();
    for(var day=1; day<=daysInMonth; day++){
      (function(day){
        var key = therapistCalYear+'-'+pad2(therapistCalMonth+1)+'-'+pad2(day);
        var isToday = todayObj.getFullYear()===therapistCalYear && todayObj.getMonth()===therapistCalMonth && todayObj.getDate()===day;
        var cell = document.createElement('div');
        cell.className = 'day-cell' + (isToday ? ' today' : '');
        var count = (therapistCalSlotsByDay[key] || []).length;
        var hasBooking = !!therapistCalBookedDays[key];
        cell.innerHTML = '<span style="font-size:12px;font-weight:600;">'+day+'</span>' +
          (count > 0 ? '<span style="width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:50%;background:#3B8F63;"></span>' : '') +
          (hasBooking ? '<span style="width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:50%;background:#6690D6;margin-left:2px;"></span>' : '');
        cell.onclick = function(){ openTherapistDayEditor(key); };
        grid.appendChild(cell);
      })(day);
    }
    renderTherapistAllSlotsList();
  });
}

document.getElementById('adminCampaignArchiveBtn').onclick = function(){
  if(!adminActiveCampaignId){
    showToast('No active campaign to hide right now.');
    return;
  }
  // "Save" always edits the current campaign in place -- there was no way to actually retire
  // one and start a genuinely separate new one (with its own fresh raised-amount tracking)
  // without silently overwriting the old campaign's title/goal, losing that history. This
  // explicitly archives (is_active: false, so it stops showing anywhere public) rather than
  // deleting -- past donations tied to it stay intact.
  var btn = this;
  btn.disabled = true;
  sb.from('donation_campaigns').update({ is_active: false }).eq('id', adminActiveCampaignId).then(function(result){
    btn.disabled = false;
    if(result.error){ showToast('Could not hide the campaign — please try again.'); return; }
    adminActiveCampaignId = null;
    document.getElementById('adminCampaignTitle').value = '';
    document.getElementById('adminCampaignDescription').value = '';
    document.getElementById('adminCampaignGoal').value = '';
    showToast('Previous campaign hidden. Fill in the fields below to start a new one.');
    renderAdminCampaign();
  });
};

NEW (exact):
```
function openMyBookings(){
  showOnly('panel-my-bookings');
  var wrap = document.getElementById('myBookingsList');
  wrap.innerHTML = '<p style="text-align:center;color:#9AABCE;font-size:12.5px;">Loading...</p>';
  // Was ordered by created_at (when the booking record was made), not session_date (when the
  // session actually happened) -- meaningfully different once someone has more than one
  // session, and the actual date/time was never shown at all. That's the real gap: a client
  // could see "Confirmed" or "Ended" but never when their sessions actually took place.
  sb.from('expert_bookings').select('*').eq('user_id', currentUser.id).order('session_date', {ascending:false, nullsFirst:false}).then(function(result){
    if(result.error){ wrap.innerHTML = '<p style="text-align:center;color:#C77B7B;font-size:12.5px;">Could not load your sessions.</p>'; return; }
    var bookings = result.data || [];
    if(bookings.length === 0){
      wrap.innerHTML = '<p style="text-align:center;color:#9AABCE;font-size:12.5px;">No sessions booked yet.</p>';
      return;
    }
    wrap.innerHTML = bookings.map(function(b){
      var statusLabel, statusBg, statusColor;
      if(b.status === 'change_requested'){ statusLabel = 'Change requested — under review'; statusBg = '#FEF3D8'; statusColor = '#7B4F00'; }
      else if(b.status === 'cancelled'){ statusLabel = 'Ended'; statusBg = '#F5F3EE'; statusColor = '#9AABCE'; }
      else if(b.payment_confirmed){ statusLabel = 'Confirmed'; statusBg = '#EAF4EE'; statusColor = '#3B8F63'; }
      else { statusLabel = 'Pending confirmation'; statusBg = '#FEF3D8'; statusColor = '#7B4F00'; }
      var cancelCount = b.cancellation_count || 0;
      var cancelText = cancelCount === 0
        ? 'You have 1 free cancellation available for this booking.'
        : 'You\'ve used your free cancellation for this booking — a further one would need to go through our team, with a 50% charge.';
      var dateLabel = b.session_date
        ? new Date(b.session_date).toLocaleDateString('en-IN', {day:'numeric', month:'short', year:'numeric'}) + ' · ' + new Date(b.session_date).toLocaleTimeString('en-IN', {hour:'numeric', minute:'2-digit'})
        : 'No time set yet';
      return '<div style="background:#FFFFFF;border:1px solid #EEE0C4;border-radius:14px;padding:14px;margin-bottom:10px;">'+
        '<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;margin-bottom:6px;">'+
          '<p style="font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:#2A2013;margin:0;">'+b.expert_name+'</p>'+
          '<span style="font-size:9px;font-weight:700;color:'+statusColor+';background:'+statusBg+';padding:3px 7px;border-radius:8px;white-space:nowrap;">'+statusLabel+'</span>'+
        '</div>'+
        '<p style="font-size:11px;color:#9AABCE;margin:0 0 4px;">'+b.role_category+'</p>'+
        '<p style="font-size:11.5px;color:#6690D6;font-weight:600;margin:0 0 8px;">'+dateLabel+'</p>'+
        (b.status === 'active' ? '<p style="font-size:11px;color:#5C6B94;margin:0;">'+cancelText+'</p>' : '')+
      '</div>';
    }).join('');
  });
}
document.getElementById('myBookingsBtn').onclick = openMyBookings;
```

  document.getElementById('therapistQualificationsInput').value = myProfile ? (myProfile.qualificationsDetail||'') : '';

  switchTherapistDashTab('clients');

// Real structural fix per direct feedback: this was one long scroll of every section stacked
// on top of each other with no organization at all. Split into three tabs by what the section
// actually IS (who it's about, when it happens, or the therapist's own profile) rather than an
// arbitrary grouping -- Clients, Schedule, Profile.
function switchTherapistDashTab(tabKey){
  ['clients','schedule','profile'].forEach(function(key){
    document.getElementById('therapistDashTab-'+key).style.display = (key === tabKey) ? 'block' : 'none';
  });
  document.querySelectorAll('.therapist-dash-tab').forEach(function(tab){
    var isActive = tab.dataset.tab === tabKey;
    tab.style.background = isActive ? '#6690D6' : 'transparent';
    tab.style.color = isActive ? '#FFF8F0' : '#9AABCE';
  });
}
document.querySelectorAll('.therapist-dash-tab').forEach(function(tab){
  tab.onclick = function(){ switchTherapistDashTab(tab.dataset.tab); };
});
```

// Same structural fix as the therapist dashboard, applied to the larger admin surface: five
// tabs grouped by what each section actually IS -- Overview (the pulse of things), Experts
// (who's on the platform), Requests & Bookings (what needs action), Organization (campaigns,
// groups, the full user base), System (technical/error visibility) -- instead of one long
// scroll through 14+ stacked sections with no grouping at all.
function switchAdminDashTab(tabKey){
  ['overview','experts','requests','organization','system'].forEach(function(key){
    document.getElementById('adminDashTab-'+key).style.display = (key === tabKey) ? 'block' : 'none';
  });
  document.querySelectorAll('.admin-dash-tab').forEach(function(tab){
    var isActive = tab.dataset.tab === tabKey;
    tab.style.background = isActive ? '#6690D6' : 'transparent';
    tab.style.color = isActive ? '#FFF8F0' : '#9AABCE';
  });
}
document.querySelectorAll('.admin-dash-tab').forEach(function(tab){
  tab.onclick = function(){ switchAdminDashTab(tab.dataset.tab); };
});

function openAdminDashboard(){

  document.querySelectorAll('.mascot-figure').forEach(function(f){ f.classList.remove('zoomed'); });

  setTimeout(function(){ positionMascotBubble(key, btnId); }, 320);
}
function positionMascotBubble(key, btnId){
  var m = MASCOTS[key];
  var bubble = document.getElementById('comicBubble');
  var btn = document.getElementById(btnId);
  document.getElementById('comicBubbleName').textContent = m.name;
  document.getElementById('comicBubbleText').textContent = m.text;
  var actionBtn = document.getElementById('comicBubbleAction');
  actionBtn.textContent = m.actionLabel;
  actionBtn.onclick = m.action;
  bubble.style.display = 'block';
  var lineup = document.getElementById('mascotLineup');
  var lineupBox = lineup.getBoundingClientRect();
  var btnBox = btn.getBoundingClientRect();
  var left = btnBox.left - lineupBox.left + (btnBox.width/2) - 30;
  left = Math.max(4, Math.min(left, lineupBox.width - bubble.offsetWidth - 4));
  bubble.style.left = left + 'px';
  bubble.style.bottom = (lineupBox.height - (btnBox.top - lineupBox.top) + 14) + 'px';
  var tailOffset = (btnBox.left - lineupBox.left + btnBox.width/2 - left - 10);
  var styleTag = document.getElementById('comicTailStyle');
  if(!styleTag){ styleTag = document.createElement('style'); styleTag.id = 'comicTailStyle'; document.head.appendChild(styleTag); }
  styleTag.textContent = '.comic-bubble::after, .comic-bubble::before { left: ' + tailOffset + 'px; }';
}

      shareImageBtn.textContent = 'Share as image';
      shareImageBtn.style.cssText = 'background:none;border:none;color:#9AABCE;font-size:10.5px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;padding:0;text-decoration:underline;';
      shareImageBtn.onclick = function(){
        if(typeof html2canvas === 'undefined'){ showToast("Screenshot library didn't load — check your connection"); return; }
        // Hide the interactive buttons for the capture only -- a screenshot with "Edit" and
        // "Share with therapist" buttons in it would look unfinished once it leaves the app.
        var wasDisplay = actionsRow.style.display;
        actionsRow.style.display = 'none';
        html2canvas(card, { backgroundColor:'#FFFFFF', scale:2 }).then(function(canvas){
          actionsRow.style.display = wasDisplay;
          canvas.toBlob(function(blob){
            var file = new File([blob], 'hobs-journal-entry.png', { type:'image/png' });
            if(navigator.canShare && navigator.canShare({ files:[file] })){
              navigator.share({ files:[file], title:'My journal entry' }).catch(function(){});
              return;
            }
            var url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
            var a = document.createElement('a'); a.href = url; a.download = 'hobs-journal-entry.png'; a.click();
            showToast('Image saved to your device');
          }, 'image/png');
        }).catch(function(){
          actionsRow.style.display = wasDisplay;
          showToast("Couldn't capture image right now");
        });
      };
      actionsRow.appendChild(shareImageBtn);
    }

<p>Informed consent for tele-consultation with the Clinical Team (Therapist, Peer Caregiver, and Psychiatrist) at Home of Beautiful Souls.</p>

<h2>ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES OF THE CLINICAL TEAM</h2>
<ul>
  <li><strong>Therapist (or Psychotherapist):</strong> Provides direct tele-psychotherapy services.   <li><strong>Peer Caregiver:</strong> Provides non-clinical, emotional, and social support. The Peer Caregiver shares relevant lived experience and assists the client in navigating their recovery journey, operating under the general direction of the Clinical Team. The Peer Caregiver is expressly excluded from providing clinical diagnosis, treatment planning, or independent crisis intervention.</li>
  <li><strong>Psychiatrist (or Consulting Psychiatrist):</strong> Provides medical oversight and consultation, which may include assessment for and management of pharmacological treatment, as necessitated by the client's condition and upon consultation or referral from the Therapist. The Psychiatrist is generally not involved in every consultation session unless their specific involvement is agreed upon in the treatment plan.</li>
</ul>

<h2>Responsibility for Adverse Events</h2>
<p>I understand that the Clinical Team (Therapist, Peer Caregiver, and Psychiatrist) will use their professional discretion to provide recommendations about the type of professional service required at any given point in time. I expressly agree to indemnify and hold harmless the Clinical Team and Home of Beautiful Souls Foundation, and agree not to hold them responsible should any adverse events — such as lack of improvement, deterioration, or a situation of potential risk of harm to self or others — occur during a video or audio consultation. I understand that I may be advised to obtain treatment at the nearest available mental health or emergency service in such situations.</p>

<h2>Confidentiality and Recording</h2>
<p>I understand that this audio/video consultation is strictly confidential. I agree to use a secure connection for these consultations, in a relatively quiet and private space. I understand that the Clinical Team will not record the session (on mobile, using an app, or online) and will not share the proceedings of this consultation with any other individual or agency, except with my consent for supervision or the training of professionals, or if mandated by a court of law.</p>
<p>Notes of the tele-psychotherapy consultation will be maintained by the Clinical Team and stored securely. These session notes can be made available to me, in the standard session record format, on my explicit request.</p>
<p>I also undertake that the proceedings of these consultations will not be recorded, shared, or disseminated by me or my relatives/other contacts to any third person or through social media. I acknowledge that unauthorized recording or dissemination of a session is a serious breach of confidentiality and may result in immediate termination of services and potential legal action. I understand that despite reasonable safety measures, there is always some risk of a technology security breach, and that in such an instance, neither the client nor the Clinical Team will hold the other responsible for the violation.</p>

<h2>Payment and Billing</h2>
<p>I understand that these consultations are charged as agreed with the Clinical Team before sessions begin, and confirmed through the HOBS Companion app. I understand that my consent given through the app is sufficient for me to receive tele-psychotherapy services. I understand that the Clinical Team will discuss the chat, audio, and video options available, and that we will decide together considering my preference and my psychotherapist's assessment of what's suitable. I understand that if there are technical communication difficulties during a session, it will be ended and a new appointment scheduled. I understand that I have the freedom to withdraw from these sessions at any time. I understand that the Clinical Team may also temporarily stop, discontinue, or recommend a different method or line of treatment if either of us experiences difficulty in the process, in my best interest.</p>

<div class="note-box"><strong>Important Note on Contract:</strong> This contract must be signed before your first session. If you have not received it, kindly send us a reminder.</div>

<p>I hereby provide my informed consent for video/audio consultations for tele-psychotherapy at Home of Beautiful Souls Foundation.</p>

<h2>GUIDELINES</h2>
<ol>
  <li><strong>Dual relationship:</strong> During our entire process, there will not be any other relationship, e.g., friendship. This ensures the professional role remains clear for the Clinical Team.</li>
  <li><strong>Time, Booking, and Cancellation Policy:</strong> All appointments are booked and confirmed through the HOBS Companion app, at least 24 hours in advance where possible. A session is confirmed once payment is made. Cancelling more than 24 hours ahead of a session carries no charge, and the amount carries forward. Cancelling within 24 hours carries a 50% charge (once per calendar month, treated as an allowed emergency cancellation); a second late cancellation within the same calendar month is charged in full.</li>
  <li><strong>Frequency of Sessions:</strong> The frequency of sessions will depend on the client's needs and the Clinical Team's understanding of the condition. Total duration of treatment will be discussed after the initial sessions, and may vary based on the client's progress.</li>

If the Clinical Team is unable to respond in that time, kindly contact emergency services nearby.   <li><strong>Termination of Consultation:</strong> If the client wishes to end treatment before the agreed course is complete, due to financial or other constraints, they must inform the Clinical Team. A plan will be worked out to safeguard the client's condition from worsening. If the consultation isn't helping the client, or symptoms are worsening, the Clinical Team may choose to terminate treatment or suggest a better means to improve.</li>
  <li><strong>Commitment:</strong> The goal of consultation is to help the client build independence. This requires commitment from both the Clinical Team and the client. The client may be given homework to practice between sessions and is expected to engage with it; if an assignment can't be completed, the reasons will be discussed.</li>
  <li><strong>Substance Use:</strong> The client should not be intoxicated during a session. If this is the case, the Clinical Team may terminate the session.</li>
</ol>

<ol>

In these cases, every effort is made to protect your identity, and the same confidentiality exceptions listed here continue to apply.</li>
