<body>

<p class="note">Tap any task to grow it — this is a concept demo, not the real app</p>

<div class="phone">
  <div class="header">
    <p class="date">Friday, July 17</p>
    <p class="title">Today's garden</p>
    <p class="sub">Tend to what matters — at your own pace.</p>
  </div>

  <div class="progress-strip" id="progressStrip"></div>

  <div class="task-list" id="taskList"></div>

  <div class="garden-footer" id="gardenFooter">
    <div class="mascot-circle">🌱</div>
    <p class="garden-msg" id="gardenMsg">3 left to grow today. No rush — Bob's just here keeping you company.</p>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
// ---- Plant stage SVGs: seed -> sprout -> budding -> bloom ----
function plantSVG(stage) {
  const soil = `<ellipse cx="23" cy="40" rx="16" ry="4" fill="#D9CBA8" opacity="0.6"/>`;
  if (stage === 0) {
    // seed / soil mound, dormant
    return `<svg viewBox="0 0 46 46">${soil}
      <ellipse cx="23" cy="37" rx="7" ry="3.5" fill="#C7B896"/>
      <circle cx="23" cy="35" r="3" fill="#A99B78"/>
    </svg>`;
  }
  if (stage === 1) {
    // sprout, two small leaves
    return `<svg viewBox="0 0 46 46" class="stage-pop">${soil}
      <ellipse cx="23" cy="37" rx="7" ry="3.5" fill="#C7B896"/>
      <path d="M23 37 L23 26" stroke="#7FA06C" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <path d="M23 29 Q17 27 16 22 Q22 23 23 29" fill="#8FB379"/>
      <path d="M23 31 Q29 29 30 25 Q24 25 23 31" fill="#7FA06C"/>
    </svg>`;
  }
  if (stage === 2) {
    // taller stem, more leaves, closed bud
    return `<svg viewBox="0 0 46 46" class="stage-pop">${soil}
      <ellipse cx="23" cy="37" rx="7" ry="3.5" fill="#C7B896"/>
      <path d="M23 37 L23 16" stroke="#6B9459" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <path d="M23 30 Q15 28 14 22 Q21 23 23 30" fill="#8FB379"/>
      <path d="M23 26 Q31 24 32 18 Q24 19 23 26" fill="#7FA06C"/>
      <circle cx="23" cy="14" r="5" fill="#D9A9C7"/>
    </svg>`;
  }
  // bloom, full flower, gentle sway
  return `<svg viewBox="0 0 46 46" class="stage-pop swaying">${soil}
    <ellipse cx="23" cy="37" rx="7" ry="3.5" fill="#C7B896"/>
    <path d="M23 37 L23 17" stroke="#6B9459" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <path d="M23 29 Q14 27 13 20 Q20 21 23 29" fill="#8FB379"/>
    <path d="M23 25 Q32 23 33 16 Q25 17 23 25" fill="#7FA06C"/>
    <g transform="translate(23,12)">
      <circle cx="0" cy="-6" r="5" fill="#E8B4D9"/>
      <circle cx="5.5" cy="-2" r="5" fill="#E8B4D9"/>
      <circle cx="3.5" cy="4.5" r="5" fill="#E8B4D9"/>
      <circle cx="-3.5" cy="4.5" r="5" fill="#E8B4D9"/>
      <circle cx="-5.5" cy="-2" r="5" fill="#E8B4D9"/>
      <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="4.5" fill="#F0C94A"/>
    </g>
  </svg>`;
}

const TASKS = [
  { id: 1, title: "Morning check-in with Bob", meta: "Self-care · 2 min", stage: 3 },
  { id: 2, title: "Breathing exercise before session", meta: "Self-care", stage: 1 },
  { id: 3, title: "Write down 3 things going okay", meta: "Journal prompt", stage: 0 },
  { id: 4, title: "Reply to Ruhi about Thursday", meta: "Reminder", stage: 0 },
];

function render() {
  const list = document.getElementById('taskList');
  list.innerHTML = '';
  TASKS.forEach(t => {
    const isDone = t.stage === 3;
    const card = document.createElement('div');
    card.className = 'task-card' + (isDone ? ' done' : '');
    card.innerHTML = `
      <div class="plant-wrap" id="plant-${t.id}">${plantSVG(t.stage)}</div>
      <div class="task-text">
        <p class="task-title">${t.title}</p>
        <p class="task-meta">${isDone ? 'In bloom 🌸' : t.meta}</p>
      </div>
    `;
    card.onclick = () => growTask(t.id);
    list.appendChild(card);
  });
  renderProgress();
  renderFooter();
}

function renderProgress() {
  const strip = document.getElementById('progressStrip');
  strip.innerHTML = '';
  TASKS.forEach(t => {
    const dot = document.createElement('div');
    dot.className = 'progress-dot' + (t.stage === 3 ? ' filled' : '');
    strip.appendChild(dot);
  });
}

function renderFooter() {
  const remaining = TASKS.filter(t => t.stage < 3).length;
  const msg = document.getElementById('gardenMsg');
  const footer = document.getElementById('gardenFooter');
  const mascot = footer.querySelector('.mascot-circle');
  if (remaining === 0) {
    mascot.textContent = '🐘';
    msg.innerHTML = `<strong>Your garden's in full bloom.</strong> Look at that — every single one. Proud of you today.`;
    footer.style.background = '#EFE6F2';
  } else {
    mascot.textContent = '🌱';
    msg.innerHTML = `${remaining} left to grow today. No rush — Bob's just here keeping you company.`;
    footer.style.background = '#E9EEE0';
  }
}

function growTask(id) {
  const task = TASKS.find(t => t.id === id);
  if (task.stage === 3) return; // already bloomed
  task.stage = 3; // per the "just show me your best idea" -- one tap takes it straight to full bloom, the reward moment itself is the point, not a multi-tap grind
  const wrap = document.getElementById(`plant-${id}`);
  wrap.innerHTML = plantSVG(3);
  spawnSparkles(wrap);
  render();
}

function spawnSparkles(wrap) {
  const symbols = ['✨', '🌿', '✦'];
  for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
    const s = document.createElement('span');
    s.className = 'sparkle';
    s.textContent = symbols[i % symbols.length];
    s.style.left = (10 + Math.random() * 20) + 'px';
    s.style.top = '10px';
    s.style.animation = `sparkleFloat 0.9s ease-out ${i * 0.05}s forwards`;
    wrap.appendChild(s);
    setTimeout(() => s.remove(), 1000);
  }
}

render();
</script>
</body>
</html>

    return `<svg viewBox="0 0 52 52" width="${size}" height="${size}" class="stage-pop">${ground}
      <path d="M26 48 L26 24" stroke="#7D9B5E" stroke-width="3.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>

      <ellipse cx="34" cy="16" rx="11" ry="10" fill="#9FC488"/>
      <ellipse cx="26" cy="10" rx="12" ry="11" fill="#A9CE8F"/>
    </svg>`;
  }
  if (pct < 1) {
    return `<svg viewBox="0 0 52 52" width="${size}" height="${size}" class="stage-pop swaying">${ground}

      <circle cx="34" cy="10" r="2.5" fill="#E8B4D9"/>
    </svg>`;
  }
  // fully bloomed day
  return `<svg viewBox="0 0 52 52" width="${size}" height="${size}" class="stage-pop swaying">${ground}
    <path d="M26 48 L26 18" stroke="#6E8F52" stroke-width="4.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <ellipse cx="15" cy="17" rx="13" ry="12" fill="#8FB876"/>
    <ellipse cx="37" cy="15" rx="13" ry="12" fill="#9FC488"/>
    <ellipse cx="26" cy="7" rx="14" ry="13" fill="#B3D89A"/>
    <circle cx="12" cy="15" r="3" fill="#F0C94A"/>
    <circle cx="38" cy="12" r="3" fill="#E8B4D9"/>
    <circle cx="26" cy="4" r="3" fill="#E8B4D9"/>
    <circle cx="20" cy="24" r="2.5" fill="#F0C94A"/>
    <circle cx="32" cy="22" r="2.5" fill="#E8B4D9"/>
  </svg>`;
}

function plantSVG(stage) {
  const soil = `<ellipse cx="22" cy="38" rx="15" ry="3.5" fill="#D9CBA8" opacity="0.6"/>`;
  if (stage === 0) return `<svg viewBox="0 0 44 44">${soil}<ellipse cx="22" cy="35" rx="6.5" ry="3" fill="#C7B896"/><circle cx="22" cy="33" r="2.6" fill="#A99B78"/></svg>`;
  if (stage === 1) return `<svg viewBox="0 0 44 44" class="stage-pop">${soil}<ellipse cx="22" cy="35" rx="6.5" ry="3" fill="#C7B896"/><path d="M22 35 L22 25" stroke="#7FA06C" stroke-width="2.3" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M22 28 Q16 26 15 21 Q21 22 22 28" fill="#8FB379"/><path d="M22 30 Q28 28 29 24 Q23 24 22 30" fill="#7FA06C"/></svg>`;
  if (stage === 2) return `<svg viewBox="0 0 44 44" class="stage-pop">${soil}<ellipse cx="22" cy="35" rx="6.5" ry="3" fill="#C7B896"/><path d="M22 35 L22 15" stroke="#6B9459" stroke-width="2.3" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M22 28 Q14 26 13 20 Q20 21 22 28" fill="#8FB379"/><path d="M22 24 Q30 22 31 16 Q23 17 22 24" fill="#7FA06C"/><circle cx="22" cy="13" r="4.5" fill="#D9A9C7"/></svg>`;
  return `<svg viewBox="0 0 44 44" class="stage-pop swaying">${soil}<ellipse cx="22" cy="35" rx="6.5" ry="3" fill="#C7B896"/><path d="M22 35 L22 16" stroke="#6B9459" stroke-width="2.3" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M22 27 Q13 25 12 19 Q19 20 22 27" fill="#8FB379"/><path d="M22 23 Q31 21 32 15 Q24 16 22 23" fill="#7FA06C"/><g transform="translate(22,11)"><circle cx="0" cy="-5.5" r="4.5" fill="#E8B4D9"/><circle cx="5" cy="-2" r="4.5" fill="#E8B4D9"/><circle cx="3" cy="4" r="4.5" fill="#E8B4D9"/><circle cx="-3" cy="4" r="4.5" fill="#E8B4D9"/><circle cx="-5" cy="-2" r="4.5" fill="#E8B4D9"/><circle cx="0" cy="0" r="4" fill="#F0C94A"/></g></svg>`;
}

// ================= Data =================
const TASKS = [
  { id: 1, title: "Prep for Thursday's session", subtasks: 3, seedsGrown: 3 }, // already bloomed
  { id: 2, title: "Reply to Ruhi about schedule", subtasks: 2, seedsGrown: 1 }, // mid-growth
  { id: 3, title: "Update client intake form", subtasks: 3, seedsGrown: 0 },
  { id: 4, title: "Quick breathing break", subtasks: 1, seedsGrown: 0 },
];

const WEEK = [
  { label: 'M', pct: 1 },
  { label: 'T', pct: 0.8 },
  { label: 'W', pct: 0.3 },
  { label: 'T', pct: 1 },
  { label: 'F', pct: 0, today: true }, // will be driven live by TASKS below
  { label: 'S', pct: 0 },
  { label: 'S', pct: 0 },
];

function taskStage(t) {
  if (t.seedsGrown >= t.subtasks) return 3; // bloomed
  if (t.seedsGrown === 0) return 0;
  return t.seedsGrown < t.subtasks / 2 ? 1 : 2;
}
function todayPct() {
  const done = TASKS.filter(t => t.seedsGrown >= t.subtasks).length;
  return done / TASKS.length;
}

// ================= Render: Tasklist =================
function renderTaskScreen() {
  document.getElementById('todayTreeSvg').innerHTML = treeSVG(todayPct(), 52);
  const strip = document.getElementById('progressStrip');
  strip.innerHTML = '';
  TASKS.forEach(t => {
    const dot = document.createElement('div');
    dot.className = 'progress-dot' + (t.seedsGrown >= t.subtasks ? ' filled' : '');
    strip.appendChild(dot);
  });

  const list = document.getElementById('taskList');
  list.innerHTML = '';
  TASKS.forEach(t => {
    const stage = taskStage(t);
    const isDone = stage === 3;
    const card = document.createElement('div');
    card.className = 'task-card' + (isDone ? ' done' : '');
    card.id = `card-${t.id}`;
    let seedsHtml = '';
    if (!isDone && t.subtasks > 1) {
      seedsHtml = '<div class="seed-row">' + Array.from({length: t.subtasks}).map((_, i) =>
        `<div class="seed-dot ${i < t.seedsGrown ? 'filled' : ''}"></div>`
      ).join('') + '</div>';
    }
    card.innerHTML = `
      <div class="plant-wrap" id="plant-${t.id}">${plantSVG(stage)}</div>
      <div class="task-text">
        <p class="task-title">${t.title}</p>
        ${isDone ? '<p class="task-meta">In bloom 🌸</p>' : (t.subtasks > 1 ? seedsHtml : `<p class="task-meta">${t.subtasks} step</p>`)}
      </div>
    `;
    card.onclick = (e) => growSeed(t.id, e.currentTarget);
    list.appendChild(card);
  });
}

function growSeed(id, cardEl) {
  const t = TASKS.find(x => x.id === id);
  if (t.seedsGrown >= t.subtasks) return; // already bloomed
  t.seedsGrown++;

  const justBloomed = t.seedsGrown >= t.subtasks;
  if (justBloomed) {
    // subtask seeds coalesce into the plant blooming
    const wrap = document.getElementById(`plant-${id}`);
    wrap.innerHTML = plantSVG(3);
    flyToTree(cardEl);
  } else {
    renderTaskScreen();
  }
  setTimeout(renderTaskScreen, justBloomed ? 550 : 0);
}

function flyToTree(cardEl) {
  const start = cardEl.getBoundingClientRect();
  const treeBtn = document.getElementById('todayTreeBtn').getBoundingClientRect();
  const seed = document.createElement('div');
  seed.className = 'flying-seed';
  seed.textContent = '🌸';
  seed.style.left = (start.left + 20) + 'px';
  seed.style.top = (start.top + 20) + 'px';
  document.body.appendChild(seed);
  requestAnimationFrame(() => {
    seed.style.left = (treeBtn.left + 20) + 'px';
    seed.style.top = (treeBtn.top + 20) + 'px';
    seed.style.transform = 'scale(0.3)';
    seed.style.opacity = '0';
  });
  setTimeout(() => seed.remove(), 750);
}

// ================= Render: Garden (week) =================
function renderGarden() {
  const field = document.getElementById('gardenField');
  field.innerHTML = '<div class="garden-ground"></div>';
  WEEK.forEach((day, i) => {
    const pct = day.today ? todayPct() : day.pct;
    const slot = document.createElement('div');
    slot.className = 'day-slot';
    const pctLabel = Math.round(pct * 100);
    slot.innerHTML = `
      <div class="tooltip">${pctLabel}% grown</div>
      ${treeSVG(pct, day.today ? 58 : 44)}
      <span class="day-label ${day.today ? 'today' : ''}">${day.label}</span>
    `;
    slot.onclick = () => { slot.classList.toggle('show-tip'); };
    field.appendChild(slot);
  });
}

// ================= Nav =================
document.getElementById('myGardenBtn').onclick = () => {
  document.getElementById('taskScreen').style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('gardenScreen').style.display = 'flex';
  renderGarden();
};
document.getElementById('gardenBackBtn').onclick = () => {
  document.getElementById('gardenScreen').style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('taskScreen').style.display = 'flex';
  renderTaskScreen();
};
document.getElementById('todayTreeBtn').onclick = () => document.getElementById('myGardenBtn').click();

renderTaskScreen();
</script>
</body>
</html>

```

function startGoogleCalendarConnect(){
  if(GOOGLE_CALENDAR_CLIENT_ID === 'PENDING_CLIENT_ID'){
    showToast('Calendar connection is being set up — check back shortly.');
    return;
  }
  var redirectUri = window.location.origin + window.location.pathname;
  var authUrl = 'https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/v2/auth?' + new URLSearchParams({

  }).toString();

}

      '<button id="gcalConnectBtn" style="width:100%;padding:11px;border-radius:10px;border:none;background:#4285F4;color:#fff;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;">Reconnect Google Calendar</button>';
    document.getElementById('gcalConnectBtn').onclick = startGoogleCalendarConnect;

}

function startGoogleCalendarConnect(){
  if(GOOGLE_CALENDAR_CLIENT_ID === 'PENDING_CLIENT_ID'){
    showToast('Calendar connection is being set up — check back shortly.');
    return;
  }
  var redirectUri = WEB_APP_URL;
  var authUrl = 'https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/v2/auth?' + new URLSearchParams({
    client_id: GOOGLE_CALENDAR_CLIENT_ID,
    redirect_uri: redirectUri,
    response_type: 'code',
    scope: GOOGLE_CALENDAR_SCOPE,
    access_type: 'offline', // required to receive a refresh token at all
    prompt: 'consent',      // forces a fresh refresh token every time, not just on first-ever connect
    state: 'gcal_connect'
  }).toString();

  // Real, confirmed cause of "clicked continue but never came back to the app": Google's
  // OAuth client here is a Web application type, which only accepts https:// redirect URIs
  // (confirmed directly -- Google flatly rejects custom URL schemes for this client type,
  // unlike the Sign-In-with-Google flow, which never actually gives Google a custom scheme at
  // all -- that goes through Supabase's own relay, and only Supabase's internal redirect uses
  // one). window.location.href triggers Android to hand the whole flow to an external browser
  // tab, and when Google redirects back to the plain https:// URL, that tab just loads the web
  // app on its own, completely disconnected from the actual native app session -- which is
  // exactly what looked like "never redirected back."
  //
  // Fix: open it in Capacitor's own in-app browser instead, and watch every page load inside
  // it for the redirect actually happening -- the moment it does, grab the code, close the
  // browser programmatically, and hand control straight back to the running app. No custom
  // scheme needed, no changes required to what's already registered in Google Console.
  if(IS_NATIVE_APP && window.Capacitor?.Plugins?.Browser){
    var CapBrowser = window.Capacitor.Plugins.Browser;
    var listenerHandle = CapBrowser.addListener('browserPageLoaded', function(){});

async function startGoogleCalendarConnect(){
  if(GOOGLE_CALENDAR_CLIENT_ID === 'PENDING_CLIENT_ID'){
    showToast('Calendar connection is being set up — check back shortly.');
    return;
  }

  // Generated now, while the app definitely has a valid session -- this is what lets the
  // landing page identify who's connecting later, even in a browser context that turns out to
  // have no session of its own (confirmed directly: this is what was actually missing before).
  var { data: tokenData, error: tokenError } = await sb.functions.invoke('google-calendar-oauth', { body: { action: 'create_state_token' } });
  if(tokenError || !tokenData?.token){
    showToast("Couldn't start the connection — please try again.");
    return;
  }

  var redirectUri = WEB_APP_URL;
  var authUrl = 'https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/v2/auth?' + new URLSearchParams({
    client_id: GOOGLE_CALENDAR_CLIENT_ID,
    redirect_uri: redirectUri,
    response_type: 'code',
    scope: GOOGLE_CALENDAR_SCOPE,
    access_type: 'offline', // required to receive a refresh token at all
    prompt: 'consent',      // forces a fresh refresh token every time, not just on first-ever connect
    state: tokenData.token
  }).toString();

  // Real, confirmed cause of "clicked continue but never came back to the app": Google's OAuth
  // client here is a Web application type, which only accepts https:// redirect URIs (Google
  // flatly rejects custom URL schemes for this client type -- unlike Sign-In-with-Google, which
  // never actually gives Google a custom scheme at all, that goes through Supabase's own relay).
  // window.location.href triggers Android to hand the whole flow to an external browser tab,
  // and the redirect back just loads the plain web app there, disconnected from the native
  // app's own session -- exactly what looked like "never redirected back."
  //
  // The state token above is what actually fixes this, not where the flow happens to run: the
  // landing page can now complete the connection correctly no matter which browser context it
  // ends up in, session or no session. Still open it in Capacitor's own in-app browser when
  // available, purely for a nicer contained experience (auto-closes itself when done) --
  // but the fix itself doesn't depend on that succeeding.
  if(IS_NATIVE_APP && window.Capacitor?.Plugins?.Browser){
    window.Capacitor.Plugins.Browser.open({ url: authUrl, presentationStyle: 'popover' });
    return;
  }
  window.location.href = authUrl;
}

async function completeGoogleCalendarConnect(code, stateToken){
  showToast('Connecting your calendar…');
  var { data, error } = await sb.functions.invoke('google-calendar-oauth', { body: { action: 'exchange_code', code: code, state_token: stateToken } });
  if(error || (data && data.error)){
    showToast("Couldn't connect — please try again.");
    return;
  }
  showToast('Calendar connected as ' + (data.google_email || 'your Google account') + '.');

async function handleGoogleCalendarCallback(){
  var params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
  var code = params.get('code');
  var stateToken = params.get('state');
  // A UUID state token specifically (not any other feature that might use ?state= or ?code=
  // on this same URL) -- the format itself is the signal, since this can no longer check
  // against a fixed literal string the way the old 'gcal_connect' constant allowed.
  var looksLikeStateToken = stateToken && /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i.test(stateToken);
  if(!code || !looksLikeStateToken) return;
  window.history.replaceState({}, document.title, window.location.pathname);
  await completeGoogleCalendarConnect(code, stateToken);
  // If this landed inside Capacitor's in-app browser (opened from startGoogleCalendarConnect),
  // close it now that the connection is done, returning control to the app automatically
  // instead of leaving the person stranded on a page with nothing left to do.
  if(window.Capacitor?.Plugins?.Browser){
    setTimeout(function(){ window.Capacitor.Plugins.Browser.close().catch(function(){}); }, 1500);
  }
}
// Runs immediately on script load, independent of login state entirely -- the landing page
// this redirects to might have no active session of its own at all (confirmed directly: this
// is exactly the scenario that broke before), so this can't wait for onAuthSuccess to fire.

NEW (exact):
```
// Repeat picker: three real patterns now, not just same-weekday-weekly -- per direct
// correction that therapists need this to actually cover how their availability really
// varies (some days repeat weekly, some only land on specific extra weekdays, some follow a
// monthly rhythm like "3rd Monday of every month").
document.getElementById('therapistRepeatToggle').onchange = function(){
  var modeArea = document.getElementById('therapistRepeatModeArea');
  var area = document.getElementById('therapistRepeatDatesArea');
  if(!this.checked){
    modeArea.style.display = 'none';
    area.style.display = 'none';
    area.innerHTML = '';
    return;
  }
  modeArea.style.display = 'block';
  document.getElementById('therapistRepeatMode').value = 'weekly';
  renderTherapistRepeatDates();
};
document.getElementById('therapistRepeatMode').onchange = renderTherapistRepeatDates;

function nthWeekdayOfMonth(year, monthIndex, weekday, n){
  // weekday: 0=Sun..6=Sat. Finds the Nth occurrence of that weekday in the given month.
  var d = new Date(year, monthIndex, 1);
  var offset = (weekday - d.getDay() + 7) % 7;
  d.setDate(1 + offset + (n-1)*7);
  return d;
}

function renderTherapistRepeatDates(){
  var area = document.getElementById('therapistRepeatDatesArea');
  var mode = document.getElementById('therapistRepeatMode').value;
  var parts = therapistCalActiveDayKey.split('-').map(Number);
  var baseDate = new Date(parts[0], parts[1]-1, parts[2]);
  var weekdayName = baseDate.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { weekday: 'long' });
  area.style.display = 'block';
  var rows = [];

  if(mode === 'weekly'){
    for(var i=1; i<=10; i++){
      var d = new Date(baseDate);
      d.setDate(d.getDate() + i*7); // same weekday, one week apart each
      var key = d.getFullYear()+'-'+pad2(d.getMonth()+1)+'-'+pad2(d.getDate());
      var label = d.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month:'short', day:'numeric', year:'numeric' });
      rows.push('<label style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:12.5px;color:#2A2013;padding:6px 0;cursor:pointer;">'+
        '<input type="checkbox" class="therapist-repeat-date-check" data-key="'+key+'" style="accent-color:#6690D6;">'+
        'Next '+weekdayName+' — '+label+
      '</label>');
    }
    area.innerHTML = '<p style="font-size:10.5px;color:#9AABCE;margin:0 0 6px;">Same time, same weekday — pick which future dates to add it to:</p>' + rows.join('');

  } else if(mode === 'multiday'){
    var dayNames = ['Sunday','Monday','Tuesday','Wednesday','Thursday','Friday','Saturday'];
    for(var wd=0; wd<7; wd++){
      if(wd === baseDate.getDay()) continue; // this day is already being added -- no need to also offer it here
      var d2 = new Date(baseDate);
      var diff = (wd - baseDate.getDay() + 7) % 7;
      d2.setDate(baseDate.getDate() + (diff === 0 ? 7 : diff)); // next occurrence of that weekday from the base date
      var key2 = d2.getFullYear()+'-'+pad2(d2.getMonth()+1)+'-'+pad2(d2.getDate());
      var label2 = d2.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month:'short', day:'numeric', year:'numeric' });
      rows.push('<label style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:12.5px;color:#2A2013;padding:6px 0;cursor:pointer;">'+
        '<input type="checkbox" class="therapist-repeat-date-check" data-key="'+key2+'" style="accent-color:#6690D6;">'+
        dayNames[wd]+' — '+label2+
      '</label>');
    }
    area.innerHTML = '<p style="font-size:10.5px;color:#9AABCE;margin:0 0 6px;">Same time, this week — pick which other weekdays to also add it to:</p>' + rows.join('');

  } else if(mode === 'monthly'){
    var weekday = baseDate.getDay();
    var occurrence = Math.ceil(baseDate.getDate() / 7); // which "Nth" occurrence this weekday is within its own month
    var ordinal = ['','1st','2nd','3rd','4th','5th'][occurrence] || (occurrence+'th');
    for(var m=1; m<=6; m++){
      var targetMonth = baseDate.getMonth() + m;
      var targetYear = baseDate.getFullYear() + Math.floor(targetMonth / 12);
      var d3 = nthWeekdayOfMonth(targetYear, targetMonth % 12, weekday, occurrence);
      var key3 = d3.getFullYear()+'-'+pad2(d3.getMonth()+1)+'-'+pad2(d3.getDate());
      var label3 = d3.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month:'long', day:'numeric', year:'numeric' });
      rows.push('<label style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:12.5px;color:#2A2013;padding:6px 0;cursor:pointer;">'+
        '<input type="checkbox" class="therapist-repeat-date-check" data-key="'+key3+'" style="accent-color:#6690D6;">'+
        'The '+ordinal+' '+weekdayName+' — '+label3+
      '</label>');
    }
    area.innerHTML = '<p style="font-size:10.5px;color:#9AABCE;margin:0 0 6px;">The '+ordinal+' '+weekdayName+' of each month — pick which months to also add it to:</p>' + rows.join('');
  }
}
```

NEW (exact):
```
Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  const corsHeaders = { "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*", "Access-Control-Allow-Headers": "authorization, x-client-info, apikey, content-type, x-goog-channel-id, x-goog-resource-id, x-goog-resource-state" };
  if (req.method === "OPTIONS") return new Response(null, { headers: corsHeaders });

  try {
    const contentType = req.headers.get("content-type") || "";

    // Explicit action calls (registering or renewing a watch channel) vs. Google's own webhook
    // pings (which never send a JSON action body, only headers) are routed separately here.
    if (contentType.includes("application/json")) {
      const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({}));
      if (body.action === "register_watch") {
        const connRows = await dbFetch(`professional_calendar_connections?user_id=eq.${body.user_id}&select=*`);
        const conn = Array.isArray(connRows) ? connRows[0] : null;
        if (!conn) return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "No connection found" }), { status: 404, headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" } });

        const accessToken = await getValidAccessToken(conn);
        if (!accessToken) return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "Reconnect needed" }), { status: 401, headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" } });

        const channelId = crypto.randomUUID();
        const watchRes = await fetch(`https://www.googleapis.com/calendar/v3/calendars/${conn.google_calendar_id}/events/watch`, {
          method: "POST",
          headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${accessToken}`, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
          body: JSON.stringify({
            id: channelId,
            type: "web_hook",
            address: `${SUPABASE_URL}/functions/v1/google-calendar-sync`,
          }),
        });
        const watchData = await watchRes.json();
        if (!watchRes.ok) {
          console.error("Google watch registration error:", watchData);
          return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "Could not start instant sync" }), { status: 502, headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" } });
        }

        await dbWrite(`professional_calendar_connections?user_id=eq.${body.user_id}`, "PATCH", {
          watch_channel_id: channelId,
          watch_resource_id: watchData.resourceId,
          watch_expires_at: new Date(Number(watchData.expiration)).toISOString(),
        }, "return=minimal");

        return new Response(JSON.stringify({ success: true }), { headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" } });
      }
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "Unknown action" }), { status: 400, headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" } });
    }

    // Google's actual webhook ping carries no body -- everything needed is in headers.
    const channelId = req.headers.get("x-goog-channel-id");
```

      const now = Date.now();
      await dbWrite("professional_calendar_connections", "POST", {
        user_id: userId,
        google_email: googleEmail,
        access_token: tokenData.access_token,
        refresh_token: tokenData.refresh_token,
        access_token_expires_at: new Date(now + tokenData.expires_in * 1000).toISOString(),
        refresh_token_expires_at: new Date(now + 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000).toISOString(),
        connected_at: new Date(now).toISOString(),
        last_refreshed_at: new Date(now).toISOString(),
        needs_reconnect: false,
      });

      // Starts instant sync right away -- registered server-side here rather than as a
      // separate frontend call, since this landing page might have no active session at all
      // (the whole reason the state-token approach exists), so it can't be relied on to make
      // a second authenticated round-trip afterward.
      fetch(`${SUPABASE_URL}/functions/v1/google-calendar-sync`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ action: "register_watch", user_id: userId }),
      }).catch((e) => console.error("Could not register calendar watch:", e));

      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ success: true, google_email: googleEmail }), {
        headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      });

        // Centralized so every place a session's state can change (client requests a time,
        // professional accepts, admin logs an appointment directly, a reschedule, a
        // cancellation) all call the same logic instead of each duplicating Google API calls.
        const bookingRows = await dbFetch(`expert_bookings?id=eq.${body.booking_id}&select=*`);
        const booking = Array.isArray(bookingRows) ? bookingRows[0] : null;
        if (!booking) return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "Booking not found" }), { status: 404, headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" } });

        const profRows = await dbFetch(`profiles?therapist_expert_name=eq.${encodeURIComponent(booking.expert_name)}&is_therapist=eq.true&select=user_id`);
        const professional = Array.isArray(profRows) ? profRows[0] : null;
        if (!professional) return new Response(JSON.stringify({ skipped: "No professional account for this expert" }), { headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" } });

        const connRows = await dbFetch(`professional_calendar_connections?user_id=eq.${professional.user_id}&select=*`);
        const conn = Array.isArray(connRows) ? connRows[0] : null;
        if (!conn || conn.needs_reconnect) return new Response(JSON.stringify({ skipped: "No active calendar connection" }), { headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" } });

        const accessToken = await getValidAccessToken(conn);
        if (!accessToken) return new Response(JSON.stringify({ skipped: "Reconnect needed" }), { headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" } });

        const linkRows = await dbFetch(`session_calendar_events?booking_id=eq.${body.booking_id}&select=*`);
        const existingLink = Array.isArray(linkRows) ? linkRows[0] : null;

        // Cancelled (or session_date cleared) -- remove the calendar event if one exists.
        if (booking.status === "cancelled" || !booking.session_date) {
          if (existingLink) {
            await fetch(`https://www.googleapis.com/calendar/v3/calendars/${conn.google_calendar_id}/events/${existingLink.google_event_id}`, {
              method: "DELETE", headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${accessToken}` },
            }).catch(() => {});
            await fetch(`${SUPABASE_URL}/rest/v1/session_calendar_events?id=eq.${existingLink.id}`, {
              method: "DELETE", headers: { apikey: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY ?? "", Authorization: `Bearer ${SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY}` },
            });
          }
          return new Response(JSON.stringify({ success: true, action: "removed" }), { headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" } });
        }

        const clientRows = await dbFetch(`profiles?user_id=eq.${booking.user_id}&select=name`);
        const clientName = (Array.isArray(clientRows) && clientRows[0]?.name) || "HOBS client";
        const startTime = new Date(booking.session_date);
        const endTime = new Date(startTime.getTime() + 45 * 60 * 1000); // default 45-minute session

        const eventBody = {
          summary: `HOBS Session — ${clientName}`,
          description: "Booked via HOBS Companion.",
          start: { dateTime: startTime.toISOString() },
          end: { dateTime: endTime.toISOString() },
          conferenceData: { createRequest: { requestId: body.booking_id, conferenceSolutionKey: { type: "hangoutsMeet" } } },
        };

        let eventRes, eventData;
        if (existingLink) {
          eventRes = await fetch(`https://www.googleapis.com/calendar/v3/calendars/${conn.google_calendar_id}/events/${existingLink.google_event_id}?conferenceDataVersion=1`, {
            method: "PATCH",
            headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${accessToken}`, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
            body: JSON.stringify(eventBody),
          });
        } else {
          eventRes = await fetch(`https://www.googleapis.com/calendar/v3/calendars/${conn.google_calendar_id}/events?conferenceDataVersion=1`, {
            method: "POST",
            headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${accessToken}`, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
            body: JSON.stringify(eventBody),
          });
        }
        eventData = await eventRes.json();
        if (!eventRes.ok) {
          console.error("Google event sync error:", eventData);
          return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "Could not sync to calendar" }), { status: 502, headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" } });
        }

        if (existingLink) {
          await fetch(`${SUPABASE_URL}/rest/v1/session_calendar_events?id=eq.${existingLink.id}`, {
            method: "PATCH",
            headers: { apikey: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY ?? "", Authorization: `Bearer ${SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY}`, "Content-Type": "application/json", Prefer: "return=minimal" },
            body: JSON.stringify({ last_known_start: startTime.toISOString(), last_known_end: endTime.toISOString(), updated_at: new Date().toISOString() }),
          });
        } else {
          await dbWrite("session_calendar_events", "POST", {
            booking_id: body.booking_id, professional_user_id: professional.user_id, google_event_id: eventData.id,
            last_known_start: startTime.toISOString(), last_known_end: endTime.toISOString(),
          }, "return=minimal");
        }

        const meetLink = eventData.conferenceData?.entryPoints?.find((e: any) => e.entryPointType === "video")?.uri;
        return new Response(JSON.stringify({ success: true, action: existingLink ? "updated" : "created", meet_link: meetLink || null }), { headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" } });
      }

      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "Unknown action" }), { status: 400, headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" } });

// place a booking's session_date or status actually changes (a client's time gets confirmed,
// a reschedule, a cancellation), rather than duplicating this at each site. Fire-and-forget:

// Time changes detected from Google Calendar never auto-apply -- per direct instruction, the

async function renderCalendarChangeRequests(){
  var section = document.getElementById('therapistCalChangeRequestsSection');
  var { data: requests } = await sb.from('calendar_change_requests').select('*').eq('professional_user_id', currentUser.id).eq('status', 'pending').order('created_at', { ascending: false });
  if(!requests || requests.length === 0){ section.style.display = 'none'; section.innerHTML = ''; return; }

  section.style.display = 'block';
  var rows = [];
  for(var r of requests){
    var { data: booking } = await sb.from('expert_bookings').select('user_id, external_client_name, is_external').eq('id', r.booking_id).single();
    var clientLabel = 'a client';
    if(booking){
      if(booking.is_external) clientLabel = booking.external_client_name || 'a client';
      else if(booking.user_id){
        var { data: clientProfile } = await sb.from('profiles').select('name').eq('user_id', booking.user_id).single();
        clientLabel = (clientProfile && clientProfile.name) || 'a client';
      }
    }
    var oldStr = r.old_start ? new Date(r.old_start).toLocaleString(undefined, {dateStyle:'medium', timeStyle:'short'}) : 'unknown time';
    var newStr = new Date(r.new_start).toLocaleString(undefined, {dateStyle:'medium', timeStyle:'short'});
    rows.push(
      '<div style="background:#FEF3D8;border:1px solid #EFD9A0;border-radius:12px;padding:14px;margin-bottom:10px;">'+
        '<p style="font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:#7B4F00;margin:0 0 4px;">Calendar time changed — needs your review</p>'+
        '<p style="font-size:11.5px;color:#2A2013;margin:0 0 3px;">Session with '+clientLabel+'</p>'+
        '<p style="font-size:11px;color:#5C6B94;margin:0 0 10px;">'+oldStr+' → <strong>'+newStr+'</strong></p>'+
        '<div style="display:flex;gap:8px;">'+
          '<button class="cal-change-approve-btn" data-id="'+r.id+'" style="flex:1;padding:9px;border-radius:8px;border:none;background:#3B8F63;color:#fff;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;">Approve</button>'+
          '<button class="cal-change-decline-btn" data-id="'+r.id+'" style="flex:1;padding:9px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid #C77B7B;background:transparent;color:#C77B7B;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;">Decline (keep original)</button>'+
        '</div>'+
      '</div>'
    );
  }
  section.innerHTML = rows.join('');

  section.querySelectorAll('.cal-change-approve-btn').forEach(function(btn){
    btn.onclick = async function(){
      var req = requests.find(function(r){ return r.id === btn.dataset.id; });
      var { error } = await sb.from('expert_bookings').update({ session_date: req.new_start }).eq('id', req.booking_id);
      if(error){ showToast("Couldn't approve — please try again."); return; }
      await sb.from('calendar_change_requests').update({ status: 'approved', resolved_at: new Date().toISOString() }).eq('id', req.id);
      showToast('Time change approved.');
      renderCalendarChangeRequests();
      renderTherapistClientsList();
    };
  });
  section.querySelectorAll('.cal-change-decline-btn').forEach(function(btn){
    btn.onclick = async function(){
      var req = requests.find(function(r){ return r.id === btn.dataset.id; });
      await sb.from('calendar_change_requests').update({ status: 'declined', resolved_at: new Date().toISOString() }).eq('id', req.id);
      showToast('Declined — correcting the calendar back to the original time.');
      syncSessionToCalendar(req.booking_id); // pushes the app's still-unchanged session_date back to Google, correcting the drift
      renderCalendarChangeRequests();
    };
  });
}

      var whenStr = new Date(r.new_start).toLocaleString(undefined, {dateStyle:'medium', timeStyle:'short'});

        '<div style="display:flex;gap:8px;">'+
          '<button class="cal-change-approve-btn" data-id="'+r.id+'" style="flex:1;padding:9px;border-radius:8px;border:none;background:#3B8F63;color:#fff;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;">Keep session</button>'+
          '<button class="cal-change-decline-btn" data-id="'+r.id+'" style="flex:1;padding:9px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid #C77B7B;background:transparent;color:#C77B7B;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;">Cancel session</button>'+
        '</div>';
    } else {
      var oldStr = r.old_start ? new Date(r.old_start).toLocaleString(undefined, {dateStyle:'medium', timeStyle:'short'}) : 'unknown time';
      var newStr = new Date(r.new_start).toLocaleString(undefined, {dateStyle:'medium', timeStyle:'short'});

        '<p style="font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:#7B4F00;margin:0 0 4px;">Calendar time changed — needs your review</p>'+

        '<div style="display:flex;gap:8px;">'+
          '<button class="cal-change-approve-btn" data-id="'+r.id+'" style="flex:1;padding:9px;border-radius:8px;border:none;background:#3B8F63;color:#fff;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;">Approve</button>'+
          '<button class="cal-change-decline-btn" data-id="'+r.id+'" style="flex:1;padding:9px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid #C77B7B;background:transparent;color:#C77B7B;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;">Decline (keep original)</button>'+
        '</div>';
    }
    rows.push('<div style="background:#FEF3D8;border:1px solid #EFD9A0;border-radius:12px;padding:14px;margin-bottom:10px;" data-type="'+r.change_type+'">'+bodyHtml+'</div>');
  }
  section.innerHTML = rows.join('');

  section.querySelectorAll('.cal-change-approve-btn').forEach(function(btn){
    btn.onclick = async function(){
      var req = requests.find(function(r){ return r.id === btn.dataset.id; });
      if(req.change_type === 'conflict_detected'){
        // "Keep session" -- nothing to change, just acknowledge and clear the flag.
        await sb.from('calendar_change_requests').update({ status: 'approved', resolved_at: new Date().toISOString() }).eq('id', req.id);
        showToast('Session kept as scheduled.');
        renderCalendarChangeRequests();
        return;
      }
      var { error } = await sb.from('expert_bookings').update({ session_date: req.new_start }).eq('id', req.booking_id);
      if(error){ showToast("Couldn't approve — please try again."); return; }
      await sb.from('calendar_change_requests').update({ status: 'approved', resolved_at: new Date().toISOString() }).eq('id', req.id);
      showToast('Time change approved.');
      renderCalendarChangeRequests();
      renderTherapistClientsList();
    };
  });
  section.querySelectorAll('.cal-change-decline-btn').forEach(function(btn){
    btn.onclick = async function(){
      var req = requests.find(function(r){ return r.id === btn.dataset.id; });
      await sb.from('calendar_change_requests').update({ status: 'declined', resolved_at: new Date().toISOString() }).eq('id', req.id);
      if(req.change_type === 'conflict_detected'){
        // "Cancel session" -- actually cancel the booking, which also removes the Google event
        // and runs the same cancellation policy as any other cancellation.
        await sb.from('expert_bookings').update({ status: 'cancelled' }).eq('id', req.booking_id);
        showToast('Session cancelled due to the conflict.');
        syncSessionToCalendar(req.booking_id);
        renderTherapistClientsList();
      } else {
        showToast('Declined — correcting the calendar back to the original time.');
        syncSessionToCalendar(req.booking_id); // pushes the app's still-unchanged session_date back to Google, correcting the drift
      }
      renderCalendarChangeRequests();
    };

async function registerWatchForUser(userId: string): Promise<{ ok: boolean; reason?: string }> {
  const connRows = await dbFetch(`professional_calendar_connections?user_id=eq.${userId}&select=*`);
  const conn = Array.isArray(connRows) ? connRows[0] : null;
  if (!conn) return { ok: false, reason: "No connection found" };

  const accessToken = await getValidAccessToken(conn);
  if (!accessToken) return { ok: false, reason: "Reconnect needed" };

  const channelId = crypto.randomUUID();
  const watchRes = await fetch(`https://www.googleapis.com/calendar/v3/calendars/${conn.google_calendar_id}/events/watch`, {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${accessToken}`, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    body: JSON.stringify({ id: channelId, type: "web_hook", address: `${SUPABASE_URL}/functions/v1/google-calendar-sync` }),
  });
  const watchData = await watchRes.json();
  if (!watchRes.ok) {
    console.error("Google watch registration error:", watchData);
    return { ok: false, reason: "Could not start instant sync" };
  }

  // Old channel isn't strictly needed once a new one exists (Google lets it lapse on its own),
  // but explicitly stopping it is the cleaner behavior rather than leaving it dangling.
  if (conn.watch_channel_id && conn.watch_resource_id) {
    fetch("https://www.googleapis.com/calendar/v3/channels/stop", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${accessToken}`, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({ id: conn.watch_channel_id, resourceId: conn.watch_resource_id }),
    }).catch(() => {});
  }

  await dbWrite(`professional_calendar_connections?user_id=eq.${userId}`, "PATCH", {
    watch_channel_id: channelId,
    watch_resource_id: watchData.resourceId,
    watch_expires_at: new Date(Number(watchData.expiration)).toISOString(),
  }, "return=minimal");

  return { ok: true };
}

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  const corsHeaders = { "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*", "Access-Control-Allow-Headers": "authorization, x-client-info, apikey, content-type, x-goog-channel-id, x-goog-resource-id, x-goog-resource-state, x-scheduler-secret" };
  if (req.method === "OPTIONS") return new Response(null, { headers: corsHeaders });

  try {
    const contentType = req.headers.get("content-type") || "";

    // Explicit action calls (registering or renewing a watch channel) vs. Google's own webhook
    // pings (which never send a JSON action body, only headers) are routed separately here.
    if (contentType.includes("application/json")) {
      const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({}));

      if (body.action === "renew_watches") {
        // Scheduled, not user-triggered -- same shared-secret pattern already used for
        // notification-scheduler, so this can't be called by just anyone hitting the endpoint.
        const schedulerSecret = req.headers.get("x-scheduler-secret");
        if (schedulerSecret !== Deno.env.get("SCHEDULER_SECRET")) {
          return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "Forbidden" }), { status: 403, headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" } });
        }
        const soon = new Date(Date.now() + 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000).toISOString(); // renew anything expiring within the next 24h
        const expiring = await dbFetch(`professional_calendar_connections?watch_expires_at=lt.${soon}&needs_reconnect=eq.false&select=user_id`);
        const results = [];
        for (const c of (Array.isArray(expiring) ? expiring : [])) {
          const r = await registerWatchForUser(c.user_id);
          results.push({ user_id: c.user_id, ...r });
        }
        return new Response(JSON.stringify({ processed: results.length, results }), { headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" } });
      }

      if (body.action === "register_watch") {
        const result = await registerWatchForUser(body.user_id);
        if (!result.ok) return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: result.reason }), { status: result.reason === "No connection found" ? 404 : 502, headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" } });
        return new Response(JSON.stringify({ success: true }), { headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" } });
      }

document.getElementById('logoutBtn').onclick = function(){
  sb.auth.signOut().then(function(){
    currentUser = null;
    pushListenersAttached = false; // so a different user signing in on this device re-registers cleanly for push
    pendingNotificationInteraction = null;
    // Full reset, not a partial one -- this used to only clear 6 of many fields, leaving things
    // like isAdmin, isTherapist, displayName, phoneNumber, dateOfBirth stale in memory (though
    // not in localStorage, which was already being cleared) until the next sign-in's fresh
    // profile fetch overwrote them. On a shared/demo device this was a real window where stale
    // data from the previous account could show before the new one's real data loaded.
    appState = getDefaultAppState();
    try { localStorage.removeItem(STORAGE_KEY); } catch(e){}
    document.getElementById('authEmail').value = '';
    document.getElementById('authPassword').value = '';
    hideAuthError();
    // Real bug fixed: for anyone who'd logged in via a restored session (not a fresh manual
    // login), authLoadingState/authFormContent never got switched even once -- that only
    // happens in the initial boot's "no session" branch. So this was leaving the splash/spinner
    // permanently stuck visible after sign-out, with the actual login form still display:none
    // underneath it -- looked exactly like being stuck on "Good to see you" / loading forever.
    document.getElementById('authLoadingState').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('authFormContent').style.display = 'block';
    document.getElementById('authOverlay').style.display = 'flex';
  });

  // if it fails to load (flaky connection, CDN hiccup, an ad-blocker catching a third-party

// Unified appointments view -- per direct correction, appointments were previously only
// visible grouped by client (buried inside each person's own row), with no single place to see
// everything chronologically or edit it easily. Every real booking for this therapist, past and
// upcoming, in one clear list.
var therapistApptFilter = 'upcoming';
function renderTherapistAppointmentsList(){
  var listEl = document.getElementById('therapistAppointmentsList');
  listEl.innerHTML = '<p style="text-align:center;color:#9AABCE;font-size:12px;">Loading…</p>';

  Promise.all([
    sb.from('expert_bookings').select('id,user_id,status,session_date,is_external,external_client_name').eq('expert_name', appState.therapistExpertName).not('session_date', 'is', null).order('session_date', { ascending: therapistApptFilter === 'upcoming' }),
    sb.from('profiles').select('user_id,name,therapist_expert_name')
  ]).then(function(results){
    var bookingsRes = results[0], profilesRes = results[1];
    if(bookingsRes.error){
      listEl.innerHTML = '<p style="color:#C77B7B;font-size:12px;">Could not load appointments.</p>';
      return;
    }
    var profileByUserId = {};
    (profilesRes.data || []).forEach(function(p){ profileByUserId[p.user_id] = p; });
    var selfUserIds = (profilesRes.data || []).filter(function(p){ return p.therapist_expert_name === appState.therapistExpertName; }).map(function(p){ return p.user_id; });

    var now = new Date();
    var rows = (bookingsRes.data || []).filter(function(b){
      if(!b.is_external && selfUserIds.indexOf(b.user_id) !== -1) return false; // exclude self-test bookings
      var isPast = new Date(b.session_date) < now || b.status === 'cancelled';
      return therapistApptFilter === 'past' ? isPast : !isPast;
    });

    if(rows.length === 0){
      listEl.innerHTML = '<p style="text-align:center;color:#9AABCE;font-size:12px;padding:16px 0;">No '+therapistApptFilter+' appointments.</p>';
      return;
    }

    listEl.innerHTML = rows.map(function(b){
      var name = b.is_external ? (b.external_client_name || 'External client') : ((profileByUserId[b.user_id] && profileByUserId[b.user_id].name) || 'Unknown client');
      var when = new Date(b.session_date).toLocaleString('en-IN', { day:'numeric', month:'short', year:'numeric', hour:'numeric', minute:'2-digit' });
      var isCancelled = b.status === 'cancelled';
      var statusBadge = isCancelled
        ? '<span style="font-size:9.5px;font-weight:700;color:#C77B7B;background:#FBEDED;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:8px;">Cancelled</span>'
        : (therapistApptFilter === 'past' ? '<span style="font-size:9.5px;font-weight:700;color:#9AABCE;background:#F3F2ED;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:8px;">Completed</span>'
          : '<span style="font-size:9.5px;font-weight:700;color:#3B8F63;background:#EAF4EE;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:8px;">Confirmed</span>');
      var actionsHtml = (therapistApptFilter === 'upcoming' && !isCancelled && !b.is_external)
        ? '<div style="display:flex;gap:6px;margin-top:8px;">'+
            '<button class="therapist-appt-edit-btn" data-user-id="'+b.user_id+'" data-booking-id="'+b.id+'" data-name="'+name.replace(/"/g,'&quot;')+'" data-session-date="'+b.session_date+'" style="flex:1;font-size:10.5px;font-weight:700;color:#6690D6;background:none;border:1px solid #C7D2E8;border-radius:8px;padding:6px;cursor:pointer;">Edit time</button>'+
            '<button class="therapist-appt-cancel-btn" data-booking-id="'+b.id+'" style="flex:1;font-size:10.5px;font-weight:700;color:#C77B7B;background:none;border:1px solid #EFC7C7;border-radius:8px;padding:6px;cursor:pointer;">Cancel</button>'+
          '</div>'
        : '';
      return '<div style="background:#FFFFFF;border:1px solid #EEE0C4;border-radius:12px;padding:12px 13px;margin-bottom:8px;">'+
        '<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;gap:8px;margin-bottom:3px;">'+
          '<p style="font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;color:#2A2013;margin:0;">'+name.replace(/</g,'&lt;')+'</p>'+statusBadge+
        '</div>'+
        '<p style="font-size:11.5px;color:#5C6B94;margin:0;">'+when+'</p>'+
        actionsHtml+
      '</div>';
    }).join('');

    listEl.querySelectorAll('.therapist-appt-edit-btn').forEach(function(btn){
      btn.onclick = function(){
        openTherapistScheduleEdit(btn.dataset.userId, btn.dataset.bookingId, btn.dataset.name, btn.dataset.sessionDate);
      };
    });
    listEl.querySelectorAll('.therapist-appt-cancel-btn').forEach(function(btn){
      btn.onclick = function(){
        if(!confirm('Cancel this appointment?')) return;
        sb.from('expert_bookings').update({ status: 'cancelled' }).eq('id', btn.dataset.bookingId).then(function(result){
          if(result.error){ showToast("Couldn't cancel — please try again."); return; }
          showToast('Appointment cancelled.');
          syncSessionToCalendar(btn.dataset.bookingId);
          renderTherapistAppointmentsList();
        });
      };
    });
  });
}
document.querySelectorAll('.therapist-appt-filter-btn').forEach(function(btn){
  btn.onclick = function(){
    therapistApptFilter = btn.dataset.filter;
    document.querySelectorAll('.therapist-appt-filter-btn').forEach(function(b){
      var active = b === btn;
      b.style.background = active ? '#6690D6' : 'transparent';
      b.style.color = active ? '#fff' : '#9AABCE';
      b.style.border = active ? 'none' : '1px solid #EEE0C4';
    });
    renderTherapistAppointmentsList();
  };
});

# Google Calendar Data — addition for the HOBS privacy policy

*(Insert this as its own section, e.g. "Google Calendar Integration," anywhere after your general "Information We Collect" section. Written to stand alone regardless of what's around it.)*

## Google Calendar Integration

HOBS Companion offers mental health professionals on our platform the option to connect their own Google Calendar to the app.

**What we access.** If a professional chooses to connect their calendar, we request permission to view and create calendar events on that professional's own Google Calendar. We do not access any other Google service (Gmail, Drive, Contacts, etc.), and we only ever access the calendar belonging to the professional who explicitly connects it — never a client's calendar, and never any calendar the professional hasn't personally authorized.

**Why we access it.** This connection is used solely to:
- Automatically create a calendar event (with a Google Meet video link) when a client books a session with that professional.
- Update or remove that event if the session is rescheduled or cancelled within HOBS Companion.
- Reflect changes made directly in Google Calendar back into HOBS Companion, so both stay in sync.
- Recognize when a professional has personal time blocked on their calendar, so that time is not offered to clients as available for booking.

**What we store.** We store the OAuth access and refresh tokens needed to maintain this connection, encrypted at rest, along with the Google account email associated with the connection. We do not store the content of any calendar event that isn't related to a HOBS Companion session (for example, we do not read or retain details of a professional's personal appointments beyond knowing that a time slot is unavailable).

**How a professional can revoke access.** A professional can disconnect their Google Calendar at any time from within the HOBS Companion app (Profile/Schedule → Calendar → Disconnect), which immediately deletes the stored tokens. They can also revoke access directly from their Google Account's security settings at any time, independent of the app.

**Data sharing.** We do not sell, rent, or share Google Calendar data with any third party. It is used exclusively for the scheduling functionality described above.

---

*Note for whoever publishes this: Google's reviewers check that this text is live on the real homeofbeautifulsouls.com domain (not just in the app) and that the "Privacy Policy" link in the Google Cloud OAuth consent screen configuration points to wherever this ends up living.*

```

# Demo video script — Google OAuth verification

Google's reviewers watch this to confirm the app actually does what you're requesting access for, and that the consent screen shown matches exactly what you submitted. Keep it simple, real, and in English (make sure your Google account's display language is set to English before recording, or the consent screen will show in whatever language it's set to).

**Length**: 2–3 minutes is plenty. Don't pad it — a short, clear recording is better than a long one.

**How to record**: screen recording of a real device or browser, your own voice or on-screen text captions explaining each step. Doesn't need to be polished — it needs to be accurate and complete.

## Shot list, in order

1. **Show the app itself first.** A few seconds of the HOBS Companion home screen, enough for a reviewer to see this is a real, functioning app — not just a login screen.

2. **Navigate to where the connection starts.** Show tapping into the therapist dashboard → Schedule tab, and pause on the "Connect Google Calendar" button so it's clearly visible before tapping it.

3. **Tap Connect Google Calendar.** Let the redirect to Google happen naturally — don't cut this part.

4. **Show the full Google sign-in / account picker screen** if it appears (choosing which Google account to use).

5. **Show the complete OAuth consent screen** — the actual Google screen listing what HOBS Companion is requesting access to. This is the single most important shot: the whole screen, readable, in English, showing the real scopes being requested (calendar events access). Don't skip past this or cut away early.

6. **Tap Allow / Continue** and show the redirect back into the app.

7. **Show the app confirming the connection** — the "Connected as [email]" state on the Calendar card.

8. **Show the actual feature working.** This is the "why" — demonstrate the thing the permission is *for*. The clearest option: book a session as a client (or simulate one), then show the resulting event appearing on the connected Google Calendar with the Meet link. If that's too much to stage, showing an existing synced session on the calendar is enough — the point is proving the access is used for what you said it's used for.

9. **(Optional but strengthens the submission) Show disconnecting.** Tap Disconnect, and show the card returning to "Not connected." This demonstrates the user is in control and access is revocable.

## What to say (captions or voiceover — keep it plain, no need for a script beyond this)

- "This is HOBS Companion, a mental health app connecting clients with therapists."
- "A therapist can connect their own Google Calendar so that sessions automatically get a calendar event with a Meet link."
- "Here's the Google consent screen showing exactly what's being requested."
- "Once connected, booking a session creates the event automatically."
- "The therapist can disconnect at any time."

## Before you record

- Set your Google account language to English.
- Use a real Google account you're comfortable showing on screen (the email will be visible).
- Do one full dry run first — the goal is one clean take showing the real flow, not editing pieces together.

## After recording

Upload as an **unlisted** YouTube video (not public, not private — unlisted is what Google's submission form expects), then paste that link into the verification submission form in Google Cloud Console.

```

NEW (exact):
```
async function pickPromptForRoom(roomId: string, anchor: PromptDef | null): Promise<PromptDef | null> {
  if (anchor) {
    // Anchors are meant to repeat daily, but never twice in the same day -- guards against an
    // accidental duplicate send if the cron fires more than once or gets retriggered manually.
    const todayStart = new Date();
    todayStart.setUTCHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
    const recent = await dbFetch(`chat_poll_history?room_id=eq.${roomId}&prompt_key=eq.${anchor.key}&sent_at=gte.${todayStart.toISOString()}&select=id`);
    if (Array.isArray(recent) && recent.length > 0) return null; // already sent today, skip
    return anchor;
  }
  const history = await dbFetch(`chat_poll_history?room_id=eq.${roomId}&select=prompt_key`);
  const usedKeys = new Set((Array.isArray(history) ? history : []).map((h: any) => h.prompt_key));
  const unused = VARIETY_PROMPTS.filter((p) => !usedKeys.has(p.key));
  const pool = unused.length > 0 ? unused : VARIETY_PROMPTS; // once exhausted, start the cycle over
  return pool[Math.floor(Math.random() * pool.length)];
}
```

// Renders a poll as its own card: Bob's question, each option as a tappable bar showing live
// results, and an "add another option" input always available at the end -- per direct
// instruction, this isn't optional trim, it's a permanent fixture of every poll.
async function renderPollCard(msg, list){
  var wrap = document.createElement('div');
  wrap.style.cssText = 'display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;margin-bottom:10px;';
  wrap.id = 'poll-card-' + msg.poll_id;

  var card = document.createElement('div');
  card.style.cssText = 'max-width:88%;background:#FFFFFF;border:1px solid #EEE0C4;border-radius:16px;padding:13px 14px;box-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(42,32,19,0.08);';
  card.innerHTML =
    '<p style="margin:0 0 3px;font-size:10.5px;font-weight:700;color:#6690D6;">🐘 Bob</p>'+
    '<p style="margin:0 0 10px;font-size:13.5px;font-weight:600;color:#2A2013;">'+(msg.text||'').replace(/</g,'&lt;')+'</p>'+
    '<div id="poll-options-' + msg.poll_id + '"></div>';
  wrap.appendChild(card);
  list.appendChild(wrap);

  await refreshPollOptions(msg.poll_id);
}

async function refreshPollOptions(pollId){
  var container = document.getElementById('poll-options-' + pollId);
  if(!container) return;

  var [{ data: options }, { data: votes }] = await Promise.all([
    sb.from('chat_poll_options').select('id, option_text, display_order').eq('poll_id', pollId).order('display_order'),
    sb.from('chat_poll_votes').select('option_id, user_id').eq('poll_id', pollId)
  ]);
  options = options || []; votes = votes || [];
  var totalVotes = votes.length;
  var myVoteOptionIds = votes.filter(function(v){ return v.user_id === currentUser.id; }).map(function(v){ return v.option_id; });

  container.innerHTML = options.map(function(opt){
    var optVotes = votes.filter(function(v){ return v.option_id === opt.id; }).length;
    var pct = totalVotes > 0 ? Math.round((optVotes / totalVotes) * 100) : 0;
    var isMine = myVoteOptionIds.indexOf(opt.id) !== -1;
    return '<div class="poll-option-row" data-option-id="'+opt.id+'" data-poll-id="'+pollId+'" style="position:relative;margin-bottom:7px;padding:9px 11px;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid '+(isMine ? '#6690D6' : '#EEE0C4')+';cursor:pointer;overflow:hidden;">'+
      '<div style="position:absolute;top:0;left:0;bottom:0;width:'+pct+'%;background:'+(isMine ? '#EAF0FB' : '#F7F4EC')+';z-index:0;transition:width 0.3s ease;"></div>'+
      '<div style="position:relative;z-index:1;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:8px;">'+
        '<span style="font-size:12.5px;color:#2A2013;'+(isMine ? 'font-weight:700;' : '')+'">'+(isMine ? '✓ ' : '')+opt.option_text.replace(/</g,'&lt;')+'</span>'+
        '<span style="font-size:10.5px;color:#9AABCE;flex-shrink:0;">'+optVotes+' · '+pct+'%</span>'+
      '</div>'+
    '</div>';
  }).join('') +
  '<div id="poll-add-option-' + pollId + '" style="display:flex;gap:6px;margin-top:4px;">'+
    '<input type="text" placeholder="+ Add another option" maxlength="60" style="flex:1;padding:8px 10px;border-radius:9px;border:1px dashed #C7D2E8;font-size:12px;font-family:inherit;box-sizing:border-box;">'+
    '<button style="padding:8px 12px;border-radius:9px;border:none;background:#6690D6;color:#fff;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;">Add</button>'+
  '</div>';

  container.querySelectorAll('.poll-option-row').forEach(function(row){
    row.onclick = async function(){
      var optionId = row.dataset.optionId;
      var alreadyMine = myVoteOptionIds.indexOf(optionId) !== -1;
      if(alreadyMine){
        await sb.from('chat_poll_votes').delete().eq('poll_id', pollId).eq('option_id', optionId).eq('user_id', currentUser.id);
      } else {
        // Single-choice by default -- clear any previous vote on this poll first, then cast
        // the new one, matching WhatsApp's default (multi-select can be added later if a group
        // genuinely needs it, but wasn't asked for here).
        await sb.from('chat_poll_votes').delete().eq('poll_id', pollId).eq('user_id', currentUser.id);
        await sb.from('chat_poll_votes').insert({ poll_id: pollId, option_id: optionId, user_id: currentUser.id });
      }
      refreshPollOptions(pollId);
    };
  });

  var addWrap = document.getElementById('poll-add-option-' + pollId);
  var addInput = addWrap.querySelector('input');
  var addBtn = addWrap.querySelector('button');
  addBtn.onclick = async function(){
    var text = addInput.value.trim();
    if(!text) return;
    var maxOrder = options.length > 0 ? Math.max.apply(null, options.map(function(o){ return o.display_order; })) : -1;
    var { error } = await sb.from('chat_poll_options').insert({ poll_id: pollId, option_text: text, added_by: currentUser.id, display_order: maxOrder + 1 });
    if(error){ showToast("Couldn't add that option — please try again."); return; }
    addInput.value = '';
    refreshPollOptions(pollId);
  };
  addInput.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){ if(e.key === 'Enter') addBtn.click(); });
}


```

      if(pollId && document.getElementById('poll-options-' + pollId)) refreshPollOptions(pollId);
    })
    .on('postgres_changes', { event: 'INSERT', schema: 'public', table: 'chat_poll_options' }, function(payload){
      var pollId = payload.new && payload.new.poll_id;
      if(pollId && document.getElementById('poll-options-' + pollId)) refreshPollOptions(pollId);
    })
    .subscribe();
}

NEW (exact):
```
// Real bug found and fixed: this used to plain .insert(), with no protection against a network
// blip that makes the CLIENT think a request failed even though the server-side insert actually
// went through -- that failure path pushes the same payload to the retry queue, and the later
// retry creates a second, fully separate row with identical content and the same original
// timestamp. Confirmed directly in production data: multiple real journal entries existed as
// exact duplicates, same text, same created_at down to the millisecond. Every table using this
// shared function (entries, who5_entries, subtasks, tasks, test_results) was equally exposed,
// since the bug lives here, not in any one caller.
// Fix: generate the row's id client-side and upsert on it, so a retry of the same logical
// attempt is a genuine no-op (updates the existing row with the same data) instead of a new row.
function generateClientId(){
  if(window.crypto && window.crypto.randomUUID) return window.crypto.randomUUID();
  // Fallback for older WebViews without crypto.randomUUID
  return 'xxxxxxxx-xxxx-4xxx-yxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx'.replace(/[xy]/g, function(c){
    var r = Math.random()*16|0, v = c === 'x' ? r : (r&0x3|0x8);
    return v.toString(16);
  });
}

function syncToSupabase(table, payload, onSuccess){
  if(currentUser && currentUser.id){
    var clientId = payload.id || generateClientId();
    var fullPayload = Object.assign({}, payload, { id: clientId, user_id: currentUser.id });
    sb.from(table).upsert(fullPayload, { onConflict: 'id' }).select().single().then(function(result){
      if(result.error){
        pendingSyncQueue.push({ table: table, payload: fullPayload, queuedAt: new Date().toISOString() });
        savePendingSyncQueue();
        return;
      }
      if(onSuccess) onSuccess(result.data);
    });
  } else {
    var clientId2 = payload.id || generateClientId();
    pendingSyncQueue.push({ table: table, payload: Object.assign({}, payload, { id: clientId2 }), queuedAt: new Date().toISOString() });
    savePendingSyncQueue();
  }
}

function retryPendingSync(){
  if(!currentUser || !currentUser.id || pendingSyncQueue.length === 0) return;
  var queue = pendingSyncQueue;
  pendingSyncQueue = [];
  savePendingSyncQueue();
  queue.forEach(function(item){
    // Same id-based upsert as the main path -- a retry of an item that actually landed earlier
    // (queued only because the client didn't hear back in time) now safely updates the same row
    // instead of creating a duplicate.
    var itemId = item.payload.id || generateClientId();
    sb.from(item.table).upsert(Object.assign({}, item.payload, { id: itemId, user_id: currentUser.id }), { onConflict: 'id' }).then(function(result){
      if(result.error){
        pendingSyncQueue.push(item);
        savePendingSyncQueue();
      }
    });
  });
  if(queue.length > 0) showToast('Caught up on ' + queue.length + ' unsaved item(s) from earlier.');
}
```

// Opens the full detail view for one appointment (from the My Appointments list, Upcoming or
// Past). Shows everything about the booking plus session notes -- editable if not yet locked,
// read-only with the attached file if already locked -- reusing the exact same
// notes/lock-payment mechanism as the monthly summary detail view, so there's only ever one
// real path for saving notes, not two that could drift apart.
function openTherapistApptDetail(bookingId, name){
  document.getElementById('therapistApptDetailName').textContent = name;
  document.getElementById('therapistApptDetailBody').innerHTML = '<p style="text-align:center;color:#9AABCE;font-size:12px;">Loading...</p>';
  document.getElementById('therapistApptDetailBackdrop').style.display = 'block';
  document.getElementById('therapistApptDetailModal').style.display = 'block';

  sb.from('expert_bookings').select('*').eq('id', bookingId).single().then(function(result){
    var bodyEl = document.getElementById('therapistApptDetailBody');
    if(result.error || !result.data){
      bodyEl.innerHTML = '<p style="color:#C77B7B;font-size:12px;text-align:center;">Could not load this appointment.</p>';
      return;
    }
    var b = result.data;
    var dateLabel = b.session_date ? new Date(b.session_date).toLocaleString('en-IN', { weekday:'short', day:'numeric', month:'short', year:'numeric', hour:'numeric', minute:'2-digit' }) : 'No date set';
    var statusColor = b.status === 'cancelled' ? '#C77B7B' : '#3B8F63';
    var paymentLabel = b.payment_confirmed === false ? 'Unpaid' : (b.payment_confirmed ? 'Paid' : '—');

    var html = '<div style="background:#F3F6FC;border-radius:12px;padding:12px;margin-bottom:16px;">'+
      '<p style="font-size:12.5px;color:#2A2013;margin:0 0 6px;"><strong>When:</strong> '+dateLabel+'</p>'+
      '<p style="font-size:12.5px;color:'+statusColor+';margin:0 0 6px;font-weight:700;"><strong style="color:#2A2013;font-weight:400;">Status:</strong> '+b.status+'</p>'+
      '<p style="font-size:12.5px;color:#2A2013;margin:0;"><strong>Payment:</strong> '+paymentLabel+(b.payment_note ? ' — '+b.payment_note.replace(/</g,'&lt;') : '')+'</p>'+
      '</div>';

    html += '<p style="font-size:11px;font-weight:700;color:#9AABCE;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.03em;margin:0 0 8px;">Session Notes</p>';
    if(b.payment_locked){
      html += '<div style="background:#EAF4EE;border-radius:10px;padding:12px;margin-bottom:6px;">'+
        '<p style="font-size:12px;color:#2A2013;margin:0;white-space:pre-wrap;">'+(b.session_notes ? b.session_notes.replace(/</g,'&lt;') : '(no notes text, only a locked payment record)')+'</p>'+
        '</div>'+
        (b.session_note_file_url ? '<a href="#" id="apptDetailViewFileBtn" data-path="'+b.session_note_file_url+'" style="font-size:11.5px;color:#6690D6;font-weight:700;">View attached file</a>' : '');
    } else {
      html += '<p style="font-size:11.5px;color:#B0AA98;margin:0 0 10px;">Not added yet.</p>'+
        '<textarea id="apptDetailNotesInput" placeholder="Session notes... (required to lock payment)" rows="3" style="width:100%;padding:10px;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid #EEE0C4;font-size:12.5px;font-family:inherit;margin-bottom:8px;box-sizing:border-box;resize:vertical;">'+(b.session_notes||'')+'</textarea>'+
        '<input type="file" id="apptDetailFileInput" accept="image/*,.pdf,.doc,.docx" style="width:100%;font-size:11px;margin-bottom:10px;">'+
        '<button id="apptDetailSaveBtn" data-id="'+b.id+'" style="width:100%;padding:11px;border-radius:10px;border:none;background:#3B8F63;color:#fff;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;">Save Notes &amp; Lock Payment</button>';
    }
    bodyEl.innerHTML = html;

    var fileBtn = document.getElementById('apptDetailViewFileBtn');
    if(fileBtn) fileBtn.onclick = function(e){
      e.preventDefault();
      sb.storage.from('session-attachments').createSignedUrl(fileBtn.dataset.path, 300).then(function(r){
        if(r.data) window.open(r.data.signedUrl, '_blank');
      });
    };
    var saveBtn = document.getElementById('apptDetailSaveBtn');
    if(saveBtn) saveBtn.onclick = function(){
      var notes = document.getElementById('apptDetailNotesInput').value.trim();
      if(!notes){ showToast('Session notes are required to lock payment.'); return; }
      var fileInput = document.getElementById('apptDetailFileInput');
      saveBtn.textContent = 'Saving...'; saveBtn.disabled = true;
      var doSave = function(fileUrl){
        var updateData = { session_notes: notes, payment_locked: true };
        if(fileUrl) updateData.session_note_file_url = fileUrl;
        sb.from('expert_bookings').update(updateData).eq('id', bookingId).then(function(r){
          if(r.error){
            showToast('Could not save — please try again.');
            saveBtn.textContent = 'Save Notes & Lock Payment'; saveBtn.disabled = false;
            return;
          }
          showToast('Notes saved and payment locked.');
          openTherapistApptDetail(bookingId, name); // re-render this same modal now locked/read-only
          renderTherapistAppointmentsList();
          if(typeof renderTherapistSummaryAndDetail === 'function') renderTherapistSummaryAndDetail();
        });
      };
      if(fileInput && fileInput.files && fileInput.files[0]){
        var file = fileInput.files[0];
        var path = bookingId + '/' + Date.now() + '_' + file.name;
        sb.storage.from('session-attachments').upload(path, file).then(function(uploadResult){
          if(uploadResult.error){ doSave(null); return; }
          doSave(path);
        });
      } else {
        doSave(null);
      }
    };
  });
}
document.getElementById('therapistApptDetailCloseBtn').onclick = function(){
  document.getElementById('therapistApptDetailBackdrop').style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('therapistApptDetailModal').style.display = 'none';
};
document.getElementById('therapistApptDetailBackdrop').onclick = document.getElementById('therapistApptDetailCloseBtn').onclick;

document.getElementById('therapistSaveProfileBtn').onclick = function(){
  var bio = document.getElementById('therapistBioInput').value.trim();
  var approaches = document.getElementById('therapistApproachesInput').value.trim();
  var specializations = document.getElementById('therapistSpecializationsInput').value.trim();
  var superpowers = document.getElementById('therapistSuperpowersInput').value.trim();
  var whyTherapist = document.getElementById('therapistWhyInput').value.trim();

  var languages = getSelectedLanguagesFromCheckboxes('therapistLanguagesCheckboxes');

  btn.textContent = 'Saving...'; btn.disabled = true;

  // (experts.name = appState.therapistExpertName). If those two values ever drift apart even by
  // a single character -- confirmed this actually happened: one professional's profile had
  // "Dr Anisha Chaubey", her real expert listing was "Dr. Anisha Chaubey" -- the update matches
  // zero rows. Supabase doesn't treat that as an error, so the old code showed a false "saved"
  // toast while nothing was written at all. Adding .select() here so a genuinely empty result
  // can be told apart from a real success, and surfacing a clear, honest error instead of lying
  // about what happened.
  sb.from('experts').update({
    bio: bio, approaches: approaches, specializations: specializations, languages: languages,

  }).eq('name', appState.therapistExpertName).select().then(function(result){

      return;
    }
    showToast('Profile updated — clients will see this right away.');
    loadExpertsFromSupabase();
  });
};

var directChatInFlight = {}; // otherUserId -> true while a start/open attempt is in progress
// Real bug found and fixed: this function has several await points between "check for an
// existing room" and "create one if none exists." A rapid double-tap on a Message button --
// very easy to do by accident on a touchscreen -- fired this twice before either call had
// actually created anything, so both found no existing room and both created one. Confirmed
// directly: two real, completely empty direct-chat rooms existed between the same two people,
// created 0.65 seconds apart. Fixing with an in-flight guard keyed by the other person's id,
// rather than patching every button that calls this individually -- protects every current
// call site and any future one automatically.
async function startOrOpenDirectChat(otherUserId){
  if(directChatInFlight[otherUserId]) return;
  directChatInFlight[otherUserId] = true;
  try{
    if(!appState.isAdmin){
      var { data: hasConnection } = await sb.rpc('users_have_active_connection', { user_a: currentUser.id, user_b: otherUserId });
      if(!hasConnection){
        showToast("You'll need an active connection with this person first.");
        return;
      }
    }
    var { data: existingRooms } = await sb.from('chat_room_members').select('room_id, chat_rooms!inner(type)').eq('user_id', currentUser.id).eq('chat_rooms.type', 'direct');
    for(var r of (existingRooms || [])){
      var { data: otherMember } = await sb.from('chat_room_members').select('user_id').eq('room_id', r.room_id).eq('user_id', otherUserId).maybeSingle();
      if(otherMember){ openChatRoom(r.room_id); return; }
    }
    var { data: newRoom, error } = await sb.from('chat_rooms').insert({ type: 'direct', created_by: currentUser.id }).select().single();
