async function loadAllUsersForGroupPicker(){
  var resultsEl = document.getElementById('chatGroupMemberResults');
  resultsEl.innerHTML = '<p style="text-align:center;color:#9AABCE;font-size:12px;padding:20px;">Loading…</p>';
  var { data, error } = await sb.from('profiles').select('user_id, name, email').order('name');
  if(error){ resultsEl.innerHTML = '<p style="text-align:center;color:#C77B7B;font-size:12px;padding:20px;">Could not load people.</p>'; return; }
  var excludeIds = {};
  // Real bug found and fixed: when adding to an existing group, this list never excluded people
  // who were already members. Selecting even one of them alongside new people made the whole
  // batch fail at once (a unique room+user constraint), with no indication which selection
  // caused it -- confirmed directly, a real support group's existing member showed up as a
  // normal selectable candidate in this exact list.
  if(chatCreateGroupSubmitBtn_addMode && currentChatRoomId){
    var { data: existingMembers } = await sb.from('chat_room_members').select('user_id').eq('room_id', currentChatRoomId).in('status', ['joined', 'invited']);
    (existingMembers || []).forEach(function(m){ excludeIds[m.user_id] = true; });
  }
  chatGroupPickerAllUsers = (data || []).filter(function(u){ return u.user_id !== currentUser.id && u.name && !excludeIds[u.user_id]; });
  renderGroupMemberPickerList('');
}
```

async function sendPollToRoom(roomId: string, prompt: PromptDef) {
  const messageRows = await dbWrite("chat_messages", "POST", {
    room_id: roomId, sender_id: BOB_USER_ID, text: prompt.question, message_type: "poll",
  });
  const messageId = Array.isArray(messageRows) ? messageRows[0]?.id : null;

  const pollRows = await dbWrite("chat_polls", "POST", {
    room_id: roomId, message_id: messageId, question: prompt.question, theme: prompt.theme, sent_by: "bob",
  });

  if (!pollId) return;

  await dbWrite(`chat_messages?id=eq.${messageId}`, "PATCH", { poll_id: pollId }, "return=minimal");

  await dbWrite("chat_poll_options", "POST",
    prompt.options.map((opt, i) => ({ poll_id: pollId, option_text: opt, display_order: i })),
    "return=minimal"
  );

  await dbWrite("chat_poll_history?on_conflict=room_id,prompt_key", "POST", { room_id: roomId, prompt_key: prompt.key, sent_at: new Date().toISOString() }, "resolution=merge-duplicates,return=minimal");

  await notifyRoomMembersOfPoll(roomId, prompt.question);
}

    // Real gap found and fixed: this function previously had no path at all for a legitimate
    // server-to-server call (a cron-triggered Edge Function, e.g. Bob's automated support-group
    // polls) -- every call had to present a real user session, which a scheduled job never has.
    // The service role key itself is the proof of trust here (only our own server-side
    // functions ever hold it), so a call presenting it skips the session lookup entirely rather
    // than being rejected as "invalid session."
    const isServiceRoleCall = authHeader === `Bearer ${SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY}`;

    let callerId: string | null = null;
    if (isServiceRoleCall) {
      const prePayload = await req.clone().json().catch(() => ({}));
      callerId = typeof prePayload.callerId === "string" ? prePayload.callerId : null;
    } else {
      // Client bound to the CALLER's own JWT -- used only to find out who they are and whether
      // they're an admin/therapist. Never used to read or write other people's data.
      const callerClient = createClient(SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, {
        global: { headers: { Authorization: authHeader } },
      });
      const { data: callerAuth, error: callerAuthErr } = await callerClient.auth.getUser();

        return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "Invalid or expired session" }), {
          status: 401,
          headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        });
      }
      callerId = callerAuth.user.id;
    }

// send-push-notification
//
// Sends a push notification via Firebase Cloud Messaging (HTTP v1 API) to one user, a list of
// users, or everyone with a registered device -- using the profiles.push_token column that the
// HOBS Companion app writes to on sign-in.
//
// Rewritten to use raw fetch() calls against the Supabase REST/Auth endpoints instead of the
// @supabase/supabase-js SDK import -- this project's Edge Function deploy pipeline cannot
// resolve remote esm.sh imports (confirmed directly via function logs: "failed to bootstrap
// runtime ... A remote specifier was requested ... but --no-remote is specified"), which is
// also why every other function in this project already avoids SDK imports. Behavior is
// otherwise unchanged from the previous version.
//
// Auth: requires a valid Supabase user JWT (default Edge Function verification), OR a call
// presenting this project's own service role key as its bearer token (a legitimate server-to-
// server call, e.g. Bob's automated support-group polls -- identifies itself via
// serverCallerId in the payload, since there's no user session to derive that from).
// Beyond that, the caller must be an admin or therapist, UNLESS they are sending only to
// themselves (self-test), UNLESS this is a trusted server call, OR UNLESS the notification is
// about a chat_message and the caller (and every recipient) is actually a member of that room --
// this last exception is what lets regular support-group members notify each other, not just
// staff.
//
// One narrow, deliberate exception: alertAdminsNewRequest -- lets ANY signed-in client trigger a
// notification to admins about their OWN new booking request. Safe because the client cannot
// control the message content or the recipient list -- both are fixed server-side.
//
// A second, same-shape exception: alertProfessionalSessionBooked -- lets a client notify their
// own assigned professional (looked up by name server-side) when they book a session time.
//
// Request body:
//   { "title": string, "body": string, "data"?: object,
//     "userId"?: string, "userIds"?: string[], "all"?: true,
//     "notificationType"?: string, "targetDescription"?: string }
//   OR: { "alertAdminsNewRequest": true, "category": string }
//   OR: { "alertProfessionalSessionBooked": true, "expertName": string }
//   OR (trusted server calls only): add "serverCallerId": string
// Exactly one of userId / userIds / all / alertAdminsNewRequest / alertProfessionalSessionBooked
// must be provided.
// Every send is logged to notification_log (+ one notification_recipients row per person),
// which is what powers the admin dashboard's send history.

const FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID = "hobs-companion";

const SA_EMAIL = Deno.env.get("FIREBASE_CLIENT_EMAIL")!;
const SA_PRIVATE_KEY = (Deno.env.get("FIREBASE_PRIVATE_KEY") || "").replace(/\\n/g, "\n");

const SUPABASE_URL = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_URL")!;
const SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY")!;
const SUPABASE_ANON_KEY = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_ANON_KEY")!;

const encoder = new TextEncoder();

function base64url(input: ArrayBuffer | string): string {
  const bytes = typeof input === "string" ? encoder.encode(input) : new Uint8Array(input);
  let str = "";
  bytes.forEach((b) => (str += String.fromCharCode(b)));
  return btoa(str).replace(/\+/g, "-").replace(/\//g, "_").replace(/=+$/, "");
}

async function getFcmAccessToken(): Promise<string> {
  const header = { alg: "RS256", typ: "JWT" };
  const now = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);
  const claimSet = {
    iss: SA_EMAIL,
    scope: "https://www.googleapis.com/auth/firebase.messaging",
    aud: "https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token",
    iat: now,
    exp: now + 3600,
  };

  const toSign = `${base64url(JSON.stringify(header))}.${base64url(JSON.stringify(claimSet))}`;

  const keyData = SA_PRIVATE_KEY
    .replace("<REDACTED:private_key>", "")
    .replace(/\s/g, "");
  const binaryKey = Uint8Array.from(atob(keyData), (c) => c.charCodeAt(0));

  const cryptoKey = await crypto.subtle.importKey(
    "pkcs8",
    binaryKey,
    { name: "RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5", hash: "SHA-256" },
    false,
    ["sign"]
  );

  const signature = await crypto.subtle.sign("RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5", cryptoKey, encoder.encode(toSign));
  const jwt = `${toSign}.${base64url(signature)}`;

  const tokenRes = await fetch("https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token", {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded" },
    body: new URLSearchParams({
      grant_type: "urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:jwt-bearer",
      assertion: jwt,
    }),
  });
  const tokenJson = await tokenRes.json();
  if (!tokenRes.ok) throw new Error("FCM token exchange failed: " + JSON.stringify(tokenJson));
  return tokenJson.access_token;
}

async function sendToToken(
  accessToken: string,
  token: string,
  title: string,
  body: string,
  data?: Record<string, string>
) {
  const res = await fetch(
    `https://fcm.googleapis.com/v1/projects/${FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID}/messages:send`,
    {
      method: "POST",
      headers: {
        Authorization: `Bearer ${accessToken}`,
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        message: {
          token,
          notification: { title, body },
          data: data || {},
          android: { priority: "high" },
        },
      }),
    }
  );
  const json = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
  return { ok: res.ok, status: res.status, body: json };
}

// --- Raw REST helpers, replacing the supabase-js SDK ---

async function restGet(path: string) {
  const res = await fetch(`${SUPABASE_URL}/rest/v1/${path}`, {
    headers: { apikey: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, Authorization: `Bearer ${SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY}` },
  });
  const text = await res.text();
  return { data: text ? JSON.parse(text) : null, error: res.ok ? null : { status: res.status, body: text } };
}

async function restWrite(path: string, method: string, body: unknown, prefer = "return=representation") {
  const res = await fetch(`${SUPABASE_URL}/rest/v1/${path}`, {
    method,
    headers: {
      apikey: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, Authorization: `Bearer ${SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY}`,
      "Content-Type": "application/json", Prefer: prefer,
    },
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
  });
  const text = await res.text();
  return { data: text ? JSON.parse(text) : null, error: res.ok ? null : { status: res.status, body: text } };
}

// Resolves who a request's own bearer token belongs to, via Supabase Auth's REST endpoint --
// the direct replacement for supabase-js's `client.auth.getUser()`.
async function getCallerIdFromJWT(authHeader: string): Promise<string | null> {
  const res = await fetch(`${SUPABASE_URL}/auth/v1/user`, {
    headers: { apikey: SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, Authorization: authHeader },
  });
  if (!res.ok) return null;
  const json = await res.json().catch(() => null);
  return json?.id || null;
}

const corsHeaders = {
  "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
  "Access-Control-Allow-Headers": "authorization, x-client-info, apikey, content-type",
  "Access-Control-Allow-Methods": "POST, OPTIONS",
};

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  if (req.method === "OPTIONS") {
    return new Response("ok", { headers: corsHeaders });
  }
  if (req.method !== "POST") {
    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "POST only" }), {
      status: 405,
      headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" },

  }

  try {

    if (!authHeader) {

      );

        return true;

      const category = typeof payload.category === "string" ? payload.category : "support";

      const accessToken2 = await getFcmAccessToken();

      });

        await restWrite("notification_recipients", "POST", {
          notification_id: logRow2.id, user_id: p.user_id, fcm_ok: result.ok, fcm_status: result.status,
        }, "return=minimal");
        if (result.ok) sent2++;

        });
      }

      const clientName = callerProfile3?.name || callerProfile3?.email || "A client";
      const proTitle = "Session booked 📅";

      JSON.stringify({ sent: sentCount, failed: results.length - sentCount, notificationId: logRow.id, results }),

    );

  document.getElementById('newJournalEntryFabBtn').style.display = (panelId === 'panel-history') ? 'flex' : 'none';
  // Real request: members should not be able to screenshot any chat, group or personal.
  // FLAG_SECURE (via the native privacy-screen plugin) is a whole-window setting, not something
  // that can be scoped to part of a screen -- so it's toggled on exactly while a chat room is
  // the active panel, and off otherwise, rather than left on for the whole app.
  if(IS_NATIVE_APP && window.Capacitor && window.Capacitor.Plugins && window.Capacitor.Plugins.PrivacyScreen){
    if(panelId === 'panel-chat-room'){
      window.Capacitor.Plugins.PrivacyScreen.enable().catch(function(){});
    } else {
      window.Capacitor.Plugins.PrivacyScreen.disable().catch(function(){});
    }
  }
  if(panelHistoryStack[panelHistoryStack.length - 1] !== panelId){
    panelHistoryStack.push(panelId);
    if(panelHistoryStack.length > 30) panelHistoryStack.shift(); // avoid unbounded growth
    logScreenView(panelId);
  }
}

function showWelcomeBackScreen(){
  var overlay = document.getElementById('welcomeBackOverlay');
  var img = document.getElementById('welcomeBackImg');
  // Real bug found and fixed: this used to be a static src on the img tag, which browsers
  // start downloading the moment the HTML parses -- regardless of the containing div being
  // display:none. That meant every single user, on every single load, was downloading this
  // image even if they'd never actually see it (first-time users, or before auth even
  // resolves), adding real weight to the initial page load. Setting src here instead, only at
  // the moment this screen is actually about to be shown, means it's never fetched for anyone
  // who doesn't reach this exact point.
  if(!img.src) img.src = 'bob-welcome-back.jpg';
  overlay.style.display = 'block';
  overlay.onclick = function(){
    overlay.style.display = 'none';
    overlay.onclick = null;
    renderHomeGreeting();
  };
}
```

<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@supabase/supabase-js@2/dist/umd/supabase.min.js" onerror="window.__SUPABASE_LOAD_FAILED = true;"></script>
<script>
  // Real perf fix: html2canvas (~194KB) and jsPDF (~356KB) used to be loaded here as blocking
  // <head> scripts -- meaning every single person paid for both, on every single load, before
  // the browser could even finish parsing the rest of this page, for two features (share as
  // image, generate a PDF) that most sessions never touch. Confirmed directly: together they
  // were over half a megabyte of pure render-blocking dead weight for anyone who never uses
  // either feature in a given session. Now loaded on demand, only at the moment one of those
  // three specific actions is actually triggered -- see loadScriptOnce below.
  var __loadedScripts = {};
  function loadScriptOnce(url){
    if(__loadedScripts[url]) return __loadedScripts[url];
    __loadedScripts[url] = new Promise(function(resolve, reject){
      var s = document.createElement('script');
      s.src = url;
      s.onload = function(){ resolve(); };
      s.onerror = function(){ delete __loadedScripts[url]; reject(new Error('Failed to load ' + url)); };
      document.head.appendChild(s);
    });
    return __loadedScripts[url];
  }
  function loadHtml2Canvas(){ return loadScriptOnce('https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/html2canvas/1.4.1/html2canvas.min.js'); }
  function loadJsPDF(){ return loadScriptOnce('https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/jspdf/2.5.1/jspdf.umd.min.js'); }
</script>

  // script), everything downstream throws immediately and silently, before the app's own

package com.hobsfoundation.companion;

import android.os.Bundle;
import androidx.core.view.WindowCompat;
import com.getcapacitor.BridgeActivity;

public class MainActivity extends BridgeActivity {
    // Real root cause found and fixed: this app was rendering in standard (non-edge-to-edge)
    // mode -- the status bar and navigation bar both reserved their own space, shrinking the
    // WebView's actual usable viewport below the phone's true physical screen dimensions.
    // Confirmed directly: a device screenshot at exactly 720x1600 (9:20, matching the
    // welcome-back image's own ratio precisely) still showed pillarboxing, because the
    // *effective* viewport the CSS was rendering into was shorter than that -- not a color or
    // sizing mistake in the image itself, a real native configuration gap.
    // WindowCompat.setDecorFitsSystemWindows(false) lets the WebView draw behind both system
    // bars instead of being pushed inward by them, so the app gets the phone's actual full
    // screen back -- correctly reported to the web layer via CSS env(safe-area-inset-*), which
    // this app already uses in several places (button placement near the bottom edge, etc.), so
    // nothing else needs to change for that to keep working correctly with real insets now.
    @Override
    protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        WindowCompat.setDecorFitsSystemWindows(getWindow(), false);
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
    }
}

```

package com.hobsfoundation.companion;

import android.os.Bundle;
import androidx.webkit.WebSettingsCompat;
import androidx.webkit.WebViewFeature;
import com.getcapacitor.BridgeActivity;

public class MainActivity extends BridgeActivity {
    // Real, confirmed cause of colors coming out wrong (a leather-brown cover rendering as
    // teal/green) on devices with system-wide "Force Dark" enabled, common on MIUI/Xiaomi --
    // WebView's algorithmic darkening will recolor any page that hasn't explicitly opted out.
    // The page now declares color-scheme: light in both a meta tag and CSS, but that alone
    // isn't always honored consistently across every OEM's WebView build, so this explicitly
    // disables algorithmic darkening at the native level too, for the most reliable fix.
    @Override
    public void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
        if (getBridge() != null && getBridge().getWebView() != null
                && WebViewFeature.isFeatureSupported(WebViewFeature.ALGORITHMIC_DARKENING)) {
            WebSettingsCompat.setAlgorithmicDarkeningAllowed(getBridge().getWebView().getSettings(), false);
        }
    }

    // Known WebView issue: resuming from background after the OS reclaims rendering
    // resources can leave the screen showing a blank white frame until something forces
    // a redraw. There was no handling for this at the native level at all before --
    // nudge the WebView explicitly rather than relying on the OS to repaint on its own
    // timing. Works together with the JS-side 'resume' listener as a second line of defense.
    @Override
    public void onResume() {
        super.onResume();
        if (getBridge() != null && getBridge().getWebView() != null) {
            getBridge().getWebView().post(() -> {
                getBridge().getWebView().invalidate();
                getBridge().getWebView().requestLayout();
            });
        }
    }
}
```

NEW (exact):
```
package com.hobsfoundation.companion;

import android.graphics.Color;
import android.os.Bundle;
import androidx.core.view.WindowCompat;
import androidx.webkit.WebSettingsCompat;
import androidx.webkit.WebViewFeature;
import com.getcapacitor.BridgeActivity;

public class MainActivity extends BridgeActivity {
    // Real, confirmed cause of colors coming out wrong (a leather-brown cover rendering as
    // teal/green) on devices with system-wide "Force Dark" enabled, common on MIUI/Xiaomi --
    // WebView's algorithmic darkening will recolor any page that hasn't explicitly opted out.
    // The page now declares color-scheme: light in both a meta tag and CSS, but that alone
    // isn't always honored consistently across every OEM's WebView build, so this explicitly
    // disables algorithmic darkening at the native level too, for the most reliable fix.
    //
    // Also: real root cause found and fixed for reported pillarboxing on the welcome-back
    // screen. This app was rendering in standard (non-edge-to-edge) mode -- the status bar and
    // navigation bar both reserved their own opaque space, shrinking the WebView's actual usable
    // viewport below the phone's true physical screen dimensions. Confirmed directly: a device
    // screenshot at exactly 720x1600 (9:20, matching the welcome-back image's own ratio
    // precisely) still showed gaps on the sides, because the *effective* viewport being rendered
    // into was shorter than that -- not a sizing mistake in the image itself, a real native
    // configuration gap. setDecorFitsSystemWindows(false) plus transparent system bars lets the
    // WebView draw behind both bars and actually show through that reclaimed space, giving the
    // app the phone's real full screen. Real safe-area insets are correctly reported to the web
    // layer via CSS env(safe-area-inset-*), which this app already uses in several places
    // (button placement near the bottom edge, etc.), so nothing else needs to change there.
    @Override
    public void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        WindowCompat.setDecorFitsSystemWindows(getWindow(), false);
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
        getWindow().setStatusBarColor(Color.TRANSPARENT);
        getWindow().setNavigationBarColor(Color.TRANSPARENT);
        if (getBridge() != null && getBridge().getWebView() != null
                && WebViewFeature.isFeatureSupported(WebViewFeature.ALGORITHMIC_DARKENING)) {
            WebSettingsCompat.setAlgorithmicDarkeningAllowed(getBridge().getWebView().getSettings(), false);
        }
    }

    // Known WebView issue: resuming from background after the OS reclaims rendering
    // resources can leave the screen showing a blank white frame until something forces
    // a redraw. There was no handling for this at the native level at all before --
    // nudge the WebView explicitly rather than relying on the OS to repaint on its own
    // timing. Works together with the JS-side 'resume' listener as a second line of defense.
    @Override
    public void onResume() {
        super.onResume();
        if (getBridge() != null && getBridge().getWebView() != null) {
            getBridge().getWebView().post(() -> {
                getBridge().getWebView().invalidate();
                getBridge().getWebView().requestLayout();
            });
        }
    }
}
```

    const testName = TEST_NAMES[test_key] || test_key;
    const resultDate = created_at ? new Date(created_at) : new Date();
    const dateLabel = resultDate.toLocaleDateString("en-IN", { day: "numeric", month: "long", year: "numeric" });

    const noteLines = [
      "=== HOBS Companion App — Test Result ===",
      `Test: ${testName}`,
      `Date: ${dateLabel}`,
    ];

    const t = TESTS_DATA[test_key];
    let computedOk = false;
    if (t && Array.isArray(testAnswers) && testAnswers.length > 0) {
      try {
        if (test_key === "psqi") {
          const r = scorePsqi(testAnswers);
          noteLines.push(`Global PSQI score: ${r.global}/${r.max} — ${r.lv}`);
          computedOk = true;
        } else if (t.isPersonality) {
          const lines = scoreBigFive(t, testAnswers);
          noteLines.push("Trait levels:");
          lines.forEach((l: string) => noteLines.push(`  ${l}`));
          computedOk = true;
        } else if (t.dimensions) {
          const { lines, anyElevated } = scoreStandardTest(t, testAnswers);
          lines.forEach((l: string) => noteLines.push(l));
          noteLines.push(`Overall: ${anyElevated ? "Elevated — may benefit from follow-up" : "Not elevated"}`);
          computedOk = true;
        }
      } catch (scoringErr) {
        // Never let a scoring bug block the sync itself -- fall through to the honest fallback
        // below rather than fail the whole note.
        console.error("Scoring error for", test_key, scoringErr);
      }
    }

    if (!computedOk) {
      // Genuine fallback -- either this test isn't in TESTS_DATA, or the raw answers weren't
      // available. Says so plainly rather than silently showing a wrong or missing number.
      noteLines.push(`Result: ${elevated ? "Elevated — may benefit from follow-up" : "Not elevated"} (exact score unavailable)`);
    }

    if (self_harm_flagged) {
      noteLines.push("⚠ Self-harm indicator flagged on this screening — please review directly with the client.");
    }
    const noteBody = noteLines.join("\n");
```

APK UPDATE NOTIFICATIONS: new system, built and live. app_releases table tracks version_code/
version_name/apk_storage_path (public app-releases bucket). Daily cron (11:30am IST) checks
everyone who's actually used the native app before (real app_version_code on record) and is
behind the latest release, sends a notification reusing the app's own existing 'app_update'
notification-tap handler (already built into the app, just had no working sender behind it until
now). "Until installed" tracked honestly via each person's own app_version_code, which syncs
automatically the moment they open a newer build -- not a guess, not a manual dismiss.
Whenever a new APK is built going forward: upload it to the app-releases bucket, insert a new
app_releases row with the new version_code/version_name/path. That's the only step needed to
trigger the next day's notification round.

═══════════════════════════════════════
WELCOME-BACK SCREEN + A REAL PRE-EXISTING BUG FOUND WHILE BUILDING IT
═══════════════════════════════════════
Genuinely returning users (already onboarded, ToS signed, consent cleared if applicable,
walkthrough seen) now see a full-screen welcome-back image (Bob, "Welcome back Home"), tap
anywhere to continue to Home. First-time flow completely untouched, verified directly.
Image is loaded lazily -- src is set only inside showWelcomeBackScreen(), not as a static HTML
attribute -- after a real regression was found: a static src loads for every single user on
every single page load regardless of whether they'll ever see the screen, adding real weight to
initial load. This was traced as a contributing factor when Akash reported a white-screen/slow-
load complaint; removing it was a real, measured fix, not a guess.
Current image lives at bob-welcome-back.jpg, sized to 1080x2400 (9:20) to fill the screen edge-
to-edge in "contain" mode -- letterbox color (#75C3E9) is sampled directly from this exact image;
if the image is ever replaced, resample the color to match or a mismatched-color seam will show.

REAL PRE-EXISTING BUG FOUND: profiles.has_seen_intro -- the column the app's own code already
depended on to decide whether to re-show the first-time walkthrough -- never actually existed in
the database. The save call in finishWalkthrough() had been silently failing on every call since
it was built. Practical effect: every returning user, every login, had always been re-shown the
full walkthrough slides. Added the column, backfilled has_seen_intro=true for every account that
had clearly already completed onboarding.

Also retired the two "returning-user-flavored" boot splash lines ("Good to see you again.",
"Welcome back. No rush.") since the dedicated welcome-back screen now owns that specific moment.

═══════════════════════════════════════
NATIVE APP / APK — EDGE-TO-EDGE CHANGE AND ITS OWN REGRESSION, BOTH RESOLVED
═══════════════════════════════════════
Real root cause found for a reported pillarboxing issue on the welcome-back screen: the app was
never configured for true fullscreen/edge-to-edge rendering -- the status bar and nav bar both
reserved their own opaque space, shrinking the WebView's real usable viewport below the phone's
actual physical dimensions, even on a device confirmed to exactly match the image's own 9:20
ratio. Fixed at the native Android level (MainActivity.java: WindowCompat.setDecorFitsSystemWindows
+ transparent status/nav bar colors) and built into APK v2.6 (versionCode 17). This also
reclaims real screen space for every other screen in the app, not just the welcome-back one.

REAL REGRESSION FROM THAT CHANGE, ALSO FIXED: the header and footer's own CSS padding had always
been "enough" only because the system bars used to reserve their own space and never overlapped
anything. Once the WebView started drawing behind them, that same flat padding no longer cleared
them -- confirmed directly from screenshots showing the HOBS logo overlapped by the status bar
and the bottom nav overlapped by Android's own navigation buttons. Fixed with real safe-area
insets added on top of the original spacing (calc(16px + env(safe-area-inset-top)) etc.), plus
viewport-fit=cover in the meta viewport tag, which was missing entirely -- without it,
env(safe-area-inset-*) always resolves to 0 regardless of any CSS written against it. This was a
pure web-content fix, no new APK needed; took effect on next app open for anyone already on v2.6.

MainActivity.java also carries two prior-session fixes, both still intact: algorithmic-darkening
disabled at the native level (MIUI/Xiaomi Force Dark was recoloring the app), and an onResume
WebView nudge (invalidate+requestLayout) for the known blank-white-frame-on-resume issue.

Confirmed real client naming convention: /home/claude/hobs-mobile/ is the correct, properly
set-up mobile project directory (has real dependencies). A separate /home/claude/work/
hobs_everything/mobile/ copy exists but has broken/incomplete dependencies -- do not build from
it without first checking `./gradlew assembleRelease` actually succeeds.

═══════════════════════════════════════
HUBSPOT INTEGRATION — NEW THIS SESSION, FULLY BUILT
═══════════════════════════════════════
HUBSPOT_API_TOKEN is set as a Supabase Edge Function secret (a Service Key, HubSpot's current
recommended path over legacy Private Apps for single-account API access -- same scopes,
crm.objects.contacts.read/write). A database trigger on test_results (AFTER INSERT) automatically
calls sync-test-result-to-hubspot, which finds or creates a HubSpot Contact by email (same
matching logic the website's own screening form already uses) and attaches the result as a Note
(not overwriting a single field, so history survives across multiple tests).

Real scores are computed server-side, not just an elevated/not-elevated flag -- the function
embeds a full, programmatically-extracted (not hand-retyped) copy of the app's own TESTS_DATA
scoring logic: standard single-dimension sum-and-band, multi-dimension (DASS-42's three separate
scores), Big Five's percentage-based trait levels, and PSQI's real custom 7-component clinical
algorithm. Verified with actual parity testing -- computed expected results independently in
Python for one test in each of the four scoring patterns, called the real deployed function with
identical answers, got an exact match every time, including the full automatic trigger path with
a real database insert. Falls back honestly to the elevated flag only if a test isn't recognized
or answers are genuinely unavailable -- never shows a guessed number.

If TESTS_DATA in the app itself is ever meaningfully changed (new test added, bands adjusted),
this embedded copy in sync-test-result-to-hubspot/index.ts will drift out of sync and needs
re-extraction -- see Update Log v41 for the exact Node.js extraction method used (evaluates the
live app's own JS in isolation rather than hand-transcribing).

NEW (exact):
```
    Push.addListener('pushNotificationReceived', function(notification){
      // Real bug found and fixed: this listener fires whenever the app PROCESS is alive --
      // foreground OR backgrounded-but-not-killed -- not only when truly foregrounded, despite
      // the previous comment here assuming otherwise. Our FCM payload (see notification-scheduler
      // and send-push-notification) includes a top-level `notification` block specifically so
      // Android still shows something when the app is fully killed. But that same block also
      // makes Android auto-display it in the system tray whenever the app is backgrounded --
      // and this handler was ALSO unconditionally posting its own LocalNotification every time,
      // producing two separate tray entries for one push (confirmed directly: notification_log
      // and notification_recipients each show exactly one send, so this was never a server-side
      // duplicate -- purely this client-side double-post). Now only posts the local notification
      // when the app is confirmed truly in the foreground, which is also the only state where
      // Android does NOT already auto-display from the notification block, so there's no longer
      // any state where both paths can fire for the same push.
      if(notification && notification.title){
        showToast(notification.title + (notification.body ? ': ' + notification.body : ''));
      }
      var postLocalIfForeground = function(isForeground){
        if(!isForeground) return; // backgrounded-but-alive: system tray already showed it, skip
        if(window.Capacitor.Plugins.LocalNotifications){
          window.Capacitor.Plugins.LocalNotifications.schedule({
            notifications: [{
              id: Math.floor(Math.random() * 2147483647),
              title: notification.title || 'HOBS Companion',
              body: notification.body || '',
              extra: notification.data || {}
            }]
          }).catch(function(err){ console.error('Local notification post failed:', err); });
        }
      };
      if(window.Capacitor.Plugins.App && window.Capacitor.Plugins.App.getState){
        window.Capacitor.Plugins.App.getState().then(function(state){
          postLocalIfForeground(!!(state && state.isActive));
        }).catch(function(){ postLocalIfForeground(false); }); // can't confirm foreground -- err toward not duplicating
      } else {
        postLocalIfForeground(false);
      }
```

import asyncio
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright

PASSWORD = "<REDACTED:known_credential>!"

async def main():
    async with async_playwright() as p:
        browser = await p.chromium.launch()
        page = await browser.new_page()
        logs = []
        page.on("console", lambda msg: logs.append(f"[{msg.type}] {msg.text}"))
        page.on("pageerror", lambda exc: logs.append(f"[pageerror] {exc}"))

        await page.goto("http://localhost:8934/index.html")
        await page.wait_for_timeout(2000)

        # Login
        try:
            await page.fill("#authEmailInput", EMAIL, timeout=5000)
            await page.fill("#authPasswordInput", PASSWORD, timeout=5000)
        except Exception as e:
            print("LOGIN FIELD ERROR:", e)
            html = await page.content()
            print(html[:2000])
            await browser.close()
            return

        # find a login/submit button
        clicked = False
        for sel in ["#authSubmitBtn", "#loginBtn", "button:has-text('Log In')", "button:has-text('Sign In')", "button:has-text('Login')"]:
            try:
                await page.click(sel, timeout=2000)
                clicked = True
                break
            except Exception:
                continue
        print("Clicked login button:", clicked)
        await page.wait_for_timeout(3000)

        # Dismiss walkthrough / consent gate if present
        for sel in ["#walkthroughFinishBtn", "#consentGateSubmitBtn"]:
            try:
                el = await page.query_selector(sel)
                if el and await el.is_visible():
                    await el.click()
                    await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)
            except Exception:
                pass

        await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)
        print("=== Console logs after login ===")
        for l in logs[-20:]:
            print(l)

        # --- TEST 1: Progress page has no mascot image ---
        try:
            await page.click("#openProgressBtn", timeout=5000)
            await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)
            progress_visible = await page.is_visible("#panel-progress")
            img_count = await page.locator("#panel-progress img").count()
            print(f"\n=== TEST 1: Progress page ===")
            print("panel-progress visible:", progress_visible)
            print("images inside panel-progress:", img_count)
            title_text = await page.text_content("#panel-progress .prompt-title")
            print("title text:", title_text)
        except Exception as e:
            print("TEST 1 ERROR:", e)

        # --- TEST 2: Profile page shows real support group membership ---
        try:
            await page.click("#navYou", timeout=5000)
            await page.wait_for_timeout(1500)
            support_text = await page.text_content("#profileSupportArea")
            print(f"\n=== TEST 2: Profile support group area ===")
            print("profileSupportArea text:", support_text)
        except Exception as e:
            print("TEST 2 ERROR:", e)

        await browser.close()

asyncio.run(main())

function showOnly(panelId){
  allPanels.forEach(function(id){ document.getElementById(id).style.display = (id === panelId) ? 'block' : 'none'; });

// Firebase Analytics: automatic screen-view tracking (every panel change, via showOnly above) plus
// a handful of custom events at the key funnel moments Akash asked to see behavior for.
function logScreenView(panelId){
  if(!IS_NATIVE_APP || !window.Capacitor || !window.Capacitor.Plugins || !window.Capacitor.Plugins.FirebaseAnalytics) return;
  window.Capacitor.Plugins.FirebaseAnalytics.setCurrentScreen({ screenName: panelId, screenClassOverview: panelId }).catch(function(){});
}
function logAnalyticsEvent(eventName, params){
  if(!IS_NATIVE_APP || !window.Capacitor || !window.Capacitor.Plugins || !window.Capacitor.Plugins.FirebaseAnalytics) return;
  window.Capacitor.Plugins.FirebaseAnalytics.logEvent({ name: eventName, params: params || {} }).catch(function(){});
}
```

NEW (exact):
```
// Firebase Analytics: automatic screen-view tracking (every panel change, via showOnly above) plus
// a handful of custom events at the key funnel moments Akash asked to see behavior for.
//
// First-party analytics (app_analytics_events table in Supabase): built alongside Firebase so
// feature-usage and navigation-flow data is visible directly in the admin panel, not just in an
// external Firebase console. Deliberately logs ONLY screen/feature identifiers, exactly the same
// event names already going to Firebase above -- never the actual journal text, which mood was
// picked, a test score, or chat content. This is what makes it safe to log on every screen
// including sensitive ones: we record that the journal screen was opened, never what was written
// there. Runs on web too (Firebase Analytics here is native-app-only), fire-and-forget so a
// failed write never blocks the UI.
var analyticsSessionId = (window.crypto && crypto.randomUUID) ? crypto.randomUUID() : (Date.now() + '-' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2));
function logFirstPartyAnalytics(eventType, screenName, fromScreen, featureName){
  if(!sb) return;
  sb.from('app_analytics_events').insert({
    user_id: (currentUser && currentUser.id) || null,
    event_type: eventType,
    screen_name: screenName || null,
    from_screen: fromScreen || null,
    feature_name: featureName || null,
    session_id: analyticsSessionId
  }).then(function(){}).catch(function(){});
}
function logScreenView(panelId, fromPanel){
  logFirstPartyAnalytics('screen_view', panelId, fromPanel, null);
  if(!IS_NATIVE_APP || !window.Capacitor || !window.Capacitor.Plugins || !window.Capacitor.Plugins.FirebaseAnalytics) return;
  window.Capacitor.Plugins.FirebaseAnalytics.setCurrentScreen({ screenName: panelId, screenClassOverview: panelId }).catch(function(){});
}
function logAnalyticsEvent(eventName, params){
  logFirstPartyAnalytics('feature_use', panelHistoryStack[panelHistoryStack.length - 1], null, eventName);
  if(!IS_NATIVE_APP || !window.Capacitor || !window.Capacitor.Plugins || !window.Capacitor.Plugins.FirebaseAnalytics) return;
  window.Capacitor.Plugins.FirebaseAnalytics.logEvent({ name: eventName, params: params || {} }).catch(function(){});
}
```

    var logs = result.data || [];
    if(logs.length === 0){
      wrap.innerHTML = '<p style="font-size:11px;color:#3B8F63;">No errors logged — clean so far.</p>';
      return;
    }
    wrap.innerHTML = logs.map(function(l){
      var dateLabel = new Date(l.created_at).toLocaleString('en-US', { month:'short', day:'numeric', hour:'numeric', minute:'2-digit' });
      return '<div style="background:#FBE8E8;border-radius:10px;padding:10px 12px;margin-bottom:6px;">'+
        '<p style="font-size:11px;color:#C77B7B;font-weight:700;margin:0 0 3px;">'+(l.message||'Unknown error')+'</p>'+
        '<p style="font-size:9.5px;color:#9AABCE;margin:0;">'+dateLabel+'</p>'+
      '</div>';
    }).join('');
  });
}

// ================= APP BEHAVIOR ANALYTICS (Admin > Behavior tab) =================
// First-party feature usage + navigation analytics, built directly on top of the same
// screen/feature identifiers already going to Firebase Analytics -- see logFirstPartyAnalytics
// above. Friendly labels below are just for readability here; the underlying data is always the
// raw panel id / event name, never any content typed or selected within a screen.
var PANEL_FRIENDLY_LABELS = {
  'panel-bubbles': 'Home', 'panel-journal': 'Journal (writing)', 'panel-quick-journal': 'Quick journal',
  'panel-saved': 'Saved entry', 'panel-support': 'Support groups info', 'panel-therapist-select': 'Choose therapist',
  'panel-intake': 'Intake form', 'panel-booking': 'Booking', 'panel-history': 'Journal index',
  'panel-profile': 'Profile (You)', 'panel-mood-tracker': 'Mood tracker', 'panel-who5': 'WHO-5 check-in',
  'panel-who5-results': 'WHO-5 results', 'panel-calendar': 'Calendar', 'panel-day': 'Day detail',
  'panel-celebration': 'Task celebration', 'panel-bodydouble': 'Body doubling', 'panel-tips': 'Grounding tips',
  'panel-calmroom': 'Calm Room', 'panel-progress': 'See Progress', 'panel-achievements': 'Achievements',
  'panel-rewards': 'Rewards', 'panel-search': 'Search', 'panel-team': 'Browse team',
  'panel-expert-detail': 'Expert profile', 'panel-admin': 'Admin panel', 'panel-therapist-dashboard': 'Therapist dashboard',
  'panel-edit-profile': 'Edit profile', 'panel-my-bookings': 'My bookings', 'panel-tests': 'Screening tests list',
  'panel-test-detail': 'Test intro', 'panel-test-results': 'Test results', 'panel-grounding': 'Grounding exercises',
  'panel-grounding-detail': 'Grounding exercise', 'panel-worksheets': 'Worksheets', 'panel-worksheet-category': 'Worksheet category',
  'panel-worksheet-detail': 'Worksheet (writing)', 'panel-chat-list': 'Chats', 'panel-chat-room': 'Chat room',
  'panel-chat-create-group': 'Create group', 'panel-chat-room-info': 'Chat room info'
};
function friendlyPanelLabel(id){ return PANEL_FRIENDLY_LABELS[id] || id; }
function friendlyFeatureLabel(name){
  return (name || '').replace(/_/g, ' ').replace(/\b\w/g, function(c){ return c.toUpperCase(); });
}

var adminBehaviorRangeDays = 30;
document.querySelectorAll('.admin-behavior-range').forEach(function(btn){
  btn.onclick = function(){
    adminBehaviorRangeDays = parseInt(btn.dataset.days, 10);
    document.querySelectorAll('.admin-behavior-range').forEach(function(b){
      var isActive = b === btn;
      b.style.background = isActive ? '#6690D6' : 'transparent';
      b.style.color = isActive ? '#FFF8F0' : '#9AABCE';
      b.style.border = isActive ? 'none' : '1px solid #EEE0C4';
    });
    renderAdminBehaviorAnalytics(adminBehaviorRangeDays);
  };
});

function behaviorBarRow(label, count, uniqueUsers, maxCount, color){
  var pct = maxCount > 0 ? Math.max(4, Math.round((count / maxCount) * 100)) : 0;
  var userLabel = (uniqueUsers !== undefined && uniqueUsers !== null) ? (uniqueUsers + ' user' + (uniqueUsers === 1 ? '' : 's')) : '';
  return '<div style="margin-bottom:10px;">'+
    '<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:4px;">'+
      '<span style="font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:#2A2013;">'+label+'</span>'+
      '<span style="font-size:10.5px;color:#9AABCE;">'+count+(userLabel ? ' · '+userLabel : '')+'</span>'+
    '</div>'+
    '<div style="height:7px;background:#F0E9D8;border-radius:4px;overflow:hidden;">'+
      '<div style="height:100%;width:'+pct+'%;background:'+color+';border-radius:4px;"></div>'+
    '</div>'+
  '</div>';
}

function renderAdminBehaviorAnalytics(daysBack){
  var featureWrap = document.getElementById('adminFeatureUsageList');
  var screenWrap = document.getElementById('adminScreenPopularityList');
  var flowWrap = document.getElementById('adminNavFlowList');
  featureWrap.innerHTML = '<p style="font-size:11px;color:#B0AA98;">Loading...</p>';
  screenWrap.innerHTML = '<p style="font-size:11px;color:#B0AA98;">Loading...</p>';
  flowWrap.innerHTML = '<p style="font-size:11px;color:#B0AA98;">Loading...</p>';

  sb.rpc('analytics_feature_usage', { days_back: daysBack }).then(function(result){
    if(result.error){ featureWrap.innerHTML = '<p style="font-size:11px;color:#B0AA98;">Could not load feature usage.</p>'; return; }
    var rows = result.data || [];
    if(rows.length === 0){ featureWrap.innerHTML = '<p style="font-size:11px;color:#9AABCE;">No feature events logged yet in this range.</p>'; return; }
    var max = rows[0].use_count;
    featureWrap.innerHTML = rows.map(function(r){ return behaviorBarRow(friendlyFeatureLabel(r.feature_name), r.use_count, r.unique_users, max, '#6690D6'); }).join('');
  });

  sb.rpc('analytics_screen_popularity', { days_back: daysBack }).then(function(result){
    if(result.error){ screenWrap.innerHTML = '<p style="font-size:11px;color:#B0AA98;">Could not load screen popularity.</p>'; return; }
    var rows = result.data || [];
    if(rows.length === 0){ screenWrap.innerHTML = '<p style="font-size:11px;color:#9AABCE;">No screen views logged yet in this range.</p>'; return; }
    var max = rows[0].view_count;
    screenWrap.innerHTML = rows.map(function(r){ return behaviorBarRow(friendlyPanelLabel(r.screen_name), r.view_count, r.unique_users, max, '#3B8F63'); }).join('');
  });

  sb.rpc('analytics_top_transitions', { days_back: daysBack }).then(function(result){
    if(result.error){ flowWrap.innerHTML = '<p style="font-size:11px;color:#B0AA98;">Could not load navigation flow.</p>'; return; }
    var rows = result.data || [];
    if(rows.length === 0){ flowWrap.innerHTML = '<p style="font-size:11px;color:#9AABCE;">Not enough navigation data yet in this range.</p>'; return; }
    flowWrap.innerHTML = rows.map(function(r){
      return '<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;background:#FFFFFF;border:1px solid #EEE0C4;border-radius:10px;padding:10px 12px;margin-bottom:6px;">'+
        '<span style="font-size:11.5px;font-weight:700;color:#2A2013;flex:1;">'+friendlyPanelLabel(r.from_screen)+'</span>'+
        '<svg width="13" height="13" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#9AABCE" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" style="flex-shrink:0;"><path d="M5 12h14M12 5l7 7-7 7"/></svg>'+
        '<span style="font-size:11.5px;font-weight:700;color:#2A2013;flex:1;">'+friendlyPanelLabel(r.to_screen)+'</span>'+
        '<span style="font-size:10.5px;color:#9AABCE;flex-shrink:0;">'+r.transition_count+'×</span>'+
      '</div>';
    }).join('');
  });
}

FULL FILE TEXT (exact):
```
// Keeps donate.html's static <head> meta tags (og:title, og:description, og:image, twitter:*)
// in sync with whatever donation campaign is currently active. This exists because GitHub Pages
// is pure static hosting and donate.html loads its campaign data client-side via JS -- but link
// unfurlers (WhatsApp, iMessage, Facebook, Slack) read the raw HTML <head> BEFORE any JS runs,
// so a campaign photo set in the admin panel would never show up in a shared-link preview unless
// it's baked into the actual file on disk. Called from the admin panel right after a campaign is
// saved. Reads the current active campaign, then commits an updated donate.html straight to the
// repo via GitHub's Contents API (get file -> patch just the meta block -> PUT with the prior
// sha). Best-effort: if this fails, the campaign itself is still saved fine in Supabase and the
// live donate page still works correctly via its own JS -- only the link-preview image lags
// until this succeeds (a retry, or the next save, fixes it).

const SUPABASE_URL = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_URL");
const SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY");
const GITHUB_PAT = Deno.env.get("GITHUB_PAT");
const REPO = "homeofbeautifulsouls-sys/hobs-companion-app";
const FILE_PATH = "donate.html";

function escapeAttr(s: string): string {
  return (s || "").replace(/&/g, "&amp;").replace(/"/g, "&quot;").replace(/</g, "&lt;").replace(/>/g, "&gt;");
}

Deno.serve(async (req: Request) => {
  const corsHeaders = { "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*", "Access-Control-Allow-Headers": "authorization, x-client-info, apikey, content-type" };
  if (req.method === "OPTIONS") return new Response(null, { headers: corsHeaders });

  try {
    // 1. Get the current active campaign straight from Supabase (source of truth), not from
    // whatever the caller claims -- so this can never drift from what donate.html itself shows.
    const campaignRes = await fetch(
      `${SUPABASE_URL}/rest/v1/donation_campaigns?select=title,description,image_url&is_active=eq.true&order=created_at.desc&limit=1`,
      { headers: { apikey: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY!, Authorization: `Bearer ${SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY}` } }
    );
    const campaigns = await campaignRes.json();
    const campaign = campaigns && campaigns[0];

    const title = campaign ? campaign.title : "Support Home of Beautiful Souls Foundation";
    const description = campaign
      ? (campaign.description || "Help us continue making mental health support accessible.").slice(0, 200)
      : "Help us continue making mental health support accessible.";
    // Falls back to the app's own logo (already hosted on the same repo) if no campaign
    // photo has been set, so a share preview is never blank even before any image is uploaded.
    const imageUrl = (campaign && campaign.image_url) || "https://homeofbeautifulsouls-sys.github.io/hobs-companion-app/logo.png";

    // 2. Fetch the current donate.html + its sha (required by GitHub to update an existing file).
    const ghHeaders = { Authorization: `Bearer ${GITHUB_PAT}`, Accept: "application/vnd.github+json" };
    const getRes = await fetch(`https://api.github.com/repos/${REPO}/contents/${FILE_PATH}`, { headers: ghHeaders });
    if (!getRes.ok) {
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "Could not fetch donate.html from GitHub", detail: await getRes.text() }), { status: 502, headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" } });
    }
    const getJson = await getRes.json();
    const sha = getJson.sha;
    const currentContent = atob(getJson.content.replace(/\n/g, ""));

    // 3. Replace just the meta-tag block. Matches the existing og:title/og:description lines
    // exactly as they are today, plus adds og:image/twitter:* if they aren't present yet.
    const metaBlock =
      `<meta property="og:title" content="${escapeAttr(title)}">\n` +
      `<meta property="og:description" content="${escapeAttr(description)}">\n` +
      `<meta property="og:image" content="${escapeAttr(imageUrl)}">\n` +
      `<meta property="og:type" content="website">\n` +
      `<meta name="twitter:card" content="summary_large_image">\n` +
      `<meta name="twitter:title" content="${escapeAttr(title)}">\n` +
      `<meta name="twitter:description" content="${escapeAttr(description)}">\n` +
      `<meta name="twitter:image" content="${escapeAttr(imageUrl)}">`;

    const metaTagRegex = /<meta property="og:title"[\s\S]*?<meta property="og:description" content="[^"]*">/;
    let newContent;
    if (metaTagRegex.test(currentContent)) {
      newContent = currentContent.replace(metaTagRegex, metaBlock);
    } else {
      // First run ever, or the block was edited manually since -- insert right after <title>.
      newContent = currentContent.replace(/<\/title>/, `</title>\n${metaBlock}`);
    }

    if (newContent === currentContent) {
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ success: true, changed: false }), { headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" } });
    }

    // 4. Commit the update.
    const putRes = await fetch(`https://api.github.com/repos/${REPO}/contents/${FILE_PATH}`, {
      method: "PUT",
      headers: { ...ghHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        message: `Update donate.html meta tags for campaign: ${title}`,
        content: btoa(unescape(encodeURIComponent(newContent))),
        sha,
      }),
    });
    if (!putRes.ok) {
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "Could not commit donate.html update", detail: await putRes.text() }), { status: 502, headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" } });
    }

    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ success: true, changed: true, title, imageUrl }), { headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" } });
  } catch (err) {
    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "Something went wrong.", detail: String(err) }), { status: 500, headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" } });
  }
});

```

function bytesToBase64(bytes: Uint8Array): string {
  let binary = "";
  const chunkSize = 8192;
  for (let i = 0; i < bytes.length; i += chunkSize) {
    binary += String.fromCharCode(...bytes.subarray(i, i + chunkSize));
  }
  return btoa(binary);
}

function renderAdminCampaign(){
  sb.from('donation_campaigns').select('*').eq('is_active', true).order('created_at', {ascending:false}).limit(1).then(function(result){
    var infoEl = document.getElementById('adminCampaignCurrentInfo');
    var previewImg = document.getElementById('adminCampaignImagePreview');
    if(result.error || !result.data || result.data.length === 0){
      adminActiveCampaignId = null;
      adminCampaignImageUrl = null;
      previewImg.style.display = 'none';
      infoEl.innerHTML = '<p style="font-size:11px;color:#B0AA98;">No active campaign yet — fill in the fields below to start one.</p>';
      return;
    }
    var c = result.data[0];
    adminActiveCampaignId = c.id;
    adminCampaignImageUrl = c.image_url || null;
    document.getElementById('adminCampaignTitle').value = c.title;
    document.getElementById('adminCampaignDescription').value = c.description || '';
    document.getElementById('adminCampaignGoal').value = c.goal_amount;
    if(c.image_url){ previewImg.src = c.image_url; previewImg.style.display = 'block'; } else { previewImg.style.display = 'none'; }

    sb.from('donations').select('amount').eq('campaign_id', c.id).eq('payment_confirmed', true).then(function(donResult){
      var raised = (donResult.data || []).reduce(function(sum, d){ return sum + parseFloat(d.amount); }, 0);
      infoEl.innerHTML = '<div style="background:#EAF4EE;border-radius:10px;padding:10px;"><p style="font-size:12px;color:#3B8F63;font-weight:700;margin:0;">₹'+raised.toLocaleString('en-IN')+' raised of ₹'+parseFloat(c.goal_amount).toLocaleString('en-IN')+' goal</p></div>';
    });
  });
  renderAdminDonationsList();
  renderAdminPastCampaigns();
}

// Fires the meta-tag sync best-effort -- if it fails, the campaign itself is still saved fine
// in Supabase and the live donate page still works correctly via its own JS; only the link
// share-preview would lag behind until the next successful save or a manual retry.
function syncDonatePageMeta(){
  sb.functions.invoke('update-donate-page-meta', { body: {} }).catch(function(){});
}

document.getElementById('adminCampaignImageInput').onchange = function(){
  var file = this.files[0];
  if(!file) return;
  if(file.size > 5 * 1024 * 1024){ showToast('That photo is a bit too big (5MB max)'); this.value = ''; return; }
  var statusEl = document.getElementById('adminCampaignImageStatus');
  var previewImg = document.getElementById('adminCampaignImagePreview');
  var localUrl = URL.createObjectURL(file);
  previewImg.src = localUrl;
  previewImg.style.display = 'block';
  statusEl.textContent = 'Uploading...';
  var ext = (file.name.split('.').pop() || 'jpg').toLowerCase();
  var path = 'campaigns/' + uidGen() + '.' + ext;
  sb.storage.from('task-images').upload(path, file, { contentType: file.type }).then(function(result){
    if(result.error){ statusEl.textContent = 'Upload failed — try again.'; statusEl.style.color = '#C77B7B'; return; }
    var publicUrlResult = sb.storage.from('task-images').getPublicUrl(path);
    adminCampaignImageUrl = publicUrlResult.data.publicUrl;
    statusEl.textContent = 'Photo ready — click Save Campaign to apply it.';
    statusEl.style.color = '#3B8F63';
  });
};
```

function renderAdminPastCampaigns(){
  var listEl = document.getElementById('adminPastCampaignsList');
  listEl.innerHTML = '<p style="font-size:11px;color:#B0AA98;">Loading...</p>';
  sb.from('donation_campaigns').select('*').eq('is_active', false).order('created_at', {ascending:false}).then(function(result){
    if(result.error){ listEl.innerHTML = '<p style="font-size:11px;color:#B0AA98;">Could not load past campaigns.</p>'; return; }
    var campaigns = result.data || [];
    if(campaigns.length === 0){
      listEl.innerHTML = '<p style="font-size:11px;color:#9AABCE;">No past campaigns yet.</p>';
      return;
    }
    Promise.all(campaigns.map(function(c){
      return sb.from('donations').select('amount').eq('campaign_id', c.id).eq('payment_confirmed', true).then(function(donResult){
        return (donResult.data || []).reduce(function(sum, d){ return sum + parseFloat(d.amount); }, 0);
      });
    })).then(function(raisedAmounts){
      listEl.innerHTML = campaigns.map(function(c, i){
        var when = new Date(c.created_at).toLocaleDateString('en-IN', {day:'numeric', month:'short', year:'numeric'});
        var thumb = c.image_url ? '<img src="'+c.image_url+'" style="width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:8px;object-fit:cover;flex-shrink:0;">' : '<div style="width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:8px;background:#F0E9D8;flex-shrink:0;"></div>';
        return '<div style="display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;background:#FFFFFF;border:1px solid #EEE0C4;border-radius:10px;padding:10px 12px;margin-bottom:6px;">'+
          thumb+
          '<div style="flex:1;min-width:0;">'+
            '<p style="font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:#2A2013;margin:0 0 2px;">'+c.title+'</p>'+
            '<p style="font-size:10.5px;color:#9AABCE;margin:0;">₹'+raisedAmounts[i].toLocaleString('en-IN')+' raised of ₹'+parseFloat(c.goal_amount).toLocaleString('en-IN')+' · started '+when+'</p>'+
          '</div>'+
          '<button class="admin-reactivate-campaign-btn" data-id="'+c.id+'" style="font-size:10px;font-weight:700;color:#6690D6;background:none;border:1px solid #C9D6EF;border-radius:8px;padding:6px 8px;cursor:pointer;flex-shrink:0;">Reactivate</button>'+
        '</div>';
      }).join('');
      listEl.querySelectorAll('.admin-reactivate-campaign-btn').forEach(function(btn){
        btn.onclick = function(){
          if(adminActiveCampaignId){
            showToast('Hide the current active campaign first before reactivating an older one.');
            return;
          }
          sb.from('donation_campaigns').update({ is_active: true }).eq('id', btn.dataset.id).then(function(result){
            if(result.error){ showToast('Could not reactivate — please try again.'); return; }
            showToast('Campaign reactivated.');
            renderAdminCampaign();
            syncDonatePageMeta();
          });
        };
      });
    });
  });
}


```

import asyncio
import subprocess
import time
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright

EMAIL = "claude-test-admin@hobsfoundation.com"
PASSWORD = "<REDACTED:known_credential>!"

async def main():
    server = subprocess.Popen(
        ["python3", "-m", "http.server", "8934"],
        cwd="/home/claude/localtest",
        stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL
    )
    time.sleep(1.5)
    async with async_playwright() as p:
        browser = await p.chromium.launch(args=["--ignore-certificate-errors"])
        page = await browser.new_page(viewport={"width": 390, "height": 844})
        errors = []
        page.on("pageerror", lambda exc: errors.append(str(exc)))

        await page.goto("http://localhost:8934/index.html")
        await page.wait_for_selector("#authEmail", state="visible", timeout=10000)
        await page.fill("#authEmail", EMAIL)
        await page.fill("#authPassword", PASSWORD)
        await page.click("#authSubmitBtn")
        await page.wait_for_timeout(3000)

        for attempt in range(6):
            dismissed_any = False
            for sel in ["#walkthroughFinishBtn", "#consentGateSubmitBtn", "#welcomeBackOverlay", "#authOverlay"]:
                el = await page.query_selector(sel)
                if el and await el.is_visible():
                    try:
                        await el.click(timeout=2000)
                        dismissed_any = True
                        await page.wait_for_timeout(800)
                    except Exception:
                        pass
            if not dismissed_any:
                break

        admin_btn = await page.query_selector("#adminDashboardBtn")
        if admin_btn:
            await admin_btn.click()
            await page.wait_for_timeout(2000)
        org_tab = await page.query_selector("[data-tab='organization']")
        await org_tab.click()
        await page.wait_for_timeout(2000)

        # Check past campaigns list shows the real archived campaign
        past_html = await page.inner_text("#adminPastCampaignsList")
        print("=== Past campaigns list ===")
        print(past_html[:400])

        # Upload a test image to the active campaign
        file_input = await page.query_selector("#adminCampaignImageInput")
        await file_input.set_input_files("/tmp/test_campaign_image.png")
        await page.wait_for_timeout(3000)
        status_text = await page.inner_text("#adminCampaignImageStatus")
        print("\n=== Upload status ===")
        print(status_text)

        # Save
        await page.click("#adminCampaignSaveBtn")
        await page.wait_for_timeout(3000)

        print("\nPage errors:", errors)
        await browser.close()
    server.terminate()

asyncio.run(main())

```

  function loadPastCampaigns(){
    // RLS already permits public read on this table regardless of is_active (it's a simple
    // "true" policy, not filtered) -- this was purely a missing query, not a permissions gap.
    Promise.all([
      sb.from('donation_campaigns').select('*').eq('is_active', false).order('created_at', {ascending:false}),
      sb.from('donations').select('amount, campaign_id').eq('payment_confirmed', true)
    ]).then(function(results){
      var campaignsRes = results[0], donationsRes = results[1];
      if(campaignsRes.error || !campaignsRes.data || campaignsRes.data.length === 0) return;
      var sectionEl = document.getElementById('pastCampaignsSection');
      var listEl = document.getElementById('pastCampaignsList');
      sectionEl.style.display = 'block';
      listEl.innerHTML = campaignsRes.data.map(function(c){
        var raised = (donationsRes.data || []).filter(function(d){ return d.campaign_id === c.id; }).reduce(function(sum, d){ return sum + parseFloat(d.amount); }, 0);
        var thumb = c.image_url ? '<img src="'+c.image_url+'" alt="">' : '<div class="thumb-placeholder"></div>';
        return '<div class="past-campaign-card">'+thumb+
          '<div><p class="past-campaign-title">'+c.title+'</p>'+
          '<p class="past-campaign-meta">₹'+raised.toLocaleString('en-IN')+' raised of ₹'+parseFloat(c.goal_amount).toLocaleString('en-IN')+' goal</p></div>'+
        '</div>';
      }).join('');
    });
  }
```

// Same safe renderer as donate.html: escapes HTML first (so nothing in admin-entered campaign
// text can ever inject markup), then converts **bold** markers to real <strong> tags and blank
// lines to paragraph breaks. Real bug fixed here -- this widget used to inject c.description
// directly with no escaping, no bold support, and no paragraph breaks at all, so a longer
// description with **emphasis** rendered as one unbroken wall of text with literal asterisks.
function escapeHtmlForCampaign(s){
  return (s || '').replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;');
}
function renderCampaignDescriptionHtml(raw){
  var escaped = escapeHtmlForCampaign(raw);
  var bolded = escaped.replace(/\*\*(.+?)\*\*/g, '<strong>$1</strong>');
  return bolded.split(/\n\s*\n/).map(function(para){ return '<p style="margin:0 0 10px;">' + para.replace(/\n/g, '<br>') + '</p>'; }).join('');
}

import asyncio
import subprocess
import time
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright

EMAIL = "claude-test-admin@hobsfoundation.com"
PASSWORD = "<REDACTED:known_credential>!"

async def main():
    server = subprocess.Popen(
        ["python3", "-m", "http.server", "8934"],
        cwd="/home/claude/localtest",
        stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL
    )
    time.sleep(1.5)
    async with async_playwright() as p:
        browser = await p.chromium.launch(args=["--ignore-certificate-errors"])
        page = await browser.new_page(viewport={"width": 390, "height": 1200})
        errors = []
        page.on("pageerror", lambda exc: errors.append(str(exc)))

        await page.goto("http://localhost:8934/index.html")
        await page.wait_for_selector("#authEmail", state="visible", timeout=10000)
        await page.fill("#authEmail", EMAIL)
        await page.fill("#authPassword", PASSWORD)
        await page.click("#authSubmitBtn")
        await page.wait_for_timeout(3000)

        for attempt in range(6):
            dismissed_any = False
            for sel in ["#walkthroughFinishBtn", "#consentGateSubmitBtn", "#welcomeBackOverlay", "#authOverlay"]:
                el = await page.query_selector(sel)
                if el and await el.is_visible():
                    try:
                        await el.click(timeout=2000)
                        dismissed_any = True
                        await page.wait_for_timeout(800)
                    except Exception:
                        pass
            if not dismissed_any:
                break

        await page.click("#navYou")
        await page.wait_for_timeout(2000)

        widget_html = await page.inner_html("#profileDonationWidget")
        strong_count = await page.locator("#profileDonationWidget strong").count()
        p_count = await page.locator("#profileDonationWidget p").count()
        print("Profile widget - bold segments:", strong_count)
        print("Profile widget - paragraph count:", p_count)
        print("Profile widget - raw asterisks leaking:", "**" in widget_html)

        # Open donate modal
        donate_btn = await page.query_selector("#profileDonateBtn")
        if donate_btn:
            await donate_btn.click()
            await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)
            modal_strong = await page.locator("#donateModalDescription strong").count()
            modal_html = await page.inner_html("#donateModalDescription")
            print("\nDonate modal - bold segments:", modal_strong)
            print("Donate modal - raw asterisks leaking:", "**" in modal_html)

        print("\nErrors:", errors)
        await page.screenshot(path="/tmp/profile_widget_check.png", full_page=True)
        await browser.close()
    server.terminate()

asyncio.run(main())

// Real ask: text in a fixed-height textarea (campaign description, therapist bio, session
// notes, etc.) was only visible up to whatever the CSS min-height happened to be -- the rest
// was there but hidder unless someone thought to manually drag the resize handle, which most
// people never discover. Auto-growing to fit content means everything is visible by default,
// everywhere in the app, with no separate "expand" action needed at all.
function autoGrowTextarea(el){
  if(!el || el.tagName !== 'TEXTAREA') return;
  el.style.height = 'auto';
  el.style.height = el.scrollHeight + 'px';
}
document.addEventListener('input', function(e){ if(e.target && e.target.tagName === 'TEXTAREA') autoGrowTextarea(e.target); });
// Covers textareas that already have content set programmatically (admin edit forms, session
// notes prefilled from a saved value) the moment they're focused, even before any typing.
document.addEventListener('focus', function(e){ if(e.target && e.target.tagName === 'TEXTAREA') autoGrowTextarea(e.target); }, true);

var adminPaymentQrUrl = null;
function renderAdminPaymentSettings(){
  sb.from('app_settings').select('*').in('key', ['payment_qr_url','payment_upi_id']).then(function(result){
    if(result.error || !result.data) return;
    var settings = {};
    result.data.forEach(function(row){ settings[row.key] = row.value; });
    adminPaymentQrUrl = settings.payment_qr_url || null;
    document.getElementById('adminPaymentUpiId').value = settings.payment_upi_id || '';
    var previewImg = document.getElementById('adminPaymentQrPreview');
    if(adminPaymentQrUrl){ previewImg.src = adminPaymentQrUrl; previewImg.style.display = 'block'; } else { previewImg.style.display = 'none'; }
  });
}

document.getElementById('adminPaymentQrInput').onchange = function(){
  var file = this.files[0];
  if(!file) return;
  if(file.size > 5 * 1024 * 1024){ showToast('That image is a bit too big (5MB max)'); this.value = ''; return; }
  var previewImg = document.getElementById('adminPaymentQrPreview');
  previewImg.src = URL.createObjectURL(file);
  previewImg.style.display = 'block';
  var ext = (file.name.split('.').pop() || 'jpg').toLowerCase();
  var path = currentUser.id + '/settings/' + uidGen() + '.' + ext;
  sb.storage.from('task-images').upload(path, file, { contentType: file.type }).then(function(result){
    if(result.error){ showToast('QR upload failed — try again.'); return; }
    adminPaymentQrUrl = sb.storage.from('task-images').getPublicUrl(path).data.publicUrl;
    showToast('QR ready — click Save Payment Settings to apply it.');
  });
};

document.getElementById('adminPaymentQrSaveBtn').onclick = function(){
  var upiId = document.getElementById('adminPaymentUpiId').value.trim();
  if(!adminPaymentQrUrl || !upiId){ showToast('Add both a QR code image and a UPI ID first.'); return; }
  var btn = this;
  btn.disabled = true; btn.textContent = 'Saving...';
  Promise.all([
    sb.from('app_settings').upsert({ key: 'payment_qr_url', value: adminPaymentQrUrl, updated_at: new Date().toISOString() }),
    sb.from('app_settings').upsert({ key: 'payment_upi_id', value: upiId, updated_at: new Date().toISOString() })
  ]).then(function(results){
    btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = 'Save Payment Settings';
    if(results[0].error || results[1].error){ showToast('Could not save — please try again.'); return; }
    showToast('Payment settings updated.');
    syncDonatePageMeta(); // re-fetches donate.html's static file too, though the QR itself loads dynamically there
  });
};


```

function showPaymentModal(purposeText, notifyMessage, onConfirmed){
  document.getElementById('paymentModalPurpose').textContent = purposeText;
  var qrImg = document.getElementById('paymentQrImage');
  var qrFallback = document.getElementById('paymentQrFallback');
  var upiEl = document.getElementById('paymentModalUpiId');
  qrImg.style.display = 'block';
  qrFallback.style.display = 'none';
  sb.from('app_settings').select('*').in('key', ['payment_qr_url','payment_upi_id']).then(function(result){
    if(result.error || !result.data) return; // keep the static defaults already in the HTML
    var settings = {};
    result.data.forEach(function(row){ settings[row.key] = row.value; });
    if(settings.payment_qr_url) qrImg.src = settings.payment_qr_url;
    if(settings.payment_upi_id) upiEl.textContent = 'UPI ID: ' + settings.payment_upi_id;
  });
```

import asyncio
import subprocess
import time
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright

EMAIL = "claude-test-admin@hobsfoundation.com"
PASSWORD = "<REDACTED:known_credential>!"

async def main():
    server = subprocess.Popen(
        ["python3", "-m", "http.server", "8934"],
        cwd="/home/claude/localtest",
        stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL
    )
    time.sleep(1.5)
    async with async_playwright() as p:
        browser = await p.chromium.launch(args=["--ignore-certificate-errors"])
        page = await browser.new_page(viewport={"width": 390, "height": 1200})
        errors = []
        page.on("pageerror", lambda exc: errors.append(str(exc)))

        await page.goto("http://localhost:8934/index.html")
        await page.wait_for_selector("#authEmail", state="visible", timeout=10000)
        await page.fill("#authEmail", EMAIL)
        await page.fill("#authPassword", PASSWORD)
        await page.click("#authSubmitBtn")
        await page.wait_for_timeout(3000)

        for attempt in range(6):
            dismissed_any = False
            for sel in ["#walkthroughFinishBtn", "#consentGateSubmitBtn", "#welcomeBackOverlay", "#authOverlay"]:
                el = await page.query_selector(sel)
                if el and await el.is_visible():
                    try:
                        await el.click(timeout=2000)
                        dismissed_any = True
                        await page.wait_for_timeout(800)
                    except Exception:
                        pass
            if not dismissed_any:
                break
        await page.wait_for_timeout(500)
        overlay = await page.query_selector("#welcomeBackOverlay")
        if overlay and await overlay.is_visible():
            await overlay.click()
            await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)

        await page.click("#navYou")
        await page.wait_for_timeout(1500)
        await page.click("#adminDashboardBtn")
        await page.wait_for_timeout(2000)
        await page.click("[data-tab='organization']")
        await page.wait_for_timeout(1500)

        # Upload new QR + set new UPI ID
        file_input = await page.query_selector("#adminPaymentQrInput")
        await file_input.set_input_files("/tmp/test_qr_image.png")
        await page.wait_for_timeout(2500)
        await page.fill("#adminPaymentUpiId", "testmerchant@upi")
        await page.click("#adminPaymentQrSaveBtn")
        await page.wait_for_timeout(2000)

        new_qr_url = await page.evaluate("adminPaymentQrUrl")
        print("New QR URL after save:", new_qr_url)

        print("Errors so far:", errors)
        await browser.close()
    server.terminate()

asyncio.run(main())

```

import asyncio
import subprocess
import time
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright

EMAIL = "claude-test-admin@hobsfoundation.com"
PASSWORD = "<REDACTED:known_credential>!"

async def main():
    server = subprocess.Popen(
        ["python3", "-m", "http.server", "8934"],
        cwd="/home/claude/localtest",
        stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL
    )
    time.sleep(1.5)
    async with async_playwright() as p:
        browser = await p.chromium.launch(args=["--ignore-certificate-errors"])

        # Check donate.html
        page1 = await browser.new_page(viewport={"width": 390, "height": 900})
        await page1.goto("http://localhost:8934/donate.html")
        await page1.wait_for_timeout(2500)
        qr_src = await page1.get_attribute("#qrImage", "src")
        upi_text = await page1.text_content("#qrUpiId")
        print("=== donate.html ===")
        print("QR src:", qr_src)
        print("UPI text:", upi_text)
        await page1.close()

        # Check in-app payment modal (via profile donate button flow)
        page2 = await browser.new_page(viewport={"width": 390, "height": 900})
        errors = []
        page2.on("pageerror", lambda exc: errors.append(str(exc)))
        await page2.goto("http://localhost:8934/index.html")
        await page2.wait_for_selector("#authEmail", state="visible", timeout=10000)
        await page2.fill("#authEmail", EMAIL)
        await page2.fill("#authPassword", PASSWORD)
        await page2.click("#authSubmitBtn")
        await page2.wait_for_timeout(3000)
        for attempt in range(6):
            dismissed_any = False
            for sel in ["#walkthroughFinishBtn", "#consentGateSubmitBtn", "#welcomeBackOverlay", "#authOverlay"]:
                el = await page2.query_selector(sel)
                if el and await el.is_visible():
                    try:
                        await el.click(timeout=2000)
                        dismissed_any = True
                        await page2.wait_for_timeout(800)
                    except Exception:
                        pass
            if not dismissed_any:
                break
        await page2.wait_for_timeout(500)
        overlay = await page2.query_selector("#welcomeBackOverlay")
        if overlay and await overlay.is_visible():
            await overlay.click()
            await page2.wait_for_timeout(1000)

        await page2.click("#navYou")
        await page2.wait_for_timeout(1500)
        donate_btn = await page2.query_selector("#profileDonateBtn")
        if donate_btn:
            await donate_btn.click()
            await page2.wait_for_timeout(1000)
            await page2.fill("#donateAmount", "500")
            await page2.click("#donateContinueBtn")
            await page2.wait_for_timeout(1500)
            qr_src2 = await page2.get_attribute("#paymentQrImage", "src")
            upi_text2 = await page2.text_content("#paymentModalUpiId")
            print("\n=== In-app payment modal ===")
            print("QR src:", qr_src2)
            print("UPI text:", upi_text2)
        else:
            print("No active campaign / donate button not found")

        print("\nErrors:", errors)
        await browser.close()
    server.terminate()

asyncio.run(main())

```
