```
function bandInterpret(score: number, bands: any[]): { cat: string; text?: string } {
  for (let i = 0; i < bands.length; i++) {
    if (score <= bands[i].max) return bands[i];
  }
  return bands[bands.length - 1];
}

// Direct port of the PSQI's real 7-component clinical scoring (subjective quality, latency,
// duration, efficiency, disturbances, medication use, daytime dysfunction) -- the one test with
// genuinely custom scoring logic rather than the standard dimension-sum-and-band approach.
function scorePsqi(rawAnswers: any[]) {
  const bedTime = rawAnswers[0], latMin = parseFloat(rawAnswers[1]) || 0, wakeTime = rawAnswers[2], hrs = parseFloat(rawAnswers[3]) || 0;
  const q5a = parseInt(rawAnswers[4]) || 0;
  const C1 = parseInt(rawAnswers[14]) || 0;
  const latScore = latMin <= 15 ? 0 : latMin <= 30 ? 1 : latMin <= 60 ? 2 : 3;
  const latSum = latScore + q5a;
  const C2 = latSum === 0 ? 0 : latSum <= 2 ? 1 : latSum <= 4 ? 2 : 3;
  const C3 = hrs > 7 ? 0 : hrs >= 6 ? 1 : hrs >= 5 ? 2 : 3;
  let C4 = 0;
  try {
    const bed = String(bedTime || "").split(":"), wake = String(wakeTime || "").split(":");
    if (bed.length === 2 && wake.length === 2 && bed[0] !== "") {
      const bedM = parseInt(bed[0]) * 60 + parseInt(bed[1]), wakeM = parseInt(wake[0]) * 60 + parseInt(wake[1]);
      let inBed = wakeM - bedM;
      if (inBed <= 0) inBed += 1440;
      if (inBed > 0 && hrs > 0) {
        const eff = (hrs * 60 / inBed) * 100;
        C4 = eff > 85 ? 0 : eff >= 75 ? 1 : eff >= 65 ? 2 : 3;
      }
    }
  } catch (_ex) { /* matches the app's own silent catch here */ }
  let distSum = 0;
  for (let i = 5; i <= 13; i++) distSum += parseInt(rawAnswers[i]) || 0;
  const C5 = distSum === 0 ? 0 : distSum <= 9 ? 1 : distSum <= 18 ? 2 : 3;
  const C6 = parseInt(rawAnswers[15]) || 0;
  const daySum = (parseInt(rawAnswers[16]) || 0) + (parseInt(rawAnswers[17]) || 0);
  const C7 = daySum === 0 ? 0 : daySum <= 2 ? 1 : daySum <= 4 ? 2 : 3;
  const global = C1 + C2 + C3 + C4 + C5 + C6 + C7;
  let lv: string;
  if (global <= 5) lv = "Good Sleep Quality";
  else if (global <= 10) lv = "Mild Sleep Difficulty";
  else if (global <= 15) lv = "Moderate Sleep Difficulty";
  else lv = "Severe Sleep Difficulty";
  return { global, lv, elevated: global > 5, max: 21 };
}

// Standard scoring path used by every test except PSQI (custom) and Big Five (percentage-based
// personality levels) -- direct port of the app's own per-dimension reverse-scoring sum plus
// band lookup.
function scoreStandardTest(t: any, testAnswers: any[]) {
  const lines: string[] = [];
  let anyElevated = false;
  let offset = 0;
  for (const dim of t.dimensions) {
    let rawSum = 0;
    for (let iIdx = 0; iIdx < dim.items.length; iIdx++) {
      const val = Number(testAnswers[offset + iIdx]) || 0;
      rawSum += dim.items[iIdx].reverse ? (dim.maxPerItem - val) : val;
    }
    offset += dim.items.length;
    if (dim.isAverage) rawSum = Math.round(rawSum / dim.items.length);
    if (dim.bands) {
      const band = bandInterpret(rawSum, dim.bands);
      const lowCats = ["Normal", "Minimal", "Low", "Lower", "Good", "Typical"];
      const isLow = lowCats.some((lc) => band.cat.indexOf(lc) !== -1);
      if (!isLow) anyElevated = true;
      const dimMax = dim.items.length * dim.maxPerItem;
      const label = dim.name ? `${dim.name}: ` : "";
      lines.push(`${label}${rawSum}/${dimMax} — ${band.cat}`);
    }
  }
  return { lines, anyElevated };
}

// Big Five personality: percentage-based Low/Moderate/High per trait, not a clinical
// elevated/not-elevated distinction -- direct port of the app's own isPersonality branch.
function scoreBigFive(t: any, testAnswers: any[]) {
  const lines: string[] = [];
  let offset = 0;
  for (const dim of t.dimensions) {
    let rawSum = 0;
    for (let iIdx = 0; iIdx < dim.items.length; iIdx++) {
      const val = Number(testAnswers[offset + iIdx]) || 0;
      rawSum += dim.items[iIdx].reverse ? (dim.maxPerItem - val) : val;
    }
    offset += dim.items.length;
    const maxPossible = dim.items.length * dim.maxPerItem;
    const pct = rawSum / maxPossible;
    const level = pct < 0.4 ? "Low" : pct < 0.65 ? "Moderate" : "High";
    lines.push(`${dim.name}: ${level} (${Math.round(pct * 100)}%)`);
  }
  return lines;
}

const TEST_NAMES: Record<string, string> = {
  pss10: "Perceived Stress Scale (PSS-10)",
  slsi: "Student Life Stress Inventory (SLSI)",
  scs: "Social Connectedness Scale (SCS)",
  aps: "Academic Procrastination Scale (APS)",
  phq9: "Depression Screening (PHQ-9)",
  gad7: "Anxiety Screening (GAD-7)",
  dass: "Depression, Anxiety & Stress Scales (DASS-42)",
  psqi: "Sleep Quality Screening (PSQI)",
  pcl5: "Trauma & Stress Response Screening (PCL-5)",
  bigfive: "Personality Screening (Big Five)",
  afi: "Attentional Function Index (AFI)",
  cfq: "Cognitive Failures Questionnaire (CFQ)",
  ders: "Difficulties in Emotion Regulation Scale (DERS)",
  ucla20: "Loneliness Screening (UCLA-20)",
  burnout: "Workplace Burnout Screening (CBI)",
  taws: "Work Stress Screening (TAWS)",
};

async function dbFetch(path: string) {
  const res = await fetch(`${SUPABASE_URL}/rest/v1/${path}`, {
    headers: { apikey: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY ?? "", Authorization: `Bearer ${SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY}` },
  });
  const text = await res.text();
  return text ? JSON.parse(text) : null;
}

async function hubspot(path: string, method: string, body?: unknown) {
  const res = await fetch(`https://api.hubapi.com${path}`, {
    method,
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${HUBSPOT_API_TOKEN}`, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    body: body ? JSON.stringify(body) : undefined,
  });
  const json = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
  return { ok: res.ok, status: res.status, json };
}

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  const corsHeaders = { "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*", "Access-Control-Allow-Headers": "content-type, x-scheduler-secret, authorization" };
  if (req.method === "OPTIONS") return new Response(null, { headers: corsHeaders });
  try {
    // Two legitimate ways in: the shared scheduler secret (for any future server-side/cron
    // trigger), or a genuinely signed-in user's own session token -- verified against Supabase
    // Auth, and cross-checked to actually match the user_id being submitted, so someone can only
    // ever sync their own result, never someone else's. This second path is the real fix: the
    // app's client-side code can never safely hold the scheduler secret, which is the actual
    // reason this function was never reachable from the app at all.
    const schedulerSecret = req.headers.get("x-scheduler-secret");
    let authedUserId: string | null = null;
    if (schedulerSecret !== Deno.env.get("SCHEDULER_SECRET")) {
      const authHeader = req.headers.get("Authorization") || "";
      if (!authHeader) {
        return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "Forbidden" }), { status: 403, headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" } });
      }
      const callerClient = createClient(SUPABASE_URL!, SUPABASE_ANON_KEY!, { global: { headers: { Authorization: authHeader } } });
      const { data: callerAuth, error: callerErr } = await callerClient.auth.getUser();
      if (callerErr || !callerAuth?.user) {
        return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "Forbidden" }), { status: 403, headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" } });
      }
      authedUserId = callerAuth.user.id;
    }

    const body = await req.json();
    const { user_id, test_key, elevated, self_harm_flagged, created_at, answers: answersFromPayload } = body;
    if (!user_id || !test_key) {
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "user_id and test_key required" }), { status: 400, headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" } });
    }
    if (authedUserId && authedUserId !== user_id) {
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "Cannot sync another user's result" }), { status: 403, headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" } });
    }

    const admin = createClient(SUPABASE_URL!, SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY!);

    // Prefer answers passed directly in the payload, but fall back to fetching the row if this
    // function is ever called some other way.
    let testAnswers = answersFromPayload;
    if (!testAnswers) {
      const rows = await dbFetch(`test_results?user_id=eq.${user_id}&test_key=eq.${test_key}&order=created_at.desc&limit=1&select=answers`);
      testAnswers = Array.isArray(rows) && rows[0]?.answers;
    }

    // Auth users' email isn't in the profiles REST view -- fetch via the admin auth endpoint.
    const userRes = await fetch(`${SUPABASE_URL}/auth/v1/admin/users/${user_id}`, {
      headers: { apikey: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY ?? "", Authorization: `Bearer ${SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY}` },
    });
    const userData = await userRes.json();
    const email = userData?.email;
    if (!email) {
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "Could not resolve a real email for this user -- skipping HubSpot sync" }), { status: 200, headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" } });
    }

    const profileArr = await dbFetch(`profiles?user_id=eq.${user_id}&select=name`);
    const clientName = (Array.isArray(profileArr) && profileArr[0]?.name) || email;

    // Find or create the Contact by email, same matching logic the website's own form uses.
    const searchResult = await hubspot("/crm/v3/objects/contacts/search", "POST", {
      filterGroups: [{ filters: [{ propertyName: "email", operator: "EQ", value: email }] }],
      limit: 1,
    });
    let contactId = searchResult.ok && searchResult.json.results?.[0]?.id;
    if (!contactId) {
      const nameParts = String(clientName).trim().split(" ");
      const createResult = await hubspot("/crm/v3/objects/contacts", "POST", {
        properties: {
          email,
          firstname: nameParts[0] || "",
          lastname: nameParts.slice(1).join(" ") || "",
        },
      });
      if (!createResult.ok) {
        return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "Could not create HubSpot contact", detail: createResult.json }), { status: 502, headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" } });
      }
      contactId = createResult.json.id;
    }

    const testName = TEST_NAMES[test_key] || test_key;
    const resultDate = created_at ? new Date(created_at) : new Date();
    const dateLabel = resultDate.toLocaleDateString("en-IN", { day: "numeric", month: "long", year: "numeric" });
    const noteLines = [
      "=== HOBS Companion App — Test Result ===",
      `Test: ${testName}`,
      `Date: ${dateLabel}`,
    ];

    const t = TESTS_DATA[test_key];
    let computedOk = false;
    if (t && Array.isArray(testAnswers) && testAnswers.length > 0) {
      try {
        if (test_key === "psqi") {
          const r = scorePsqi(testAnswers);
          noteLines.push(`Global PSQI score: ${r.global}/${r.max} — ${r.lv}`);
          computedOk = true;
        } else if (t.isPersonality) {
          const lines = scoreBigFive(t, testAnswers);
          noteLines.push("Trait levels:");
          lines.forEach((l: string) => noteLines.push(`  ${l}`));
          computedOk = true;
        } else if (t.dimensions) {
          const { lines, anyElevated } = scoreStandardTest(t, testAnswers);
          lines.forEach((l: string) => noteLines.push(l));
          noteLines.push(`Overall: ${anyElevated ? "Elevated — may benefit from follow-up" : "Not elevated"}`);
          computedOk = true;
        }
      } catch (scoringErr) {
        // Never let a scoring bug block the sync itself -- fall through to the honest fallback
        // below rather than fail the whole note.
        console.error("Scoring error for", test_key, scoringErr);
      }
    }
    if (!computedOk) {
      // Genuine fallback -- either this test isn't in TESTS_DATA, or the raw answers weren't
      // available. Says so plainly rather than silently showing a wrong or missing number.
      noteLines.push(`Result: ${elevated ? "Elevated — may benefit from follow-up" : "Not elevated"} (exact score unavailable)`);
    }
    if (self_harm_flagged) {
      noteLines.push("⚠️ Self-harm indicator flagged on this screening — please review directly with the client.");
    }

    const noteBody = noteLines.join("\n");
    const noteResult = await hubspot("/crm/v3/objects/notes", "POST", {
      properties: {
        hs_timestamp: resultDate.toISOString(),
        hs_note_body: noteBody,
      },
      associations: [
        { to: { id: contactId }, types: [{ associationCategory: "HUBSPOT_DEFINED", associationTypeId: 202 }] },
      ],
    });
    if (!noteResult.ok) {
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "Could not create HubSpot note", detail: noteResult.json }), { status: 502, headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" } });
    }

    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ success: true, contact_id: contactId, note_id: noteResult.json.id }), { headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" } });
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("sync-test-result-to-hubspot error:", err);
    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "Something went wrong.", detail: String(err) }), { status: 500, headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" } });
  }
});
```

```
function renderTestItem(){
  var item = testFlatItems[testIdx];
  document.getElementById('testProgress').textContent = 'Question ' + (testIdx+1) + ' of ' + testFlatItems.length;
  document.getElementById('testItemText').textContent = item.text;
  document.getElementById('testProg').style.width = (((testIdx+1)/testFlatItems.length)*100) + '%';
  var scaleWrap = document.getElementById('testScale');
  scaleWrap.innerHTML = '';

  var backBtn = document.getElementById('testBackBtn');
  var nextBtn = document.getElementById('testNextBtn');
  backBtn.style.visibility = testIdx === 0 ? 'hidden' : 'visible';
  nextBtn.textContent = (testIdx === testFlatItems.length - 1) ? 'See Results →' : 'Next →';

  var hasAnswer = testAnswers[testIdx] !== undefined && testAnswers[testIdx] !== null && testAnswers[testIdx] !== '';
  nextBtn.disabled = !hasAnswer;

  if(item.type === 'number' || item.type === 'time'){
    var inp = document.createElement('input');
    inp.type = item.type;
    inp.style.cssText = 'width:100%;padding:13px;border-radius:12px;border:1.5px solid #EEE0C4;font-size:14px;font-family:inherit;box-sizing:border-box;margin-bottom:10px;';
    if(item.unit) inp.placeholder = 'e.g. ' + (item.unit === 'hours' ? '7.5' : '20') + ' ' + item.unit;
    if(hasAnswer) inp.value = testAnswers[testIdx];
    inp.oninput = function(){
      if(inp.value){ testAnswers[testIdx] = inp.value; } else { delete testAnswers[testIdx]; }
      nextBtn.disabled = !inp.value;
    };
    scaleWrap.appendChild(inp);
    inp.focus();
  } else {
    item.scale.forEach(function(opt){
      var btn = document.createElement('button');
      btn.textContent = opt.label;
      var isSelected = hasAnswer && testAnswers[testIdx] === opt.val;
      btn.style.cssText = 'display:block;width:100%;padding:13px;border-radius:12px;border:1.5px solid '+(isSelected?'#6690D6':'#EEE0C4')+';background:'+(isSelected?'#EAF0FB':'#FFFFFF')+';color:'+(isSelected?'#2E5090':'#2A2013')+';font-size:13.5px;font-weight:'+(isSelected?'700':'600')+';cursor:pointer;margin-bottom:8px;';
      btn.onclick = function(){
        testAnswers[testIdx] = opt.val;
        renderTestItem(); // re-render this same question so the new selection highlights immediately
      };
      scaleWrap.appendChild(btn);
    });
  }
}
document.getElementById('testBackBtn').onclick = function(){
  if(testIdx === 0) return;
  testIdx--;
  renderTestItem();
};
document.getElementById('testNextBtn').onclick = function(){
  var item = testFlatItems[testIdx];
  var hasAnswer = testAnswers[testIdx] !== undefined && testAnswers[testIdx] !== null && testAnswers[testIdx] !== '';
  if(!hasAnswer){ showToast('Please answer this question first'); return; }
  if(testIdx >= testFlatItems.length - 1){ finishTest(); } else { testIdx++; renderTestItem(); }
};
```

```
  const res = await fetch(`https://api.hubapi.com${path}`, {
    method,
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${HUBSPOT_API_TOKEN}`, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
```

NEW (exact):
```
    Push.addListener('pushNotificationReceived', function(notification){
      // Real bug found and fixed (second time): the July 21 fix above this comment was solving
      // a genuine duplicate-notification problem, but did so by assuming Android's own native
      // auto-display is always reliable for backgrounded/killed apps, and skipping the JS-side
      // post entirely whenever not confirmed foreground. That created a single point of failure:
      // if native auto-display doesn't fire for ANY reason (confirmed one real cause already --
      // a missing notification channel, fixed in v2.9, but there could be others, e.g. OEM
      // battery/background restrictions), the notification is now just silently gone, with
      // nothing else to catch it. Before July 21, this app ALWAYS explicitly posted a local
      // notification via JS on receipt, which is a real guarantee, not dependent on Android's own
      // background-display behavior at all -- restoring that guarantee here, for every state
      // where this listener can even fire (foreground and backgrounded-but-alive; a fully killed
      // app has no JS running at all, so that state still depends on native handling regardless).
      // To avoid reintroducing the original double-post bug, a persisted per-notification-id
      // guard (not a random id) now prevents THIS device from showing the exact same
      // server-side notification twice -- it does not skip posting altogether the way the old
      // foreground-only check did, so there's no state where the notification can go missing
      // entirely, only (rarely, if native auto-display also fires) a possible duplicate, which is
      // a far smaller problem than a silent miss.
      if(notification && notification.title){
        showToast(notification.title + (notification.body ? ': ' + notification.body : ''));
      }
      var notifId = notification && notification.data && notification.data.notification_id;
      var alreadyShownKey = 'hobs_shown_notif_ids';
      var alreadyShown = [];
      try { alreadyShown = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(alreadyShownKey) || '[]'); } catch(e){ alreadyShown = []; }
      if(notifId && alreadyShown.indexOf(notifId) !== -1){
        return; // this exact server-side notification was already shown on this device
      }
      if(window.Capacitor.Plugins.LocalNotifications){
        window.Capacitor.Plugins.LocalNotifications.schedule({
          notifications: [{
            id: Math.floor(Math.random() * 2147483647),
            title: notification.title || 'HOBS Companion',
            body: notification.body || '',
            extra: notification.data || {}
          }]
        }).catch(function(err){ console.error('Local notification post failed:', err); });
      }
      if(notifId){
        alreadyShown.push(notifId);
        if(alreadyShown.length > 50) alreadyShown = alreadyShown.slice(-50); // keep this bounded
        try { localStorage.setItem(alreadyShownKey, JSON.stringify(alreadyShown)); } catch(e){ /* not critical if this fails */ }
      }
      // Note: receiving it (even while foregrounded) isn't the same as the person actually
      // engaging with it -- "opened" is tracked only on an actual tap, in the action handlers below.
    });
```

```
function showPolicyModal(onContinue){
```

NEW (exact):
```
// Real Razorpay Checkout, shared by every payment context in the app (session payment,
// cancellation charge, in-app donation). Creates a real order server-side first, then opens
// Checkout with it. The success handler here is only ever used to show a "confirming" message --
// it never marks anything paid itself. Only razorpay-webhook, after independently verifying
// Razorpay's own signature server-side, can do that -- exactly the same trust boundary already
// used on the web donate page.
function openRazorpayPayment(orderRequestBody, checkoutOptions, onDismissedOrFailed){
  loadRazorpayCheckout().then(function(){
    fetch('https://adjvptkzyckkvewbfmzf.supabase.co/functions/v1/create-razorpay-order', {
      method: 'POST', headers: {'Content-Type':'application/json'},
      body: JSON.stringify(orderRequestBody)
    }).then(function(r){ return r.json(); }).then(function(order){
      if(order.error){
        showToast(order.error);
        if(onDismissedOrFailed) onDismissedOrFailed();
        return;
      }
      var rzp = new Razorpay(Object.assign({
        key: order.key_id, amount: order.amount, currency: order.currency, order_id: order.order_id,
        name: 'Home of Beautiful Souls Foundation', theme: { color: '#6690D6' },
      }, checkoutOptions));
      rzp.on('payment.failed', function(){
        showToast('Payment failed — please try again.');
        if(onDismissedOrFailed) onDismissedOrFailed();
      });
      rzp.open();
    }).catch(function(){
      showToast('Could not start payment — please try again.');
      if(onDismissedOrFailed) onDismissedOrFailed();
    });
  }).catch(function(){
    showToast('Could not load the payment screen — check your connection and try again.');
    if(onDismissedOrFailed) onDismissedOrFailed();
  });
}

function showPolicyModal(onContinue){
```

```
function renderAdminPaymentSettings(){

    if(result.error || !result.data) return;
    var settings = {};

  });
}

document.getElementById('adminPaymentQrInput').onchange = function(){
  var file = this.files[0];
  if(!file) return;
  if(file.size > 5 * 1024 * 1024){ showToast('That image is a bit too big (5MB max)'); this.value = ''; return; }
  var previewImg = document.getElementById('adminPaymentQrPreview');
  previewImg.src = URL.createObjectURL(file);
  previewImg.style.display = 'block';
  var ext = (file.name.split('.').pop() || 'jpg').toLowerCase();
  var path = currentUser.id + '/settings/' + uidGen() + '.' + ext;
  sb.storage.from('task-images').upload(path, file, { contentType: file.type }).then(function(result){
    if(result.error){ showToast('QR upload failed — try again.'); return; }
    adminPaymentQrUrl = sb.storage.from('task-images').getPublicUrl(path).data.publicUrl;
    showToast('QR ready — click Save Payment Settings to apply it.');
  });
};

document.getElementById('adminPaymentQrSaveBtn').onclick = function(){
  var upiId = document.getElementById('adminPaymentUpiId').value.trim();
  if(!adminPaymentQrUrl || !upiId){ showToast('Add both a QR code image and a UPI ID first.'); return; }
  var btn = this;
  btn.disabled = true; btn.textContent = 'Saving...';
  Promise.all([
    sb.from('app_settings').upsert({ key: 'payment_qr_url', value: adminPaymentQrUrl, updated_at: new Date().toISOString() }),
    sb.from('app_settings').upsert({ key: 'payment_upi_id', value: upiId, updated_at: new Date().toISOString() })
  ]).then(function(results){
    btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = 'Save Payment Settings';
    if(results[0].error || results[1].error){ showToast('Could not save — please try again.'); return; }
    showToast('Payment settings updated.');
  });
};
```

```
Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  const corsHeaders = { "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*", "Access-Control-Allow-Headers": "content-type" };
  if (req.method === "OPTIONS") return new Response(null, { headers: corsHeaders });
  try {
    const body = await req.json();
    const purpose = body.purpose || "donation"; // default keeps existing donate.html calls working unchanged

    // Zero-side-effect ping for a keep-warm cron -- returns immediately, touches neither the
    // database nor Razorpay's API. Real bug found and fixed via direct timing: this function was
    // taking 2s+ on a cold start vs 0.5-0.7s warm, and a real user's tap was sometimes the one
    // that woke it up from cold. A periodic ping keeps an instance warm so real requests don't.
    if (purpose === "ping") {
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ warm: true }), { headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" } });
    }


```

```
function findScrollableAncestor(el){
  var node = el.parentElement;
  while(node && node !== document.body){
    var style = window.getComputedStyle(node);
    if((style.overflowY === 'auto' || style.overflowY === 'scroll') && node.scrollHeight > node.clientHeight){
      return node;
    }
    node = node.parentElement;
  }
  return null;
}
function autoGrowTextarea(el){
  if(!el || el.tagName !== 'TEXTAREA') return;
  if(el.offsetParent === null) return; // hidden (e.g. an inactive admin tab) -- scrollHeight would read 0 and lock in a broken height; retried once it's actually shown, see switchAdminDashTab and showOnly
  // Real bug found and fixed: collapsing to height:auto before measuring scrollHeight briefly
  // shrinks the whole scrollable content area on every single keystroke -- and browsers clamp
  // scroll position when content briefly shrinks, which is exactly what "keeps snapping back to
  // the end of the page while typing" looks like. Capturing and restoring the nearest scrollable
  // ancestor's position across the resize means the momentary collapse never has a visible
  // effect, regardless of where the person had scrolled to.
  var scrollParent = findScrollableAncestor(el);
  var savedScrollTop = scrollParent ? scrollParent.scrollTop : null;
  el.style.height = 'auto';
  el.style.height = el.scrollHeight + 'px';
  if(scrollParent && savedScrollTop !== null) scrollParent.scrollTop = savedScrollTop;
}
document.addEventListener('input', function(e){ if(e.target && e.target.tagName === 'TEXTAREA') autoGrowTextarea(e.target); });
```

```
  // Real bug found and fixed: collapsing to height:auto before measuring scrollHeight briefly
```

```
  // position immediately afterward wasn't enough on its own -- confirmed by testing that

  // native "keep the focused caret visible" auto-scroll, not CSS scroll anchoring. That native
  // behavior was firing AFTER our restore in the same reflow cycle, undoing it. Re-applying the
  // restore one animation frame later, after the browser's own adjustment has already happened,
  // makes ours the final word instead of racing it.
  var scrollParent = findScrollableAncestor(el);
  var savedScrollTop = scrollParent ? scrollParent.scrollTop : null;
  el.style.height = 'auto';
  el.style.height = el.scrollHeight + 'px';
  if(scrollParent && savedScrollTop !== null){
    scrollParent.scrollTop = savedScrollTop;
    requestAnimationFrame(function(){ scrollParent.scrollTop = savedScrollTop; });
  }
}
```
